13.7.5: na naśyati kr̥taṁ karma sadā pañcendriyairiha,
te hyasya sākṣiṇo nityaṁ ṣaṣṭha ātmā tathaiva ca ॥5॥
13.7.11: avākśirāstu yo lambedudavāsaṁ ca yo vaset,
satataṁ caikaśāyī yaḥ sa labhetepsitāṁ gatim ॥11॥
13.7.17: striyastriṣavaṇaṁ snātvā vāyuṁ pītvā kratuṁ labhet,
13.7.18: salilāśī bhaved yastu sadāgniḥ saṁskr̥to dvijaḥ,
13.7.20: adhītya sarvavedān vai sadyo duḥkhād vimucyate,
13.7.21: yā dustyajā durmatibhiryā na jīryati jīryataḥ,
yo’sau prāṇāntiko rogastāṁ tr̥ṣṇāṁ tyajataḥ sukham ॥21॥
13.7.23: acodyamānāni yathā puṣpāṇi ca phalāni ca,
svakālaṁ nātivartante tathā karma purā kr̥tam ॥23॥
13.7.24: jīryanti jīryataḥ keśā dantā jīryanti jīryataḥ,
cakṣuḥśrotre ca jīryete tr̥ṣṇaikā na tu jīryate ॥24॥
13.7.25: yena prīṇāti pitaraṁ tena prītaḥ prajāpatiḥ,
prīṇāti mātaraṁ yena pr̥thivī tena pūjitā ॥25॥
13.7.26: yena prīṇātyupādhyāyaṁ tena syād brahma pūjitam,
sarve tasyādr̥tā dharmā yasyaite traya ādr̥tāḥ,
13.7.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate anuśāsanaparvaṇi dānadharmaparvaṇi karmaphalikopākhyāne saptamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥7॥
13.8.1: ke pūjyāḥ ke namaskāryāḥ kān namasyasi bhārata,
13.8.3: spr̥hayāmi dvijātibhyo yeṣāṁ brahma paraṁ dhanam,
13.8.4: udvahanti na sīdanti tebhyo vai spr̥hayāmyaham ॥4॥
13.8.8: ye cāpi teṣāṁ śrotāraḥ sadā sadasi sammatāḥ,
13.8.11: śūrā vīrāśca śataśaḥ santi loke yudhiṣṭhira,
13.8.12: dhanyaḥ syāṁ yadyahaṁ bhūyaḥ saumya brāhmaṇako’pi vā,
13.8.13: na me tvattaḥ priyataro loke’smin pāṇḍunandana,
13.8.14: tena satyena gaccheyaṁ lokān yatra sa śāntanuḥ ॥14॥
13.8.15: na me pituḥ pitā vāpi ye cānye’pi suhr̥jjanāḥ ॥15॥
13.8.16: na hi me vr̥jinaṁ kiñcid vidyate brāhmaṇeṣviha,
aṇu vā yadi vā sthūlaṁ vidyate sādhukarmasu ॥16॥
13.8.17: karmaṇā manasā vāpi vācā vāpi parantapa,
13.8.19: teṣu me tāta gantavyamahnāya ca cirāya ca ॥19॥
13.8.20: yathā bhartrāśrayo dharmaḥ strīṇāṁ loke yudhiṣṭhira,
sa devaḥ sā gatirnānyā kṣatriyasya tathā dvijāḥ ॥20॥
13.8.21: pitāputrau ca vijñeyau tayorhi brāhmaṇo guruḥ ॥21॥
13.8.22: nārī tu patyabhāve vai devaraṁ kurute patim,
13.8.23: putravacca tato rakṣyā upāsyā guruvacca te,
13.8.26: hanyuḥ kruddhā mahārāja brāhmaṇā ye tapasvinaḥ ॥26॥
13.8.28: daṇḍapāṇiryathā goṣu pālo nityaṁ hi rakṣayet,
brāhmaṇān brahma ca tathā kṣatriyaḥ paripālayet ॥28॥
13.9.1: brāhmaṇānāṁ tu ye lokāḥ pratiśrutya pitāmaha,
na prayacchanti mohāt te ke bhavanti mahādyute ॥1॥
13.9.2: etanme tattvato brūhi dharmaṁ dharmabhr̥tāṁ vara,
pratiśrutya durātmāno na prayacchanti ye narāḥ ॥2॥
13.9.3: yo na dadyāt pratiśrutya svalpaṁ vā yadi vā bahu,
13.9.4: yāṁ rātriṁ jāyate jīvo yāṁ rātriṁ ca vinaśyati,
etasminnantare yad yat sukr̥taṁ tasya bhārata ॥4॥
13.9.5: yacca tasya hutaṁ kiñcid dattaṁ vā bharatarṣabha,
13.9.8: śr̥gālasya ca saṁvādaṁ vānarasya ca bhārata ॥8॥
13.9.9: tau sakhāyau purā hyāstāṁ mānuṣatve parantapa,
anyāṁ yoniṁ samāpannau śārgālīṁ vānarīṁ tathā ॥9॥
13.9.11: kiṁ tvayā pāpakaṁ pūrvaṁ kr̥taṁ karma sudāruṇam,
13.9.14: kiṁ tvayā pātakaṁ karma kr̥taṁ yenāsi vānaraḥ ॥14॥
13.9.15: tasmānna brāhmaṇasvaṁ tu hartavyaṁ viduṣā sadā,
samaṁ vivādo moktavyo dātavyaṁ sa pratiśrutam ॥15॥
13.9.16: ityetad bruvato rājan brāhmaṇasya mayā śrutam,
13.9.17: kathāṁ kathayataḥ pūrvaṁ brāhmaṇaṁ prati pāṇḍava ॥17॥
13.9.18: na hartavyaṁ vipradhanaṁ kṣantavyaṁ teṣu nityaśaḥ,
13.9.19: evameva ca māṁ nityaṁ brāhmaṇāḥ sandiśanti vai,
pratiśrutya bhaved deyaṁ nāśā kāryā dvijottame ॥19॥
13.9.21: pradahecca hi taṁ rājan kakṣamakṣayyabhug yathā ॥21॥
13.9.22: sa eva hi yadā tuṣṭo vacasā pratinandati,
13.9.26: brāhmaṇasya hi dattena dhruvaṁ svargo hyanuttamaḥ,
śakyaḥ prāptuṁ viśeṣeṇa dānaṁ hi mahatī kriyā ॥26॥
13.9.28: velāyāṁ na tu kasyāñcid gacched vipro hyapūjitaḥ ॥28॥
13.9.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate anuśāsanaparvaṇi dānadharmaparvaṇi śr̥gālavānarasaṁvāde navamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥9॥
13.10.2: sūkṣmā gatirhi dharmasya yatra muhyanti mānavāḥ ॥2॥
13.10.3: atra te vartayiṣyāmi śr̥ṇu rājan yathākramam,
r̥ṣīṇāṁ vadatāṁ pūrvaṁ śrutamāsīt yathā purā ॥3॥
13.10.11: tatra kaścit samutsāhaṁ kr̥tvā śūdro dayānvitaḥ,
13.10.16: āsyatāṁ yadi te buddhiḥ śuśrūṣānirato bhava ॥16॥
13.10.18: kathamatra mayā kāryaṁ śraddhā dharmaparā ca me ॥18॥
13.10.20: tatra vedīṁ ca bhūmiṁ ca devatāyatanāni ca,
13.10.21: baliṁ ca kr̥tvā hutvā ca devatāṁ cāpyapūjayat ॥21॥
13.10.23: evaṁ hi sumahān kālo vyatyakrāmata tasya vai ॥23॥
13.10.27: atha taṁ tāpasaṁ śūdraḥ so’bravīd bharatarṣabha,
13.10.31: sa ca tat kr̥tavān śūdraḥ sarvaṁ yadr̥ṣirabravīt ॥31॥
13.10.33: r̥ṣiṇā pitr̥kārye ca sa ca dharmapathe sthitaḥ,
pitr̥kārye kr̥te cāpi visr̥ṣṭaḥ sa jagāma ha ॥33॥
13.10.34: atha dīrghasya kālasya sa tapyan śūdratāpasaḥ,
vane pañcatvamagamat sukr̥tena ca tena vai ॥34॥
13.10.36: evaṁ tau tatra sambhūtāvubhau śūdramunī tadā ॥36॥
13.10.38: kalpaprayoge cotpanne jyotiṣe ca paraṁ gataḥ ॥38॥
13.10.39: sāṅkhye caiva parā prītistasya caivaṁ vyavardhata,
13.10.44: atha śūnye purodhāstu saha rājñā samāgataḥ ॥44॥
13.10.47: varāṇāṁ te śataṁ dadyāṁ kiṁ bataikaṁ dvijottama,
snehācca bahumānācca nāstyadeyaṁ hi me tava ॥47॥
13.10.48: ekaṁ vai varamicchāmi yadi tuṣṭo’si pārthiva,
pratijānīhi tāvat tvaṁ satyaṁ yad vada nānr̥tam ॥48॥
13.10.49: yadi jñāsyāmi vakṣyāmi ajānan na tu saṁvade ॥49॥
13.10.50: śāntihomeṣu ca sadā kiṁ tvaṁ hasasi vīkṣya mām ॥50॥
13.10.51: savrīḍaṁ vai bhavati hi mano me hasatā tvayā,
13.10.52: suvyaktaṁ kāraṇaṁ hyatra na te hāsyamakāraṇam,
kautūhalaṁ me subhr̥śaṁ tattvena kathayasva me ॥52॥
13.10.57: br̥syāṁ darbheṣu havye ca kavye ca munisattama,
13.10.58: ahaṁ rājā ca viprendra paśya kālasya paryayam,
13.10.59: etasmāt kāraṇād brahman prahase tvāṁ dvijottama,
na tvāṁ paribhavan brahman prahasāmi gururbhavān ॥59॥
13.10.61: evaṁ tavograṁ hi tapa upadeśena nāśitam,
13.10.62: gr̥hyatāṁ draviṇaṁ vipra pūtātmā bhava sattama ॥62॥
13.10.63: tato visr̥ṣṭo rājñā tu vipro dānānyanekaśaḥ,
brāhmaṇebhyo dadau vittaṁ bhūmiṁ grāmāṁśca sarvaśaḥ ॥63॥
13.10.64: kr̥cchrāṇi cīrtvā ca tato yathoktāni dvijottamaiḥ,
tīrthāni cāpi gatvā vai dānāni vividhāni ca ॥64॥
13.10.65: tameva cāśramaṁ gatvā cacāra vipulaṁ tapaḥ ॥65॥
13.10.66: tataḥ siddhiṁ parāṁ prāpto brāhmaṇo rājasattama,
13.10.67: brāhmaṇena na vaktavyaṁ tasmād varṇāvare jane ॥67॥
13.10.67d1: na ca pravaktavyamiha kiñcid varṇāvare jane.
13.10.68: eteṣu kathayan rājan brāhmaṇo na praduṣyati ॥68॥
13.10.70: duruktasya bhayād rājan nābhāṣante ca kiñcana ॥70॥
13.10.73: satyānr̥tena hi kr̥ta upadeśo hinasti hi ॥73॥
13.10.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate anuśāsanaparvaṇi dānadharmaparvaṇi śūdramunisaṁvāde daśamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥10॥
13.11.1: kīdr̥śe puruṣe tāta strīṣu vā bharatarṣabha,
śrīḥ padmā vasate nityaṁ tanme brūhi pitāmaha ॥1॥
13.11.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate anuśāsanaparvaṇi dānadharmaparvaṇi śrīrukmiṇīsaṁvāde ekādaśo’dhyāyaḥ ॥11॥
13.12.0d2: ye cāpyanye pare tāta kr̥taghnā nirapatrapāḥ,
13.12.0d3: mātāpitr̥gurūṇāṁ ca ye na tiṣṭhanti śāsane.
13.12.0d11: svaṁ rūpaṁ māhiṣaṁ kr̥tvā sumahāntaṁ manoharam,
13.12.0d12: tato mahiṣarūpī sa dharmo dharmabhr̥tāṁ vara.
13.12.0d15: dr̥ṣṭvā ca pr̥thivīṁ sarvāṁ salilena pariplutām,
jalāśayān sa tān dr̥ṣṭvā vipraḥ pramudito’bhavat.
13.12.0d17: ato nu bhadraṁ mahiṣaḥ śilāpaṭṭa iva sthitaḥ,
13.12.0d18: kr̥taghnā narakaṁ yānti ye tu viśvāsaghātinaḥ.
13.12.0d20: kr̥taghnatāṁ ca samprāpya maraṇāntā ca niṣkr̥tiḥ.
13.12.0d25: evaṁ dharmabhr̥taḥ sarve vimr̥śanti tathā kr̥tam,
na sa kaścid vatsanābha yasya nopahataṁ manaḥ.
13.12.5: indro jñātvā tu taṁ yajñaṁ mahābhāgaḥ sureśvaraḥ,
13.12.6: na caivāsyāntaraṁ rājan sa dadarśa mahātmanaḥ,
13.12.10: atha pītodakaṁ so’śvaṁ vr̥kṣe baddhvā nr̥pottamaḥ,
13.12.12: ārohiṣye kathaṁ tvaśvaṁ kathaṁ yāsyāmi vai puram,
13.12.13: jātaṁ mahābalānāṁ me tān pravakṣyāmi kiṁ tvaham,
13.12.14: mr̥dutvaṁ ca tanutvaṁ ca viklavatvaṁ tathaiva ca,
13.12.15: vyāyāme karkaśatvaṁ ca vīryaṁ ca puruṣe guṇāḥ,
pauruṣaṁ vipraṇaṣṭaṁ vai strītvaṁ kenāpi me’bhavat ॥15॥
13.12.18: kintvidaṁ tviti vijñāya vismayaṁ paramaṁ gatāḥ,
athovāca sa rājarṣiḥ strībhūto vadatāṁ varaḥ ॥18॥
13.12.22: samprītyā bhujyatāṁ rājyaṁ vanaṁ yāsyāmi putrakāḥ ॥22॥
13.12.23: gatvā caivāśramaṁ sā tu tāpasaṁ pratyapadyata ॥23॥
13.12.25: puruṣatve sutā yūyaṁ strītve ceme śataṁ sutāḥ,
13.12.28: bhedayāmāsa tān gatvā nagaraṁ vai nr̥pātmajān ॥28॥
13.12.29: bhrātr̥̄ṇāṁ nāsti saubhrātraṁ yeṣvekasya pituḥ sutāḥ,
13.12.32: tacchrutvā tāpasī cāpi santaptā praruroda ha,
13.12.33: kena duḥkhena santaptā rodiṣi tvaṁ varānane,
brāhmaṇaṁ taṁ tato dr̥ṣṭvā sā strī karuṇamabravīt ॥33॥
13.12.34: putrāṇāṁ dve śate brahman kālena vinipātite,
ahaṁ rājābhavaṁ vipra tatra pūrvaṁ śataṁ mama ॥34॥
13.12.36: putrān rājye pratiṣṭhāpya vanamasmi tato gataḥ ॥36॥
13.12.37: āśrame janitaṁ brahman nītaṁ tannagaraṁ mayā ॥37॥
13.12.38: teṣāṁ ca vairamutpannaṁ kālayogena vai dvija,
13.12.39: indrastāṁ duḥkhitāṁ dr̥ṣṭvā abravīt paruṣaṁ vacaḥ,
purā suduḥsahaṁ bhadre mama duḥkhaṁ tvayā kr̥tam ॥39॥
13.12.40: indro’hamasmi durbuddhe vairaṁ te pātitaṁ mayā ॥40॥
13.12.41: indraṁ dr̥ṣṭvā tu rājarṣiḥ pādayoḥ śirasā gataḥ,
13.12.43: putrāste katame rājan jīvantvetat pracakṣva me,
strībhūtasya hi ye jātāḥ puruṣasyātha ye’bhavan ॥43॥
13.12.44: strībhūtasya hi ye putrāste me jīvantu vāsava ॥44॥
13.12.45: indrastu vismito dr̥ṣṭvā striyaṁ papraccha tāṁ punaḥ,
puruṣotpāditā ye te kathaṁ dveṣyāḥ sutāstava ॥45॥
13.12.46: strībhūtasya hi ye jātāḥ snehastebhyo’dhikaḥ katham,
13.12.47: striyāstvabhyadhikaḥ sneho na tathā puruṣasya vai,
tasmāt te śakra jīvantu ye jātāḥ strīkr̥tasya vai ॥47॥
13.12.49: varaṁ ca vr̥ṇu rājendra yaṁ tvamicchasi suvrata,
13.12.50: strītvameva vr̥ṇe śakra puṁstvaṁ necchāmi vāsava,
13.12.51: puruṣatvaṁ kathaṁ tyaktvā strītvaṁ codayase vibho,
13.12.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate anuśāsanaparvaṇi dānadharmaparvaṇi bhaṅgāsvanopākhyāne dvādaśo’dhyāyaḥ ॥12॥
13.13.1: kathaṁ vai lokayātrāṁ tu kiṁśīlaśca samācaret ॥1॥
13.13.2: kāyena trividhaṁ karma vācā cāpi caturvidham,
13.13.6d4: vaikuṇṭhaṁ śaraṇaṁ devaṁ pratipede ca taiḥ saha.
13.13.6d12: pavitrāṇāṁ pavitraṁ ca maṅgalānāṁ ca maṅgalam,
13.13.6d14: jeṣyadhvaṁ dānavān yūyaṁ mayaiva saha saṅgare.
13.13.6d15: tato devagaṇānāṁ ca dānavānāṁ ca yudhyatām,
13.13.6d23: na hyenaṁ veda tattvena bhuvanaṁ bhuvaneśvaram,
saṅkhyātuṁ naiva cātmānaṁ nirguṇaṁ guṇināṁ varam.
13.13.6d26: teṣāṁ kathayatāṁ tatra kathānte patatāṁ varaḥ,
13.13.6d30: kautūhalaṁ vainateya paraṁ no hr̥di vartate,
13.13.6d31: kiṁ mayā brūta vaktavyaṁ kāryaṁ ca vadatāṁ varāḥ.
13.13.6d32: yūyaṁ hi māṁ yathāyuktaṁ sarve vai deṣṭumarhatha,
13.13.6d34: etad bhavantaṁ pr̥cchāmo devo’yaṁ kva kr̥tālayaḥ.
13.13.6d35: tvaṁ priyaścāsya bhaktaśca nānyaḥ kāśyapa vidyate.
13.13.6d37: vedeṣvapi ca viśvātmā gīyate na ca vidmahe,
13.13.6d40: jāyante tāta tasmāddhi tiṣṭhate teṣvasau vibhuḥ,
13.13.6d41: tasya devasya tattvena tannaḥ śaṁsa yathātatham,
13.13.6d42: mayā tu mahadāścaryaṁ purā dr̥ṣṭaṁ sanātane,
13.13.6d43: na sma śakyo mayā vettuṁ na bhavadbhiḥ kathañcana.
13.13.6d44: yathā māṁ prāha bhagavāṁstathā tacchrūyatāṁ mama,
13.13.6d46: avr̥thā te’stu madvākyaṁ brūhi kiṁ karavāṇi te.
13.13.6d47: jñātumicchāmi kastvaṁ hi tato me dāsyase varam.
13.13.6d48: uvāca varadaḥ prītaḥ kāle tvaṁ mābhivetsyasi.
13.13.6d49: vāhanaṁ bhava me sādhu varaṁ dadmi tavottamam,
na te vīryeṇa sadr̥śaḥ kaścilloke bhaviṣyati.
13.13.6d50: pataṅga patatāṁ śreṣṭha na devo nāpi dānavaḥ,
13.13.6d52: vāhanaṁ te bhaviṣyāmi yathā vadati māṁ bhavān.
13.13.6d56: sa muhūrtamiva dhyātvā māmāha vadatāṁ varaḥ.
13.13.6d61: samāsādya tu taṁ viśvamahaṁ mūrdhnā praṇamya ca,
13.13.6d68: tatastatra hariṁ dr̥ṣṭvā jagataḥ prabhavaṁ vibhum,
13.13.6d71: ahaṁ tu tattvajijñāsuḥ ko’si kasyāsi kutra vā,
samprāptaḥ padavīṁ deva sa māṁ santrātumarhasi.
13.13.6d72: mama tvaṁ viditaḥ saumya yathāvat tattvadarśane,
jñāpitaścāpi yat pitrā taccāpi viditaṁ mahat.
13.13.6d73: vainateya na kasyāpi ahaṁ vaidyaḥ kathañcana,
māṁ hi vindanti vidvāṁso ye jñāne pariniṣṭhitāḥ.
13.13.6d75: sthūlaṁ māṁ vetsyase tasmājjagataḥ kāraṇe sthitam,
13.13.6d78: atha devaḥ samāsādya manasaḥ sadr̥śaṁ javam,
13.13.6d82: viveśa devaḥ svāṁ yoniṁ māmidaṁ cābhyabhāṣata,
tataśca prāviśaṁ tatra saha tena mahātmanā,
13.13.6d85: athāhaṁ varadaṁ devaṁ nāpaśyaṁ tatra saṅgatam,
13.13.6d101: acyutāya tuṣārāya vīrāya ca samāya ca.
13.13.6d106: r̥ce ca yajuṣe sāmne trailokyapataye namaḥ.
13.13.6d114: stavyaṁ stavaṁ stutavatastat tamo me praṇaśyata,
mā bhairgarutman dānto’si punaḥ sendrān divaukasaḥ.
13.13.6d115: svaṁ caiva bhavanaṁ gatvā drakṣyase putrabāndhavān,
13.13.6d118: yuktān siddhān naiṣṭhikāṁśca japato yajato gr̥hīn.
13.13.6d125: yadi jānāsi māṁ bhaktaṁ yadi vānugraho mayi,
13.13.6d128: kāni tānyagnihotrāṇi keṣāṁ śabdaḥ śruto mayā,
13.13.6d130: māṁ na devā na gandharvā na piśācā na rākṣasāḥ,
13.13.6d132: mano buddhiśca tejaśca tamaḥ sattvaṁ rajastathā.
13.13.6d134: dharmayuktaṁ ca puṇyaṁ ca so’hamasmi nirāmayaḥ.
13.13.6d136: yat tu me paramaṁ guhyaṁ rūpaṁ sūkṣmārthadarśibhiḥ,
13.13.6d137: yat tu me paramaṁ guhyaṁ yena vyāptamidaṁ jagat,
13.13.6d139: yo māṁ yathā vedayati tasya tasyāsmi kāśyapa,
13.13.6d140: māṁ tu jñātuṁ kr̥tā buddhirbhavatā pakṣisattama,
13.13.6d144: ya evaṁ buddhayo dhīrāste māṁ gacchanti tādr̥śāḥ.
13.13.6d147: yat tad viyati dr̥ṣṭaṁ tat saraḥ padmotpalāyutam,
13.13.6d152: madbhaktāḥ satataṁ te vai bhaktastānapi cāpyaham,
13.13.6d157: mayā sarvamidaṁ vyāptaṁ mayi sarvaṁ pratiṣṭhitam.
13.13.6d159: teṣāmahaṁ tapo dīptaṁ tejaḥ samyak samāhitam,
nityaṁ te mayi vartante teṣu cāhamatandritaḥ.
13.13.6d163: teṣveva ca samādhāya samyageti sa māmajam,
13.13.6d167: āsādayati tad brahma yatra gatvā na śocati,
13.13.6d168: madbhaktyā ca dvijaśreṣṭhā gacchanti paramāṁ gatim,
yad guhyaṁ paramaṁ buddheraliṅgagrahaṇaṁ ca yat.
13.13.6d169: na vāyuḥ pavate tatra na tasmin jyotiṣāṁ gatiḥ.
13.13.6d170: na cāpaḥ pr̥thivī naiva nākāśaṁ na manogatiḥ,
13.13.6d172: etat sūkṣmasya ca dvāraṁ kāryāṇāṁ kāraṇaṁ tvaham,
13.13.6d174: vaktā mantā rasayitā ghrātā draṣṭā pradarśakaḥ,
boddhā boddhayitā cāhaṁ gantā śrotā cidātmakaḥ.
13.13.6d176: ahaṁ tejo dvijātīnāṁ mama tejo dvijātayaḥ,
13.13.6d178: dharmamarthaṁ ca kāmaṁ ca mokṣaṁ caivārjavaṁ japam,
tamaḥ sattvaṁ rajaścaiva karmajaṁ ca bhavāpyayam.
13.13.6d180: mama yat paramaṁ guhyo śāśvataṁ dhruvamavyayam,
tadevaṁ paramo guhyo devo nārāyaṇo hariḥ.
13.13.6d182: gacchanti taṁ mahātmānaṁ paraṁ brahma sanātanam,
13.13.6d184: madbhakto bhava nityaṁ tvaṁ tato vetsyasi me padam,
13.13.6d185: etacchreyaḥ paraṁ caitat panthānaṁ viddhi mokṣiṇām,
13.13.6d187: etad vaḥ sarvamākhyātaṁ ceṣṭitaṁ tasya dhīmataḥ.
13.13.6d190: ya imāṁ śrāvayed vidvān kathāṁ parvasu parvasu.
13.13.6d191: śrāddhakāle ca viprāṇāṁ ya imāṁ śrāvayecchuciḥ.
13.13.6d192: na tatra rakṣasāṁ bhāgo nāsurāṇāṁ ca vidyate,
13.13.6d193: yaḥ paṭhet satataṁ yuktaḥ sa vrajet tatsalokatām,
vedān pārayate vipro rājā vijayavān bhavet.
13.13.6d198: dhyāyanto manasā viṣṇuṁ gacchanti paramāṁ gatim.
13.13.6d199: tadeva paramo mokṣo mokṣadvāraṁ ca bhārata,
13.13.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate anuśāsanaparvaṇi dānadharmaparvaṇi lokayātrākathane trayodaśo’dhyāyaḥ ॥13॥
13.14.3: yo hi sarvagato devo na ca sarvatra dr̥śyate ॥3॥
13.14.4: brahmādayaḥ piśācāntā yaṁ hi devā upāsate ॥4॥
13.14.5: prakr̥tīnāṁ paratvena puruṣasya ca yaḥ paraḥ,
akṣaraṁ paramaṁ brahma asacca sadasacca yaḥ ॥5॥
13.14.7: ko hi śakto guṇān vaktuṁ devadevasya dhīmataḥ,
13.14.8: ko hi śakto bhavaṁ jñātuṁ madvidhaḥ parameśvaram,
13.14.10: rudrabhaktyā tu kr̥ṣṇena jagad vyāptaṁ mahātmanā,
taṁ prasādya tadā devaṁ badaryāṁ kila bhārata ॥10॥
13.14.11: arthāt priyataratvaṁ ca sarvalokeṣu vai tadā,
13.14.13: yuge yuge tu kr̥ṣṇena toṣito vai maheśvaraḥ,
13.14.15: yasmāt parataraṁ caiva nānyaṁ paśyāmi bhārata,
13.14.16: vibhūtiṁ caiva kārtsnyena satyāṁ māheśvarīṁ nr̥pa ॥16॥
13.14.22: na gatiḥ karmaṇāṁ śakyā velumīśasya tattvataḥ,
13.14.23: sa kathaṁ naramātreṇa śakyo jñātuṁ satāṁ gatiḥ ॥23॥
13.14.27: yadavāptaṁ ca me pūrvaṁ sāmbahetoḥ suduṣkaram,
yathāvad bhagavān dr̥ṣṭo mayā pūrvaṁ samādhinā ॥27॥
13.14.31: na hi te’prāpyamastīha triṣu lokeṣu kiñcana,
13.14.34: yathā te janitāḥ putrā rukmiṇyāṁ cāruvikramāḥ,
13.14.35: anujānīhi māṁ rājñi kariṣye vacanaṁ tava ॥35॥
13.14.36: sā ca māmabravīd gaccha śivāya vijayāya ca,
brahmā śivaḥ kāśyapaśca nadyo devā mano’nugāḥ ॥36॥
13.14.40: rakṣantu sarvatra gataṁ tvāṁ yādava sukhāya ca,
13.14.66: yaḥ pūjyaḥ pūjayasi māṁ draṣṭavyo draṣṭumicchasi ॥66॥
13.14.70: tapasā brahmacaryeṇa satyena ca damena ca ॥70॥
13.14.71: tejasāṁ tapasāṁ caiva nidhiḥ sa bhagavāniha ॥71॥
13.14.72: āste devyā sadācintyo yaṁ prārthayasi śatruhan ॥72॥
13.14.75: viṣṇoścakraṁ ca tad ghoraṁ vajramākhaṇḍalasya ca,
13.14.76: yat tad bhagavatā pūrvaṁ dattaṁ cakraṁ tavānagha,
13.14.78: sudarśanaṁ bhavatyevaṁ bhavenoktaṁ tadā tu tat ॥78॥
13.14.79: sudarśanaṁ tadā tasya loke nāma pratiṣṭhitam,
13.14.84: kuśadvīpaṁ ca sa dadau rājyena bhagavānajaḥ,
tathā śatamukho nāma dhātrā sr̥ṣṭo mahāsuraḥ ॥84॥
13.14.85: taṁ prāha bhagavāṁstuṣṭaḥ kiṁ karomīti śaṅkaraḥ ॥85॥
13.14.86: taṁ vai śatamukhaḥ prāha yogo bhavatu me’dbhutaḥ,
balaṁ ca daivataśreṣṭha śāśvataṁ samprayaccha me ॥86॥
13.14.87: tatheti bhagavānāha tasya tad vacanaṁ prabhuḥ,
13.14.89: yogeśvaraṁ devagītaṁ vettha kr̥ṣṇa na saṁśayaḥ,
13.14.95: nāhaṁ tasya munerbhūyo vaśagā syāṁ kathañcana ॥95॥
13.14.98: vinā bhartrā ca rudreṇa bhaviṣyati na saṁśayaḥ,
vaṁśe tavaiva nāmnā tu khyātiṁ yāsyati cepsitām ॥98॥
13.14.101: vatsākṣayā ca te kīrtistrailokye vai bhaviṣyati ॥101॥
13.14.104: tamāha bhagavān rudraḥ sākṣāt tuṣṭo’smi te’nagha,
13.14.105: śakreṇa tu purā devo vārāṇasyāṁ janārdana,
13.14.106: nāradena tu bhaktyāsau bhava ārādhitaḥ purā ॥106॥
13.14.107: tejasā tapasā kīrtyā tvatsamo na bhaviṣyati ॥107॥
13.14.108: mayāpi ca yathā dr̥ṣṭo devadevaḥ purā vibho ॥108॥
13.14.109: yadarthaṁ ca mayā devaḥ prayatena tathā vibho ॥109॥
13.14.113: kasyacit tvatha kālasya dhaumyena saha mādhava,
13.14.114: tatrāpi ca mayā dr̥ṣṭā duhyamānā payasvinī,
lakṣitaṁ ca mayā kṣīraṁ svāduto hyamr̥topamam ॥114॥
13.14.116: tataḥ piṣṭaṁ samāloḍya toyena saha mādhava ॥116॥
13.14.117: atha gavyaṁ payastāta kadācit prāśitaṁ mayā ॥117॥
13.14.118: pitrāhaṁ yajñakāle hi nīto jñātikulaṁ mahat,
tatra sā kṣarate devī divyā gauḥ suranandinī ॥118॥
13.14.119: tasyāhaṁ tat payaḥ pītvā rasena hyamr̥topamam,
13.14.120: sa ca piṣṭarasastāta na me prītimupāvahat,
13.14.121: nedaṁ kṣīrodanaṁ mātaryat tvaṁ me dattavatyasi,
13.14.126: tapasā japyanityānāṁ śivo naḥ paramā gatiḥ ॥126॥
13.14.127: kutaḥ kṣīrodanaṁ vatsa sukhāni vasanāni ca ॥127॥
13.14.128: taṁ prapadya sadā vatsa sarvabhāvena śaṅkaram,
13.14.130: ko’yamamba mahādevaḥ sa kathaṁ ca prasīdati,
kutra vā vasate devo draṣṭavyo vā kathañcana ॥130॥
13.14.131: tuṣyate vā kathaṁ śarvo rūpaṁ tasya ca kīdr̥śam,
kathaṁ jñeyaḥ prasanno vā darśayejjanani mama ॥131॥
13.14.132: evamuktā tadā kr̥ṣṇa mātā me sutavatsalā,
13.14.133: pramārjantī ca gātrāṇi mama vai madhusūdana,
13.14.136: ko hi tattvena tad veda īśasya caritaṁ śubham,
kr̥tavān yāni rūpāṇi devadevaḥ purā kila,
krīḍate ca tathā śarvaḥ prasīdati yathā ca vai ॥136॥
13.14.139: tāni te kīrtayiṣyāmi yanmāṁ tvaṁ paripr̥cchasi ॥139॥
13.14.146: karoti vā sa rūpāṇi dhārayatyapi parvatam,
13.14.148: daṇḍī chatrī ca kuṇḍī ca dvijānāṁ dhāraṇastathā,
13.14.153: yo hi yaṁ kāmayet kāmaṁ yasminnarthe’rcyate punaḥ,
tat sarvaṁ vetti deveśastaṁ prapadya yadīcchasi ॥153॥
13.14.156: hasate gāyate caiva nr̥tyate ca manoharam,
13.14.158: jāgarti caiva svapiti jr̥mbhate ca yathāsukham ॥158॥
13.14.159: japate japyate caiva tapate tapyate punaḥ,
13.14.160: dr̥śyate dr̥śyate cāpi bālo vr̥ddho yuvā tathā ॥160॥
13.14.164: hr̥di prāṇo mano jīvo yogātmā yogasañjñitaḥ,
13.14.166: bhaja putra mahādevaṁ tataḥ prāpsyasi cepsitam ॥166॥
13.14.171: ekabhakta iti jñātvā jijñāsāṁ kurute tadā ॥171॥
13.14.176: varaṁ vr̥ṇīṣva mattastvaṁ yat te manasi vartate ॥176॥
13.14.177: śakrasya tu vacaḥ śrutvā nāhaṁ prītamanābhavam,
13.14.178: nāhaṁ tvatto varaṁ kāṅkṣe nānyasmādapi daivatāt,
13.14.179: satyaṁ satyaṁ hi naḥ śakra vākyametat suniścitam,
na yanmaheśvaraṁ muktvā kathānyā mama rocate ॥179॥
13.14.185: divasaṁ divasārdhaṁ vā muhūrtaṁ vā kṣaṇaṁ lavam,
13.14.186: api kīṭaḥ pataṅgo vā bhaveyaṁ śaṅkarājñayā,
na tu śakra tvayā dattaṁ trailokyamapi kāmaye ॥186॥
13.14.187: bhavāmi sa hi naḥ paraḥ kāmaḥ,
13.14.194: ātmānaṁ paramaṁ yasmād varaṁ tasmād vr̥ṇīmahe ॥194॥
13.14.196: yaṁ jñātvā nānuśocanti varaṁ tasmād vr̥ṇīmahe ॥196॥
13.14.201: agnirāpo’nilaḥ pr̥thvī khaṁ buddhiśca mano mahān,
sraṣṭā caiṣāṁ bhaved yo’nyo brūhi kaḥ parameśvarāt ॥201॥
13.14.202: brūhi caiṣāṁ bhavecchakra ko’nyo’sti paramaṁ śivāt ॥202॥
13.14.203: ārādhya sa tu deveśamaśnute mahatīṁ śriyam ॥203॥
13.14.204: vidyate vai mahādevād brūhi kaḥ parameśvarāt ॥204॥
13.14.205: ko’nyaḥ śaknoti deveśād diteḥ sampādituṁ sutān ॥205॥
13.14.206: viddhi tvete mahādevād brūhi kaḥ parameśvarāt ॥206॥
13.14.212: yadi devāḥ surāḥ śakra paśyantyanyāṁ bhavād gatim ॥212॥
13.14.213: kiṁ na gacchanti śaraṇaṁ marditāścāsuraiḥ surāḥ,
13.14.216: kasya vānyasya retastad yena haimo giriḥ kr̥taḥ ॥216॥
13.14.217: kasya cārdhe sthitā kāntā anaṅgaḥ kena nirjitaḥ ॥217॥
13.14.218: brūhīndra paramaṁ sthānaṁ kasya devaiḥ praśasyate,
śmaśāne kasya krīḍārthaṁ nr̥tte vā ko’bhibhāṣyate ॥218॥
13.14.219: kasyaiśvaryaṁ samānaṁ ca bhūtaiḥ ko vāpi krīḍate,
13.14.220: varṣate tapate ko’nyo jvalate tejasā ca kaḥ ॥220॥
13.14.221: prakāmaṁ krīḍate ko vā trailokye sacarācare ॥221॥
13.14.226: dharmādharmau yataḥ śakra tamahaṁ kāraṇaṁ bruve ॥226॥
13.14.228: nāsti ceśāt paraṁ śakra taṁ prapadya yadīcchasi ॥228॥
13.14.229: pratyakṣaṁ nanu te sureśa viditaṁ saṁyogaliṅgodbhavaṁ
kāmārthī varayāmi saṁyatamanā mokṣāya sadyaḥ śivam ॥229॥
13.14.231: arcyate’rcitapūrvaṁ vā brūhi yadyasti te śrutiḥ ॥231॥
13.14.232: yasya brahmā ca viṣṇuśca tvaṁ cāpi saha devataiḥ,
arcayadhvaṁ sadā liṅgaṁ tasmāt śreṣṭhatamo hi saḥ ॥232॥
13.14.233: na padmāṅkā na cakrāṅkā na vajrāṅkā yataḥ prajāḥ,
liṅgāṅkā ca bhagāṅkā ca tasmānmāheśvarī prajā ॥233॥
13.14.235: dvābhyāṁ tanubhyāṁ vyāptaṁ hi carācaramidaṁ jagat ॥235॥
13.14.236: tasmād varamahaṁ kāṅkṣe nidhanaṁ vāpi kauśika,
gaccha vā tiṣṭha vā śakra yatheṣṭaṁ balasūdana ॥236॥
13.14.237: kāmameṣa varo me’stu śāpo vātha maheśvarāt,
13.14.238: na prasīdati me devaḥ kimetaditi cintayan ॥238॥
13.14.247: tejasā tu tadā vyāptaṁ durnirīkṣyaṁ samantataḥ ॥247॥
13.14.248: muhūrtamiva tat tejo vyāpya sarvā diśo daśa ॥248॥
13.14.262: yena tat tripuraṁ dagdhvā kṣaṇād bhasmīkr̥taṁ purā,
13.14.263: nirdaheta ca yat kr̥tsnaṁ trailokyaṁ sacarācaram,
13.14.266: dārayed yāṁ mahīṁ kr̥tsnāṁ śoṣayed vā mahodadhim,
saṁhared vā jagat kr̥tsnaṁ visr̥ṣṭaṁ śūlapāṇinā ॥266॥
13.14.267: yauvanāśvo hato yena māndhātā sabalaḥ purā,
13.14.285: teṣāṁ madhyagato devo rarāja bhagavān śivaḥ ॥285॥
13.14.294: namaḥ pavanavegāya namo devāya vai namaḥ,
13.14.315: namo bhavāya śarvāya viśvarūpāya vai namaḥ ॥315॥
13.14.316: namo viśvāya māyāya cintyācintyāya vai namaḥ ॥316॥
13.14.317: tvaṁ no gatiśca śreṣṭhaśca tvameva hr̥dayaṁ tathā,
13.14.318: ātmā ca sarvabhūtānāṁ sāṅkhye puruṣa ucyate,
13.14.325: kṣīrodaḥ sāgarāṇāṁ ca śailānāṁ himavān giriḥ,
13.14.326: ādistvamasi lokānāṁ saṁhartā kāla eva ca,
yaccānyadapi loke vai sarva tejo’dhikaṁ smr̥tam ॥326॥
13.14.327: tat sarvaṁ bhagavāneva iti me niścitā matiḥ,
13.14.328: prasīda mama bhaktasya dīnasya kr̥paṇasya ca ॥328॥
13.14.330: madbhakta iti deveśa tat sarvaṁ kṣantumarhasi,
13.14.331: nārghyaṁ te na mayā dattaṁ pādyaṁ cāpi maheśvara,
13.14.333: puṣpavr̥ṣṭiḥ śubhā tāta papāta mama mūrdhani,
vavau ca mārutaḥ puṇyaḥ śucigandhaḥ sukhāvahaḥ ॥333॥
13.14.340: anayā caiva bhaktyā te atyarthaṁ prītimānaham,
13.14.342: abruvaṁ ca tadā devaṁ harṣagadgadayā girā,
jānubhyāmavanīṁ gatvā praṇamya ca punaḥ punaḥ ॥342॥
13.14.343: adya jāto hyahaṁ deva saphaṁla janma cādya me,
13.14.344: yaṁ na paśyanti caivāddhā devā hyamitavikramam,
tamahaṁ dr̥ṣṭavān devaṁ ko’nyo dhanyataro mayā ॥344॥
13.14.345: evaṁ dhyāyanti vidvāṁsaḥ paraṁ tattvaṁ sanātanam,
13.14.348: sa rudraḥ saṁharan kr̥tsnaṁ jagat sthāvarajaṅgamam ॥348॥
13.14.350: eṣa devo mahādevo jagat sr̥ṣṭvā carācaram,
13.14.352: yadi deyo varo mahyaṁ yadi tuṣṭo’si me prabho,
bhaktirbhavatu me nityaṁ tvayi deva sureśvara ॥352॥
13.14.353: atītānāgataṁ caiva vartamānaṁ ca yad vibho,
13.14.354: āśrame ca sadāsmākaṁ sāṁnidhyaṁ paramastu te ॥354॥
13.14.359: tatra te bhavitā kāmaṁ sāṁnidhyaṁ payaso nidheḥ,
13.14.360: akṣayā bāndhavāścaiva kulaṁ gotraṁ ca te sadā ॥360॥
13.14.362: tiṣṭha vatsa yathākāmaṁ notkaṇṭhāṁ ca kariṣyasi,
13.14.364: evaṁ dr̥ṣṭo mayā kr̥ṣṇa devadevaḥ samādhinā,
tadavāptaṁ ca me sarvaṁ yaduktaṁ tena dhīmatā ॥364॥
13.14.365: pratyakṣaṁ caiva te kr̥ṣṇa paśya siddhān vyavasthitān,
13.14.368: vismayaṁ paramaṁ gatvā abruvaṁ taṁ mahāmunim ॥368॥
13.14.370: api tāvanmamāpyevaṁ dadyāt sa bhagavān śivaḥ,
13.14.374: viditaṁ me mahābāho prasādāt tasya dhīmataḥ ॥374॥
13.14.375: kasmāt prasādaṁ bhagavān na kuryāt tava mādhava ॥375॥
13.14.377: japyaṁ tu te pradāsyāmi yena drakṣyasi śaṅkaram,
13.14.380: daṇḍī muṇḍī kuśī cīrī ghr̥tākto mekhalī kr̥taḥ,
13.14.381: tr̥tīyaṁ ca caturthaṁ ca pañcamaṁ cānilāśanaḥ,
13.14.384: tatra sthitaśca bhagavān devyā saha mahādyutiḥ,
tapasā tejasā kāntyā dīptayā saha bhāryayā ॥384॥
13.14.397: bhr̥gurdakṣaḥ kaśyapaśca vasiṣṭhaḥ kāśya eva ca ॥397॥
13.14.398: chandāṁsi dīkṣā yajñāśca dakṣiṇāḥ pāvako haviḥ,
13.14.399: prajānāṁ pālakāḥ sarve saritaḥ pannagā nagāḥ,
13.14.400: namasyanti prabhuṁ śāntaṁ parvatāḥ sāgarā diśaḥ ॥400॥
13.14.402: sarvāṇi caiva bhūtāni sthāvarāṇi carāṇi ca,
13.14.403: purastād dhiṣṭhitaṁ dr̥ṣṭvā mameśānaṁ ca bhārata ॥403॥
13.14.404: īkṣituṁ ca mahādevaṁ na me śaktirabhūt tadā ॥404॥
13.14.405: tato māmabravīd devaḥ paśya kr̥ṣṇa vadasva ca,
13.14.406: tvatsamo nāsti me kaścit triṣu lokeṣu vai priyaḥ,
śirasā vandite deve devī prītā hyumā tadā,
13.14.408: tvaṁ vai brahmā ca rudraśca varuṇo’gnirmanurbhavaḥ,
dhātā tvaṣṭā vidhātā ca tvaṁ prabhuḥ sarvatomukhaḥ ॥408॥
13.14.409: tvatto jātāni bhūtāni sthāvarāṇi carāṇi ca,
13.14.411: vedāśca yajñāḥ somaśca dakṣiṇā pāvako haviḥ,
13.14.412: iṣṭaṁ dattamadhītaṁ ca vratāni niyamāśca ye,
13.14.413: kāmaḥ krodho bhayaṁ lobho madaḥ stambho’tha matsaraḥ,
13.14.417: tvāṁ buddhvā brāhmaṇo vedāt pramohaṁ viniyacchati ॥417॥
13.14.420: tvaṁ vai prabhārciḥ puruṣaḥ sarvasya hr̥di saṁśritaḥ,
13.14.423: viditvā sapta sūkṣmāṇi paḍaṅgaṁ tvāṁ ca mūrtitaḥ,
13.14.426: mama mūrdhni ca divyānāṁ kusumānāṁ sugandhinām,
rāśayo nipatanti sma vāyuśca susukho vavau ॥426॥
13.14.427: nirīkṣya bhagavān devīṁ hyumāṁ māṁ ca jagaddhitaḥ,
13.14.428: viduḥ kr̥ṣṇa parāṁ bhaktimasmāsu tava śatruhan,
kriyatāmātmanaḥ śreyaḥ prītirhi tvayi me parā ॥428॥
13.14.429: vr̥ṇīṣvāṣṭau varān kr̥ṣṇa dātāsmi tava sattama,
13.14.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate anuśāsanaparvaṇi dānadharmaparvaṇi meghavāhanaparvākhyāne caturdaśo’dhyāyaḥ ॥14॥
13.15.3: tato māṁ jagato mātā dhāriṇī sarvapāvanī ॥3॥
13.15.4: datto bhagavatā putraḥ sāmbo nāma tavānagha ॥4॥
13.15.5: matto’pyaṣṭau varāniṣṭān gr̥hāṇa tvaṁ dadāmi te,
praṇamya śirasā sā ca mayoktā pāṇḍunandana ॥5॥
13.15.9: evaṁ dattvā varān devo mama devī ca bhārata,
13.15.10: namaskr̥tvā tu sa prāha devadevāya suvrata ॥10॥
13.15.11: nāsti śarvasamo devo nāsti śarvasamā gatiḥ,
nāsti śarvasamo dāne nāsti śarvasamo raṇe ॥11॥
13.15.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate anuśāsanaparvaṇi dānadharmaparvaṇi meghavāhanaparvākhyāne pañcadaśo’dhyāyaḥ ॥15॥
13.16.4: yaṁ paṭhanti sadā sāṅkhyāścintayanti ca yoginaḥ,
13.16.5: utpattau ca vināśe ca kāraṇaṁ yaṁ vidurbudhāḥ,
13.16.7: evaṁ bruvanneva tadā dadarśa tapasāṁ nidhim,
13.16.11d1: tapasyugre sthito bhūtvā dr̥ṣṭvā tuṣṭāva ceśvaram.
13.16.14: bhūrikalyāṇada vibho paraṁ satyaṁ namo’stu te,
13.16.16: na vidustvāṁ tu tattvena kuto vetsyāmahe vayam,
tvattaḥ pravartate sarvaṁ tvayi sarvaṁ pratiṣṭhitam ॥16॥
13.16.20: dvāraṁ tu svargamokṣāṇāmākṣeptā tvaṁ dadāsi ca ॥20॥
13.16.21: tvaṁ vai svargaśca mokṣaśca kāmaḥ krodhastvameva ca,
13.16.22: brahmā bhavaśca viṣṇuśca skandendrau savitā yamaḥ,
13.16.23: karma satyānr̥te cobhe tvamevāsti ca nāsti ca ॥23॥
13.16.25: yaccaitat paramaṁ brahma yacca tat paramaṁ padam,
yā gatiḥ sāṅkhyayogānāṁ sa bhavān nātra saṁśayaḥ ॥25॥
13.16.26: nūnamadya kr̥tārthāḥ sma nūnaṁ prāptāḥ satāṁ gatim,
13.16.27: yanna vidmaḥ paraṁ devaṁ śāśvataṁ yaṁ vidurbudhāḥ ॥27॥
13.16.30: sa eṣa bhagavān devaḥ sarvakr̥t sarvatomukhaḥ,
13.16.31: prāṇakr̥t prāṇabhr̥t prāṇī prāṇadaḥ prāṇināṁ gatiḥ ॥31॥
13.16.36: ayaṁ sa satyakāmānāṁ satyalokaḥ paraṁ satām,
13.16.40: yaṁ jñātvā na punarjanma maraṇaṁ cāpi vidyate,
yaṁ viditvā paraṁ vedyaṁ veditavyaṁ na vidyate ॥40॥
13.16.41: yaṁ labdhvā paramaṁ lābhaṁ nādhikaṁ manyate budhaḥ,
13.16.43: yaṁ ca vedavido vedyaṁ vedānte ca pratiṣṭhitam,
prāṇāyāmaparā nityaṁ yaṁ viśanti japanti ca ॥43॥
13.16.49: r̥taṁ satyaṁ paraṁ brahma stuvantyātharvaṇā dvijāḥ,
yajñasya paramā yoniḥ patiścāyaṁ paraḥ smr̥taḥ ॥49॥
13.16.52: dhruvaḥ saptarṣayaścaiva bhuvanāḥ sapta eva ca ॥52॥
13.16.54: asya devasya yad bhāgaṁ kr̥tsnaṁ samparivartate ॥54॥
13.16.57: iyaṁ sā paramā kāṣṭhā iyaṁ sā paramā kalā,
iyaṁ sā paramā siddhiriyaṁ sā paramā gatiḥ ॥57॥
13.16.58: iyaṁ sā paramā śāntiriyaṁ sā nirvr̥tiḥ parā,
yaṁ prāpya kr̥takr̥tyāḥ sma ityamanyanta yoginaḥ ॥58॥
13.16.60: yā gatiryajñaśīlānāṁ sā gatistvaṁ na saṁśayaḥ ॥60॥
13.16.61: tapyatāṁ yā gatirdeva paramā sā gatirbhavān ॥61॥
13.16.63: prakr̥tīnāṁ layānāṁ ca sā gatistvaṁ sanātana ॥63॥
13.16.64: kaivalyā yā gatirdeva paramā sā gatirbhavān ॥64॥
13.16.66: jagau ca paramaṁ brahma yat purā lokakr̥jjagau ॥66॥
13.16.67: uvāca bhagavān deva umayā sahitaḥ prabhuḥ ॥67॥
13.16.68: na vidustvāmiti tatastuṣṭaḥ provāca taṁ śivaḥ ॥68॥
13.16.71: kaṁ vā kāmaṁ dadāmyadya brūhi yad vatsa kāṅkṣase,
prāñjaliḥ sa uvācedaṁ tvayi bhaktirdr̥ḍhāstu me ॥71॥
13.16.72: etān dattvā varān devo vandyamānaḥ surarṣibhiḥ,
13.16.74: nāmāni mānavaśreṣṭha tāni tvaṁ śr̥ṇu siddhaye ॥74॥
13.16.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate anuśāsanaparvaṇi dānadharmaparvaṇi meghavāhanaparvākhyāne ṣoḍaśo’dhyāyaḥ ॥16॥
13.17.1: tataḥ sa prayato bhūtvā mama tāta yudhiṣṭhira,
13.17.7: tena te śrāvayiṣyāmi yat tad brahma sanātanam,
na śakyaṁ vistarāt kr̥tsnaṁ vaktuṁ sarvasya kenacit ॥7॥
13.17.9: kastasya śaknuyād vaktuṁ guṇān kārtsnyena mādhava,
13.17.10: aprāpya tu tato’nujñāṁ na śakyaḥ stotumīśvaraḥ ॥10॥
13.17.11: yadā tenābhyanujñātaḥ stuto vai sa tadā mayā,
13.17.13: śr̥ṇu nāmnāṁ ca yaṁ kr̥ṣṇa yaduktaṁ padmayoninā,
13.17.14: gireḥ sāraṁ yathā hema puṣpasāraṁ yathā madhu ॥14॥
13.17.16: māṅgalyaṁ pauṣṭikaṁ caiva rakṣoghnaṁ pāvanaṁ mahat ॥16॥
13.17.18: sa kr̥ṣṇa narakaṁ yāti saha pūrvaiḥ sahātmajaiḥ ॥18॥
13.17.20: yaṁ jñātvā antakāle’pi gaccheta paramāṁ gatim,
13.17.25: brahmaṇāmapi yad brahma parāṇāmapi yat param ॥25॥
13.17.26: śāntānāmapi yaḥ śānto dyutīnāmapi yā dyutiḥ ॥26॥
13.17.27: dāntānāmapi yo dānto dhīmatāmapi yā ca dhīḥ,
13.17.28: yajñānāmapi yo yajñaḥ śivānāmapi yaḥ śivaḥ,
13.17.29: yogināmapi yo yogī kāraṇānāṁ ca kāraṇam,
yato lokāḥ sambhavanti na bhavanti yataḥ punaḥ ॥29॥
13.17.30: aṣṭottarasahasraṁ tu nāmnāṁ śarvasya me śr̥ṇu,
13.17.31: sthiraḥ sthāṇuḥ prabhurbhīmaḥ pravaro varado varaḥ,
13.17.32: jaṭī carmī śikhaṇḍī ca sarvāṅgaḥ sarvabhāvanaḥ,
13.17.43: aśanī śataghnī khaḍgī paṭṭiśī cāyudhī mahān ॥43॥
13.17.45: dīrghaśca harikeśaśca sutīrthaḥ kr̥ṣṇa eva ca,
13.17.51: ghoro mahātapāḥ pāśo nityo giriruho nabhaḥ,
13.17.58: śikhī muṇḍī jaṭī jvālī mūrtijo mūrddhago balī,
13.17.76: bhagahārī nihantā ca kālo brahmā pitāmahaḥ ॥76॥
13.17.79: dambho hyadambho vaidambho vaśyo vaśakaraḥ kaliḥ,
13.17.80: akṣaraṁ paramaṁ brahma balavacchakra eva ca,
13.17.104: dhātā śakraśca viṣṇuśca mitrastvaṣṭā dhruvo dharaḥ ॥104॥
13.17.131: chatraṁ succhatro vikhyāto lokaḥ sarvāśrayaḥ kramaḥ,
muṇḍo virūpo vikr̥to daṇḍī kuṇḍī vikurvaṇaḥ ॥131॥
13.17.141: vyāsaḥ sargaḥ susaṅkṣepo vistaraḥ paryayo naraḥ,
13.17.142: kalāḥ kāṣṭhā lavā mātrā muhūrtāhaḥkṣapāḥ kṣaṇāḥ,
13.17.150: guhaḥ kānto nijaḥ sargaḥ pavitraṁ sarvapāvanaḥ,
13.17.153: vratādhipaḥ paraṁ brahma bhaktānāṁ paramā gatiḥ,
13.17.155: stotavyamarcyaṁ vandyaṁ ca kaḥ stoṣyati jagatpatim,
13.17.160: tathaiva ca manuṣyeṣu ye manuṣyāḥ pradhānataḥ,
13.17.163: stuvantaḥ stūyamānāśca tuṣyanti ca ramanti ca ॥163॥
13.17.166: etad deveṣu duṣprāpaṁ manuṣyeṣu na labhyate,
13.17.171: gīyate ca sa buddhyeta brahmā śaṅkarasaṁnidhau ॥171॥
13.17.172: idaṁ puṇyaṁ pavitraṁ ca sarvadā pāpanāśanam,
yogadaṁ mokṣadaṁ caiva svargadaṁ toṣadaṁ tathā ॥172॥
13.17.173: evametat paṭhante ya ekabhaktyā tu śaṅkaram,
yā gatiḥ sāṅkhyayogānāṁ vrajantyetāṁ gatiṁ tadā ॥173॥
13.17.175: etad rahasyaṁ paramaṁ brahmaṇo hr̥di saṁsthitam,
brahmā provāca śakrāya śakraḥ provāca mr̥tyave ॥175॥
13.17.177: taṇḍiḥ provāca śukrāya gautamāya ca bhārgavaḥ,
13.17.181: piśācā yātudhānā vā guhyakā bhujagā api ॥181॥
13.17.182: yaḥ paṭheta śuciḥ pārtha brahmacārī jitendriyaḥ,
13.17.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate anuśāsanaparvaṇi dānadharmaparvaṇi mahādevasahasranāmastotre saptadaśo’dhyāyaḥ ॥17॥
13.18.1: paṭhasva putra bhadraṁ te prīyatāṁ te maheśvaraḥ ॥1॥
13.18.2: purā putra mayā merau tapyatā paramaṁ tapaḥ,
13.18.5: prītaśca bhagavān jñānaṁ dadau mama bhavāntakam,
13.18.10: āha māṁ tripuraghno vai yaśaste’gryaṁ bhaviṣyati ॥10॥
13.18.13: paraśuṁ ca tato devo divyānyastrāṇi caiva me ॥13॥
13.18.14: pāpaṁ ca te na bhavitā ajeyaśca bhaviṣyasi,
13.18.15: tadavāptaṁ ca me sarvaṁ prasādāt tasya dhīmataḥ ॥15॥
13.18.26: tasya vākyasya nidhane pārtha jāto hyahaṁ mr̥gaḥ,
tato māṁ śaraṇaṁ prāptaṁ prāha yogī maheśvaraḥ ॥26॥
13.18.27: sāmyaṁ mamāstu te saukhyaṁ yuvayorvardhatāṁ kratuḥ ॥27॥
13.18.28: paraṁ dhātā vidhātā ca sukhaduḥkhe ca sarvadā ॥28॥
13.18.29: acintya eṣa bhagavān karmaṇā manasā girā,
na me tāta yudhiśreṣṭha vidyayā paṇḍitaḥ samaḥ ॥29॥
13.18.31: tato’tha bhagavānāha prīto māṁ vai yudhiṣṭhira,
13.18.33: maṇimanthe’tha śaile vai purā sampūjito mayā,
13.18.34: tato māṁ bhagavān prīta idaṁ vacanamabravīt,
varaṁ vr̥ṇīṣva bhadraṁ te yaste manasi vartate ॥34॥
13.18.35: yadi prīto mahādevo bhaktyā paramayā prabhuḥ ॥35॥
13.18.39: tulyaṁ mama sahasraṁ tu sutānāṁ brahmavādinām,
13.18.41: apyasāvīpsitaḥ putro mama syād vai maheśvarāt ॥41॥
13.18.42: iti matvā hr̥di mataṁ prāha māṁ surasattamaḥ,
13.18.43: vedānāṁ ca sa vai vaktā kuruvaṁśakarastathā ॥43॥
13.18.44: itihāsasya kartā ca putraste jagato hitaḥ,
13.18.47: tatrasthena stuto devaḥ prāha māṁ vai nareśvara,
13.18.48: rujā śūlakr̥tā caiva na te vipra bhaviṣyati,
13.18.49: tvaṁ bhaviṣyasyanupamo janma vai saphalaṁ kuru ॥49॥
13.18.53: abravīnmāṁ tato mātā duḥkhitā rudatī bhr̥śam,
13.18.54: na tāta taruṇaṁ dāntaṁ pitā tvāṁ paśyate’nagha,
13.18.55: pitā mātā ca te tvaṁ ca putra mr̥tyuvivarjitāḥ ॥55॥
13.18.56: bhaviṣyatha viśa kṣipraṁ draṣṭāsi pitaraṁ kṣaye,
13.18.57: apaśyaṁ pitaraṁ tāta iṣṭiṁ kr̥tvā viniḥsr̥tam,
13.18.58: tān visr̥jya ca māṁ prāha pitā sāsrāvilekṣaṇaḥ,
13.18.59: diṣṭyā dr̥ṣṭo’si me putra kr̥tavidya ihāgataḥ,
13.18.64: brahmatvaṁ keśavatvaṁ vā śakratvaṁ vā suraiḥ saha ॥64॥
13.18.65: manasāpi śivaṁ tāta ye prapadyanti mānavāḥ ॥65॥
13.18.66: vidhūya sarvapāpāni devaiḥ saha vasanti te,
bhittvā bhittvā ca kūlāni hutvā sarvamidaṁ jagat ॥66॥
13.18.67: yajed devaṁ virūpākṣaṁ na sa pāpena lipyate,
13.18.69: evameva mahādevaṁ bhaktā ye mānavā bhuvi ॥69॥
13.18.70: na te saṁsāravaśagā iti me niścitā matiḥ,
13.18.72: rakṣā dīkṣā saṁyamā ye ca kecit ॥72॥
13.18.81: śūdro gatiṁ pretya tathā sukhaṁ ca ॥81॥
13.18.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate anuśāsanaparvaṇi dānadharmaparvaṇi meghavāhanaparvākhyāne aṣṭādaśo’dhyāyaḥ ॥18॥
13.19.3: sandehaḥ sumahāneṣa viruddha iti me matiḥ,
iha yaḥ sahadharmo vai pretyāyaṁ vihitaḥ kva nu ॥3॥
13.19.7: anr̥tāḥ striya ityevaṁ vedeṣvapi hi paṭhyate,
13.19.9: yadaitad yādr̥śaṁ caitad yathā caitat pravartitam,
13.19.12: suprabhāṁ nāma vai nāmnā rūpeṇāpratimāṁ bhuvi,
13.19.13: sā tasya dr̥ṣṭvaiva mano jahāra śubhalocanā,
13.19.14: r̥ṣistamāha deyā me sutā tubhyaṁ hi tacchr̥ṇu,
gaccha tāvad diśaṁ puṇyāmuttarāṁ drakṣyase tataḥ ॥14॥
13.19.14d2: svabhartrā svajanopeta iha pretya ca modate.
13.19.15: kiṁ draṣṭavyaṁ mayā tatra vaktumarhati me bhavān,
tathedānīṁ mayā kāryaṁ yathā vakṣyati māṁ bhavān ॥15॥
13.19.19: iṣṭaṁ kila girau sthānaṁ taddivyamiti śuśruma,
nityaṁ saṁnihito devastathā te pārṣadāḥ smr̥tāḥ ॥19॥
13.19.21: r̥tavaḥ kālarātriśca ye divyā ye ca mānuṣāḥ ॥21॥
13.19.22: devaṁ copāsate sarve rūpiṇaḥ kila tatra ha,
13.19.23: ramaṇīyaṁ manogrāhi tatra vai drakṣyase striyam ॥23॥
13.19.24: draṣṭavyā sā tvayā tatra sampūjyā caiva yatnataḥ ॥24॥
13.19.25: tāṁ dr̥ṣṭvā vinivr̥ttastvaṁ tataḥ pāṇiṁ grahīṣyasi,
yadyeṣa samayaḥ sarvaḥ sādhyatāṁ tatra gamyatām ॥25॥
13.19.26: yatra tvaṁ vadase sādho bhavān bhavatu satyavāk ॥26॥
13.19.29: aśoke vimale tīrthe snātvā vai tarpya devatāḥ,
tatra vāsāya śayane kauśe sukhamuvāsa ha ॥29॥
13.19.30: tato rātryāṁ vyatītāyāṁ prātarutthāya sa dvijaḥ,
13.19.33: atha te rākṣasāḥ sarve ye’bhirakṣanti padminīm,
13.19.38: sukhaṁ prāpto bhavān kaccit kiṁ vā mattaścikīrṣati,
brūhi sarvaṁ kariṣyāmi yanmāṁ vakṣyasi vai dvija ॥38॥
13.19.39: bhavanaṁ praviśa tvaṁ me yathākāmaṁ dvijottama,
13.19.40: prāviśad bhavanaṁ svaṁ vai gr̥hītvā taṁ dvijottamam,
āsanaṁ svaṁ dadau caiva pādyamarghyaṁ tathaiva ca ॥40॥
13.19.44: alambuṣā ghr̥tācī ca citrā citrāṅgadā ruciḥ ॥44॥
13.19.45: manoharā sukeśī ca sumukhī hāsinī prabhā,
vidyutā praśamī dāntā vidyotā ratireva ca ॥45॥
13.19.48: sāgraḥ saṁvatsaro jāto vipreha tava paśyataḥ ॥48॥
13.19.49: hāryo’yaṁ viṣayo brahman gāndharvo nāma nāmataḥ,
chandato vartatāṁ vipra yathā vadati vā bhavān ॥49॥
13.19.52: prīto’smi sadr̥śaṁ caiva tava sarvaṁ dhanādhipa,
13.19.55: pradakṣiṇaṁ tathā cakre prayataḥ śirasā nataḥ,
13.19.56: sa taṁ pradakṣiṇaṁ kr̥tvā triḥ śailaṁ cottarāmukhaḥ,
13.19.61: sa tatra kāñcanaṁ divyaṁ sarvaratnamayaṁ gr̥ham,
13.19.62: vimānāni ca ramyāṇi ratnāni vividhāni ca ॥62॥
13.19.66: atha dvāraṁ samabhito gatvā sthitvā tato’bravīt ॥66॥
13.19.67: atha kanyāḥ parivr̥tā gr̥hāt tasmād vinirgatāḥ ॥67॥
13.19.68: nānārūpāḥ sapta vibho kanyāḥ sarvā manoharāḥ,
yāṁ yāmapaśyat kanyāṁ vai sā sā tasya mano’harat ॥68॥
13.19.69: tato dhr̥tiḥ samutpannā tasya viprasya dhīmataḥ ॥69॥
13.19.70: sa ca tāsāṁ surūpāṇāṁ tasyaiva bhavanasya hi ॥70॥
13.19.72: svastīti tena caivoktā sā strī pratyavadat tadā ॥72॥
13.19.74: prajñātā yā praśāntā yā śeṣā gacchantu cchandataḥ,
13.19.75: atha tāṁ saṁviśan prāha śayane bhāsvare tadā ॥75॥
13.19.76: saṁlāpāt tena vipreṇa tathā sā tatra bhāṣitā ॥76॥
13.19.77: atha sā vepamānāṅgī nimittaṁ śītajaṁ tadā ॥77॥
13.19.79: sopāgūhad bhujābhyāṁ tu r̥ṣiṁ prītyā nararṣabha,
13.19.81: kāmena mohitā cāhaṁ tvāṁ bhajantīṁ bhajasva mām,
prahr̥ṣṭo bhava viprarṣe samāgaccha mayā saha ॥81॥
13.19.82: upagūha ca māṁ vipra kāmārtāhaṁ bhr̥śaṁ tvayi,
13.19.83: mama cedaṁ dhanaṁ sarvaṁ yaccānyadapi paśyasi ॥83॥
13.19.84: prabhustvaṁ bhava sarvatra mayi caiva na saṁśayaḥ,
sarvān kāmān vidhāsyāmi ramasva sahito mayā ॥84॥
13.19.85: tvadvaśāhaṁ bhaviṣyāmi raṁsyase ca mayā saha ॥85॥
13.19.86: sarvān kāmānupāśnīmo ye divyā ye ca mānuṣāḥ,
nātaḥ paraṁ hi nārīṇāṁ vidyate ca kadācana ॥86॥
13.19.88: na ca dahyanti gacchantyaḥ sutaptairapi pāṁsubhiḥ,
13.19.89: bhadre nirveṣṭukāmaṁ māṁ viddhi satyena vai śape ॥89॥
13.19.90: evaṁ lokān gamiṣyāmi putrairiti na saṁśayaḥ ॥90॥
13.19.91: bhadre dharmaṁ vijānīhi jñātvā coparamasva ha,
nānilo’gnirna varuṇo na cānye tridaśā dvija ॥91॥
13.19.92: priyāḥ strīṇāṁ yathā kāmo ratiśīlā hi yoṣitaḥ,
13.19.93: naitā jānanti pitaraṁ na kulaṁ na ca mātaram ॥93॥
13.19.94: na bhrātr̥̄n na ca bhartāraṁ na ca putrān na devarān,
13.19.95: āsyatāṁ rucitaśchandaḥ kiṁ ca kāryaṁ bravīhi me ॥95॥
13.19.96: sā strī provāca bhagavan drakṣyase deśakālataḥ,
13.19.98: cintāṁ paramikāṁ bheje santapta iva cābhavat ॥98॥
13.19.99: yad yadaṅgaṁ hi so’paśyat tasyā viprarṣabhastadā,
13.19.100: devateyaṁ gr̥hasyāsya śāpāt kiṁ nu virūpitā,
asyāśca kāraṇaṁ vettuṁ na yuktaṁ sahasā mayā ॥100॥
13.19.102: atha sā strī tathovāca bhagavan paśya vai raveḥ,
13.19.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate anuśāsanaparvaṇi dānadharmaparvaṇi aṣṭāvakradiksaṁvāde ekonaviṁśo’dhyāyaḥ ॥19॥
13.20.1: atha sā strī tamuvāca bāḍhamevaṁ bhavatviti,
13.20.2: anujñātā ca muninā sā strī tena mahātmanā,
13.20.5: sa tena susukhoṣṇena tasyā hastasukhena ca ॥5॥
13.20.6: vyatītāṁ rajanīṁ kr̥tsnāṁ nājānāt sa mahāvrataḥ,
13.20.7: pūrvasyāṁ diśi sūryaṁ ca so’paśyaduditaṁ divi,
tasya buddhiriyaṁ kiṁ nu mohastattvamidaṁ bhavet ॥7॥
13.20.9: tasya svādutayānnasya na prabhūtaṁ cakāra saḥ,
13.20.10: tatra vai śayane divye tasya tasyāśca kalpite ॥10॥
13.20.11: pr̥thak caiva tathā suptau sā strī sa ca munistadā,
tathārdharātre sā strī tu śayanaṁ tadupāgamat ॥11॥
13.20.12: na bhadre paradāreṣu mano me samprasajjati,
uttiṣṭha bhadre bhadraṁ te svayaṁ vai viramasva ca ॥12॥
13.20.13: sā tadā tena vipreṇa tathā tena nivartitā,
13.20.15: bādhate maithunaṁ vipra mama bhaktiṁ ca paśya vai,
adharmaṁ prāpsyase vipra yanmāṁ tvaṁ nābhinandasi ॥15॥
13.20.16: prabhavāmi sadā dhr̥tyā bhadre svaśayanaṁ vraja ॥16॥
13.20.18: yadi vā doṣajātaṁ tvaṁ paradāreṣu paśyasi,
ātmānaṁ sparśayāmyadya pāṇiṁ gr̥hṇīṣva me dvija ॥18॥
13.20.19: na doṣo bhavitā caiva satyenaitad bravīmyaham,
svatantrāṁ māṁ vijānīhi yo’dharmaḥ so’stu vai mayi,
13.20.20: svatantrā tvaṁ kathaṁ bhadre brūhi kāraṇamatra vai,
nāsti triloke strī kācid yā vai svātantryamarhati ॥20॥
13.20.21: pitā rakṣati kaumāre bhartā rakṣati yauvane,
putrāśca sthāvire kāle nāsti strīṇāṁ svatantratā ॥21॥
13.20.22: kaumāraṁ brahmacaryaṁ me kanyaivāsmi na saṁśayaḥ,
patnīṁ kuruṣva māṁ vipra śraddhāṁ vijahi mā mama ॥22॥
13.20.23: yathā mama tathā tubhyaṁ yathā tubhyaṁ tathā mama,
jijñāseyamr̥ṣestasya vighnaḥ satyaṁ na kiṁ bhavet ॥23॥
13.20.24: āścaryaṁ paramaṁ hīdaṁ kiṁ nu śreyo hi me bhavet,
13.20.25: kiṁ tvasyāḥ paramaṁ rūpaṁ jīrṇamāsīt kathaṁ punaḥ,
13.20.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate anuśāsanaparvaṇi dānadharmaparvaṇi aṣṭāvakradiksaṁvāde viṁśo’dhyāyaḥ ॥20॥
13.21.1: na bibheti kathaṁ sā strī śāpācca paramadyuteḥ,
kathaṁ nivr̥tto bhagavāṁstad bhavān prabravītu me ॥1॥
13.21.2: na cānr̥taṁ te vaktavyaṁ brūhi brāhmaṇakāmyayā ॥2॥
13.21.5: uttarāṁ māṁ diśaṁ viddhi dr̥ṣṭaṁ strīcāpalaṁ ca te,
13.21.6: sa tvaṁ yena ca kāryeṇa samprāpto bhagavāniha ॥6॥
13.21.7: tavopadeśaṁ kartuṁ vai tacca sarvaṁ kr̥taṁ mayā ॥7॥
13.21.8: kanyāṁ prāpsyasi tāṁ vipra putriṇī ca bhaviṣyati ॥8॥
13.21.11: tasya sammānanārthaṁ me tvayi vākyaṁ prabhāṣitam ॥11॥
13.21.12: śrutvā tu vacanaṁ tasyāḥ sa vipraḥ prāñjaliḥ sthitaḥ,
13.21.15: tasya cottarato deśe dr̥ṣṭaṁ me daivataṁ mahat ॥15॥
13.21.17: tamuvāca tadā vipraḥ sutāṁ pratigr̥hāṇa me,
13.21.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate anuśāsanaparvaṇi dānadharmaparvaṇi aṣṭāvakradiksaṁvāde ekaviṁśo’dhyāyaḥ ॥21॥
13.22.0d3: parvataṁ nāradaṁ caivamasitaṁ devalaṁ ca tam,
āruṇeyaṁ ca raibhyaṁ ca etānatrāgatān purā.
13.22.0d5: arcayitvārhato vipraṁ kiṁ kurma iti cābruvan.
13.22.0d10: yatra te saṁśayo brahman samutpannaḥ sa ucyatām.
13.22.0d13: āsīd dharmaḥ purā vipra catuṣpādaḥ kr̥te yuge,
13.22.0d14: tasmin vyatīte samprāptaṁ tr̥tīyaṁ dvāparaṁ yugam.
13.22.0d16: lokavr̥ttaṁ ca dharmaṁ ca ucyamānaṁ nibodha me,
13.22.0d18: kiṁ caturvarṇaniyataṁ havyaṁ kavyaṁ na naśyati.
13.22.0d19: mantrapūtaṁ sadā havyaṁ kavyaṁ caiva na naśyati,
13.22.0d21: catvāro hyatha ye varṇā havyaṁ kavyaṁ pradāsyate,
13.22.0d22: asurān gacchate dattaṁ viprai rakṣāṁsi kṣatriyaiḥ,
vaiśyaiḥ pretāni vai dattaṁ śūdrairbhūtāni gacchati.
13.22.0d23: dāsyanti havyakavyāni teṣāṁ dattaṁ kva gacchati.
13.22.0d24: naiva devā na pitaraḥ pratigr̥hṇanti tat svayam.
13.22.0d25: yātudhānāḥ piśācāśca bhūtā ye cāpi nairr̥tāḥ,
13.22.0d26: yat prayacchanti vidhivat tad vai bhuñjanti devatāḥ.
13.22.0d27: śrutaṁ varṇāvarairdattaṁ havyaṁ kavyaṁ ca nārada,
samprayoge ca putrāṇāṁ kanyānāṁ ca bravīhi me.
13.22.0d29: jātamātrā tu dātavyā kanyakā sadr̥śe vare,
kāle dattāsu kanyāsu pitā dharmeṇa yujyate.
13.22.0d30: yastu puṣpavatīṁ kanyāṁ bāndhavo na prayacchati,
13.22.0d31: avadhyātaḥ sa kanyāyā bandhuḥ prāpnoti bhrūṇahām.
13.22.0d35: evaṁ kanyā parā lakṣmī ratistoṣaśca dehinām,
13.22.0d36: ānayitvā svakād varṇāt kanyakāṁ yo bhajennaraḥ,
13.22.0d37: sādhvī kulaṁ vardhayati sādhvī puṣṭirgr̥he parā,
sādhvī lakṣmī ratiḥ sākṣāt pratiṣṭhā santatistathā.
13.22.0d38: kāni tīrthāni bhagavan nr̥ṇāṁ dehāśritāni vai,
tāni vai śaṁsa bhagavan yāthātathyena pr̥cchataḥ.
13.22.0d39: nr̥ṇāṁ tīrthāni pañcāhuḥ pāṇau saṁnihitāni vai.
13.22.0d40: ādyatīrthaṁ tu tīrthānāṁ vaiṣṇavo bhāga ucyate,
13.22.0d41: kathaṁ na vighnaṁ bhavati etadicchāmi veditum.
13.22.0d43: havyaṁ kavyaṁ ca dharmātmā sarvaṁ tacchrotriyo’rhati,
13.22.3: śraddhayā parayā pūto yaḥ prayacched dvijātaye,
havyaṁ kavyaṁ tathā dānaṁ ko doṣaḥ syāt pitāmaha ॥3॥
13.22.4: pūto bhavati sarvatra kimuta tvaṁ mahādyute ॥4॥
13.22.5: na brāhmaṇaṁ parīkṣeta daiveṣu satataṁ naraḥ,
kavyapradāne tu budhāḥ parīkṣyaṁ brāhmaṇaṁ viduḥ ॥5॥
13.22.6: na brāhmaṇaḥ sādhayate havyaṁ daivāt prasiddhyati,
13.22.7: mārkaṇḍeyaḥ purā prāha iti lokeṣu buddhimān ॥7॥
13.22.8: apūrvo’pyathavā vidvān sambandhī vā yathā bhavet,
tapasvī yajñaśīlo vā kathaṁ pātraṁ bhavet tu saḥ ॥8॥
13.22.9: hrīmānr̥juḥ satyavādī pātraṁ pūrve ca ye trayaḥ ॥9॥
13.22.10: tatremaṁ śr̥ṇu me pārtha caturṇāṁ tejasāṁ matam,
13.22.11: tathā duścaritaṁ sarvaṁ trivr̥tyāṁ ca nimajjati ॥11॥
13.22.12: sāṅkhyaṁ purāṇaṁ ca kule ca janma,
13.22.14: aśvamedhasahasraṁ ca satyaṁ ca tulayā dhr̥tam,
13.22.16: yadi te brāhmaṇā loke vratino bhuñjate haviḥ,
dattaṁ brāhmaṇakāmāya kathaṁ tat sukr̥taṁ bhavet ॥16॥
13.22.21: tebhyo hiraṇyaṁ ratnaṁ vā gāmaśvaṁ vā dadāti yaḥ,
daśa varṣāṇi viṣṭhāṁ sa bhuṅkte nirayamāsthitaḥ ॥21॥
13.22.23: vaiśvadevaṁ ca ye mūḍhā viprāya brahmacāriṇe,
dadate neha rājendra te lokān bhuñjate’śubhān ॥23॥
13.22.24: kiṁ paraṁ brahmacaryaṁ ca kiṁ paraṁ dharmalakṣaṇam,
kiṁ ca śreṣṭhatamaṁ śaucaṁ tanme brūhi pitāmaha ॥24॥
13.22.26: kasmin kāle cared dharmaṁ kasmin kāle’rthamācaret,
kasmin kāle sukhī ca syāt tanme brūhi pitāmaha ॥26॥
13.22.27: paścāt kāmaṁ niṣeveta na ca gacchet prasaṅgitām ॥27॥
13.22.30: praharenna narendreṣu na hanyād gāṁ tathaiva ca,
13.22.31: nāgniṁ parityajejjātu na ca vedān parityajet,
na ca brāhmaṇamākrośet samaṁ tad brahmahatyayā ॥31॥
13.22.32: kīdr̥śāḥ sādhavo viprāḥ kebhyo dattaṁ mahāphalam,
kīdr̥śānāṁ ca bhoktavyaṁ tanme brūhi pitāmaha ॥32॥
13.22.35: svakarmaniratā ye ca tebhyo dattaṁ mahāphalam ॥35॥
13.22.39: dravyāṇi cānyāni tathā pretyabhāve na śocati ॥39॥
13.22.40d1: tr̥pte tr̥ptāḥ sarva devāḥ pitaro munayo’pi ca,
13.22.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate anuśāsanaparvaṇi dānadharmaparvaṇi bahuprāśnike dvāviṁśo’dhyāyaḥ ॥22॥
13.23.1: śrāddhakāle ca daive ca pitrye’pi ca pitāmaha,
13.23.3: kālahīnaṁ tu yad dānaṁ taṁ bhāgaṁ rakṣasāṁ viduḥ ॥3॥
13.23.4: laṅghitaṁ cāvalīḍhaṁ ca kalipūrvaṁ ca yat kr̥tam,
rajasvalābhidr̥ṣṭaṁ ca taṁ bhāgaṁ rakṣasāṁ viduḥ ॥4॥
13.23.5: avaghuṣṭaṁ ca yad bhuktamavratena ca bhārata,
parāmr̥ṣṭaṁ śunā caiva taṁ bhāgaṁ rakṣasāṁ viduḥ ॥5॥
13.23.6: ruditaṁ cāvadhūtaṁ ca taṁ bhāgaṁ rakṣasāṁ viduḥ ॥6॥
13.23.7: niroṅkāreṇa yad bhuktaṁ saśastreṇa ca bhārata,
durātmanā ca yad bhuktaṁ taṁ bhāgaṁ rakṣasāṁ viduḥ ॥7॥
13.23.8: parocchiṣṭaṁ ca yad bhuktaṁ paribhuktaṁ ca yad bhavet,
daive pitrye ca satataṁ taṁ bhāgaṁ rakṣasāṁ viduḥ ॥8॥
13.23.10: durācāraiśca yad bhuktaṁ taṁ bhāgaṁ rakṣasāṁ viduḥ ॥10॥
13.23.11: ye bhāgā rakṣasāṁ prāptāsta uktā bharatarṣabha,
ata ūrdhvaṁ visargasya parīkṣāṁ brāhmaṇe śr̥ṇu ॥11॥
13.23.12: daive vāpyatha pitrye vā rājan nārhanti ketanam ॥12॥
13.23.13: śvitrī klībaśca kuṣṭhī ca tathā yakṣmahataśca yaḥ,
apasmārī ca yaścāndho rājan nārhanti ketanam ॥13॥
13.23.17: anuyoktā ca yo vipro anuyuktaśca bhārata,
13.23.21: r̥ṇakartā ca yo rājan yaśca vārdhuṣiko naraḥ,
13.23.23: śrāddhe daive ca nirdiṣṭo brāhmaṇo bharatarṣabha,
13.23.25: na tveva vaṇijaṁ tāta śrāddhe ca parikalpayet ॥25॥
13.23.26: agnihotrī ca yo vipro grāmavāsī ca yo bhavet,
13.23.30: paścācca pītavān somaṁ sa rājan ketanakṣamaḥ ॥30॥
13.23.31: bhavet sarvātithiḥ paścāt sa rājan ketanakṣamaḥ ॥31॥
13.23.34: śrāddhasya brāhmaṇaḥ kālaḥ prāptaṁ dadhi ghr̥taṁ tathā,
13.23.34d2: laukikaṁ saṅgave’rthyaṁ ca snānādi hyatha madhyame.
13.23.35: śrāddhāpavarge viprasya svadhā vai muditā bhavet,
13.23.38: vaiśyasya daive vaktavyaṁ prīyantāṁ devatā iti,
13.23.39: brahmakṣatre hi mantroktā vaiśyasya ca yudhiṣṭhira ॥39॥
13.23.40: bālvajī hyeva vaiśyasya dharma eṣa yudhiṣṭhira ॥40॥
13.23.42: yavīyān paśuhiṁsāyāṁ tulyadharmo bhavet sa hi ॥42॥
13.23.46: arthenānyena yo lipset karmārthaṁ caiva bhārata,
13.23.48: pitryaṁ vāpyathavā daivaṁ dīyate yat pitāmaha,
13.23.52: taskarebhyaḥ parebhyo vā ye bhayārtā yudhiṣṭhira,
13.23.53: vaṭavo yasya bhikṣanti tebhyo dattaṁ mahāphalam ॥53॥
13.23.57: spr̥hayanti ca bhuktvānnaṁ teṣu dattaṁ mahāphalam ॥57॥
13.23.59: nirayaṁ yena gacchanti svargaṁ caiva hi tat śr̥ṇu ॥59॥
13.23.60: ye’nr̥taṁ kathayanti sma te vai nirayagāminaḥ ॥60॥
13.23.62: sūcakāśca pareṣāṁ ye te vai nirayagāminaḥ ॥62॥
13.23.63: prapāṇāṁ ca sabhānāṁ ca saṅkramāṇāṁ ca bhārata,
13.23.64: anāthāṁ pramadāṁ bālāṁ vr̥ddhāṁ bhītāṁ tapasvinīm,
vañcayanti narā ye ca te vai nirayagāminaḥ ॥64॥
13.23.75: brāhmaṇānāṁ gavāṁ caiva kanyānāṁ ca yudhiṣṭhira,
ye’ntaraṁ yānti kāryeṣu te vai nirayagāminaḥ ॥75॥
13.23.76: śalyānāṁ dhanuṣāṁ caiva te vai nirayagāminaḥ ॥76॥
13.23.79: bandhakāśca paśūnāṁ ye te vai nirayagāminaḥ ॥79॥
13.23.81: tyajanti kr̥takr̥tyā ye te vai nirayagāminaḥ ॥81॥
13.23.82: bālānāmatha vr̥ddhānāṁ dāsānāṁ caiva ye narāḥ,
13.23.84: hanti putrān paśūn kr̥tsnān brāhmaṇātikramaḥ kr̥taḥ ॥84॥
13.23.85: dānena tapasā caiva satyena ca yudhiṣṭhira,
13.23.90: āśramāṇāṁ ca kartāraḥ kulānāṁ caiva bhārata,
deśānāṁ nagarāṇāṁ ca te narāḥ svargagāminaḥ ॥90॥
13.23.94: ye vai jitendriyā dhīrāste narāḥ svargagāminaḥ ॥94॥
13.23.97: suvarṇasya ca dātāro gavāṁ ca bharatarṣabha,
yānānāṁ vāhanānāṁ ca te narāḥ svargagāminaḥ ॥97॥
13.23.98: dātāro vāsasāṁ caiva te narāḥ svargagāminaḥ ॥98॥
13.23.100: dātāraḥ prārthitānāṁ ca te narāḥ svargagāminaḥ ॥100॥
13.23.101: rasānāṁ cātha bījānāṁ dhānyānāṁ ca yudhiṣṭhira,
13.23.103: dānadharmaṁ ca dānasya yat pūrvamr̥ṣibhiḥ kr̥tam ॥103॥
13.23.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate anuśāsanaparvaṇi dānadharmaparvaṇi svarganarakagāmivarṇane trayoviṁśo’dhyāyaḥ ॥23॥
13.24.1: idaṁ me tattvato rājan vaktumarhasi bhārata,
13.24.7: utpādayati yo vighnaṁ taṁ vidyād brahmaghātinam ॥7॥
13.24.8: yaḥ pravr̥ttāṁ śrutiṁ samyak śāstraṁ vā munibhiḥ kr̥tam,
13.24.9: na prayacchati yaḥ kanyāṁ taṁ vidyād brahmaghātinam ॥9॥
13.24.10: adharmanirato mūḍho mithyā yo vai dvijātiṣu,
13.24.11: hareta yo vai sarvasvaṁ taṁ vidyād brahmaghātinam ॥11॥
13.24.12: āśrame vā vane vāpi grāme vā yadi vā pure,
13.24.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate anuśāsanaparvaṇi dānadharmaparvaṇi brahmaghnakathane caturviṁśo’dhyāyaḥ ॥24॥
13.25.1: tīrthānāṁ darśanaṁ śreyaḥ snānaṁ ca bharatarṣabha,
13.25.2: vaktumarhasi me tāni śrotāsmi niyataṁ prabho ॥2॥
13.25.5: tat sarvaṁ śrotumicchāmi tanme śaṁsa mahāmune ॥5॥
13.25.6: upaspr̥śya phalaṁ kiṁ syātteṣu tīrtheṣu vai mune,
pretyabhāve mahāprājña tad yathāsti tathā vada ॥6॥
13.25.7: vigāhya vai nirāhāro nirmalo munivad bhavet ॥7॥
13.25.9: puṣkaraṁ ca prabhāsaṁ ca naimiṣaṁ sāgarodakam,
13.25.11: kuśeśayaṁ ca devaṁ taṁ dhūyate tasya kilbiṣam,
13.25.13: tathā kanakhale snātvā dhūtapāpmā divaṁ vrajet ॥13॥
13.25.16: ekamāsaṁ nirāhāraḥ sa paśyati hi devatāḥ,
saptagaṅge trigaṅge ca indramārge ca tarpayan ॥16॥
13.25.17: sudhāṁ vai labhate bhoktuṁ yo naro jāyate punaḥ,
13.25.18: ekamāsaṁ nirāhāraḥ siddhiṁ māsena sa vrajet,
13.25.20: deveṣu labhate kīrtiṁ yaśasā ca virājate ॥20॥
13.25.21: aśvinyāṁ rūpavarcaskaṁ pretya vai labhate naraḥ ॥21॥
13.25.25: āśrame kr̥ttikānāṁ tu snātvā yastarpayet pitr̥̄n,
13.25.26: trasānāṁ sthāvarāṇāṁ ca dvipadānāṁ bhayaṁ tyajet ॥26॥
13.25.42: aśmapr̥ṣṭhe gayāyāṁ ca niravinde ca parvate,
13.25.43: agneḥ pure naraḥ snātvā agnikanyāpure vaset ॥43॥
13.25.45: punarāvartanandāṁ ca mahānandāṁ ca sevya vai,
13.25.53: vaivasvatasya sadanaṁ na sa gacchet kadācana,
yasya kanyāhrade vāso devalokaṁ sa gacchati ॥53॥
13.25.54: sidhyate tu mahābāho yo naro jāyate’maraḥ ॥54॥
13.25.59: maināke parvate snātvā tathā sandhyāmupāsya ca,
kāmaṁ jitvā ca vai māsaṁ sarvayajñaphalaṁ labhet ॥59॥
13.25.61: nandīśvarasya mūrtiṁ tu dr̥ṣṭvā mucyeta kilbiṣaiḥ,
svargamārge naraḥ snātvā brahmalokaṁ sa gacchati ॥61॥
13.25.63: adhruvaṁ jīvitaṁ jñātvā yo vai vedāntago dvijaḥ ॥63॥
13.25.64: tataḥ siddho divaṁ gacched brahmalokaṁ sanātanam ॥64॥
13.25.65: kāmaṁ krodhaṁ ca lobhaṁ ca yo jitvā tīrthamāvaset,
na tena kiñcinna prāptaṁ tīrthābhigamanād bhavet ॥65॥
13.25.68: suhr̥dāṁ ca japet karṇe śiṣyasyānugatasya ca ॥68॥
13.25.71: uttame ca kule janma labhejjātīśca saṁsmaret ॥71॥
13.25.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate anuśāsanaparvaṇi dānadharmaparvaṇi āṅgirasatīrthayātrāyāṁ pañcaviṁśo’dhyāyaḥ ॥25॥
13.26.16: prakāśanto diśaḥ sarvā vismayaṁ paramaṁ yayuḥ,
13.26.17: kathānte śirasā pādau spr̥ṣṭvā bhīṣmasya pāṇḍavaḥ,
13.26.18: ke deśāḥ ke janapadā āśramāḥ ke ca parvatāḥ,
prakr̥ṣṭāḥ puṇyataḥ kāśca jñeyā nadyaḥ pitāmaha ॥18॥
13.26.22: śilavr̥ttistu yat kr̥tyaṁ prātastat kr̥tavān śuciḥ,
13.26.23: tau sametya mahātmānau sukhāsīnau kathāḥ śubhāḥ,
13.26.24: praśnaṁ papraccha medhāvī yanmāṁ tvaṁ paripr̥cchasi ॥24॥
13.26.25: ke deśaḥke janapadāḥ ke’’śramāḥ ke ca parvatāḥ,
13.26.27: gatiṁ tāṁ na labhejjanturgaṅgāṁ saṁsevya yāṁ labhet ॥27॥
13.26.28: nyastāni na punasteṣāṁ tyāgaḥ svargād vidhīyate ॥28॥
13.26.29: gāṁ tyaktvā mānavā vipra divi tiṣṭhanti te janāḥ ॥29॥
13.26.30: pūrve vayasi karmāṇi kr̥tvā pāpāni ye narāḥ,
paścāt gaṅgāṁ niṣevante te’pi yāntyuttamāṁ gatim ॥30॥
13.26.31: vyuṣṭirbhavati yā puṁsāṁ na sā kratuśatairapi ॥31॥
13.26.34: tadvad deśā diśaścaiva hīnā gaṅgājalaiḥ śivaiḥ ॥34॥
13.26.36: yathā hīnaṁ nabho’rkeṇa bhūḥśailaiḥ khaṁ ca vāyunā,
tathā deśā diśaścaiva gaṅgāhīnā na saṁśayaḥ ॥36॥
13.26.37: triṣu lokeṣu ye kecit prāṇinaḥ sarva eva te,
tarpyamāṇāḥ parāṁ tr̥ptiṁ yānti gaṅgājalaiḥ śubhaiḥ ॥37॥
13.26.38: yastu sūryeṇa niṣṭaptaṁ gāṅgeyaṁ pibate jalam,
13.26.39: pibed yaścāpi gaṅgāmbhaḥ samau syātāṁ na vā samau ॥39॥
13.26.40: tiṣṭhed yugasahasraṁ tu padenaikena yaḥ pumān,
māsamekaṁ tu gaṅgāyāṁ samau syātāṁ na vā samau ॥40॥
13.26.41: tiṣṭhed yatheṣṭaṁ yaścāpi gaṅgāyāṁ sa viśiṣyate ॥41॥
13.26.42: agnau prāstaṁ pradhūyeta yathā tūlaṁ dvijottama,
13.26.44: bhavanti nirviṣāḥ sarpā yathā tārkṣyasya darśanāt,
13.26.45: teṣāṁ pratiṣṭhā gaṅgeha śaraṇaṁ śarma varma ca ॥45॥
13.26.46: patato narake gaṅgā saṁśritān pretya tārayet ॥46॥
13.26.48: te bhavanti śivā vipra ye vai gaṅgāmupāśritāḥ ॥48॥
13.26.49: yathā surāṇāmamr̥taṁ pitr̥̄ṇāṁ ca yathā svadhā,
sudhā yathā ca nāgānāṁ tathā gaṅgājalaṁ nr̥ṇām ॥49॥
13.26.60: sambhaved yā parā prītirgaṅgāyāḥ puline nr̥ṇām ॥60॥
13.26.61: vīkṣya gaṅgāṁ bhavet pūto atra me nāsti saṁśayaḥ ॥61॥
13.26.62: saptāvarān sapta parān pitr̥̄ṁstebhyaśca ye pare,
13.26.64: darśanāt sparśanāt pānāt tathā gaṅgeti kīrtanāt,
13.26.65: ya icchet saphalaṁ janma jīvitaṁ śrutameva ca,
13.26.66: na sutairna ca vittena karmaṇā na ca tatphalam,
13.26.67: samarthā ye na paśyanti gaṅgāṁ puṇyajalāṁ śivām ॥67॥
13.26.68: devaiḥ sendraiśca ko gaṅgāṁ nopaseveta mānavaḥ ॥68॥
13.26.69: vidyāvadbhiḥ śritāṁ gaṅgāṁ pumān ko nāma nāśrayet ॥69॥
13.26.70: cintayenmanasā gaṅgāṁ sa gatiṁ paramāṁ labhet ॥70॥
13.26.71: na bhayebhyo bhayaṁ tasya na pāpebhyo na rājataḥ,
13.26.72: mahāpuṇyāṁ ca gaganāt patantīṁ vai maheśvaraḥ,
dadhāra śirasā gaṅgāṁ tāmeva divi sevate ॥72॥
13.26.73: yastu tasyā jalaṁ sevet kr̥takr̥tyaḥ pumān bhavet ॥73॥
13.26.74: deveśaśca tathā nr̥̄ṇāṁ gaṅgā ca saritāṁ tathā ॥74॥
13.26.75: na bhaveddhi tathā duḥkha yathā gaṅgāviyogajam ॥75॥
13.26.76: tathā prasādo bhavati gaṅgāṁ vīkṣya yathā bhavet ॥76॥
13.26.77: pūrṇaminduṁ yathā dr̥ṣṭvā nr̥ṇāṁ dr̥ṣṭiḥ prasīdati,
tathā tripathagāṁ dr̥ṣṭvā nr̥ṇāṁ dr̥ṣṭiḥ prasīdati ॥77॥
13.26.78: gaṅgāṁ yo’nugato bhaktyā sa tasyāḥ priyatāṁ vrajet ॥78॥
13.26.84: trilokagoptrīṁ ye gaṅgāṁ saṁśritāste divaṁ gatāḥ ॥84॥
13.26.87: khyātiryasyāḥ khaṁ divaṁ gāṁ ca nityaṁ
13.26.104: tathā tvamapi kaunteya bhaktyā paramayā yutaḥ,
13.26.106: itihāsamimaṁ puṇyaṁ śr̥ṇuyād yaḥ paṭheta vā,
13.26.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate anuśāsanaparvaṇi dānadharmaparvaṇi gaṅgāmāhātmyakathane ṣaḍviṁśo’dhyāyaḥ ॥26॥
13.27.1: prajñāśrutābhyāṁ vr̥ttena śīlena ca yathā bhavān,
13.27.2: bhavān viśiṣṭo buddhyā ca prajñayā tapasā tathā,
tasmād bhavantaṁ pr̥cchāmi dharmaṁ dharmabhr̥tāṁ vara,
13.27.3: kṣatriyo yadi vā vaiśyaḥ śūdro vā rājasattama,
13.27.4: tapasā vā sumahatā karmaṇā vā śrutena vā,
13.27.6: paryāye tāta kasmiṁścid brāhmaṇo nāma jāyate ॥6॥
13.27.8: mataṅgo nāma nāmnā vai sarvaiḥ samudito guṇaiḥ ॥8॥
13.27.10: sa bālaṁ gardabhaṁ rājan vahantaṁ māturantike,
13.27.11: tatra tīvraṁ vraṇaṁ dr̥ṣṭvā gardabhī putragr̥ddhinī,
13.27.12: brāhmaṇe dāruṇaṁ nāsti maitro brāhmaṇa ucyate,
13.27.13: ayaṁ tu pāpaprakr̥tirbāle na kurute dayām,
13.27.15: brūhi rāsabhi kalyāṇi mātā me yena dūṣitā,
kathaṁ māṁ vetsi caṇḍālaṁ kṣipraṁ rāsabhi śaṁsa me ॥15॥
13.27.16: kathaṁ māṁ vetsi caṇḍālaṁ brāhmaṇyaṁ yena naśyate,
13.27.17: brāhmaṇyāṁ vr̥ṣalena tvaṁ mattāyāṁ nāpitena ha,
13.27.20: kuśalaṁ tu kutastasya yasyeyaṁ jananī pitaḥ ॥20॥
13.27.21: amānuṣī gardabhīyaṁ tasmāt tapsye tapo mahat ॥21॥
13.27.24: mataṅga tapsyase kiṁ tvaṁ bhogānutsr̥jya mānuṣān ॥24॥
13.27.25: varaṁ dadāmi te hanta vr̥ṇīṣva tvaṁ yadicchasi,
yaccāpyavāpyaṁ hr̥di te sarvaṁ tad brūhi māciram ॥25॥
13.27.26: gaccheyaṁ tadavāpyeha vara eṣa vr̥to mayā ॥26॥
13.27.27: etat śrutvā tu vacanaṁ tamuvāca purandaraḥ,
13.27.30: caṇḍālayonau jātena na tat prāpyaṁ kathañcana ॥30॥
13.27.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate anuśāsanaparvaṇi dānadharmaparvaṇi indramataṅgasaṁvāde saptaviṁśo’dhyāyaḥ ॥27॥
13.28.2: brāhmaṇyaṁ durlabhaṁ tāta prārthayāno na lapsyase ॥2॥
13.28.3: mā kr̥thāḥ sāhasaṁ putra naiṣa dharmapathastava ॥3॥
13.28.4: na hi śakyaṁ tvayā prāptuṁ brāhmaṇyamiha durmate,
13.28.6: sa jāyate pulkaso vā caṇḍālo vāpyasaṁśayaḥ ॥6॥
13.28.10: tataḥ ṣaṣṭiguṇe kāle rājanyo nāma jāyate,
13.28.13: taṁ ca prāpya ciraṁ kālaṁ tatraiva parivartate,
13.28.14: tadevaṁ śokaharṣau tu kāmadveṣau ca putraka,
13.28.15: tāṁścejjayati śatrūn sa tadā prāpnoti sadgatim,
atha te vai jayantyenaṁ tālāgrādiva pātyate ॥15॥
13.28.16: vr̥ṇīṣva kāmamanyaṁ tvaṁ brāhmaṇyaṁ hi sudurlabham ॥16॥
13.28.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate anuśāsanaparvaṇi dānadharmaparvaṇi indramataṅgasaṁvāde aṣṭāviṁśo’dhyāyaḥ ॥28॥
13.29.4: anyaṁ kāmaṁ vr̥ṇīṣva tvaṁ mā vr̥thā te’stvayaṁ śramaḥ ॥4॥
13.29.5: adhyatiṣṭhad gayāṁ gatvā soṁ’guṣṭhena śataṁ samāḥ ॥5॥
13.29.6: tvagasthibhūto dharmātmā sa papāteti naḥ śrutam ॥6॥
13.29.11: brāhmaṇaḥ kurute taddhi yathā yad yacca vāñchati,
13.29.13: anyaṁ varaṁ vr̥ṇīṣva tvaṁ durlabho’yaṁ hi te varaḥ,
kiṁ māṁ tudasi duḥkhārtaṁ mr̥taṁ mārayase ca mām ॥13॥
13.29.14: tvāṁ tu śocāmi yo labdhvā brāhmaṇyaṁ na bubhūṣase,
13.29.16: brāhmaṇyaṁ yo na jānīte dhanaṁ labdhveva durlabham,
13.29.18: daivaṁ tu kathametad vai yadahaṁ mātr̥doṣataḥ ॥18॥
13.29.19: nūnaṁ daivaṁ na śakyaṁ hi pauruṣeṇātivartitum ॥19॥
13.29.20: yadarthaṁ yatnavāneva na labhe vipratāṁ vibho,
evaṅgate tu dharmajña dātumarhasi me varam ॥20॥
13.29.21: yadi te’hamanugrāhyaḥ kiñcid vā sukr̥taṁ mama,
13.29.24: kartumarhasi tad deva śirasā tvāṁ prasādaye,
chandodeva iti khyātaḥ strīṇāṁ pūjyo bhaviṣyasi ॥24॥
13.29.25: kīrtiśca te’tulā vatsa triṣu lokeṣu yāsyati,
13.29.26: evametat paraṁ sthānaṁ brāhmaṇyaṁ nāma bhārata,
13.29.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate anuśāsanaparvaṇi dānadharmaparvaṇi indramataṅgasaṁvāde ekonatriṁśo’dhyāyaḥ ॥29॥
13.30.1: suduṣprāpaṁ yad bravīṣi brāhmaṇyaṁ vadatāṁ vara ॥1॥
13.30.3: vītahavyaśca nr̥patiḥ śruto me vipratāṁ gataḥ,
13.30.4: sa kena karmaṇā prāpto brāhmaṇyaṁ rājasattamaḥ,
13.30.5: śr̥ṇu rājan yathā rājā vītahavyo mahāyaśāḥ,
13.30.8: haihayasya tu rājendra daśasu strīṣu bhārata,
13.30.9: dhanurvede ca vede ca sarvatraiva kr̥taśramāḥ ॥9॥
13.30.10: haryaśva iti vikhyāto babhūva jayatāṁ varaḥ ॥10॥
13.30.12: taṁ tu hatvā narapatiṁ haihayāste mahārathāḥ,
13.30.20: sa niṣkramya dadau yuddhaṁ tebhyo rājā mahābalaḥ,
13.30.21: sa tu yuddhe mahārāja dinānāṁ daśatīrdaśa,
13.30.25: kimāgamanakr̥tyaṁ te sarvaṁ prabrūhi me nr̥pa,
yat te priyaṁ tat kariṣye na me’trāsti vicāraṇā ॥25॥
13.30.27: ekaśeṣaḥ kr̥to vaṁśo mama taiḥ pāpakarmabhiḥ ॥27॥
13.30.28: na bhetavyaṁ na bhetavyaṁ saudeva vyetu te bhayam ॥28॥
13.30.30: athāsya tanayo jajñe pratardana iti śrutaḥ ॥30॥
13.30.31: vedaṁ cāpi jagau kr̥tsnaṁ dhanurvedaṁ ca bhārata ॥31॥
13.30.32: tejo lokyaṁ sa saṅgr̥hya tasmin deśe samāviśat ॥32॥
13.30.33: tataḥ sa kavacī dhanvī stūyamānaḥ surarṣibhiḥ,
13.30.34: sa rathī baddhanistriṁśo babhau dīpta ivānalaḥ,
prayayau sa dhanurdhunvan khaḍgī carmī śarāsanī ॥34॥
13.30.35: taṁ dr̥ṣṭvā paramaṁ harṣaṁ sudevatanayo yayau,
mene ca manasā dagdhān vaitahavyān sa pārthivaḥ ॥35॥
13.30.38: sarathaḥ sa tu santīrya gaṅgāmāśu parākramī,
13.30.45: yayau bhr̥guṁ ca śaraṇaṁ vītahavyo narādhipaḥ,
abhayaṁ ca dadau tasmai rāje rājan bhr̥gustadā ॥45॥
13.30.47: bho bhoḥ ke’trāśrame santi bhr̥goḥ śiṣyā mahātmanaḥ,
13.30.48: sa taṁ viditvā tu bhr̥gurniścakrāmāśramāt tadā,
13.30.49: uvāca cainaṁ rājendra kiṁ kāryaṁ brūhi pārthiva,
13.30.50: tasya putrairhi me kr̥tsno brahman vaṁśaḥ praṇāśitaḥ ॥50॥
13.30.53: nehāsti kṣatriyaḥ kaścit sarve hīme dvijātayaḥ,
etat tu vacanaṁ śrutvā bhr̥gostathyaṁ pratardanaḥ ॥53॥
13.30.55: ya eṣa rājā vīryeṇa svajātiṁ tyājito mayā,
anujānīhi māṁ brahman dhyāyasva ca śivena mām ॥55॥
13.30.56: tyājito hi mayā jātimeṣa rājā bhr̥gūdvaha,
13.30.60: yatra gr̥tsamado rājan brāhmaṇaiḥ sa mahīyate,
13.30.62: vitatyasya sutaḥ satyaḥ santaḥ satyasya cātmajaḥ ॥62॥
13.30.63: prakāśasya ca vāgindro babhūva jayatāṁ varaḥ ॥63॥
13.30.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate anuśāsanaparvaṇi dānadharmaparvaṇi vītahavyopākhyānaṁ nāma triṁśo’dhyāyaḥ ॥30॥
13.31.1: ke pūjyā vai triloke’smin mānavā bharatarṣabha,
vistareṇa tadācakṣva na hi tr̥pyāmi kathyataḥ ॥1॥
13.31.6: sthāṇuṁ skandaṁ tathā lakṣmīṁ viṣṇuṁ brahmāṇameva ca ॥6॥
13.31.7: satataṁ ye namasyanti tān namasyāmyahaṁ vibho ॥7॥
13.31.10: samyag yajanti ye ceṣṭīḥ kṣāntā dāntā jitendriyāḥ,
satyaṁ dharmaṁ kṣitiṁ gāśca tān namasyāmi yādava ॥10॥
13.31.11: ye vai tapasi vartante vane mūlaphalāśanāḥ,
13.31.13: ye vedaṁ prāpya durdharṣā vāgmino brahmacāriṇaḥ,
13.31.16: suvratā munayo ye ca brāhmaṇāḥ satyasaṅgarāḥ,
13.31.17: niḥsukhā nirdhanā ye tu tān namasyāmi yādava ॥17॥
13.31.18: ye vedaṁ prāpya durdharṣā vāgmino brahmavādinaḥ ॥18॥
13.31.19: ahiṁsāniratā ye ca ye ca satyavratā narāḥ,
13.31.26: tasmāt tvamapi vārṣṇeya dvijān pūjaya nityadā,
pūjitāḥ pūjanārhā hi sukhaṁ dāsyanti te’nagha ॥26॥
13.31.27: asmillom̐ke sadā hyete paratra ca sukhapradāḥ,
carante mānyamānā vai pradāsyanti sukhaṁ tava ॥27॥
13.31.28: ye sarvātithayo nityaṁ goṣu ca brāhmaṇeṣu ca,
13.31.29: nityaṁ śamaparā ye ca tathā ye cānasūyakāḥ,
13.31.30: sarvān devān namasyanti ye caikaṁ vedamāśritāḥ,
13.31.35: mātāpitrorguruṣu ca samyag vartanti ye sadā,
13.31.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate anuśāsanaparvaṇi dānadharmaparvaṇi kr̥ṣṇanāradasaṁvāde ekatriṁśo’dhyāyaḥ ॥31॥
13.32.2: kiṁ tasya bharataśreṣṭha phalaṁ bhavati tattvataḥ ॥2॥
13.32.6: bhayaṁ te sumahat kasmāt kutra kiṁ vā kr̥taṁ tvayā,
13.32.9: tyajeyaṁ bhava viśrabdhaḥ kapota na bhayaṁ tava ॥9॥
13.32.11: māṁsaṁ ca rudhiraṁ cāsya majjā medaśca me hitam,
13.32.12: tr̥ṣṇā me bādhate’tyugrā kṣudhā nirdahatīva mām,
muñcainaṁ na hi śakṣyāmi rājan mandayituṁ kṣudhām ॥12॥
13.32.14: yadi svaviṣaye rājan prabhustvaṁ rakṣaṇe nr̥ṇām,
13.32.16: prabhutvaṁ hi parākramya samyak pakṣahareṣu te,
13.32.17: śrutvā śyenasya tad vākyaṁ rājarṣirvismayaṁ gataḥ,
13.32.18: govr̥ṣo vā varāho vā mr̥go vā mahiṣo’pi vā,
13.32.19: na muñcati mamāṅgāni dvijo’yaṁ paśya vai dvija ॥19॥
13.32.20: na varāhaṁ na cokṣāṇaṁ na cānyān vividhān dvijān,
13.32.21: yastu me vihito bhakṣyaḥ svayaṁ devaiḥ sanātanaḥ,
13.32.22: tatastvaṁ me prayacchādya svamāṁsaṁ tulayā dhr̥tam ॥22॥
13.32.26: niruddhaṁ gaganaṁ sarvaṁ śubhraṁ meghaiḥ samantataḥ ॥26॥
13.32.27: mahī pracalitā cāsīt tasya satyena karmaṇā,
13.32.28: tathāpi na samastena kapotena babhūva ha ॥28॥
13.32.34: sa rājarṣirgataḥ svargaṁ karmaṇā tena śāśvatam,
śaraṇāgateṣu caivaṁ tvaṁ kuru sarvaṁ yudhiṣṭhira ॥34॥
13.32.36: kiṁ na prāptaṁ bhavet tena svavyājeneha karmaṇā ॥36॥
13.32.39: pūtātmā vai bhavet loke śr̥ṇuyād yaśca nityaśaḥ ॥39॥
13.32.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate anuśāsanaparvaṇi dānadharmaparvaṇi śyenakapotasaṁvāde dvātriṁśo’dhyāyaḥ ॥32॥
13.33.1: kiṁ rājñaḥ sarvakr̥tyānāṁ garīyaḥ syāt pitāmaha,
kurvan kiṁ karma nr̥patirubhau lokau samaśnute ॥1॥
13.33.6: teṣu śānteṣu tad rāṣṭraṁ sarvameva virājate ॥6॥
13.33.7: te pūjyāste namaskāryā mānyāste pitaro yathā,
13.33.17: yamiccheyuḥ sa rājā syād ye neṣṭaḥ sa parābhavet ॥17॥
13.33.18: satyaṁ bravīmi te rājan vinaśyeyurna saṁśayaḥ ॥18॥
13.33.19: parikupyanti te rājan satataṁ dviṣatāṁ dvijāḥ ॥19॥
13.33.20: brāhmaṇā yaṁ praśaṁsanti puruṣaḥ sa pravardhate,
13.33.23: śreyān parājayastebhyo na jayo jayatāṁ vara ॥23॥
13.33.24: yastu sarvamidaṁ hanyād brāhmaṇaṁ ca na tatsamam,
13.33.26: na sa jāto’janiṣyad vā pr̥thivyāmiha kaścana,
13.33.27: durdharā pr̥thivī rājan durjayā brāhmaṇā bhuvi ॥27॥
13.33.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate anuśāsanaparvaṇi dānadharmaparvaṇi brāhmaṇapraśaṁsā nāma trayastriṁśo’dhyāyaḥ ॥33॥
13.34.3: jāyatāṁ brahmavarcasvī rāṣṭre vai brāhmaṇaḥ śuciḥ ॥3॥
13.34.5: vāsayeta gr̥he rājan na tasmāt paramasti vai,
13.34.7: na tasyāśnanti pitaro yasya viprā na bhuñjate ॥7॥
13.34.8: brāhmaṇeṣu tu tuṣṭeṣu prīyante pitaraḥ sadā ॥8॥
13.34.9: tathaiva devatā rājan nātra kāryā vicāraṇā,
tathaiva te’pi prīyante yeṣāṁ bhavati taddhaviḥ ॥9॥
13.34.10: na ca pretya vinaśyanti gacchanti ca parāṁ gatim,
13.34.11: brāhmaṇādeva tad bhūtaṁ prabhavanti yataḥ prajāḥ ॥11॥
13.34.12: yataścāyaṁ prabhavati pretya yatra ca gacchati,
vedaiṣa mārgaṁ svargasya tathaiva narakasya ca ॥12॥
13.34.13: brāhmaṇo bharataśreṣṭha svadharmaṁ caiva veda yaḥ ॥13॥
13.34.14: ye cainamanuvartante te na yānti parābhavam,
na te pretya vinaśyanti gacchanti na parābhavam ॥14॥
13.34.15: yad brāhmaṇamukhāt prāptaṁ pratigr̥hṇanti vai vacaḥ,
13.34.16: kṣatriyāṇāṁ pratapatāṁ tejasā ca balena ca,
brāhmaṇeṣveva śāmyanti tejāṁsi ca balāni ca ॥16॥
13.34.19: yat kiñcit kathyate loke śrūyate paṭhyate’pi vā,
13.34.21: mātaraṁ sarvabhūtānāṁ pr̥cche tvāṁ saṁśayaṁ śubhe,
kenasvit karmaṇā pāpaṁ vyapohati naro gr̥hī ॥21॥
13.34.23: iti māṁ nāradaḥ prāha satataṁ sarvabhūtaye ॥23॥
13.34.25: brāhmaṇā yaṁ praśaṁsanti sa manuṣyaḥ pravardhate,
atha yo brāhmaṇān kruṣṭaḥ parābhavati so’cirāt ॥25॥
13.34.27: paśya candre kr̥taṁ lakṣma samudro lavaṇodakaḥ,
13.34.29: icchan kīrtiṁ ca bhūtiṁ ca lokāṁśca madhusūdana,
13.34.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate anuśāsanaparvaṇi dānadharmaparvaṇi pr̥thvīvāsudevasaṁvāde catustriṁśo’dhyāyaḥ ॥34॥
13.35.4: sr̥ṣṭvā dvijātīn dhātā hi yathāpūrvaṁ samādadhat ॥4॥
13.35.5: gupto gopāyate brahmā śreyo vastena śobhanam ॥5॥
13.35.6: svameva kurvatāṁ karma śrīrvo brāhmī bhaviṣyati,
13.35.7: na śaudraṁ karma kartavyaṁ brāhmaṇena vipaścitā,
śaudraṁ hi kurvataḥ karma dharmaḥ samuparudhyate ॥7॥
13.35.11: yaccaiva mānuṣe loke yacca deveṣu kiñcana,
sarvaṁ tu tapasā sādhyaṁ jñānena niyamena ca ॥11॥
13.35.20: adhāryā setunā gaṅgā durjayā brāhmaṇā bhuvi ॥20॥
13.35.23: pratigrahaṁ ye neccheyustebhyo rakṣyaṁ tvayā nr̥pa ॥23॥
13.35.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate anuśāsanaparvaṇi dānadharmaparvaṇi brāhmaṇapraśaṁsāyāṁ pañcatriṁśo’dhyāyaḥ ॥35॥
13.36.3: śreṣṭhaṁ tvāṁ kena manyante tad vai prabrūhi tattvataḥ ॥3॥
13.36.4: nāsūyāmi yadā viprān brāhmameva ca me matam,
13.36.6: te viśrabdhāḥ prabhāṣante sampr̥cchante ca māṁ sadā,
13.36.11: yuddhaṁ pitā me hr̥ṣṭātmā vismitaḥ samapadyata ॥11॥
13.36.12: dr̥ṣṭvā ca brāhmaṇānāṁ tu mahimānaṁ mahātmanām,
13.36.15: api ca jñānasampannaḥ sarvān vedān piturgr̥he,
ślāghamāna ivādhīyād grāmya ityeva taṁ viduḥ ॥15॥
13.36.17: garbheṇa duṣyate kanyā gr̥havāsena ca dvijaḥ ॥17॥
13.36.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate anuśāsanaparvaṇi dānadharmaparvaṇi brāhmaṇapraśaṁsāyāmindraśambarasaṁvāde ṣaṭtriṁśo’dhyāyaḥ ॥36॥
13.37.1: dūrādabhyāgataṁ cāpi kiṁ pātraṁ syāt pitāmaha ॥1॥
13.37.2: yo yo yāceta yat kiñcit sarvaṁ dadyāma ityapi ॥2॥
13.37.5: pātraṁ vidyāt tu tattvena yasmai dattaṁ na santapet ॥5॥
13.37.10: apūrvaṁ caiva pūrvaṁ ca tatpātraṁ mānamarhati ॥10॥
13.37.13: ākroṣṭā cātivaktā ca brāhmaṇānāṁ sadaiva hi ॥13॥
13.37.14: boddhavyastādr̥śastāta naraṁ śvānaṁ hi taṁ viduḥ ॥14॥
13.37.15: yathā śvā bhaṣituṁ caiva hantuṁ caivāvasajjate,
13.37.18: evaṁ gr̥hasthaḥ karmāṇi kurvan dharmānna hīyate ॥18॥
13.37.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate anuśāsanaparvaṇi dānadharmaparvaṇi pātraparīkṣāyāṁ saptatriṁśo’dhyāyaḥ ॥37॥
13.38.1: striyo hi mūlaṁ doṣāṇāṁ laghucittā hi tāḥ smr̥tāḥ ॥1॥
13.38.4: saṁśayo hr̥di kaścinme brūhi tanme sumadhyame ॥4॥
13.38.5: viṣaye sati vakṣyāmi samarthaṁ manyase ca mām ॥5॥
13.38.7: pratyuvāca na śakṣyāmi strī satī nindituṁ striyaḥ ॥7॥
13.38.8: na māmarhasi devarṣe niyoktuṁ kārya īdr̥śe ॥8॥
13.38.9: tāmuvāca sa devarṣiḥ satyaṁ vada sumadhyame,
mr̥ṣāvāde bhaved doṣaḥ satye doṣo na vidyate ॥9॥
13.38.11: maryādāsu na tiṣṭhanti sa doṣaḥ strīṣu nārada ॥11॥
13.38.12: na strībhyaḥ kiñcidanyad vai pāpīyastaramasti vai,
striyo hi mūlaṁ doṣāṇāṁ tathā tvamapi vettha ha ॥12॥
13.38.14: pāpīyaso narān yad vai lajjāṁ tyaktvā bhajāmahe ॥14॥
13.38.15: striyaṁ hi yaḥ prārthayate saṁnikarṣaṁ ca gacchati,
13.38.20: yāśca śaśvad bahumatā rakṣyante dayitāḥ striyaḥ,
13.38.21: paṅguṣvatha ca devarṣe ye cānye kutsitā narāḥ,
13.38.22: apyanyonyaṁ pravartante na hi tiṣṭhinti bhartr̥ṣu ॥22॥
13.38.23: alābhāt puruṣāṇāṁ hi bhayāt parijanasya ca,
13.38.26: dr̥ṣṭvaiva puruṣaṁ hr̥dyaṁ yoniḥ praklidyate striyāḥ ॥26॥
13.38.28: na kāmabhogān vipulān nālaṅkārān na saṁśrayān,
13.38.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate anuśāsanaparvaṇi dānadharmaparvaṇi pañcacūḍānāradasaṁvāde aṣṭatriṁśo’dhyāyaḥ ॥38॥
13.39.1: ime vai mānavā loke strīṣu sajjantyabhīkṣṇaśaḥ,
13.39.3: striyo vā keṣu rajyante virajyante ca tāḥ punaḥ ॥3॥
13.39.4: iti tāḥ puruṣavyāghra kathaṁ śakyāstu rakṣitum,
13.39.5: na cāsāṁ mucyate kaścit puruṣo hastamāgataḥ ॥5॥
13.39.6: śambarasya ca yā māyā māyā yā namucerapi ॥6॥
13.39.8: uśanā veda yacchāstraṁ yacca veda br̥haspatiḥ ॥8॥
13.39.9: strībuddhyā na viśiṣyeta tāstu rakṣyāḥ kathaṁ naraiḥ,
13.39.10: iti yāstāḥ kathaṁ vīra saṁrakṣyāḥ puruṣairiha,
13.39.12: apāstāśca tathā rājan vikurvanti manaḥ striyaḥ,
imāḥ prajā mahābāho dhārmikya iti naḥ śrutam ॥12॥
13.39.13: kastāḥ śakto rakṣituṁ syāditi me saṁśayo mahān ॥13॥
13.39.13d1: yadi śakyā kuruśreṣṭha rakṣā tāsāṁ kadācana.
13.39.14: kartuṁ vā kr̥tapūrvaṁ vā tanme vyākhyātumarhasi ॥14॥
13.39.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate anuśāsanaparvaṇi dānadharmaparvaṇi strīsvabhāvakathane ekonacatvāriṁśo’dhyāyaḥ ॥39॥
13.40.1: yathā bravīṣi kauravya nārīṁ prati janādhipa ॥1॥
13.40.2: yathā rakṣā kr̥tā pūrvaṁ vipulena mahātmanā ॥2॥
13.40.3: yadarthaṁ tacca te tāta pravakṣyāmi narādhipa ॥3॥
13.40.4: na hi strībhyaḥ paraṁ putra pāpīyaḥ kiñcidasti vai,
agnirhi pramadā dīpto māyāśca mayajā vibho ॥4॥
13.40.5: prajā imā mahābāho dhārmikya iti naḥ śrutam ॥5॥
13.40.6: svayaṁ gacchanti devatvaṁ tato devāniyād bhayam,
13.40.8: pūrvasarge tu kaunteya sādhvyo nārya ihābhavan ॥8॥
13.40.9: tābhyaḥ kāmān yathākāmaṁ prādāddhi sa pitāmahaḥ ॥9॥
13.40.10: tāḥ kāmalubdhāḥ pramadāḥ prabādhante narān sadā,
krodhaṁ kāmasya deveśaḥ sahāyaṁ cāsr̥jat prabhuḥ ॥10॥
13.40.11: na ca strīṇāṁ kriyāḥ kāściditi dharmo vyavasthitaḥ ॥11॥
13.40.13: durvāgbhāvaṁ ratiṁ caiva dadau strībhyaḥ prajāpatiḥ,
na tāsāṁ rakṣaṇaṁ śakyaṁ kartuṁ puṁsāṁ kathañcana ॥13॥
13.40.15: na śakyā rakṣituṁ nāryastā hi nityamasaṁyatāḥ,
13.40.16: yathā rakṣā kr̥tā pūrvaṁ vipulena gurustriyāḥ,
13.40.20: tasmād balena bhāryāyā rakṣaṇaṁ sa cakāra ha,
13.40.22: āhūya dayitaṁ śiṣyaṁ vipulaṁ prāha bhārgavam,
13.40.23: yataḥ prārthayate nityaṁ tāṁ rakṣasva yathābalam,
apramattena te bhāvyaṁ sadā prati purandaram ॥23॥
13.40.24: sa hi rūpāṇi kurute vividhāni bhr̥gūttama,
13.40.31: gauraṁ śyāmaṁ ca kr̥ṣṇaṁ ca varṇaṁ vikurute punaḥ ॥31॥
13.40.36: na śakyamasya grahaṇaṁ kartuṁ vipula kenacit ॥36॥
13.40.37: api viśvakr̥tā tāta yena sr̥ṣṭamidaṁ jagat,
13.40.42: kiṁ nu śakyaṁ mayā kartuṁ gurudārābhirakṣaṇe ॥42॥
13.40.45: athavā pauruṣeṇeyaṁ na śakyā rakṣituṁ mayā ॥45॥
13.40.48: na ceyaṁ rakṣituṁ śakyā yathānyā pramadā nr̥bhiḥ ॥48॥
13.40.49: avaśyaṁ karaṇīyaṁ hi guroriha hi śāsanam ॥49॥
13.40.50: yadi tvetadahaṁ kuryāmāścaryaṁ syāt kr̥taṁ mayā,
13.40.52: yathā hi śūnyāṁ pathikaḥ sabhāmadhyāvaset pathi ॥52॥
13.40.54: tapaśca vipulaṁ dr̥ṣṭvā gurorātmana eva ca ॥54॥
13.40.55: iti niścitya manasā rakṣāṁ prati sa bhārgavaḥ,
anvatiṣṭhat paraṁ yatnaṁ yathā tacchr̥ṇu pārthiva ॥55॥
13.40.59: uvāsa rakṣaṇe yukto na ca sā tamabuddhyata ॥59॥
13.40.60: yaṁ kālaṁ nāgato rājan gurustasya mahātmanaḥ,
kratuṁ samāpya svagr̥haṁ taṁ kālaṁ so’bhyarakṣata ॥60॥
13.40.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate anuśāsanaparvaṇi dānadharmaparvaṇi vipulopākhyāne catvāriṁśo’dhyāyaḥ ॥40॥
13.41.6: utthātukāmā tu satī viṣṭabdhā vipulena sā,
13.41.8: tat samprāptaṁ hi māṁ subhru purā kālo’tivartate ॥8॥
13.41.10: na śaśāka ca sā rājan pratyutthātumaninditā,
vaktuṁ ca nāśakad rājan viṣṭabdhā vipulena sā ॥10॥
13.41.12: tāṁ nirvikārāṁ dr̥ṣṭvā tu punareva śacīpatiḥ ॥12॥
13.41.13: ehyehīti tataḥ sā tu prativaktumiyeṣa tam ॥13॥
13.41.14: sa tāṁ vācaṁ guroḥ patnyā vipulaḥ paryavartayat,
13.41.15: vrīḍitā sā tu tadvākyamuktvā paravaśā tadā ॥15॥
13.41.18: sa taṁ ghoreṇa tapasā yuktaṁ dr̥ṣṭvā purandaraḥ ॥18॥
13.41.21: kiṁ nu tadvismr̥taṁ śakra na tanmanasi te sthitam,
13.41.22: mameyaṁ rakṣyate mūḍha gaccha pāpa yathāgatam ॥22॥
13.41.23: nāhaṁ tvāmadya mūḍhātman daheyaṁ hi svatejasā,
13.41.24: sa ca ghoratamo dhīmān gururme pāpacetasam,
13.41.25: naivaṁ tu śakra kartavyaṁ punarmānyāśca te dvijāḥ,
13.41.26: māvamaṁsthā na tapasā nasādhyaṁ nāma kiñcana ॥26॥
13.41.27: tat śrutvā vacanaṁ śakro vipulasya mahātmanaḥ,
13.41.30: abhivādya ca śāntātmā sa guruṁ guruvatsalaḥ,
13.41.32: tat śrutvā sa munistuṣṭo vipulasya pratāpavān,
13.41.33: dharme ca sthiratāṁ dr̥ṣṭvā sādhu sādhvityabhāṣata ॥33॥
13.41.35: sthitiṁ ca dharme jagrāha sa tasmād guruvatsalaḥ,
13.41.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate anuśāsanaparvaṇi dānadharmaparvaṇi vipulopākhyāne ekacatvāriṁśo’dhyāyaḥ ॥41॥
13.42.2: sa tena karmaṇā spardhan pr̥thivīṁ pr̥thivīpate,
13.42.3: ubhau lokau jitau cāpi tathaivāmanyata prabhuḥ,
karmaṇā tena kauravya tapasā vipulena ca ॥3॥
13.42.5: etasminneva kāle tu divyā kācid varāṅganā,
13.42.8: tasyā hi bhaginī tāta jyeṣṭhā nāmnā prabhāvatī,
13.42.13: sa tathetyabravīd rājaṁstaṁ ca deśaṁ jagāma ha ॥13॥
13.42.14: yasmin deśe tu tānyāsan patitāni nabhastalāt,
13.42.15: sa tatastāni jagrāha divyāni rucirāṇi ca,
13.42.16: tadā jagāma tūrṇaṁ ca campāṁ campakamālinīm ॥16॥
13.42.17: sa vane nirjane tāta dadarśa mithunaṁ nr̥ṇām,
13.42.18: ekastu na tadā rājaṁścakratuḥ kalahaṁ tataḥ ॥18॥
13.42.19: neti neti ca tau rājan parasparamathocatuḥ ॥19॥
13.42.21: vipulasya pare loke yā gatiḥ sā bhavediti ॥21॥
13.42.23: mithunasyāsya kiṁ me syāt kr̥taṁ pāpaṁ yathā gatiḥ,
13.42.26: kurvataḥ śapathaṁ tena yaḥ kr̥to mithunena tu,
13.42.28: etat śrutvā tu vipulo nāpaśyad dharmasaṅkaram,
13.42.31: vidhāya na mayā coktaṁ satyametad gurostathā ॥31॥
13.42.32: amanyata mahābhāga tathā tacca na saṁśayaḥ ॥32॥
13.42.33: sa campāṁ nagarīmetya puṣpāṇi gurave dadau,
pūjayāmāsa ca guruṁ vidhivat sa gurupriyaḥ ॥33॥
13.42.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate anuśāsanaparvaṇi dānadharmaparvaṇi vipulopākhyāne dvicatvāriṁśo’dhyāyaḥ ॥42॥
13.43.1: devaśarmā mahātejā yat tat śr̥ṇu janādhipa ॥1॥
13.43.2: kiṁ te vipula dr̥ṣṭaṁ vai tasmin śiṣya mahāvane,
te tvāṁ jānanti vipula ātmā ca rucireva ca ॥2॥
13.43.3: brahmarṣe mithunaṁ kiṁ tat ke ca te puruṣā vibho,
ye māṁ jānanti tattvena yanmāṁ tvaṁ paripr̥cchasi ॥3॥
13.43.4: yad vai tanmithunaṁ brahmannahorātraṁ hi viddhi tat,
cakravat parivarteta tat te jānāti duṣkr̥tam ॥4॥
13.43.5: ye ca te puruṣā vipra akṣairdīvyanti hr̥ṣṭavat,
13.43.6: na māṁ kaścid vijānīta iti kr̥tvā na viśvaset,
naro rahasi pāpātmā pāpakaṁ karma vai dvija ॥6॥
13.43.7: kurvāṇaṁ hi naraṁ karma pāpaṁ rahasi sarvadā,
13.43.8: tathaiva hi bhaveyuste lokāḥ pāpakr̥to yathā,
kr̥tvā nācakṣataḥ karma mama tacca yathākr̥tam ॥8॥
13.43.9: te tvāṁ harṣasmitaṁ dr̥ṣṭvā guroḥ karmānivedakam,
13.43.10: puruṣe pāpakaṁ karma śubhaṁ vā śubhakarmiṇaḥ ॥10॥
13.43.11: tat tvayā mama yat karma vyabhicārād bhayātmakam,
13.43.12: tenaiva hi bhaveyuste lokāḥ pāpakr̥to yathā,
kr̥tvā nācakṣataḥ karma mama yacca tvayā kr̥tam ॥12॥
13.43.13: tvayāśakyā ca durvr̥ttyā rakṣituṁ pramadā dvija,
na ca tvaṁ kr̥tavān kiñcidataḥ prīto’smi tena te ॥13॥
13.43.13d1: manodoṣavihīnānāṁ na doṣaḥ syāt tathā tava,
13.43.15: sajjanti puruṣe nāryaḥ puṁsāṁ so’rthaśca puṣkalaḥ,
13.43.16: rakṣitā ca tvayā putra mama cāpi niveditā,
ahaṁ te prītimāṁstāta svasthaḥ svargaṁ gamiṣyasi ॥16॥
13.43.19: tasmād bravīmi pārtha tvāṁ striyo rakṣyāḥ sadaiva ca,
ubhayaṁ dr̥śyate tāsu satataṁ sādhvasādhu ca ॥19॥
13.43.22: evametāsu rakṣā vai śakyā kartuṁ mahātmabhiḥ,
anyathā rājaśārdūla na śakyā rakṣituṁ striyaḥ ॥22॥
13.43.23: nāsāmasti priyo nāma maithune saṅgameti yaḥ ॥23॥
13.43.27: tenaikena tu rakṣā vai vipulena kr̥tā striyāḥ,
13.43.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate anuśāsanaparvaṇi dānadharmaparvaṇi vipulopākhyāne tricatvāriṁśo’dhyāyaḥ ॥43॥
13.44.3: śīlavr̥tte samājñāya vidyāṁ yoniṁ ca karma ca,
13.44.5: śiṣṭānāṁ kṣatriyāṇāṁ ca dharma eṣa sanātanaḥ,
13.44.6: abhipretā ca yā yasya tasmai deyā yudhiṣṭhira,
13.44.7: dhanena bahudhā krītvā sampralobhya ca bāndhavān,
13.44.8: hatvā chittvā ca śīrṣāṇi rudatāṁ rudatīṁ gr̥hāt,
13.44.9: pañcānāṁ tu trayo dharmyā dvāvadharmyau yudhiṣṭhira,
13.44.10: brāhmaḥ kṣātro’tha gāndharva ete dharmyā nararṣabha,
pr̥thag vā yadi vā miśrāḥ kartavyā nātra saṁśayaḥ ॥10॥
13.44.11: tisro bhāryā brāhmaṇasya dve bhārye kṣatriyasya tu,
vaiśyaḥ svajātyāṁ vindeta tāsvapatyaṁ samaṁ bhavet ॥11॥
13.44.12: brāhmaṇī tu bhavejjyeṣṭhā kṣatriyā kṣatriyasya tu,
13.44.15: yasyāstu na bhaved bhrātā pitā vā bharatarṣabha,
nopayaccheta tāṁ jātu putrikādharmiṇī hi sā ॥15॥
13.44.17: prajā na hīyate tasyā ratiśca bharatarṣabha,
13.44.18: asapiṇḍā ca yā māturasagotrā ca yā pituḥ,
13.44.20: pāṇigrahītā cānyaḥ syāt kasya bhāryā pitāmaha,
13.44.21: yat kiñcit karma mānuṣyaṁ saṁsthānāya pradr̥śyate,
13.44.24: dharmato yāṁ prayacchanti yāṁ ca krīṇanti bhārata ॥24॥
13.44.25: tathā siddhyanti te mantrā nādattāyāḥ kathañcana ॥25॥
13.44.30: tadetat sarvamācakṣva na hi tr̥pyāmi kathyatām ॥30॥
13.44.31: naiva niṣṭhākaraṁ śulkaṁ jñātvā’’sīt tena nāhr̥tam,
na hi śulkaparāḥ santaḥ kanyāṁ dadati karhicit ॥31॥
13.44.33: yacca tāṁ ca dadatyevaṁ na śulkaṁ vikrayo na saḥ,
13.44.34: dāsyāmi bhavate kanyāmiti pūrvaṁ na bhāṣitam,
ye cāhurye ca nāhurye ye cāvaśyaṁ vadantyuta ॥34॥
13.44.35: kanyāvaraḥ purā datto marudbhiriti naḥ śrutam ॥35॥
13.44.37: samīkṣya ca bahūn doṣān saṁvāsād viddhi pāṇayoḥ,
yathā niṣṭhākaraṁ śulkaṁ na jātvāsīt tathā śr̥ṇu ॥37॥
13.44.38: jitvā ca māgadhān sarvān kāśīnatha ca kosalān ॥38॥
13.44.39: kanyā gr̥hītā tatraiva visarjyā iti me pitā ॥39॥
13.44.41: ācāraṁ tattvato vettumicchāmi ca punaḥ punaḥ ॥41॥
13.44.42: tato mayaivamukte tu vākye dharmabhr̥tāṁ varaḥ,
13.44.43: yadi vaḥ śulkato niṣṭhā na pāṇigrahaṇāt tathā,
13.44.44: na hi dharmavidaḥ prāhuḥ pramāṇaṁ vākyataḥ smr̥tam,
yeṣāṁ vai śulkato niṣṭhā na pāṇigrahaṇāt tathā ॥44॥
13.44.45: prasiddhaṁ bhāṣitaṁ dāne naiṣāṁ pratyāyakaṁ punaḥ,
ye manyante krayaṁ śulkaṁ na te dharmavido narāḥ ॥45॥
13.44.46: na caitebhyaḥ pradātavyā na voḍhavyā tathāvidhā,
na hyeva bhāryā kretavyā na vikrayyā kathañcana ॥46॥
13.44.47: ye ca krīṇanti dāsīṁ ca vikrīṇanti tathaiva ca,
bhavet teṣāṁ tathā niṣṭhā lubdhānāṁ pāpacetasām ॥47॥
13.44.49: tannaśchindhi mahāprājña tvaṁ hi vai prājñasammataḥ ॥49॥
13.44.51: yatreṣṭaṁ tatra deyā syānnātra kāryā vicāraṇā,
13.44.52: devaraṁ praviśet kanyā tapyed vāpi tapaḥ punaḥ,
13.44.53: iti ye saṁvadantyatra ta etaṁ niścayaṁ viduḥ ॥53॥
13.44.55: pāṇigrahasya bhāryā syād yasya cādbhiḥ pradīyate,
iti deyaṁ vadantyatra ta enaṁ niścayaṁ viduḥ ॥55॥
13.44.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate anuśāsanaparvaṇi dānadharmaparvaṇi vivāhadharmakathane catuścatvāriṁśo’dhyāyaḥ ॥44॥
13.45.1: tatra kā pratipattiḥ syāt tanme brūhi pitāmaha ॥1॥
13.45.2: yā putrakasya r̥ddhasya pratipālyā tadā bhavet,
13.45.4: tat tasyānye praśaṁsanti dharmajñā netare janāḥ ॥4॥
13.45.5: etat tu nāpare cakrurapare jātu sādhavaḥ,
13.45.8: asadeva hi dharmasya pradānaṁ dharma āsuraḥ,
13.45.9: bhāryāpatyorhi sambandhaḥ strīpuṁsoḥ svalpa eva tu,
ratiḥ sādhāraṇo dharma iti cāha sa pārthivaḥ ॥9॥
13.45.11: yathaivātmā tathā putraḥ putreṇa duhitā samā,
13.45.12: mātuśca yautakaṁ yat syāt kumārībhāga eva saḥ,
13.45.13: dadāti hi sa piṇḍān vai piturmātāmahasya ca,
13.45.14: anyatra jāmayā sārdhaṁ prajānāṁ putra īhate,
13.45.15: vikrītāsu hi ye putrā bhavanti pitureva te ॥15॥
13.45.18: yo manuṣyaḥ svakaṁ putraṁ vikrīya dhanamicchati,
kanyāṁ vā jīvitārthāya yaḥ śulkena prayacchati ॥18॥
13.45.19: svedaṁ mūtraṁ purīṣaṁ ca tasmin mūḍhaḥ samaśnute ॥19॥
13.45.20: alpo vā bahu vā rājan vikrayastāvadeva saḥ ॥20॥
13.45.22: vaśyāṁ kumārīṁ balato ye tāṁ samupabhuñjate,
13.45.23: anyo’pyatha na vikreyo manuṣyaḥ kiṁ punaḥ prajāḥ,
13.45.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate anuśāsanaparvaṇi dānadharmaparvaṇi vivāhadharme yamagāthā nāma pañcacatvāriṁśo’dhyāyaḥ ॥45॥
13.46.1: yasyāḥ kiñcinnādadate jñātayo na sa vikrayaḥ ॥1॥
13.46.2: sarvaṁ ca pratideyaṁ syāt kanyāyai tadaśeṣataḥ ॥2॥
