13.46.4: yadi vai strī na roceta pumāṁsaṁ na pramodayet,
apramodāt punaḥ puṁsaḥ prajano na pravardhate ॥4॥
13.46.5: striyo yatra ca pūjyante ramante tatra devatāḥ ॥5॥
13.46.6: tadā caitat kulaṁ nāsti yadā śocanti jāmayaḥ ॥6॥
13.46.7: naiva bhānti na vardhante śriyā hīnāni pārthiva ॥7॥
13.46.10: strīpratyayo hi vai dharmo ratibhogāśca kevalāḥ,
13.46.14: pitā rakṣati kaumāre bhartā rakṣati yauvane,
putrāśca sthāvire bhāve na strī svātantryamarhati ॥14॥
13.46.15: śriya etāḥ striyo nāma satkāryā bhūtimicchatā,
pālitā nigr̥hītā ca śrīḥ strī bhavati bhārata ॥15॥
13.46.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate anuśāsanaparvaṇi dānadharmaparvaṇi vivāhadharme strīpraśaṁsā nāma ṣaṭcatvāriṁśo’dhyāyaḥ ॥46॥
13.47.1: atīva saṁśayacchettā bhavān vai prathitaḥ kṣitau ॥1॥
13.47.2: kaścittu saṁśayo me’sti tanme brūhi pitāmaha,
jāte’smin saṁśaye rājan nānyaṁ pr̥cchema kañcana ॥2॥
13.47.4: brāhmaṇī kṣatriyā vaiśyā śūdrā ca ratimicchataḥ ॥4॥
13.47.6: kena vā kiṁ tato hāryaṁ pitr̥vittāt pitāmaha,
13.47.8: brāhmaṇasya bhavecchūdrā na tu dr̥ṣṭāntataḥ smr̥tā ॥8॥
13.47.11: lakṣaṇyaṁ govr̥ṣo yānaṁ yat pradhānatamaṁ bhavet,
13.47.12: śeṣaṁ tu daśadhā kāryaṁ brāhmaṇasvaṁ yudhiṣṭhira,
13.47.16: savarṇāsu tu jātānāṁ samān bhāgān prakalpayet ॥16॥
13.47.17: triṣu varṇeṣu jāto hi brāhmaṇād brāhmaṇo bhavet ॥17॥
13.47.19: tattu dattaṁ haret pitrā nādattaṁ hartumarhati,
avaśyaṁ hi dhanaṁ deyaṁ śūdrāputrāya bhārata ॥19॥
13.47.20: ānr̥śaṁsyaṁ paro dharma iti tasmai pradīyate,
13.47.21: yadyapyeṣa saputraḥ syādaputro yadi vā bhavet,
13.47.22: traivārṣikād yadā bhaktādadhikaṁ syād dvijasya tu,
yajeta tena dravyeṇa na vr̥thā sādhayed dhanam ॥22॥
13.47.23: trisahasraparo dāyaḥ striyai deyo dhanasya vai,
bhartrā tacca dhanaṁ dattaṁ yathārhaṁ bhoktumarhati ॥23॥
13.47.25: striyāstu yad bhavet vittaṁ pitrā dattaṁ yudhiṣṭhira,
brāhmaṇyāstaddharet kanyā yathā putrastathā hi sā ॥25॥
13.47.26: sā hi putrasamā rājan vihitā kurunandana,
evaṁ dharmamanusmr̥tya na vr̥thā sādhayed dhanam ॥26॥
13.47.28: kṣatriyāyāṁ tathaiva syād vaiśyāyāmapi caiva hi ॥28॥
13.47.29: kasmāt tu viṣamaṁ bhāgaṁ bhajeran nr̥pasattama,
yadā sarve trayo varṇāstvayoktā brāhmaṇā iti ॥29॥
13.47.30: proktena caiva nāmnāyaṁ viśeṣaḥ sumahān bhavet ॥30॥
13.47.30d1: tisraḥ kr̥tvā puro bhāryāḥ paścād vindeta brāhmaṇīm.
13.47.31: sā jyeṣṭhā sā ca pūjyā syāt sā ca bhāryā garīyasī ॥31॥
13.47.32: havyaṁ kavyaṁ ca yaccānyad dharmayuktaṁ gr̥he bhavet ॥32॥
13.47.33: na tasyāṁ jātu tiṣṭhantyāmanyā tat kartumarhati,
brāhmaṇī tveva kuryād vā brāhmaṇasya yudhiṣṭhira ॥33॥
13.47.34: annaṁ pānaṁ ca mālyaṁ ca vāsāṁsyābharaṇāni ca,
brāhmaṇyaitāni deyāni bhartuḥ sā hi garīyasī ॥34॥
13.47.36: atha cedanyathā kuryād yadi kāmād yudhiṣṭhira,
13.47.37: brāhmaṇyāḥ sadr̥śaḥ putraḥ kṣatriyāyāśca yo bhavet,
13.47.38: na tu jātyā samā loke brāhmaṇyāḥ kṣatriyā bhavet,
brāhmaṇyāḥ prathamaḥ putro bhūyān syād rājasattama ॥38॥
13.47.39: yathā na sadr̥śī jātu brāhmaṇyāḥ kṣatriyā bhavet ॥39॥
13.47.40: kṣatriyāyāstathā vaiśyā na jātu sadr̥śī bhavet,
śrīśca rājyaṁ ca kośaśca kṣatriyāṇāṁ yudhiṣṭhira ॥40॥
13.47.41: vihitaṁ dr̥śyate rājan sāgarāntāṁ ca medinīm,
kṣatriyo hi svadharmeṇa śriyaṁ prāpnoti bhūyasīm,
rājā daṇḍadharo rājan rakṣā nānyatra kṣatriyāt ॥41॥
13.47.46: uktaṁ te vidhivad rājan brāhmaṇasya pitāmaha,
itareṣāṁ tu varṇānāṁ kathaṁ vai niyamo bhavet ॥46॥
13.47.47: tr̥tīyā ca bhavecchūdrā na tu dr̥ṣṭāntataḥ smr̥tā ॥47॥
13.47.48: eṣa eva kramo hi syāt kṣatriyāṇāṁ yudhiṣṭhira,
aṣṭadhā tu bhavet kāryaṁ kṣatriyasvaṁ janādhipa ॥48॥
13.47.49: yuddhāvahārikaṁ yacca pituḥ syāt sa haret tu tat ॥49॥
13.47.50: so’pi dattaṁ haret pitrā nādattaṁ hartumarhati ॥50॥
13.47.51: ekaiva hi bhaved bhāryā vaiśyasya kurunandana,
dvitīyā tu bhavet śūdrā na tu dr̥ṣṭāntataḥ smr̥tā ॥51॥
13.47.53: pañcadhā tu bhavet kāryaṁ vaiśyasvaṁ bharatarṣabha,
13.47.55: so’pi dattaṁ haret pitrā nādattaṁ hartumarhati,
13.47.56: śūdrasya syāt savarṇaiva bhāryā nānyā kathañcana,
13.47.58: jyeṣṭhasya bhāgo jyeṣṭhaḥ syādekāṁśo yaḥ pradhānataḥ,
13.47.61: evaṁ jātiṣu sarvāsu savarṇaḥ śreṣṭhatāṁ gataḥ,
13.47.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate anuśāsanaparvaṇi dānadharmaparvaṇi vivāhadharme rikthavibhāgo nāma saptacatvāriṁśo’dhyāyaḥ ॥47॥
13.48.1: arthāllobhād vā kāmād vā varṇānāṁ cāpyaniścayāt,
13.48.2: ko dharmaḥ kāni karmāṇi tanme brūhi pitāmaha ॥2॥
13.48.3: asr̥jat sa hi yajñārthe pūrvameva prajāpatiḥ ॥3॥
13.48.8: dve cāpi bhārye vaiśyasya dvayorātmāsya jāyate,
13.48.16: te cāpi sadr̥śaṁ varṇaṁ janayanti svayoniṣu,
13.48.17: yathā śūdro’pi brāhmaṇyāṁ jantuṁ bāhyaṁ prasūyate,
13.48.18: pratilomaṁ tu vardhante bāhyād bāhyatarāt punaḥ,
13.48.29: pracchannā vā prakāśā vā veditavyāḥ svakarmabhiḥ ॥29॥
13.48.34: gobrāhmaṇāya sāhāyyaṁ kurvāṇā vai na saṁśayaḥ,
13.48.35: bhavanti manujavyāghra tatra me nāsti saṁśayaḥ ॥35॥
13.48.42: pitryaṁ vā bhajate śīlaṁ mātr̥jaṁ vā tathobhayam,
na kathañcana saṅkīrṇaḥ prakr̥tiṁ svāṁ niyacchati ॥42॥
13.48.44: kule srotasi sañcchanne yasya syād yonisaṅkaraḥ,
13.48.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate anuśāsanaparvaṇi dānadharmaparvaṇi vivāhadharme varṇasaṅkarakathane aṣṭacatvāriṁśo’dhyāyaḥ ॥48॥
13.49.1: brūhi tāta kuruśreṣṭha varṇānāṁ tvaṁ pr̥thak pr̥thak,
kīdr̥śyāṁ kīdr̥śāścāpi putrāḥ kasya ca ke ca te ॥1॥
13.49.2: atra no muhyatāṁ rājan saṁśayaṁ chettumarhasi ॥2॥
13.49.6: etat sarvaṁ yathātattvaṁ vyākhyātuṁ me tvamarhasi ॥6॥
13.49.7: triṣu varṇeṣu ye putrā brāhmaṇasya yudhiṣṭhira,
varṇayośca dvayoḥ syātāṁ yau rājanyasya bhārata ॥7॥
13.49.9: cāṇḍālo vrātyavaidyau ca brāhmaṇyāṁ kṣatriyāsu ca,
13.49.10: brāhmaṇyāṁ kṣatriyāyāṁ ca kṣatriyasyaika eva tu ॥10॥
13.49.11: putrā hyete na śakyante mithyākartuṁ narādhipa ॥11॥
13.49.12: tulyāvetau sutau kasya sanme brūhi pitāmaha ॥12॥
13.49.13: retajo vā bhavet putrastyakto vā kṣetrajo bhavet,
13.49.14: retajaṁ vidma vai putraṁ kṣetrajasyāgamaḥ katham,
adhyūḍhaṁ vidma vai putraṁ bhittvā tu samayaṁ katham ॥14॥
13.49.15: na tatra kāraṇaṁ retaḥ sa kṣetrasvāmino bhavet ॥15॥
13.49.16: putrakāmo hi putrārthe yāṁ vr̥ṇīte viśāmpate,
kṣetrajaṁ tu pramāṇaṁ syānna vai tatrātmajaḥ sutaḥ ॥16॥
13.49.17: na hyātmā śakyate hantuṁ dr̥ṣṭāntopagato hyasau ॥17॥
13.49.18: na tatra retaḥ kṣetraṁ vā yatra lakṣyeta bhārata ॥18॥
13.49.19: śukraṁ kṣetraṁ pramāṇaṁ vā yatra lakṣyaṁ na bhārata ॥19॥
13.49.20: na cāsya mātāpitarau jñāyetāṁ sa hi kr̥trimaḥ ॥20॥
13.49.21: yo varṇaḥ poṣayet taṁ ca tadvarṇastasya jāyate ॥21॥
13.49.22: kathamasya prayoktavyaḥ saṁskāraḥ kasya vā katham,
deyā kanyā kathaṁ ceti tanme brūhi pitāmaha ॥22॥
13.49.23: ātmavat tasya kurvīta saṁskāraṁ svāmivat tathā,
13.49.24: atha deyā tu kanyā syāt tadvarṇasya yudhiṣṭhira ॥24॥
13.49.28: etat te sarvamākhyātaṁ kiṁ bhūyaḥ śrotumicchasi ॥28॥
13.49.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate anuśāsanaparvaṇi dānadharmaparvaṇi vivāhadharme putrapratinidhikathane ekonapañcāśattamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥49॥
13.50.1: darśane kīdr̥śaḥ snehaḥ saṁvāse ca pitāmaha,
13.50.4: nihatya mānaṁ krodhaṁ ca praharṣaṁ śokameva ca,
13.50.8: gaṅgā ca yamunā caiva saritaśca sarāṁsi ca,
13.50.17: avatīrya tataḥ sarve jālaṁ cakr̥ṣire tadā ॥17॥
13.50.21: taṁ jālenoddhr̥taṁ dr̥ṣṭvā te tadā vedapāragam,
sarve prāñjalayo dāśāḥ śirobhiḥ prāpatan bhuvi ॥21॥
13.50.23: sa munistat tadā dr̥ṣṭvā matsyānāṁ kadanaṁ kr̥tam,
13.50.24: ajñānād yat kr̥taṁ pāpaṁ prasādaṁ tatra naḥ kuru,
karavāma priyaṁ kiṁ te tanno brūhi mahāmune ॥24॥
13.50.25: yo me’dya paramaḥ kāmastaṁ śr̥ṇudhvaṁ samāhitāḥ ॥25॥
13.50.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate anuśāsanaparvaṇi dānadharmaparvaṇi cyavanopākhyāne pañcāśattamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥50॥
13.51.1: nahuṣastu tataḥ śrutvā cyavanaṁ taṁ tathāgatam,
13.51.2: śaucaṁ kr̥tvā yathānyāyaṁ prāñjaliḥ prayato nr̥paḥ,
13.51.3: arcayāmāsa taṁ cāpi tasya rājñaḥ purohitaḥ,
13.51.4: karavāṇi priyaṁ kiṁ te tanme brūhi dvijottama,
sarvaṁ kartāsmi bhagavan yadyapi syāt suduṣkaram ॥4॥
13.51.5: mama mūlyaṁ prayacchaibhyo matsyānāṁ vikrayaiḥ saha ॥5॥
13.51.7: sahasraṁ nāhamarhāmi kiṁ vā tvaṁ manyase nr̥pa,
sadr̥śaṁ dīyatāṁ mūlyaṁ svabuddhyā niścayaṁ kuru ॥7॥
13.51.8: syādidaṁ bhagavan mūlyaṁ kiṁ vānyanmanyate bhavān ॥8॥
13.51.11: rājan nārhāmyahaṁ koṭiṁ bhūyo vāpi mahādyute,
sadr̥śaṁ dīyatāṁ mūlyaṁ brāhmaṇaiḥ saha cintaya ॥11॥
13.51.12: ardhaṁ rājyaṁ samagraṁ vā niṣādebhyaḥ pradīyatām,
13.51.13: ardhaṁ rājyaṁ samagraṁ ca mūlyaṁ nārhāmi pārthiva,
13.51.18: bravītu bhagavān mūlyaṁ maharṣeḥ sadr̥śaṁ bhr̥goḥ,
paritrāyasva māmasmadviṣayaṁ ca kulaṁ ca me ॥18॥
13.51.20: plavo bhava maharṣe tvaṁ kuru mūlyaviniścayam ॥20॥
13.51.21: uvāca harṣayan sarvānamātyān pārthivaṁ ca tam ॥21॥
13.51.21d1: brāhmaṇānāṁ gavāṁ caiva kulamekaṁ dvidhā kr̥tam,
13.51.27: kīrtanaṁ śravaṇaṁ dānaṁ darśanaṁ cāpi pārthiva,
13.51.28: gāvo lakṣmyāḥ sadā mūlaṁ goṣu pāpmā na vidyate,
annameva sadā gāvo devānāṁ paramaṁ haviḥ ॥28॥
13.51.29: gāvo yajñasya netryo vai tathā yajñasya tā mukham ॥29॥
13.51.30: amr̥taṁ hyavyayaṁ divyaṁ kṣaranti ca vahanti ca,
13.51.31: tejasā vapuṣā caiva gāvo vahnisamā bhuvi,
gāvo hi sumahat tejaḥ prāṇināṁ ca sukhapradāḥ ॥31॥
13.51.32: niviṣṭaṁ gokulaṁ yatra śvāsaṁ muñcati nirbhayam,
13.51.33: gāvaḥ svargasya sopānaṁ gāvaḥ svarge’pi pūjitāḥ,
gāvaḥ kāmaduho devyo nānyat kiñcit paraṁ smr̥tam ॥33॥
13.51.34: ityetad goṣu me proktaṁ māhātmyaṁ bharatarṣabha,
13.51.35: darśanaṁ kathanaṁ caiva sahāsmābhiḥ kr̥taṁ mune,
satāṁ sāptapadaṁ maitraṁ prasādaṁ naḥ kuru prabho ॥35॥
13.51.37d1: yā gatirviditā tvadya narake śaraṇaṁ bhavān.
13.51.39: divaṁ gacchata vai kṣipraṁ matsyaiḥ saha jalodbhavaiḥ ॥39॥
13.51.41: tataḥ sa rājā nahuṣo vismitaḥ prekṣya dhīvarān,
13.51.44: tato jagrāha dharme sa sthitimindranibho nr̥paḥ,
13.51.46: niṣādāśca divaṁ jagmuste ca matsyā janādhipa,
nahuṣo’pi varaṁ labdhvā praviveśa svakaṁ puram ॥46॥
13.51.47: etatte kathitaṁ tāta yanmāṁ tvaṁ paripr̥cchasi,
darśane yādr̥śaḥ snehaḥ saṁvāse vā yudhiṣṭhira ॥47॥
13.51.48: kiṁ bhūyaḥ kathyatāṁ vīra kiṁ te hr̥di vivakṣitam ॥48॥
13.51.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate anuśāsanaparvaṇi dānadharmaparvaṇi cyavanopākhyāne ekapañcāśattamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥51॥
13.52.1: taṁ me śr̥ṇu mahābāho śrutvā vyākhyātumarhasi ॥1॥
13.52.4: kauśikācca kathaṁ vaṁśāt kṣatrād vai brāhmaṇo bhavet ॥4॥
13.52.5: rāmasya ca naravyāghra viśvāmitrasya caiva hi ॥5॥
13.52.6: eṣa doṣaḥ sutān hitvā tattvaṁ vyākhyātumarhasi ॥6॥
13.52.7: cyavanasya ca saṁvādaṁ kuśikasya ca bhārata ॥7॥
13.52.15: tataḥ sa rājā cyavanaṁ madhuparkaṁ yathāvidhi,
13.52.16: bhagavan paravantau svo brūhi kiṁ karavāvahe ॥16॥
13.52.17: yadi rājyaṁ yadi dhanaṁ yadi gāḥ saṁśitavrata,
yajñadānāni ca tathā brūhi sarvaṁ dadāmi te ॥17॥
13.52.18: idaṁ gr̥hamidaṁ rājyamidaṁ dharmāsanaṁ ca te,
13.52.20: na rājyaṁ kāmaye rājan na dhanaṁ na ca yoṣitaḥ,
na ca gā na ca vai deśān na yajñaṁ śrūyatāmidam ॥20॥
13.52.22: evamukte tadā tena dampatī tau jaharṣatuḥ,
13.52.27: tataḥ sa parayā prītyā pratyuvāca narādhipam,
13.52.28: tadvacaḥ pūjayitvā tu tathetyāha sa pārthivaḥ,
13.52.29: tataḥ sa bhuktvā bhagavān dampatī prāha dharmavit,
13.52.31: saṁvāhitavyau me pādau jāgr̥tavyaṁ ca te’niśam ॥31॥
13.52.32: na prabodhayatāṁ tau ca dampatī rajanīkṣaye ॥32॥
13.52.34: tataḥ sa bhagavān vipraḥ samādiśya narādhipam,
13.52.35: sa tu rājā nirāhāraḥ sabhāryaḥ kurunandana,
13.52.39: sa muhūrtaṁ samāśvasya saha devyā mahādyutiḥ,
13.52.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate anuśāsanaparvaṇi dānadharmaparvaṇi cyavanakuśikasaṁvāde dvipañcāśattamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥52॥
13.53.1: bhāryā cāsya mahābhāgā tanme brūhi pitāmaha ॥1॥
13.53.3: sa praviśya purīṁ dīno nābhyabhāṣata kiñcana,
13.53.4: atha śūnyena manasā praviśya svagr̥haṁ nr̥paḥ,
13.53.5: vismitau tamr̥ṣiṁ dr̥ṣṭvā tadāścaryaṁ vicintya ca,
darśanāt tasya tu tadā viśrāntau sambabhūvatuḥ ॥5॥
13.53.6: yathāsthānaṁ ca tau sthitvā bhūyastaṁ saṁvavāhatuḥ,
13.53.7: tenaiva ca sa kālena pratyabuddhyata vīryavān,
na ca tau cakratuḥ kiñcid vikāraṁ bhayaśaṅkitau ॥7॥
13.53.11: yadā tau nirvikārau tu lakṣayāmāsa bhārgavaḥ,
tata utthāya sahasā snānaśālāṁ viveśa ha ॥11॥
13.53.14: atha snātaḥ saḥ bhagavān siṁhāsanagataḥ prabhuḥ,
13.53.16: sa rājā samupājahre tadannaṁ saha bhāryayā ॥16॥
13.53.20: gr̥hasthānāṁ ca yad bhojyaṁ yaccāpi vanavāsinām,
13.53.21: tataḥ sarvaṁ samānīya tacca śayyāsanaṁ muniḥ ॥21॥
13.53.23: na ca tau cakratuḥ krodhaṁ dampatī sumahāmatī,
13.53.24: tathaiva ca sa rājarṣistasthau tāṁ rajanīṁ tadā,
sabhāryo vāgyataḥ śrīmān na ca kopaṁ samāviśat ॥24॥
13.53.27: punareva ca viprarṣiḥ provāca kuśikaṁ nr̥pam,
sabhāryo māṁ rathenāśu vaha yatra bravīmyaham ॥27॥
13.53.29: ityuktaḥ sa munī rājñā tena hr̥ṣṭena tadvacaḥ,
13.53.30: sajjīkuru rathaṁ kṣipraṁ yaste sāṅgrāmiko mataḥ,
13.53.32: tataḥ sa taṁ tathetyuktvā kalpayitvā mahāratham,
bhāryāṁ vāme dhuri tadā cātmānaṁ dakṣiṇe tathā ॥32॥
13.53.34: bhagavan kva ratho yātu bravītu bhr̥gunandana,
yatra vakṣyasi viprarṣe tatra yāsyati te rathaḥ ॥34॥
13.53.35: itaḥ prabhr̥ti yātavyaṁ padakaṁ padakaṁ śanaiḥ ॥35॥
13.53.36: śramo mama yathā na syāt tathā macchandacāriṇau,
susukhaṁ caiva voḍhavyo janaḥ sarvaśca paśyatu ॥36॥
13.53.37: notsāryāḥ pathikāḥ kecit tebhyo dāsye vasu hyaham,
13.53.38: sarvān dāsyāmyaśeṣeṇa dhanaṁ ratnāni caiva hi,
13.53.39: tasya tad vacanaṁ śrutvā rājā bhr̥tyāṁstathābravīt,
13.53.42: pr̥ṣṭhe viddhau kaṭe caiva nirvikārau tamūhatuḥ ॥42॥
13.53.44: bahuśo bhr̥śaviddhau tau sravantau ca kṣatodbhavam,
13.53.46: kruddhā api muniśreṣṭhaṁ vīkṣituṁ neha śaknumaḥ ॥46॥
13.53.49: tataḥ sa nirvikārau tu dr̥ṣṭvā bhr̥gukulodvahaḥ,
13.53.51: avatīrya rathaśreṣṭhād dampatī tau mumoca ha,
vimocya caitau vidhivat tato vākyamuvāca ha ॥51॥
13.53.52: dadāni vāṁ varaṁ śreṣṭhaṁ taṁ brūtāmiti bhārata ॥52॥
13.53.53: sukumārau ca tau viddhau karābhyāṁ munisattamaḥ,
13.53.54: viśrāntau ca prabhāvāt te ūcatustau tu bhārgavam ॥54॥
13.53.55: na vr̥thā vyāhr̥taṁ pūrvaṁ yanmayā tad bhaviṣyati ॥55॥
13.53.57: ihasthaṁ māṁ sabhāryastvaṁ draṣṭāsi śvo narādhipa ॥57॥
13.53.58: na ca manyustvayā kāryaḥ śreyaste samupasthitam,
yat kāṅkṣitaṁ hyadisthaṁ te tat sarvaṁ hi bhaviṣyati ॥58॥
13.53.60: na me manyurmahābhāga pūtau svo bhagavaṁstvayā,
13.53.61: pratodena vraṇā ye me sabhāryasya tvayā kr̥tāḥ,
tān na paśyāmi gātreṣu svastho’smi saha bhāryayā ॥61॥
13.53.62: śriyā paramayā yuktāṁ yathā dr̥ṣṭā purā mayā ॥62॥
13.53.67: tairvr̥taḥ kuśiko rājā śriyā paramayā jvalan,
13.53.68: tataḥ praviśya nagaraṁ kr̥tvā paurvāhṇikīḥ kriyāḥ,
13.53.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate anuśāsanaparvaṇi dānadharmaparvaṇi cyavanakuśikasaṁvāde tripañcāśattamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥53॥
13.54.1: tataḥ sa rājā rātryante pratibuddho mahāmanāḥ,
13.54.6: puṣpitān karṇikārāṁśca tatra tatra dadarśa ha ॥6॥
13.54.7: tatra tatra pariklr̥ptā dadarśa sa mahīpatiḥ ॥7॥
13.54.14: na dadarśa ca tān bhūyo dadarśa ca punarnr̥paḥ ॥14॥
13.54.17: aho saha śarīreṇa prāpto’smi paramāṁ gatim,
13.54.22: kṣaṇena tad vanaṁ caiva te caivāpsarasāṁ gaṇāḥ ॥22॥
13.54.24: tataḥ sa rājā kuśikaḥ sabhāryastena karmaṇā ॥24॥
13.54.26: paśya bhadre yathā bhāvāścitrā dr̥ṣṭāḥ sudurlabhāḥ,
13.54.27: tapasā tadavāpyaṁ hi yat tu śakyaṁ manorathaiḥ,
13.54.30: brāhmaṇyaṁ durlabhaṁ loke rājyaṁ hi sulabhaṁ naraiḥ ॥30॥
13.54.35: rājan samyag jitānīha pañca pañca svayaṁ tvayā ॥35॥
13.54.37: na hi te vr̥jinaṁ kiñcit susūkṣmamapi vidyate,
13.54.39: vartitaṁ bhr̥guśārdūla yanna dagdho’smi tad bahu,
eṣa eva varo mukhyaḥ prāpto me bhr̥gunandana ॥39॥
13.54.40: yat prīto’si mayā brahman kulaṁ trātaṁ ca me’nagha,
eṣa me’nugraho vipra jīvite ca prayojanam ॥40॥
13.54.41: etad rājyaphalaṁ caiva tapasaśca phalaṁ mama,
yadi tvaṁ prītimān vipra mayi vai bhr̥gunandana ॥41॥
13.54.42: asti me saṁśayaḥ kaścit tanme vyākhyātumarhasi ॥42॥
13.54.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate anuśāsanaparvaṇi dānadharmaparvaṇi cyavanakuśikasaṁvāde catuḥpañcāśattamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥54॥
13.55.1: varaśca gr̥hyatāṁ matto yaśca te saṁśayo hr̥di,
taṁ prabrūhi naraśreṣṭha sarvaṁ sampādayāmi te ॥1॥
13.55.2: yadi prīto’si bhagavaṁstato me vada bhārgava,
13.55.5: tailābhyaktasya gamanaṁ bhojanaṁ ca gr̥he mama,
13.55.6: niryāṇaṁ ca rathenāśu sahasā yat kr̥taṁ tvayā,
dhanānāṁ ca visargasya vanasyāpi ca darśanam ॥6॥
13.55.15: na ca te duṣkr̥taṁ kiñcidahamāsādayaṁ gr̥he,
13.55.16: supto’smi yadi māṁ kaścid bodhayediti pārthiva ॥16॥
13.55.17: yadā tvayā sabhāryeṇa saṁsupto na prabodhitaḥ,
ahaṁ tadaiva te prīto manasā rājasattama ॥17॥
13.55.18: utthāya cāsmi niṣkrānto yadi māṁ tvaṁ mahīpate,
pr̥ccheḥ kva yāsyasītyevaṁ śapeyaṁ tvāmiti prabho ॥18॥
13.55.19: antarhitaḥ punaścāsmi punareva ca te gr̥he,
13.55.20: evaṁ buddhiṁ samāsthāya karśitau vāṁ kṣudhā mayā ॥20॥
13.55.21: na ca te’bhūt susūkṣmo’pi manyurmanasi pārthiva,
13.55.22: bhojanaṁ ca samānāyya yat tadā dīpitaṁ mayā,
kruddhyethā yadi mātsaryāditi tanmarṣitaṁ ca me ॥22॥
13.55.23: sabhāryo māṁ vahasveti tacca tvaṁ kr̥tavāṁstathā ॥23॥
13.55.24: aviśaṅko narapate prīto’haṁ cāpi tena ha,
dhanotsarge’pi ca kr̥te na tvāṁ krodhaḥ pradharṣayat ॥24॥
13.55.25: tataḥ prītena te rājan punaretat kr̥taṁ tava,
13.55.26: yat te vane’smin nr̥pate dr̥ṣṭaṁ divyaṁ nidarśanam ॥26॥
13.55.28: tatra yā’’sīt spr̥hā rājaṁstaccāpi viditaṁ mayā ॥28॥
13.55.29: brāhmaṇyaṁ kāṅkṣase hi tvaṁ tapaśca pr̥thivīpate,
13.55.30: evametad yathā’’ttha tvaṁ brāhmaṇyaṁ tāta durlabham,
13.55.31: bhaviṣyatyeṣa te kāmaḥ kuśikāt kauśiko dvijaḥ,
13.55.34: varaṁ gr̥hāṇa rājarṣe yat te manasi vartate,
13.55.35: eṣa eva varo me’dya yastvaṁ prīto mahāmune,
bhavatvetad yathā’’ttha tvaṁ bhavet pautro mamānagha ॥35॥
13.55.36: brāhmaṇyaṁ me kulasyāstu bhagavanneṣa me varaḥ,
13.55.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate anuśāsanaparvaṇi dānadharmaparvaṇi cyavanakuśikasaṁvādo nāma pañcapañcāśattamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥55॥
13.56.2: te ca bhedaṁ gamiṣyanti daivayuktena hetunā ॥2॥
13.56.6: kañcit kālaṁ tu vahniṁ ca sa eva śamayiṣyati,
13.56.8: sa tu taṁ pratigr̥hyaiva putre saṅkrāmayiṣyati ॥8॥
13.56.10: kulāt tu tava dharmātman kanyāṁ so’dhigamiṣyati,
13.56.12: viśvāmitraṁ tava kule gādheḥ putraṁ sudhārmikam ॥12॥
13.56.13: striyau tu kāraṇaṁ tatra parivarte bhaviṣyataḥ ॥13॥
13.56.15: bhavitā tvaṁ ca sambandhī bhr̥gūṇāṁ bhāvitātmanām,
13.56.16: śrutvā hr̥ṣṭo’bhavad rājā vākyaṁ cedamuvāca ha,
13.56.18: brahmabhūtaṁ kulaṁ me’stu dharme cāsya mano bhavet ॥18॥
13.56.20: etat te kathitaṁ sarvamaśeṣeṇa mayā nr̥pa,
13.56.21: janma rāmasya ca munerviśvāmitrasya caiva hi ॥21॥
13.56.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate anuśāsanaparvaṇi dānadharmaparvaṇi cyavanakuśikasaṁvāde ṣaṭpañcāśattamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥56॥
13.57.2: prāpya rājyāni śataśo mahīṁ jitvātha bhārata,
13.57.3: kā nu tāsāṁ varastrīṇāṁ samavasthā bhaviṣyati,
13.57.4: vayaṁ hi tān kurūn hatvā jñātīṁśca suhr̥do’pi vā,
13.57.6: yudhiṣṭhirasya tad vākyaṁ śrutvā bhīṣmo mahāmanāḥ,
13.57.7: rahasyamadbhutaṁ caiva śr̥ṇu vakṣyāmi yat tvayi,
yā gatiḥ prāpyate yena pretyabhāve viśāmpate ॥7॥
13.57.8: āyuḥ prakarṣo bhogāśca labhyante tapasā vibho ॥8॥
13.57.9: jñānaṁ vijñānamārogyaṁ rūpaṁ sampat tathaiva ca,
13.57.11: ahiṁsāyāḥ phalaṁ rūpaṁ dīkṣāyā janma vai kule,
13.57.13: striyastriṣavaṇaṁ snātvā vāyuṁ pītvā kratuṁ labhet ॥13॥
13.57.14: nityasnāyī bhaved dakṣaḥ sandhye tu dve japan dvijaḥ,
13.57.24: upavāsaṁ ca dīkṣāṁ ca abhiṣekaṁ ca pārthiva,
13.57.26: labhate ca śivaṁ jñānaṁ phalapuṣpaprado naraḥ ॥26॥
13.57.42: tasya tad vacanaṁ śrutvā prītātmā kurunandanaḥ,
13.57.43: pitāmahasya yad vākyaṁ tad vo rocatviti prabhuḥ ॥43॥
13.57.44: tatastu pāṇḍavāḥ sarve draupadī ca yaśasvinī,
13.58.4: taḍāgānāṁ ca vakṣyāmi kr̥tānāṁ cāpi ye guṇāḥ,
13.58.9: tasmāt tāṁste pravakṣyāmi taḍāge ye guṇāḥ smr̥tāḥ,
13.58.10: varṣākāle taḍāge tu salilaṁ yasya tiṣṭhati,
13.58.11: śaratkāle tu salilaṁ taḍāge yasya tiṣṭhati,
13.58.12: sa vai bahusuvarṇasya yajñasya labhate phalam ॥12॥
13.58.13: yasya vai śaiśire kāle taḍāge salilaṁ bhavet,
13.58.14: taḍāgaṁ sukr̥taṁ yasya vasante tu mahāśrayam,
13.58.15: vājimedhaphalaṁ tasya phalaṁ vai munayo viduḥ ॥15॥
13.58.16: sa kulaṁ tārayet sarvaṁ yasya khāte jalāśaye,
gāvaḥ pibanti salilaṁ sādhavaśca narāḥ sadā ॥16॥
13.58.17: taḍāge yasya gāvastu pibanti tr̥ṣitā jalam,
13.58.18: yat pibanti jalaṁ tatra snāyante viśramanti ca,
taḍāge yasya tat sarvaṁ pretyānantyāya kalpate ॥18॥
13.58.19: durlabhaṁ salilaṁ tāta viśeṣeṇa paratra vai,
13.58.20: tilān dadata pānīyaṁ dīpān dadata jāgrata,
13.58.23: sthāvarāṇāṁ ca bhūtānāṁ jātayaḥ ṣaṭ prakīrtitāḥ,
13.58.24: etā jātyastu vr̥kṣāṇāṁ teṣāṁ rope guṇāstvime,
kīrtiśca mānuṣe loke pretya caiva phalaṁ śubham ॥24॥
13.58.25: labhate nāma loke ca pitr̥bhiśca mahīyate,
devaloke gatasyāpi nāma tasya na naśyati ॥25॥
13.58.26: tārayed vr̥kṣaropī ca tasmād vr̥kṣāṁśca ropayet ॥26॥
13.58.27: tasya putrā bhavantyete pādapā nātra saṁśayaḥ,
13.58.28: puṣpaiḥ suragaṇān vr̥kṣāḥ phalaiścāpi tathā pitr̥̄n,
13.58.31: tasmāt taḍāge sadvr̥kṣā ropyāḥ śreyo’rthinā sadā,
13.58.32: ete svarge mahīyante ye cānye satyavādinaḥ ॥32॥
13.58.33: yajecca vividhairyajñaiḥ satyaṁ ca satataṁ vadet ॥33॥
13.58.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate anuśāsanaparvaṇi dānadharmaparvaṇi ārāmataḍāgavarṇanaṁ nāma aṣṭapañcāśattamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥58॥
13.59.1: tebhyo viśiṣṭaṁ kiṁ dānaṁ mataṁ te kurupuṅgava ॥1॥
13.59.2: kautūhalaṁ hi paramaṁ tatra me vidyate prabho,
dātāraṁ dattamanveti yad dānaṁ tat pracakṣva me ॥2॥
13.59.4: dattaṁ manyeta yad dattvā tad dānaṁ śreṣṭhamucyate,
13.59.6: dānāni hi naraṁ pāpānmokṣayanti na saṁśayaḥ ॥6॥
13.59.7: yad yadiṣṭatamaṁ loke yaccāsya dayitaṁ gr̥he,
13.59.8: priyāṇi labhate nityaṁ priyadaḥ priyakr̥t tathā,
priyo bhavati bhūtānāmiha caiva paratra ca ॥8॥
13.59.9: yo nārcati yathāśakti sa nr̥śaṁso yudhiṣṭhira ॥9॥
13.59.11: apahanyāt kṣudhāṁ yastu na tena puruṣaḥ samaḥ ॥11॥
13.59.13: āśiṣaṁ ye na deveṣu na ca martyeṣu kurvate,
13.59.18: yat kariṣyasi kalyāṇaṁ tat te loke yudhāmpate ॥18॥
13.59.20: eṣa te vitato yajñaḥ śraddhāpūtaḥ sadakṣiṇaḥ,
13.59.22: ya evaṁ naiva kupyante na lubhyanti tr̥ṇeṣvapi,
ta eva naḥ pūjyatamā ye cāpi priyavādinaḥ ॥22॥
13.59.23: ete na bahu manyante na pravartanti cāpare,
13.59.24: kṣātreṇāpi hi saṁsr̥ṣṭaṁ tejaḥ śāmyati vai dvije ॥24॥
13.59.29: yathā patyāśrayo dharmaḥ strīṇāṁ loke sanātanaḥ,
13.59.30: paśyanto dāruṇaṁ karma satataṁ kṣatriye sthitam ॥30॥
13.59.32: atra te vartayiṣyāmi yathā dharmaṁ sanātanam,
rājanyo brāhmaṇān rājan purā paricacāra ha ॥32॥
13.59.35: apareṣāṁ pareṣāṁ ca parebhyaścāpi ye pare ॥35॥
13.59.36: kṣatriyāṇāṁ pratapatāṁ tejasā ca balena ca,
brāhmaṇeṣveva śāmyanti tejāṁsi ca tapāṁsi ca ॥36॥
13.59.37: na me pitā priyataro na tvaṁ tāta tathā priyaḥ,
na me pituḥ pitā rājan na cātmā na ca jīvitam ॥37॥
13.59.38: tvattaśca me priyataraḥ pr̥thivyāṁ nāsti kaścana,
13.59.39: tena satyena gaccheyaṁ lokān yatra ca śāntanuḥ ॥39॥
13.59.40: paśyeyaṁ ca satāṁ lokān śucīn brahmapuraskr̥tān,
tatra me tāta gantavyamahnāya ca cirāya ca ॥40॥
13.59.41: yanme kr̥taṁ brāhmaṇeṣu na tapye tena pārthiva ॥41॥
13.60.3: brāhmaṇo dhr̥timān vidvān devān prīṇāti tuṣṭimān ॥3॥
13.60.5: mriyate yācamāno vai na jātu mriyate dadat,
13.60.6: ānr̥śaṁsyaṁ paro dharmo yācate yat pradīyate,
13.60.7: yadi vai tādr̥śā rāṣṭrān vaseyuste dvijottamāḥ,
13.60.14: api te brāhmaṇā bhuktvā gatāḥ soddharaṇān gr̥hān ॥14॥
13.60.17: tr̥tīyaṁ savanaṁ te vai vaiśvadevaṁ yudhiṣṭhira ॥17॥
13.60.19: eṣa te vitato yajñaḥ śraddhāpūtaḥ sadakṣiṇaḥ ॥19॥
13.61.1: dānaṁ yajñaḥ kriyā ceha kiṁsvit pretya mahāphalam,
kasya jyāyaḥ phalaṁ proktaṁ kīdr̥śebhyaḥ kathaṁ kadā ॥1॥
13.61.3: antarvedyāṁ ca yad dattaṁ śraddhayā cānr̥śaṁsyataḥ,
13.61.4: raudraṁ karma kṣatriyasya satataṁ tāta vartate,
tasya vaitānikaṁ karma dānaṁ caiveha pāvanam ॥4॥
13.61.5: na tu pāpakr̥tāṁ rājñāṁ pratigr̥hṇanti sādhavaḥ,
13.61.8: yat te te na kariṣyanti kr̥taṁ te na bhaviṣyati,
13.61.9: iṣṭaṁ dattaṁ ca manyethā ātmānaṁ dānakarmaṇā,
13.61.13: aśvavanti ca yānāni veśmāni śayanāni ca ॥13॥
13.61.15: upacchannaṁ prakāśaṁ vā vr̥ttyā tān pratipālayet,
13.61.16: sañcayitvā punaḥ kośaṁ yad rāṣṭraṁ pālayiṣyasi ॥16॥
13.61.17: ātmanaśca pareṣāṁ ca vr̥ttiṁ saṁrakṣa bhārata ॥17॥
13.61.18: yogaḥ kṣemaśca te nityaṁ brāhmaṇeṣvastu bhārata ॥18॥
13.61.21: yo rakṣibhyaḥ sampradāya rājā rāṣṭraṁ vilumpati,
13.61.22: yajed rājā na taṁ yajñaṁ praśaṁsantyasya sādhavaḥ ॥22॥
13.61.25: na khātapūrvaṁ kurvīta na rudantī dhanaṁ haret ॥25॥
13.61.26: hr̥taṁ kr̥paṇavittaṁ hi rāṣṭraṁ hanti nr̥paśriyam,
dadyācca mahato bhogān kṣudbhayaṁ praṇudet satām ॥26॥
13.61.27: nāśnanti vidhivat tāni kiṁ nu pāpataraṁ tataḥ ॥27॥
13.61.28: yadi te tādr̥śo rāṣṭre vidvān sīdet kṣudhā dvijaḥ,
13.61.29: dhik tasya jīvitaṁ rājño rāṣṭre yasyāvasīdati,
dvijo’nyo vā manuṣyo’pi śibirāha vaco yathā ॥29॥
13.61.30: yasya sma viṣaye rājñaḥ snātakaḥ sīdati kṣudhā,
13.61.31: krośantyo yasya vai rāṣṭrād hr̥yante tarasā striyaḥ,
krośatāṁ patiputrāṇāṁ mr̥to’sau na ca jīvati ॥31॥
13.61.32: taṁ vai rājakaliṁ hanyuḥ prajāḥ sannahya nirghr̥ṇam ॥32॥
13.61.33: ahaṁ vo rakṣitetyuktvā yo na rakṣati bhūmipaḥ,
sa saṁhatya nihantavyaḥ śveva sonmāda āturaḥ ॥33॥
13.61.34: pāpaṁ kurvanti yat kiñcit prajā rājñā hyarakṣitāḥ,
caturthaṁ tasya pāpasya rājā vindati bhārata ॥34॥
13.61.36: śubhaṁ vā yacca kurvanti prajā rājñā surakṣitāḥ,
caturthaṁ tasya puṇyasya rājā cāpnoti bhārata ॥36॥
13.62.5: apyalpaṁ pradaduḥ sarve pr̥thivyā iti naḥ śrutam,
bhūmimeva daduḥ sarve bhūmiṁ te bhuñjate janāḥ ॥5॥
13.62.8: yathā dānaṁ tathā bhoga iti dharmeṣu niścayaḥ,
saṅgrāme vā tanuṁ jahyād dadyācca pr̥thivīmimām ॥8॥
13.62.10: saiva pāpaṁ plāvayati saiva pāpāt pramocayet ॥10॥
13.62.13: ya etāṁ viduṣe dadyāt pr̥thivīṁ pr̥thivīpatiḥ,
13.62.14: punaścāsau janiṁ prāpya rājavat syānna saṁśayaḥ,
tasmāt prāpyaiva pr̥thivīṁ dadyāt viprāya pārthivaḥ ॥14॥
13.62.15: na cāpātreṇa vā grāhyā dattadāne na cācaret ॥15॥
13.62.16: ye cānye bhūmimiccheyuḥ kuryurevaṁ na saṁśayaḥ,
yaḥ sādhorbhūmimādatte na bhūmiṁ vindate tu saḥ ॥16॥
13.62.17: bhūmiṁ dattvā tu sādhubhyo vindate bhūmimuttamām,
pretya ceha ca dharmātmā samprāpnoti mahad yaśaḥ ॥17॥
13.62.18: yasya viprāstu śaṁsanti sādhorbhūmiṁ sadaiva hi,
na tasya śatravo rājan praśaṁsanti vasundharām ॥18॥
13.62.19: yat kiñcit puruṣaḥ pāpaṁ kurute vr̥ttikarśitaḥ,
13.62.21: yo yajetāśvamedhena dadyād vā sādhave mahīm ॥21॥
13.62.26: yathā janitrī svaṁ putraṁ kṣīreṇa bharate sadā,
13.62.29: bhūmiṁ vr̥ttikarīṁ dattvā satrī bhavati mānavaḥ ॥29॥
13.62.30: yathā dhāvati gaurvatsaṁ sravantī vatsalā payaḥ,
13.62.31: udīrṇaṁ vāpi śaraṇaṁ yathā bhavati kāmadaḥ ॥31॥
13.62.32: naraḥ pratigrāhya mahīṁ na yāti paramāpadam ॥32॥
13.62.33: tathā bhūmikr̥taṁ dānaṁ sasye sasye vivardhate ॥33॥
13.62.34: yāḥ śrutvā jāmadagnyena dattā bhūḥ kāśyapāya vai ॥34॥
13.62.35: māmevādatta māṁ datta māṁ dattvā māmavāpsyatha,
asmillom̐ke pare caiva tad dattaṁ jāyate punaḥ ॥35॥
13.62.36: ya imāṁ vyāhr̥tiṁ veda brāhmaṇo vedasammitām,
13.62.38: punāti ya idaṁ veda vedavādaṁ tathaiva ca,
13.62.39: yathā śrutvā mahīṁ dadyānnādadyāt sādhutaśca tām ॥39॥
13.62.41: na te sukhaṁ prabudhyanti na sukhaṁ prasvapanti ca ॥41॥
13.62.42: yogakṣemā hi bahavo rāṣṭraṁ nāsyāviśanti tat ॥42॥
13.62.43: atha yeṣāṁ punaḥ prājño rājā bhavati dhārmikaḥ,
sukhaṁ te pratibudhyante susukhaṁ prasvapanti ca ॥43॥
13.62.44: tasya rājñaḥ śubhai rājyaiḥ karmabhirnirvr̥tā narāḥ,
13.62.45: sa kulīnaḥ sa puruṣaḥ sa bandhuḥ sa ca puṇyakr̥t,
sa dātā sa ca vikrānto yo dadāti vasundharām ॥45॥
13.62.46: ādityā iva dīpyante tejasā bhuvi mānavāḥ,
dadanti vasudhāṁ sphītāṁ ye vedaviduṣi dvije ॥46॥
13.62.49: bhūmau jāyanti puruṣā bhūmau niṣṭhāṁ vrajanti ca,
13.62.50: eṣā mātā pitā caiva jagataḥ pr̥thivīpate,
13.62.53: yadakṣayaṁ mahārghaṁ ca tad brūhi vadatāṁ vara ॥53॥
13.62.55d1: vidyādānaṁ ca kanyānāṁ dānaṁ pāpaharaṁ param,
13.62.56: na bhūmidānād devendra paraṁ kiñciditi prabho,
13.62.57: ye śūrā nihatā yuddhe svaryātā raṇagr̥ddhinaḥ,
13.62.59: pañca pūrvā hi puruṣāḥ ṣaḍanye vasudhāṁ gatāḥ,
13.62.63: dadāti yaḥ sahasrākṣa svargaṁ yāti sa mānavaḥ ॥63॥
13.62.66: taṁ janāḥ kathayantīha yāvad bhavati gauriyam ॥66॥
13.62.69: api kr̥tvā naraḥ pāpaṁ bhūmiṁ dattvā dvijātaye,
13.62.70: sāgarān saritaḥ śailān kānanāni ca sarvaśaḥ,
13.62.74: dātā daśānugr̥hṇāti daśa hanti tathā kṣipan,
13.62.75: na dadāti pratiśrutya dattvāpi ca haret tu yaḥ,
13.62.76: ye bhajanti dvijaśreṣṭhaṁ nopasarpanti te yamam ॥76॥
13.62.79: brāhmaṇānāṁ hr̥te kṣetre hanyāt tripuruṣaṁ kulam ॥79॥
13.62.82: akṣayām̐llabhate lokān bhūmiṁsatra hi tasya tat ॥82॥
13.62.83: vidhūya kaluṣaṁ sarvaṁ virajāḥ sammataḥ satām,
13.62.84: tathā bhūmikr̥taṁ dānaṁ sasye sasye vivardhate ॥84॥
13.62.87: yo dadāti mahīṁ samyag vidhineha dvijātaye ॥87॥
13.62.92: nāsti bhūmisamaṁ dānaṁ nāsti mātr̥samo guruḥ,
nāsti satyasamo dharmo nāsti dānasamo nidhiḥ ॥92॥
13.62.94: na tasya rakṣasāṁ bhāgo nāsurāṇāṁ bhavatyuta ॥94॥
13.62.95: akṣayaṁ ca bhaved dattaṁ pitr̥bhyastanna saṁśayaḥ,
13.62.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate anuśāsanaparvaṇi dānadharmaparvaṇi indrabr̥haspatisaṁvāde dviṣaṣṭitamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥62॥
13.63.2: kena tuṣyanti te sadyaḥ kiṁ tuṣṭāḥ pradiśanti ca,
śaṁsa me tanmahābāho phalaṁ puṇyakr̥taṁ mahat ॥2॥
13.63.3: dattaṁ kiṁ phalavad rājanniha loke paratra ca,
13.63.6: annena sadr̥śaṁ dānaṁ na bhūtaṁ na bhaviṣyati,
13.63.7: annena dhāryate sarvaṁ viśvaṁ jagadidaṁ prabho ॥7॥
13.63.8: annād bhavanti vai prāṇāḥ pratyakṣaṁ nātra saṁśayaḥ ॥8॥
13.63.12: annadaḥ prāpnute rājan divi ceha ca yatsukham ॥12॥
13.63.13: api śvapāke śuni vā na dānaṁ vipraṇaśyati ॥13॥
13.63.16: brāhmaṇāya viśeṣeṇa na sa pāpena muhyate ॥16॥
13.63.17: annadānaṁ hi śūdre ca brāhmaṇe ca viśiṣyate ॥17॥
13.63.18: na pr̥cched gotracaraṇaṁ svādhyāyaṁ deśameva ca,
13.63.20: asmākamapi putro vā pautro vānnaṁ pradāsyati ॥20॥
13.63.21: brāhmaṇo hi mahadbhūtaṁ svayaṁ dehīti yācati,
akāmo vā sakāmo vā dattvā puṇyamavāpnuyāt ॥21॥
13.63.23: mahābhāge kule pretya janma cāpnoti bhārata ॥23॥
13.63.24: dattvā tvannaṁ naro loke tathā sthānamanuttamam,
nityaṁ miṣṭānnadāyī tu svarge vasati satkr̥taḥ ॥24॥
13.63.25: annaṁ prāṇā narāṇāṁ hi sarvamanne pratiṣṭhitam,
13.63.26: annadaḥ prāṇado loke sarvadaḥ procyate tu saḥ ॥26॥
13.63.28: upyate tatra yad bījaṁ taddhi puṇyaphalaṁ mahat ॥28॥
13.63.31: annaṁ bhuvaṁ divaṁ khaṁ ca sarvamanne pratiṣṭhitam ॥31॥
13.63.34: annataḥ sarvametaddhi yat kiñcit sthāṇu jaṅgamam,
13.63.35: kīrtiśca vardhate śaśvat triṣu lokeṣu pārthiva ॥35॥
13.63.36: tacca meghagataṁ vāri śakro varṣati bhārata ॥36॥
13.63.38: tad yadā meghato vāri patitaṁ bhavati kṣitau,
tadā vasumatī devī snigdhā bhavati bhārata ॥38॥
13.63.39: tataḥ sasyāni rohanti yena vartayate jagat,
13.63.40: agnīṣomau hi tacchukraṁ sr̥jataḥ puṣyataśca ha ॥40॥
13.63.41: eka eva smr̥to rāśistato bhūtāni jajñire ॥41॥
13.63.45: annadānāṁ hi ye lokāstāṁstvaṁ śr̥ṇu janādhipa,
13.63.49: vāpyo vīthyaḥ sabhāḥ kūpā dīrghikāścaiva sarvaśaḥ,
13.63.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate anuśāsanaparvaṇi dānadharmaparvaṇi annadānapraśaṁsāyāṁ triṣaṣṭitamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥63॥
13.64.1: śrutaṁ me bhavato vākyamannadānasya yo vidhiḥ,
13.64.7: dogdhrīṁ dattvā savatsāṁ tu nakṣatre somadaivate,
13.64.10: puṣyeṇa kanakaṁ dattvā kr̥taṁ vākr̥tameva ca,
13.64.11: āśleṣāyāṁ tu yo rūpyamr̥ṣabhaṁ vā prayacchati,
13.64.18: prāpnoti lokān sa śubhāniha caiva mahad yaśaḥ ॥18॥
13.64.20: na ca durgāṇyavāpnoti svargalokaṁ ca gacchati ॥20॥
13.64.21: dattvā yathoktaṁ viprebhyo vr̥ttimiṣṭāṁ sa vindati,
13.64.22: dattvā yugaśataṁ cāpi naraḥ svarge mahīyate ॥22॥
13.64.23: kālaśākaṁ tu viprebhyo dattvā martyaḥ samūlakam,
13.64.24: pitr̥̄n prīṇayate cāpi gatimiṣṭāṁ ca gacchati ॥24॥
13.64.31: sarvabhakṣaphalopetaḥ sa vai pretya sukhī bhavet ॥31॥
13.64.32: sa pitr̥̄n prīṇayati vai pretya cānantyamaśnute ॥32॥
13.64.35: gāḥ suprabhūtāḥ prāpnoti naraḥ pretya yaśastathā ॥35॥
13.64.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate anuśāsanaparvaṇi dānadharmaparvaṇi nakṣatrayogadānaṁ nāma catuḥṣaṣṭitamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥64॥
13.65.1: sarvān kāmān prayacchanti ye prayacchanti kāñcanam,
13.65.3: tasmāt kūpāṁśca vāpīśca taḍāgāni ca khānayet ॥3॥
13.65.5: sarvaṁ tārayate vaṁśaṁ yasya khāte jalāśaye,
gāvaḥ pibanti viprāśca sādhavaśca narāḥ sadā ॥5॥
13.65.6: sa durgaṁ viṣamaṁ kr̥tsnaṁ na kadācidavāpnute ॥6॥
13.65.10: ghr̥taṁ māse āśvayuji viprebhyo yaḥ prayacchati,
13.65.11: pāyasaṁ sarpiṣā miśraṁ dvijebhyo yaḥ prayacchati,
gr̥haṁ tasya na rakṣāṁsi dharṣayanti kadācana ॥11॥
13.65.12: na prāpnuyācca vyasanaṁ karakān yaḥ prayacchati ॥12॥
13.65.13: prayato brāhmaṇāgre yaḥ śraddhayā parayā yutaḥ,
13.65.15: siddhyantyarthāḥ sadā tasya kāryāṇi vividhāni ca,
uparyupari śatrūṇāṁ vapuṣā dīpyate ca saḥ ॥15॥
13.65.16: na taṁ tyajanti paśavaḥ saṅgrāme ca jayatyapi ॥16॥
13.66.1: yat phalaṁ tasya bhavati tanme brūhi pitāmaha ॥1॥
13.66.4: śakaṭaṁ damyasaṁyuktaṁ dattaṁ bhavati caiva hi ॥4॥
13.66.5: yat phalaṁ tiladāne ca bhūmidāne ca kīrtitam,
godāne cānnadāne ca bhūyastad brūhi kaurava ॥5॥
13.66.6: śr̥ṇuṣva mama kaunteya tiladānasya yat phalam,
13.66.7: pitr̥̄ṇāṁ paramaṁ bhojyaṁ tilāḥ sr̥ṣṭāḥ svayambhuvā,
13.66.10: tato divyaṁ gatā bhāvaṁ pradāneṣu tilāḥ prabho ॥10॥
13.66.13: samā gavyena haviṣā pravr̥ttiṣu ca saṁsthitāḥ ॥13॥
13.66.15: ucchinne tu purā havye kuśikarṣiḥ parantapaḥ,
13.66.20: tvaṁ hi sarvasya jagataḥ sthāvarasya carasya ca ॥20॥
13.66.23: imaṁ tu deśaṁ munayaḥ paryupāsanti nityadā,
13.66.27: na sīdati sa kr̥cchreṣu na ca durgāṇyavāpnute,
13.66.28: mudito vasati prājñaḥ śakreṇa saha pārthiva ॥28॥
13.66.30: gr̥he yasya vaset tuṣṭaḥ pradhānaṁ lokamaśnute,
13.66.32: na coṣarāṁ na nirdagdhāṁ mahīṁ dadyāt kathañcana ॥32॥
13.66.33: na śmaśānaparītāṁ ca na ca pāpaniṣevitām,
pārakye bhūmideśe tu pitr̥̄ṇāṁ nirvapet tu yaḥ ॥33॥
13.66.34: tasmāt krītvā mahīṁ dadyāt svalpāmapi vicakṣaṇaḥ ॥34॥
13.66.35: piṇḍaḥ pitr̥bhyo datto vai tasyāṁ bhavati śāśvataḥ,
13.66.37: ataḥ paraṁ tu godānaṁ kīrtayiṣyāmi te’nagha,
13.66.38: brāhmo loke vasantyetāḥ somena saha bhārata ॥38॥
13.66.39: yāṁ tāṁ brahmarṣayaḥ siddhāḥ prārthayanti parāṁ gatim,
payasā haviṣā dadhnā śakr̥tā cātha carmaṇā ॥39॥
13.66.40: nāsāṁ śītātapau syātāṁ sadaitāḥ karma kurvate ॥40॥
13.66.41: brāhmaṇaiḥ sahitā yānti tasmāt pāramakaṁ padam ॥41॥
13.66.44: tā imā bipramukhyebhyo yo dadāti mahīpate,
13.66.45: gavāṁ sahasradaḥ pretya narakaṁ na prapadyate,
13.66.46: tasmād dadāti yo dhenumamr̥taṁ sa prayacchati ॥46॥
13.66.47: tasmād dadāti yo dhenuṁ sa haumyaṁ samprayacchati ॥47॥
13.66.48: svargo vai mūrtimāneṣa vr̥ṣabhaṁ yo gavāṁ patim,
vipre guṇayute dadyāt sa vai svarge mahīyate ॥48॥
13.66.49: tasmād dadāti yo dhenuṁ prāṇāneṣa prayacchati ॥49॥
13.66.50: tasmād dadāti yo dhenuṁ śaraṇaṁ samprayacchati ॥50॥
13.66.51: na vadhārthaṁ pradātavyā na kīnāśe na nāstike,
13.66.52: dadat sa tādr̥śānāṁ vai naro gāṁ pāpakarmaṇām,
13.66.53: na kr̥śāṁ nāpavatsāṁ vā vandhyāṁ rogānvitāṁ tathā,
na vyaṅgāṁ na pariśrāntāṁ dadyād gāṁ brāhmaṇāya vai ॥53॥
13.66.55: ityetad gopradānaṁ ca tiladānaṁ ca kīrtitam,
tathā bhūmipradānaṁ ca śr̥ṇuṣvānne ca bhārata ॥55॥
13.66.56: annasya hi pradānena rantidevo divaṁ gataḥ ॥56॥
13.66.57: svāyambhuvaṁ mahat sthānaṁ sa gacchati narādhipa ॥57॥
13.66.58: prāpnuvanti narāḥ śreyo yathā hyannapradāḥ prabho ॥58॥
13.66.59: annaṁ vai prathamaṁ dravyamannaṁ śrīśca parā matā,
annāt prāṇaḥ prabhavati tejo vīryaṁ balaṁ tathā ॥59॥
13.66.63: sa vai brahmavidāṁ lokān prāpnuyād bharatarṣabha ॥63॥
13.66.65: bhūmidānasya ca phalaṁ godānasya ca kīrtitam ॥65॥
13.67.1: śrutaṁ dānaphalaṁ tāta yat tvayā parikīrtitam,
13.67.5: na tasmāt paramaṁ dānaṁ kiñcidastīti me manaḥ,
13.67.6: annād balaṁ ca tejaśca prāṇināṁ vardhate sadā ॥6॥
13.67.7: sāvitryā hyapi kaunteya śrutaṁ te vacanaṁ śubham ॥7॥
13.67.8: yataśca yad yathā caiva devasatre mahāmate,
anne datte nareṇeha prāṇā dattā bhavantyuta ॥8॥
13.67.9: śrutaṁ hi te mahābāho lomaśasyāpi tadvacaḥ ॥9॥
13.67.10: prāṇān dattvā kapotāya yat prāptaṁ śibinā purā,
tāṁ gatiṁ labhate dattvā dvijasyānnaṁ viśāmpate ॥10॥
13.67.11: tasmād viśiṣṭāṁ gacchanti prāṇadā iti naḥśrutam,
nīrajātena hi vinā na kiñcit sampravartate ॥11॥
13.67.12: amr̥taṁ ca sudhā caiva svāhā caiva svadhā tathā ॥12॥
13.67.14: devānāmamr̥taṁ hyannaṁ nāgānāṁ ca sudhā tathā,
pitr̥̄ṇāṁ ca svadhā proktā paśūnāṁ cāpi vīrudhaḥ ॥14॥
13.67.16: tasmāt pānīyadānād vai na paraṁ vidyate kvacit,
13.67.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate anuśāsanaparvaṇi dānadharmaparvaṇi pānīyadānamāhātmye saptaṣaṣṭitamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥67॥
13.68.1: tilānāṁ kīdr̥śaṁ dānamatha dīpasya caiva hi,
annānāṁ vāsasāṁ caiva bhūya eva bravīhi me ॥1॥
13.68.2: brāhmaṇasya ca saṁvādaṁ yamasya ca yudhiṣṭhira ॥2॥
13.68.3: madhyadeśe mahān grāmo brāhmaṇānāṁ babhūva ha,
13.68.5: atha prāha yamaḥ kañcit puruṣaṁ kr̥ṣṇavāsasam,
13.68.6: gaccha tvaṁ brāhmaṇagrāmaṁ tato gatvā tamānaya,
13.68.9: tamānaya yathoddiṣṭaṁ pūjā kāryā hi tasya vai,
13.68.10: tasmai yamaḥ samutthāya pūjāṁ kr̥tvā ca vīryavān ॥10॥
13.68.11: evamukte tu vacane dharmarājena sa dvijaḥ ॥11॥
13.68.13: yo hi dharmaṁ carati vai taṁ tu jānāmi kevalam ॥13॥
13.68.14: gaccha vipra tvamadyaiva ālayaṁ svaṁ mahādyute,
brūhi sarvaṁ yathā svairaṁ karavāṇi kimacyuta ॥14॥
13.68.15: yat tatra kr̥tvā sumahat puṇyaṁ syāt tad bravīhi me,
sarvasya hi pramāṇaṁ tvaṁ trailokyasyāpi sattama ॥15॥
13.68.16: tilāḥ paramakaṁ dānaṁ puṇyaṁ caiveha śāśvatam ॥16॥
13.68.19: vaiśākhyāṁ paurṇamāsyāṁ tu tilān dadyād dvijātiṣu,
tilā bhakṣayitavyāśca sadā tvālambhanaṁ ca taiḥ ॥19॥
13.68.20: tathā’’paḥ sarvadā deyāḥ peyāścaiva na saṁśayaḥ ॥20॥
13.68.22: prapāśca kāryā dānārthaṁ nityaṁ te dvijasattama,
bhukte’pyannaṁ pradeyaṁ tu pānīyaṁ vai viśeṣataḥ ॥22॥
13.68.23: ityukte sa tadā tena yamadūtena vai gr̥hān,
13.68.24: nītvā taṁ yamadūto’pi gr̥hītvā śarmiṇaṁ tadā,
yayau sa dharmarājāya nyavedayata cāpi tam ॥24॥
13.68.25: kr̥tvā ca saṁvidaṁ tena visasarja yathāgatam ॥25॥
13.68.26: tasyāpi ca yamaḥ sarvamupadeśaṁ cakāra ha,
pretyaitya ca tataḥ sarvaṁ cakāroktaṁ yamena tat ॥26॥
13.68.27: tasmād dīpaprado nityaṁ santārayati vai pitr̥̄n ॥27॥
13.68.28: devatānāṁ pitr̥̄ṇāṁ ca cakṣuṣyaṁ cātmanāṁ vibho ॥28॥
13.68.30: yad vai dadāti viprebhyo brāhmaṇaḥ pratigr̥hya vai,
13.68.31: yo dadāti sthitaḥ sthityāṁ tādr̥śāya pratigraham,
ubhayorakṣayaṁ dharmaṁ taṁ manuḥ prāha dharmavit ॥31॥
13.68.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate anuśāsanaparvaṇi dānadharmaparvaṇi yamabrāhmaṇasaṁvāde aṣṭaṣaṣṭitamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥68॥
13.69.3: vede vā yat samākhyātaṁ tanme vyākhyātumarhasi ॥3॥
13.69.5: yo brūyāccāpi śiṣyāya dharmyāṁ brāhmīṁ sarasvatīm,
13.69.6: tathaiva gāḥ praśaṁsanti na tu deyaṁ tataḥ param,
13.69.8: santāḍyā na tu pādena gavāṁ madhye na ca vrajet,
13.69.10: pracāre vā nivāte vā budho nodvejayeta gāḥ,
13.69.11: pūyante śakr̥tā yāsāṁ pūtaṁ kimadhikaṁ tataḥ ॥11॥
13.69.12: ghāsamuṣṭiṁ paragave dadyāt saṁvatsaraṁ tu yaḥ,
13.69.13: sa hi putrān yaśo’rthaṁ ca śriyaṁ cāpyadhigacchati,
13.69.14: kīdr̥śāya pradātavyā na deyāḥ kīdr̥śāya ca ॥14॥
13.69.17: yaścaiva dharmaṁ kurute tasya dharmaphalaṁ ca yat,
13.69.18: yaścāsya kurute vr̥ttiṁ sarve te pitarastrayaḥ ॥18॥
13.69.19: kalmaṣaṁ guruśuśrūṣā hanti māno mahad yaśaḥ,
aputratāṁ trayaḥ putrā avr̥ttiṁ daśa dhenavaḥ ॥19॥
13.69.21: yaḥ kṣudbhayād vai na vikarma kuryā-
13.69.22d2: na pālayanti cet tasya hantā vaivasvato yamaḥ,
daṇḍayan bhartsayan nityaṁ nirayebhyo na muñcati.
13.69.22d3: tathā gavāṁ paritrāṇe pīḍane ca śubhāśubham,
13.69.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate anuśāsanaparvaṇi dānadharmaparvaṇi godānamāhātmye ekonasaptatitamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥69॥
13.70.8: śubhaṁ tvayā karma kr̥taṁ na pāpakam,
13.70.9: nr̥pa dvijebhyaḥ kva nu tad gataṁ tava ॥9॥
13.70.11: gavāṁ sahasre saṅkhyātā tadā sā paśupairmama,
13.70.12: apaśyat parimārgaṁśca tāṁ gāṁ paragr̥he dvijaḥ,
13.70.13: bhavān dātā bhavān hartetyatha tau māmavocatām ॥13॥
13.70.16: kr̥taṁ ca bharate sā gaurmama putramapastanam,
na sā śakyā mayā dātumityuktvā sa jagāma ha ॥16॥
13.70.18: na rājñāṁ pratigr̥hṇāmi śakto’haṁ svasya mārgaṇe,
13.70.19: na jagrāha yayau cāpi tadā sa brāhmaṇarṣabhaḥ ॥19॥
13.70.22: asti caiva kr̥taṁ pāpamajñānāt tadapi tvayā,
carasva pāpaṁ paścād vā pūrvaṁ vā tvaṁ yathecchasi ॥22॥
13.70.23: rakṣitāsmīti coktaṁ te pratijñā cānr̥tā tava,
13.70.28: anujānīhi māṁ kr̥ṣṇa gaccheyaṁ divamadya vai ॥28॥
13.70.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate anuśāsanaparvaṇi dānadharmaparvaṇi nr̥gopākhyāne saptatitamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥70॥
13.71.1: vistareṇa mahābāho na hi tr̥pyāmi kathyatām ॥1॥
13.71.7: yamaṁ paśyeti taṁ putramaśapat sa mahātapāḥ ॥7॥
13.71.10: vyatītaṁ tadahaḥśeṣaṁ sā cogrā tatra śarvarī ॥10॥
13.71.12: sa paryapr̥cchat taṁ putraṁ kṣīṇaṁ paryāgataṁ punaḥ,
13.71.13: api putra jitā lokāḥ śubhāste svena karmaṇā,
diṣṭyā cāsi punaḥ prāpto na hi te mānuṣaṁ vapuḥ ॥13॥
13.71.14: sa tāṁ vārtāṁ piturmadhye maharṣīṇāṁ nyavedayat ॥14॥
13.71.21: yānaṁ samāropya tu māṁ sa devo
13.71.26: nadyo vīthyaḥ sabhā vāpyo dīrghikāścaiva sarvaśaḥ,
13.71.37: abhāve gopradātr̥̄ṇāṁ kathaṁ lokān hi gacchati ॥37॥
13.71.39: alābhe yo gavāṁ dadyād ghr̥tadhenuṁ yatavrataḥ,
13.71.40: ghr̥tālābhe tu yo dadyāt tiladhenuṁ yatavrataḥ,
sa durgāt tārito dhenvā kṣīranadyāṁ pramodate ॥40॥
13.71.44: prāpto mayā yatra dr̥ṣṭo yamo vai,
13.71.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate anuśāsanaparvaṇi dānadharmaparvaṇi yamavākyaṁ nāma ekasaptatitamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥71॥
13.72.1: uktaṁ te gopradānaṁ vai nāciketamr̥ṣiṁ prati,
13.72.4: kiṁ tvasti mama sandeho gavāṁ lokaṁ prati prabho,
13.72.7: kīdr̥śā bhagavam̐llokā gavāṁ tad brūhi me’nagha,
13.72.8: kīdr̥śāḥ kimphalāḥ kiṁsvit paramastatra ko guṇaḥ,
13.72.9: kathaṁ bahuvidhaṁ dānaṁ syādalpamapi vā katham ॥9॥
13.72.10: adattvā gopradāḥ santi kena vā tacca śaṁsa me ॥10॥
13.72.11: kathaṁ vā bahudātā syādalpadātrā samaḥ prabho,
13.72.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate anuśāsanaparvaṇi dānadharmaparvaṇi gopradānike dvisaptatitamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥72॥
13.73.2: santi nānāvidhā lokā yāṁstvaṁ śakra na paśyasi,
13.73.3: saśarīrā hi tān yānti brāhmaṇāḥ śubhabuddhayaḥ ॥3॥
13.73.5: te tu lokāḥ sahasrākṣa śr̥ṇu yādr̥gguṇānvitāḥ,
na tatra kramate kālo na jarā na ca pāvakaḥ ॥5॥
13.73.6: tathā nāstyaśubhaṁ kiñcinna vyādhistatra na klamaḥ,
yad yacca gāvo manasā tasmin vāñchanti vāsava ॥6॥
13.73.7: tat sarvaṁ prāpnuvanti sma mama pratyakṣadarśanāt,
13.73.8: vāpyaḥ sarāṁsi sarito vividhāni vanāni ca,
13.73.14: na vai gurughno na mr̥ṣā sampralāpī,
13.73.18: yo vai dyūte dhanaṁ jitvā gāḥ krītvā samprayacchati,
13.73.19: dāyādyād yāḥ sma vai gāvo nyāyapūrvairupārjitāḥ,
pradadyāt tāḥ pradātr̥̄ṇāṁ sambhavantyapi ca dhruvāḥ ॥19॥
13.73.20: pratigr̥hya tu yo dadyād gāḥ saṁśuddhena cetasā,
13.73.22: na jātu brāhmaṇo vācyo yadavācyaṁ śacīpate,
13.73.23: satye dharme ca niratastasya śakra phalaṁ śr̥ṇu,
13.73.32: ekenaiva ca bhaktena yaḥ krītvā gāṁ prayacchati,
13.73.33: tāvat pradānāt sa gavāṁ phalamāpnoti śāśvatam,
brāhmaṇasya phalaṁ hīdaṁ kṣatriyasya tu vai śr̥ṇu ॥33॥
13.73.34: tato’rdhena tu vaiśyasya śūdro vaiśyārdhataḥ smr̥taḥ ॥34॥
13.73.35: yāvat sandarśayed gāṁ vai sa tāvat phalamaśnute ॥35॥
13.73.36: saṅgrāmeṣvarjayitvā tu yo vai gāḥ samprayacchati,
13.73.37: abhāve yo gavāṁ dadyāt tiladhenuṁ yatavrataḥ,
durgāt sa tārito dhenvā kṣīranadyāṁ pramodate ॥37॥
13.73.46: kāntāre brāhmaṇān gāśca yaḥ paritrāti kauśika,
13.73.48: lokān bahuvidhān divyān yaccāsya hr̥di vartate,
13.73.51: mama loke suraiḥ sārdhaṁ loke yatrāpi cecchati ॥51॥
13.73.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate anuśāsanaparvaṇi dānadharmaparvaṇi pitāmahendrasaṁvāde trisaptatitamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥73॥
13.74.1: etad vijñātumicchāmi kva nu tasya gatirbhavet ॥1॥
13.74.2: bhakṣārthaṁ vikrayārthaṁ vā ye’pahāraṁ hi kurvate,
13.74.3: vikrayārthaṁ hi yo hiṁsyād bhakṣayed vā niraṅkuśaḥ,
13.74.4: yāvanti tasyā romāṇi tāvad varṣāṇi majjati ॥4॥
13.74.5: vikraye cāpahāre ca te doṣā vai smr̥tāḥ prabho ॥5॥
13.74.6: apahr̥tya tu yo gāṁ vai brāhmaṇāya prayacchati,
13.74.9: suvarṇaṁ paramaṁ dānaṁ suvarṇaṁ dakṣiṇā parā,
suvarṇaṁ pāvanaṁ śakra pāvanānāṁ paraṁ smr̥tam ॥9॥
13.74.10: eṣā me dakṣiṇā proktā samāsena mahādyute ॥10॥
13.74.14: ya idaṁ brāhmaṇo nityaṁ vaded brāhmaṇasaṁsadi ॥14॥
13.74.15: tasya lokāḥ kilākṣayyā daivataiḥ saha nityadā ॥15॥
13.74.15d1: iti brahmā sa bhagavān uvāca parameśvaraḥ
13.75.1: pravakṣyāmi tu sandehaṁ tanme brūhi pitāmaha ॥1॥
13.75.2: vratānāṁ kiṁ phalaṁ proktaṁ kīdr̥śaṁ vā mahādyute,
niyamānāṁ phalaṁ kiṁ ca svadhītasya ca kiṁ phalam ॥2॥
13.75.3: dattasyeha phalaṁ kiṁ ca vedānāṁ dhāraṇe ca kim,
adhyāpane phalaṁ kiṁ ca sarvamicchāmi veditum ॥3॥
13.75.4: apratigrāhake kiṁ ca phalaṁ loke pitāmaha,
tasya kiṁ ca phalaṁ dr̥ṣṭaṁ śrutaṁ yastu prayacchati ॥4॥
13.75.5: svakarmaniratānāṁ ca śūrāṇāṁ cāpi kiṁ phalam,
śauce ca kiṁ phalaṁ proktaṁ brahmacarye ca kiṁ phalam ॥5॥
13.75.7: vettumicchāmi dharmajña paraṁ kautūhalaṁ hi me ॥7॥
13.75.8: yo vrataṁ vai yathoddiṣṭaṁ tathā sampratipadyate,
13.75.10: svadhītasyāpi ca phalaṁ dr̥śyate’mutra ceha ca,
13.75.11: damasya tu phalaṁ rājan śr̥ṇu tvaṁ vistareṇa me,
dāntāḥ sarvatra sukhino dāntāḥ sarvatra nirvr̥tāḥ ॥11॥
13.75.12: prārthayanti ca yad dāntā labhante tanna saṁśayaḥ ॥12॥
13.75.13: svarge yathā pramodante tapasā vikrameṇa ca ॥13॥
13.75.14: dānād damo viśiṣṭo hi dadatkiñcit dvijātaye ॥14॥
13.75.15: dātā kupyati no dāntastasmād dānāt paraṁ damaḥ,
yastu dadyādakupyan hi tasya lokāḥ sanātanāḥ ॥15॥
13.75.16: krodho hanti hi yad dānaṁ tasmād dānāt paraṁ damaḥ,
13.75.17: r̥ṣīṇāṁ sarvalokeṣu yāni te yānti devatāḥ,
13.75.18: kāmayānā mahatsthānaṁ tasmād dānāt paraṁ damaḥ,
13.75.19: adhītyāpi hi yo vedān nyāyavidbhyaḥ prayacchati ॥19॥
13.75.20: yuddhe yaśca paritrātā so’pi svarge mahīyate ॥20॥
13.75.22: śūrānvayānāṁ nirdiṣṭaṁ phalaṁ śūrasya caiva hi ॥22॥
13.75.25: ārjave ca tathā śūrāḥ śame vartanti mānavāḥ,
taistaiśca niyamaiḥ śūrā bahavaḥ santi cāpare,
13.75.28: satyaṁ ca bruvato nityaṁ samaṁ vā syānna vā samam ॥28॥
13.75.29: aśvamedhasahasraṁ ca satyaṁ ca tulayā dhr̥tam,
13.75.30: satyena maruto vānti sarvaṁ satye pratiṣṭhitam ॥30॥
13.75.31: satyamāhuḥ paro dharmastasmāt satyaṁ na laṅghayet ॥31॥
13.75.34: asaṁśayaṁ vinītātmā sa vai svarge mahīyate,
brahmacaryasya ca guṇaṁ śr̥ṇu tvaṁ vasudhādhipa ॥34॥
13.75.38: pratyakṣaṁ hi tathā hyetad brāhmaṇeṣu tapasviṣu,
13.75.39: mātāpitroḥ pūjane yo dharmastamapi me śr̥ṇu ॥39॥
13.75.40: śuśrūṣate yaḥ pitaraṁ na cāsūyet kadācana,
13.75.41: tasya rājan phalaṁ viddhi svarloke sthānamarcitam,
13.76.1: vidhiṁ gavāṁ paraṁ śrotumicchāmi nr̥pa tattvataḥ,
13.76.2: na godānāt paraṁ kiñcid vidyate vasudhādhipa,
13.76.6: āhvānaṁ ca prayuñjīta samaṅge bahuleti ca,
13.76.8: sa tāmekāṁ niśāṁ gobhiḥ samasakhyaḥ samavrataḥ,
13.76.15: ūrdhvāsyā bhavitavyā ca vaiṣṇavīti ca codayet ॥15॥
13.76.16: nāma saṅkīrtayet tasyā yathāsaṅkhyottaraṁ sa vai,
phalaṁ ṣaṭtriṁśadaṣṭau ca sahasrāṇi ca viṁśatiḥ ॥16॥
13.76.18: na syād duḥkhī vasudātā ca kāmam,
13.76.19: gā vai dattvā govratī syāt trirātraṁ
13.76.28: gāḥ puṇyā vai prāpya rājyaṁ kurūṇām ॥28॥
13.76.31: na ca dhuri nr̥pa gāmayukta bhūya-
13.76.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate anuśāsanaparvaṇi dānadharmaparvaṇi godānakathane ṣaṭsaptatitamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥76॥
13.77.1: tato yudhiṣṭhiro rājā bhūyaḥ śāntanavaṁ nr̥pam,
13.77.5: asuryā nāma te lokā gāṁ dattvā tān na gacchati,
13.77.6: dattvā tamaḥ praviśati dvijaṁ kleśena yojayet ॥6॥
13.77.10: vr̥ddhānāṁ bruvatāṁ tāta śrutaṁ me yat purātanam,
13.77.11: prajāḥ sr̥jeti cādiṣṭaḥ pūrvaṁ dakṣaḥ svayambhuvā,
13.77.12: tathā vr̥ttiṁ samāśritya vartayanti prajā vibho ॥12॥
13.77.14: yajñairavāpyate somaḥ sa ca goṣu pratiṣṭhitaḥ,
tato devāḥ pramodante pūrvaṁ vr̥ttistataḥ prajāḥ ॥14॥
13.77.17: sa gatastasya tr̥ptiṁ tu gandhaṁ surabhimudgiran,
13.77.20: śirasyavāpa tat kruddhaḥ sa tadaikṣata ca prabhuḥ ॥20॥
13.77.25: na duṣyatyanilo nāgnirna suvarṇaṁ na codadhiḥ ॥25॥
13.77.27: vr̥ṣabhaṁ ca dadau tasmai saha gobhiḥ prajāpatiḥ ॥27॥
13.77.29: dhvajaṁ ca vāhanaṁ caiva tasmāt sa vr̥ṣabhadhvajaḥ,
īśvaraḥ sa gavāṁ madhye vr̥ṣabhāṅkaḥ prakīrtitaḥ ॥29॥
13.77.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate anuśāsanaparvaṇi dānadharmaparvaṇi goprabhavakathane saptasaptatitamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥77॥
13.78.3: yat kīrtayan sadā martyaḥ prāpnuyāt puṇyamuttamam ॥3॥
13.78.4: tasmai provāca vacanaṁ praṇatāya hitaṁ tadā,
13.78.5: gāvaḥ pratiṣṭhā bhūtānāṁ gāvaḥ svastyayanaṁ mahat ॥5॥
13.78.6: gāvo bhūtaṁ ca bhavyaṁ ca gāvaḥ puṣṭiḥ sanātanī,
gāvo lakṣmyāstathā mūlaṁ goṣu dattaṁ na naśyati ॥6॥
13.78.7: annaṁ hi paramaṁ gāvo devānāṁ paramaṁ haviḥ,
13.78.8: gāvo yajñasya hi phalaṁ goṣu yajñāḥ pratiṣṭhitāḥ,
gāvo bhaviṣyaṁ bhūtaṁ ca goṣu yajñāḥ pratiṣṭhitāḥ ॥8॥
13.78.10: yāni kāni ca durgāṇi duṣkr̥tāni kr̥tāni ca,
taranti caiva pāpmānaṁ dhenuṁ ye dadati prabho ॥10॥
13.78.11: ekāṁ ca daśagurdadyād daśa dadyācca gośatī,
śataṁ sahasragurdadyāt sarve tulyaphalā hi te ॥11॥
13.78.12: samr̥ddho yaśca kīnāśo nārghyamarhanti te trayaḥ ॥12॥
13.78.16: nākīrtayitvā gāḥ supyāt tāsāṁ saṁsmr̥tya cotpatet,
13.78.17: na cāsāṁ māṁsamaśnīyād gavāṁ puṣṭiṁ tathāpnuyāt ॥17॥
13.78.19: gomayena sadā snāyāt karīṣe cāpi saṁviśet,
13.78.20: sārdre carmaṇi bhuñjīta nirīkṣed vāruṇīṁ diśam,
vāgyataḥ sarpiṣā bhūmau gavāṁ puṣṭiṁ sadāśnute ॥20॥
13.78.21: ghr̥taṁ dadyād ghr̥taṁ prāśed gavāṁ puṣṭiṁ sadāśnute ॥21॥
13.78.24: gā vai paśyāmyahaṁ nityaṁ gāvaḥ paśyantu māṁ sadā,
gāvo’smākaṁ vayaṁ tāsāṁ yato gāvastato vayam ॥24॥
13.78.25: evaṁ rātrau divā cāpi sameṣu viṣameṣu ca,
mahābhayeṣu ca naraḥ kīrtayan mucyate bhayāt ॥25॥
13.78.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate anuśāsanaparvaṇi dānadharmaparvaṇi gopradānike aṣṭasaptatitamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥78॥
13.79.2: bhavema na ca lipyema doṣeṇeti parantapa ॥2॥
13.79.4: tathā sarvāṇi bhūtāni sthāvarāṇi carāṇi ca,
13.79.5: tābhyo varaṁ dadau brahmā tapaso’nte svayaṁ prabhuḥ,
13.79.9: lohitāṁ tulyavatsāṁ tu dhenuṁ dattvā payasvinīm,
13.79.11: samānavatsāṁ śvetāṁ tu dhenuṁ dattvā payasvinīm,
13.79.12: samānavatsāṁ kr̥ṣṇāṁ tu dhenuṁ dattvā payasvinīm,
13.79.13: samānavatsāṁ dhūmrāṁ tu dhenuṁ dattvā payasvinīm,
13.79.19: samānavatsāṁ gaurīṁ tu dhenuṁ dattvā payasvinīm,
13.79.26: vīṇānāṁ vallakīnāṁ ca nūpurāṇāṁ ca siñjitaiḥ,
13.79.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate anuśāsanaparvaṇi dānadharmaparvaṇi gopradānike ekonāśītitamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥79॥
13.80.1: ghr̥tanadyo ghr̥tāvartāstā me santu sadā gr̥he ॥1॥
13.80.2: ghr̥taṁ me hr̥daye nityaṁ ghr̥taṁ nābhyāṁ pratiṣṭhitam,
ghr̥taṁ sarveṣu gātreṣu ghr̥taṁ me manasi sthitam ॥2॥
13.80.3: gāvo mamāgrato nityaṁ gāvaḥ pr̥ṣṭhata eva ca,
gāvo me sarvataścaiva gavāṁ madhye vasāmyaham ॥3॥
13.80.4: ityācamya japet sāyaṁ prātaśca puruṣaḥ sadā,
yadahnā kurute pāpaṁ tasmāt sa parimucyate ॥4॥
13.80.5: prāsādā yatra sauvarṇā vasordhārā ca yatra sā,
13.80.6: vahanti yatra vai nadyastatra yānti sahasradāḥ ॥6॥
13.80.7: gavāṁ śatasahasraṁ tu yaḥ prayacched yathāvidhi,
13.80.8: dadhāti sukr̥tān lokān punāti ca kulaṁ naraḥ ॥8॥
13.80.13: nātaḥ puṇyataraṁ dānaṁ nātaḥ puṇyataraṁ phalam,
13.80.15: tāṁ dhenuṁ śirasā vande bhūtabhavyasya mātaram ॥15॥
13.80.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate anuśāsanaparvaṇi dānadharmaparvaṇi gopradānike aśītitamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥80॥
13.81.1: pavitrāṇāṁ pavitraṁ yacchiṣṭaṁ loke ca yad bhavet,
pāvanaṁ paramaṁ caiva tanme brūhi pitāmaha ॥1॥
13.81.2: gāvo mahārthāḥ puṇyāśca tārayanti ca mānavān,
13.81.3: na hi puṇyatamaṁ kiñcid gobhyo bharatasattama,
etāḥ puṇyāḥ pavitrāśca triṣu lokeṣu sattamāḥ ॥3॥
13.81.9: kiṁ ca kr̥tvā paraṁ sthānaṁ prāpnuvanti manīṣiṇaḥ,
kena devāḥ pavitreṇa svargamaśnanti vā vibho ॥9॥
13.81.10: kiṁ ca yajñasya yajñatvaṁ kva ca yajñaḥ pratiṣṭhitaḥ,
devānāmuttamaṁ kiṁ ca kiṁ ca satramitaḥ param ॥10॥
13.81.11: pavitrāṇāṁ pavitraṁ ca yat tad brūhi pitarmama,
13.81.12: gāvaḥ pratiṣṭhā bhūtānāṁ tathā gāvaḥ parāyaṇam,
gāvaḥ puṇyāḥ pavitrāśca godhanaṁ pāvanaṁ tathā ॥12॥
13.81.14: tato brahmā tu gāḥ prāyamupaviṣṭāḥ samīkṣya ha,
īpsitaṁ pradadau tābhyo gobhyaḥ pratyekaśaḥ prabhuḥ ॥14॥
13.81.17: gāvastejo mahad divyaṁ gavāṁ dānaṁ praśasyate,
13.81.18: te vai sukr̥tinaḥ proktāḥ sarvadānapradāśca te,
gavāṁ lokaṁ tathā puṇyamāpnuvanti ca te’nagha ॥18॥
13.81.33: gāśca śuśrūṣate yaśca samanveti ca sarvaśaḥ,
13.81.34: druhyenna manasā vāpi goṣu nityaṁ sukhapradaḥ,
13.81.35: dāntaḥ prītamanā nityaṁ gavāṁ vyuṣṭiṁ tathāśnute,
13.81.36: gavāmuṣṇaṁ payaḥ pītvā tryahamuṣṇaṁ ghr̥taṁ pibet,
tryahamuṣṇaṁ ghr̥taṁ pītvā vāyubhakṣo bhavet tryaham ॥36॥
13.81.37: yat pavitraṁ pavitrāṇāṁ tad ghr̥taṁ śirasā vahet ॥37॥
13.81.38: ghr̥taṁ prāśed ghr̥taṁ dadyād gavāṁ puṣṭiṁ tathāśnute ॥38॥
13.81.41: gāvaḥ pavitrāḥ puṇyāśca pāvanaṁ paramaṁ mahat,
13.81.42: gavāṁ madhye śucirbhūtvā gomatīṁ manasā japet,
13.81.43: agnimadhye gavāṁ madhye brāhmaṇānāṁ ca saṁsadi,
13.81.45: gāvastuṣṭāḥ prayacchanti sevitā vai na saṁśayaḥ ॥45॥
13.81.46: rohiṇya iti jānīhi naitābhyo vidyate param ॥46॥
13.81.47: ityuktaḥ sa mahātejāḥ śukaḥ pitrā mahātmanā,
pūjayāmāsa gāṁ nityaṁ tasmāt tvamapi pūjaya ॥47॥
13.81.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate anuśāsanaparvaṇi dānadharmaparvaṇi gopradānike ekāśītitamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥81॥
13.82.1: mayā gavāṁ purīṣaṁ vai śriyā juṣṭamiti śrutam,
13.82.3: śrīḥ kr̥tveha vapuḥ kāntaṁ gomadhyeṣu viveśa ha,
13.82.4: kāsi devi kuto vā tvaṁ rūpeṇāpratimā bhuvi,
vismitāḥ sma mahābhāge tava rūpasya sampadā ॥4॥
13.82.5: icchāma tvāṁ vayaṁ jñātuṁ kā tvaṁ kva ca gamiṣyasi,
13.82.6: mayā daityāḥ parityaktā vinaṣṭāḥ śāśvatīḥ samāḥ ॥6॥
13.82.10: icchāmi cāpi yuṣmāsu vastuṁ sarvāsu nityadā,
āgatya prārthaye yuṣmān śrījuṣṭā bhavatātha vai ॥10॥
13.82.11: adhruvā capalā ca tvaṁ sāmānyā bahubhiḥ saha,
na tvāmicchāma bhadraṁ te gamyatāṁ yatra raṁsyase ॥11॥
13.82.12: vapuṣmantyo vayaṁ sarvāḥ kimasmākaṁ tvayādya vai,
yatheṣṭaṁ gamyatāṁ tatra kr̥takāryā vayaṁ tvayā ॥12॥
13.82.13: kimetad vaḥ kṣamaṁ gāvo yanmāṁ nehābhinandatha,
na māṁ samprati gr̥hṇīdhvaṁ kasmād vai durlabhāṁ satīm ॥13॥
13.82.14: satyaṁ ca lokavādo’yaṁ loke carati suvratāḥ,
13.82.15: mahadugraṁ tapaḥ kr̥tvā māṁ niṣevanti mānavāḥ,
13.82.16: prabhāva eṣa vo gāvaḥ pratigr̥hṇīta māmiha,
13.82.18: bahunā ca kimuktena gamyatāṁ yatra vāñchasi,
13.82.23: vaseyaṁ yatra vo dehe tanme vyākhyātumarhatha,
13.82.24: śakr̥nmūtre nivasa tvaṁ puṇyametaddhi naḥ śubhe ॥24॥
13.82.25: evaṁ bhavatu bhadraṁ vaḥ pūjitāsmi sukhapradāḥ ॥25॥
13.82.26: evaṁ kr̥tvā tu samayaṁ śrīrgobhiḥ saha bhārata,
13.82.27: māhātmyaṁ ca gavāṁ bhūyaḥ śrūyatāṁ gadato mama ॥27॥
13.82.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate anuśāsanaparvaṇi dānadharmaparvaṇi śrīgosaṁvādo nāma dvyaśītitamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥82॥
13.83.1: ye ca gāṁ samprayacchanti hutaśiṣṭāśinaśca ye,
13.83.2: r̥te dadhi ghr̥teneha na yajñaḥ sampravartate,
tena yajñasya yajñatvamato mūlaṁ ca kathyate ॥2॥
13.83.5: gāvastejaḥ paraṁ proktamiha loke paratra ca,
na gobhyaḥ paramaṁ kiñcit pavitraṁ bharatarṣabha ॥5॥
13.83.14: kiṁ tapo brahmacaryaṁ vā gobhiḥ kr̥tamiheśvara,
13.83.15: tataḥ provāca brahmā taṁ śakraṁ balaniṣūdanam,
13.83.16: tena tvamāsāṁ māhātmyaṁ vetsi śr̥ṇu yat prabho,
gavāṁ prabhāvaṁ paramaṁ māhātmyaṁ ca surarṣabha ॥16॥
13.83.17: yajñāṅgaṁ kathitā gāvo yajña eva ca vāsava,
etābhiśca vinā yajño na varteta kathañcana ॥17॥
13.83.19: janayanti ca dhānyāni bījāni vividhāni ca,
tato yajñāḥ pravartante havyaṁ kavyaṁ ca sarvaśaḥ ॥19॥
13.83.22: evaṁ te kāraṇaṁ śakra nivāsakr̥tamadya vai ॥22॥
13.83.25: tacca me śr̥ṇu kārtsnyena vadato balasūdana,
13.83.27: tāṁ tu dr̥ṣṭvā mahādevīṁ tapyamānāṁ mahattapaḥ ॥27॥
13.83.28: dakṣasya duhitā devī surabhī nāma nāmataḥ,
13.83.31: tatra gatvā mayā sārdhaṁ paryupāsanta tāṁ śubhām,
13.83.34: eṣa eva varo me’dya yat prīto’si mamānagha ॥34॥
13.83.38: mānuṣeṣu ca kurvāṇāḥ prajāḥ karma śubhāstava,
13.83.39: yacca svarge sukhaṁ devi tat te sampatsyate śubhe ॥39॥
13.83.40: na tatra kramate mr̥tyurna jarā na ca pāvakaḥ ॥40॥
13.83.41: na daivaṁ nāśubhaṁ kiñcid vidyate tatra vāsava,
13.83.42: brahmacaryeṇa tapasā yatnena ca damena ca ॥42॥
13.83.43: tapasā mahatā caiva sukr̥tena ca karmaṇā ॥43॥
13.83.46: gāścakre bahumānaṁ ca tāsu nityaṁ yudhiṣṭhira ॥46॥
13.83.47: etat te sarvamākhyātaṁ pāvanaṁ ca mahādyute,
13.83.50: goṣu bhaktaśca labhate yad yadicchati mānavaḥ,
striyo’pi bhaktā yā goṣu tāśca kāmamavāpnuyuḥ ॥50॥
13.83.52: vidyārthī cāpnuyād vidyāṁ sukhārthī prāpnuyāt sukham,
na kiñcid durlabhaṁ caiva gavāṁ bhaktasya bhārata ॥52॥
13.83.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate anuśāsanaparvaṇi dānadharmaparvaṇi golokavarṇane tryaśītitamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥83॥
13.84.2: rājyaṁ hi satataṁ duḥkhaṁ durdharaṁ cākr̥tātmabhiḥ,
bhūyiṣṭhaṁ ca narendrāṇāṁ vidyate na śubhā gatiḥ ॥2॥
13.84.3: sarve ca kathitā dharmāstvayā me kurunandana ॥3॥
13.84.4: evameva gavāmuktaṁ pradānaṁ te nr̥geṇa ha,
13.84.6: tatra śrutistu paramā suvarṇaṁ dakṣiṇeti vai,
13.84.7: kiṁ suvarṇaṁ kathaṁ jātaṁ kasmin kāle kimātmakam,
kiṁ daivaṁ kiṁ phalaṁ caiva kasmācca paramucyate ॥7॥
13.84.9: paramaṁ dakṣiṇārthe ca tad bravīhi pitāmaha ॥9॥
13.84.12: mātā me jāhnavī cātra sāhāyyamakarot tadā ॥12॥
13.84.17: tato me punarevāsīt sañjñā sañcintya śāstrataḥ,
nāyaṁ vedeṣu vihito vidhirhasta iti prabho ॥17॥
13.84.18: sākṣānneha manuṣyasya piṇḍaṁ hi pitaraḥ kvacit ॥18॥
13.84.19: gr̥hṇanti vihitaṁ cetthaṁ piṇḍo deyaḥ kuśeṣviti,
13.84.23: tvayā hi kurvatā śāstraṁ pramāṇamiha pārthiva ॥23॥
13.84.24: ātmā dharmaḥ śrutaṁ vedāḥ pitaraścarṣibhiḥ saha,
13.84.26: kiṁ tu bhūmergavāṁ cārthe suvarṇaṁ dīyatāmiti,
evaṁ vayaṁ ca dharmajña sarve cāsmatpitāmahāḥ ॥26॥
13.84.27: pāvitā vai bhaviṣyanti pāvanaṁ hi paraṁ hi tat,
13.84.31: tato jitvā mahīṁ kr̥tsnāṁ rāmo rājīvalocanaḥ ॥31॥
13.84.33: vipāpmā ca sa tejasvī tena kratuphalena ca ॥33॥
13.84.35: pāvanaṁ yat paraṁ nr̥̄ṇāmugre karmaṇi vartatām ॥35॥
13.84.40: kena vā karmayogena pradāneneha kena vā,
prabrūta pāvanaṁ kiṁ me bhavediti tapodhanāḥ ॥40॥
13.84.41: gāśca bhūmiṁ ca vittaṁ ca dattveha bhr̥gunandana,
pāpakr̥t pūyate martya iti bhārgava śuśruma ॥41॥
13.84.42: anyad dānaṁ tu viprarṣe śrūyatāṁ pāvanaṁ mahat,
13.84.43: dagdhvā lokān purā vīryāt sambhūtamiha śuśruma,
13.84.45: phalaṁ dāsyati te yat tu dāne paramihocyate,
suvarṇaṁ yacca yasmācca yathā ca guṇavattamam ॥45॥
13.84.48: iḍā gāvaḥ payaḥ somo bhūmirityeva ca smr̥tiḥ ॥48॥
13.84.49: jagat sarvaṁ ca nirmathya tejorāśiḥ samutthitaḥ,
13.84.56: agnirhi devatāḥ sarvāḥ suvarṇaṁ ca tadātmakam ॥56॥
13.84.57: tasmāt suvarṇaṁ dadatā dattāḥ sarvāḥ sma devatāḥ,
bhavanti puruṣavyāghra na hyataḥ paramaṁ viduḥ ॥57॥
13.84.58: bhūya eva ca māhātmyaṁ suvarṇasya nibodha me,
13.84.59: prajāpateḥ kathayato yathānyāyaṁ tu tasya vai ॥59॥
13.84.63: ayaṁ samāgamo deva devyā saha tavānagha ॥63॥
13.84.68: na hi te pr̥thivī devī na ca dyaurna divaṁ vibho ॥68॥
13.84.69: nedaṁ dhārayituṁ śaktāḥ samastā iti me matiḥ,
13.84.70: tasmāt prasādaṁ bhagavan kartumarhasi naḥ prabho,
na devyāṁ sambhavet putro bhavataḥ surasattama,
13.84.72: ūrdhvaretāḥ samabhavat tataḥ prabhr̥ti cāpi saḥ ॥72॥
13.84.73: rudrāṇīti tataḥ kruddhā prajocchede tadā kr̥te,
13.84.75: prajocchedo mama kr̥to yasmād yuṣmābhiradya vai,
tasmāt prajā vaḥ khagamāḥ sarveṣāṁ na bhaviṣyati ॥75॥
13.84.81: sthānāni devatānāṁ hi vimānāni purāṇi ca,
13.84.82: te dīnamanasaḥ sarve devatā r̥ṣayaśca ye,
13.84.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate anuśāsanaparvaṇi dānadharmaparvaṇi suvarṇotpattirnāma caturaśītitamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥84॥
13.85.2: paritrāyasva no deva na hyanyā gatirasti naḥ ॥2॥
13.85.4: vihitaṁ pūrvamevātra mayā vai vyetu vo jvaraḥ ॥4॥
13.85.5: devairna śakyate hantuṁ sa kathaṁ praśamaṁ vrajet ॥5॥
13.85.6: sa hi naiva sma devānāṁ nāsurāṇāṁ na rakṣasām,
vadhyaḥ syāmiti jagrāha varaṁ tvattaḥ pitāmaha ॥6॥
13.85.10: yato vo bhayamutpannaṁ ye cānye suraśatravaḥ ॥10॥
13.85.11: rudrasya tejaḥ praskannamagnau nipatitaṁ ca yat ॥11॥
13.85.13: sa tu nāvāpa taṁ śāpaṁ naṣṭaḥ sa hutabhuk tadā,
tasmād vo bhayahr̥d devāḥ samutpatsyati pāvakiḥ ॥13॥
13.85.15: na hi tejasvināṁ śāpāstejaḥsu prabhavanti vai,
13.85.18: sa vo manogataṁ kāmaṁ devaḥ sampādayiṣyati ॥18॥
13.85.25: sa saṁsupto jale devā bhagavān havyavāhanaḥ,
13.85.26: tasya darśanamiṣṭaṁ vo yadi devā vibhāvasoḥ,
13.85.28: śaśāpa sa tamāsādya na rasān vetsyasīti vai ॥28॥
13.85.29: taṁ vai saṁyujya śāpena maṇḍūkaṁ tvarito yayau,
13.85.37: anugrahaṁ tu nāgānāṁ yaṁ cakruḥ śr̥ṇu taṁ prabho,
13.85.40: śukena khyāpito vipra taṁ devāḥ samupādravan,
13.85.48: tvāṁ niyokṣyāmahe kārye tad bhavān kartumarhati ॥48॥
13.85.49: kr̥te ca tasmin bhavitā tavāpi sumahān guṇaḥ ॥49॥
13.85.50: brūta yad bhavatāṁ kāryaṁ kartāsmi tadahaṁ surāḥ,
bhavatāṁ tu niyojyo’smi mā vo’trāstu vicāraṇā ॥50॥
13.85.53: apatyaṁ tejasā yuktaṁ pravīraṁ janaya prabho,
13.85.54: anyatra bhavato vīryaṁ tasmāt trāyasva naḥ prabho ॥54॥
13.85.56: vavr̥dhe sa tadā garbhaḥ kakṣe kr̥ṣṇagatiryathā ॥56॥
13.85.57: santāpamagamat tīvraṁ soḍhuṁ sā na śaśāka ha ॥57॥
13.85.62: vimūḍhāsmi kr̥tānena na me svāsthyaṁ yathā purā,
vihvalā cāsmi bhagavaṁśceto naṣṭaṁ ca me’nagha ॥62॥
13.85.63: dhāraṇe nāsya śaktāhaṁ garbhasya tapatāṁ vara,
13.85.64: na tejaso’sti saṁsparśo mama deva vibhāvaso,
13.85.65: tvayyeva tadahaṁ manye dharmādharmau ca kevalau ॥65॥
13.85.67: śaktā hyasi mahīṁ kr̥tsnāṁ voḍhuṁ dhārayituṁ tathā,
13.85.68: samutsasarja taṁ garbhaṁ merau girivare tadā ॥68॥
13.85.71: papraccha saritāṁ śreṣṭhāṁ kaccid garbhaḥ sukhodayaḥ,
tejasā kena vā yuktaḥ sarvametad bravīhi me ॥71॥
13.85.72: jātarūpaḥ sa garbho vai tejasā tvamivānagha,
13.85.73: gandho’sya sa kadambānāṁ tulyo vai tapatāṁ vara ॥73॥
13.85.74: yad dravyaṁ parasaṁsr̥ṣṭaṁ pr̥thivyāṁ parvateṣu ca ॥74॥
13.85.79: pr̥thivī ca tadā devī khyātā vasumatīti vai ॥79॥
13.85.80: sa tu garbho mahātejā gāṅgeyaḥ pāvakodbhavaḥ,
13.85.81: putraṁ vai tāśca taṁ bālaṁ pupuṣuḥ stanyavisravaiḥ ॥81॥
13.85.85: pavitraṁ ca pavitrāṇāṁ maṅgalānāṁ ca maṅgalam,
13.85.87: api cedaṁ purā rāma śrutaṁ me brahmadarśanam,
13.85.88: aiśvarye vāruṇe rāma rudrasyeśasya vai prabho ॥88॥
13.85.90: mūrtimanti ca sāmāni yajūṁṣi ca sahasraśaḥ,
13.85.92: bhūtaṁ bhavyaṁ bhaviṣyaṁ ca dadhāra bhagavān śivaḥ ॥92॥
13.85.94: dyaurnabhaḥ pr̥thivī khaṁ ca tathā caivaiṣa bhūpatiḥ,
13.85.95: eṣa brahmā śivo rudro varuṇo’gniḥ prajāpatiḥ,
13.85.96: tasya yajñaḥ paśupatestapaḥ kratava eva ca,
13.85.98: svayambhuvastu tā dr̥ṣṭvā retaḥ samapatad bhuvi ॥98॥
13.85.99: tasya śukrasya vispandān pāṁsūn saṅgr̥hya bhūmitaḥ,
trāsyat pūṣā karābhyāṁ vai tasminneva hutāśane ॥99॥
13.85.101: skannamātraṁ ca tacchukraṁ sruveṇa parigr̥hya saḥ,
13.85.102: tataḥ sa janayāmāsa bhūtagrāmaṁ ca vīryavān,
13.85.105: puruṣā vapuṣā yuktāḥ svaiḥ svaiḥ prasavajairguṇaiḥ,
13.85.114: uddiṣṭāste tathāṅgārā ye dhiṣṇyeṣu divi sthitāḥ ॥114॥
13.85.115: ādikartā ca lokasya tatparaṁ brahma tad dhruvam,
13.85.117: trīṇi pūrvāṇyapatyāni mama tāni na saṁśayaḥ,
iti jānīta khagamā mama yajñaphalaṁ hi tat ॥117॥
13.85.119: mamaiva tānyapatyāni mama śukraṁ hutaṁ hi tat ॥119॥
13.85.120: ahaṁ kartā hi satrasya hotā śukrasya caiva ha,
yasya bījaṁ phalaṁ tasya śukraṁ cet kāraṇaṁ matam ॥120॥
13.85.122: vayaṁ ca bhagavan sarve jagacca sacarācaram,
13.85.125: tadā sa vāruṇaḥ khyāto bhr̥guḥ prasava karmavit ॥125॥
13.85.127: ete hi prasravāḥ sarve prajānāṁ patayastrayaḥ,
13.85.128: bhr̥gostu putrāḥ saptāsan sarve tulyā bhr̥gorguṇaiḥ,
13.85.129: śukro vareṇyaśca vibhuḥ savanaśceti sapta te,
bhārgavā vāruṇāḥ sarve yeṣāṁ vaṁśe bhavānapi ॥129॥
13.85.131: ghoro virūpaḥ saṁvartaḥ sudhanvā cāṣṭamaḥ smr̥taḥ,
13.85.136: kaviṁ tāta bhr̥guṁ cāpi tasmāt tau vāruṇau smr̥tau ॥136॥
13.85.142: sarve hi vayamete ca tavaiva prasavaḥ prabho,
devānāṁ brāhmaṇānāṁ ca tvaṁ hi kartā pitāmaha ॥142॥
13.85.144: te tvanenaiva rūpeṇa prajaniṣyanti vai prajāḥ,
13.85.145: ityuktaḥ sa tadā taistu brahmā lokapitāmahaḥ,
13.85.146: evametat purā vr̥ttaṁ tasya yajñe mahātmanaḥ,
13.85.149: kuśastambe juhotyagniṁ suvarṇe tatra ca sthite,
valmīkasya vapāyāṁ ca karṇe vājasya dakṣiṇe ॥149॥
13.85.152: tasmād ye vai prayacchanti suvarṇaṁ dharmadarśinaḥ,
devatāste prayacchanti samastā iti naḥ śrutam ॥152॥
13.85.153: tasya cātamaso lokā gacchataḥ paramāṁ gatim,
13.85.154: dadāti kāñcanaṁ yo vai duḥsvapnaṁ pratihanti saḥ ॥154॥
13.85.156: dadāti paścimāṁ sandhyāṁ yaḥ suvarṇaṁ yatavrataḥ,
13.85.157: sendreṣu caiva lokeṣu pratiṣṭhāṁ vindate śubhām,
iha loke yaśaḥ prāpya śāntapāpmā ca modate ॥157॥
13.85.159: na ca kṣarati tebhyaśca yaśaścaivāpnute mahat,
13.85.161: agnimityeva tat prāhuḥ pradānaṁ ca sukhāvaham,
13.85.162: kārtikeyasya ca vibho tad viddhi bhr̥gunandana ॥162॥
13.85.165: suvarṇadāne ca mayā kathitāste guṇā vibho,
tasmāt suvarṇaṁ viprebhyaḥ prayaccha dadatāṁ vara ॥165॥
13.85.166: dadai suvarṇaṁ viprebhyo vyamucyata ca kilbiṣāt ॥166॥
13.85.167: pradānasya phalaṁ caiva janma cāsya yudhiṣṭhira ॥167॥
13.85.168: tasmāt tvamapi viprebhyaḥ prayaccha kanakaṁ bahu,
13.85.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate anuśāsanaparvaṇi dānadharmaparvaṇi suvarṇotpattirnāma pañcāśītitamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥85॥
13.86.2: sa kathaṁ tārakaḥ prāpto nidhanaṁ tad bravīhi me ॥2॥
13.86.3: uktaṁ sa devatānāṁ hi avadhya iti pārthiva,
13.86.4: kārtsnyena tārakavadhaṁ paraṁ kautūhalaṁ hi me ॥4॥
13.86.7: ṣaṇṇāṁ tāsāṁ tataḥ prītaḥ pāvako garbhadhāraṇāt,
13.86.8: praṭsu vartmasu tejo’gneḥ sakalaṁ nihitaṁ prabho ॥8॥
13.86.15: rudro dhātā ca viṣṇuśca yamaḥ pūṣāryamā bhagaḥ ॥15॥
13.86.20: lebhire paramaṁ harṣaṁ menire cāsuraṁ hatam,
tato devāḥ priyāṇyasya sarva eva samāharan ॥20॥
13.86.23: gavāṁ mātā ca gā devī dadau śatasahasraśaḥ ॥23॥
13.86.25: varuṇo vāruṇān divyān sagajān pradadau śubhān,
13.86.27: vardhamānaṁ tu taṁ dr̥ṣṭvā prārthayāmāsa tārakaḥ,
13.86.31: īśo goptā ca devānāṁ priyakr̥cchaṅkarasya ca ॥31॥
13.86.35: rāmaḥ suvarṇaṁ dattvā hi vimuktaḥ sarvakilbiṣaiḥ,
13.86.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate anuśāsanaparvaṇi dānadharmaparvaṇi tārakavadhopākhyānaṁ nāma ṣaḍaśītitamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥86॥
13.87.1: cāturvarṇyasya dharmātman dharmāḥ proktā yathā tvayā,
tathaiva me śrāddhavidhiṁ kr̥tsnaṁ prabrūhi pārthiva ॥1॥
13.87.4: piśācakinnarāṇāṁ ca pūjyā vai pitaraḥ sadā ॥4॥
13.87.5: tasmāt tān sarvayajñena puruṣaḥ pūjayet sadā ॥5॥
13.87.8: tat sarvaṁ kīrtayiṣyāmi yathāvat tannibodha me ॥8॥
13.87.10: striyo dvitīyāṁ jāyante tr̥tīyāyāṁ tu vājinaḥ,
13.87.11: pañcamyāṁ bahavaḥ putrā jāyante kurvatāṁ nr̥pa,
13.87.13: vivardhante tu daśamīṁ gāvaḥ śrāddhān vikurvataḥ ॥13॥
13.87.15: rajataṁ bahuvittaṁ ca suvarṇaṁ ca manoramam ॥15॥
13.87.16: jñātīnāṁ tu bhavecchreṣṭhaḥ kurvan śrāddhaṁ trayodaśīm,
avaśyaṁ tu yuvāno’sya pramīyante narā gr̥he ॥16॥
13.87.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate anuśāsanaparvaṇi dānadharmaparvaṇi śrāddhakalpe saptāśītitamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥87॥
13.88.2: havīṁṣi śrāddhakalpe tu yāni śrāddhavido viduḥ,
tāni me śr̥ṇu kāmyāni phalaṁ caiva yudhiṣṭhira ॥2॥
13.88.3: dattena māsaṁ prīyante śrāddhena pitaro nr̥pa ॥3॥
13.88.4: sarveṣveva tu bhojyeṣu tilāḥ prādhānyataḥ smr̥tāḥ ॥4॥
13.88.5: yathā gavyaṁ tathā yuktaṁ pāyasaṁ sarpiṣā saha ॥5॥
13.88.7: api naḥ svakule jāyād yo no dadyāttrayodaśīm,
13.88.9: eṣṭavyā bahavaḥ putrā yadyeko’pi gayāṁ vrajet,
13.88.10: āpo mūlaṁ phalaṁ māṁsamannaṁ vāpi pitr̥kṣaye,
13.89.1: tāni me śr̥ṇu kāmyāni nakṣatreṣu pr̥thak pr̥thak ॥1॥
13.89.2: śrāddhaṁ yaḥ kr̥ttikāyoge kurvīta satataṁ naraḥ,
13.89.7: citrāyāṁ tu dadacchrāddhaṁ labhed rūpavataḥ sutān,
13.89.11: śravaṇeṣu dadacchrāddhaṁ pretya gacchet sa sadgatim ॥11॥
13.89.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate anuśāsanaparvaṇi dānadharmaparvaṇi śrāddhakalpe ekonanavatitamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥89॥
13.90.2: daive karmaṇi pitrye tu nyāyamāhuḥ parīkṣaṇam ॥2॥
13.90.4: śrāddhe tvatha mahārāja parīkṣed brāhmaṇān budhaḥ,
13.90.5: apāṅkteyāstu ye rājan kīrtayiṣyāmi tān śr̥ṇu ॥5॥
13.90.10: śvabhiśca yaḥ parikrāmed yaḥ śunā daṣṭa eva ca,
13.90.13: purīṣe tasya te māsaṁ pitarastasya śerate,
13.90.14: yattu vāṇijake dattaṁ neha nāmutra tad bhavet ॥14॥
13.90.15: bhasmanīva hutaṁ havyaṁ tathā paunarbhave dvije,
havyaṁ kavyaṁ prayacchanti teṣāṁ tat pretya naśyati ॥15॥
13.90.16: purīṣaṁ bhuñjate teṣāṁ pitaraḥ pretya niścayaḥ ॥16॥
13.90.18: ṣaṣṭiṁ kāṇaḥ śataṁ ṣaṇḍhaḥ śvitrī yāvatprapaśyati,
13.90.19: yad veṣṭitaśirā bhuṅkte yad bhuṅkte dakṣiṇāmukhaḥ,
sopānatkaśca yad bhuṅkte sarvaṁ vidyāt tadāsuram ॥19॥
13.90.20: asūyatā ca yad dattaṁ yacca śraddhāvivarjitam,
13.90.24: ye tvatastān pravakṣyāmi parīkṣasveha tān dvijān ॥24॥
13.90.34: ye ca bhāṣyavidaḥ kecid ye ca vyākaraṇe ratāḥ,
13.90.35: adhītya ca yathānyāyaṁ vidhivat tasya kāriṇaḥ,
13.90.40: na ca syāt patito rājan paṅktipāvana eva saḥ,
13.90.41: yasya mitrapradhānāni śrāddhāni ca havīṁṣi ca ॥41॥
13.90.42: na prīṇanti pitr̥̄n devān svargaṁ ca na sa gacchati,
sa vai muktaḥ pippalaṁ bandhanād vā
13.90.45: tasmai śrāddhaṁ na dātavyaṁ na hi bhasmani hūyate ॥45॥
13.90.49: r̥ṣīṇāṁ samaye nityaṁ ye caranti yudhiṣṭhira,
13.90.51: tatra ye brāhmaṇān kecinna nindanti hi te narāḥ ॥51॥
13.90.52: ye tu nindanti jalpeṣu na tāñchrāddheṣu bhojayet,
13.90.54: priyo vā yadi vā dveṣyasteṣāṁ tu śrāddhamāvapet,
13.90.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate anuśāsanaparvaṇi dānadharmaparvaṇi śrāddhakalpe navatitamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥90॥
13.91.1: kena saṅkalpitaṁ śrāddhaṁ kasmin kāle kimātmakam,
13.91.2: kāni śrāddhāni varjyāni kāni mūlaphalāni ca,
13.91.3: yathā śrāddhaṁ sampravr̥ttaṁ yasmin kāle yadātmakam,
yena saṅkalpitaṁ caiva tanme śr̥ṇu janādhipa ॥3॥
13.91.4: tasya vaṁśe mahārāja dattātreya iti smr̥taḥ ॥4॥
13.91.6: pūrṇe varṣasahasrānte sa kr̥tvā duṣkaraṁ tapaḥ,
13.91.10: yāni tasyaiva bhojyāni mūlāni ca phalāni ca ॥10॥
13.91.11: uktāni yāni cānnāni yāni ceṣṭāni tasya ha,
13.91.13: r̥te ca lavaṇaṁ bhojyaṁ śyāmākānnaṁ dadau prabhuḥ ॥13॥
13.91.15: kr̥tvā ca dakṣiṇāgrān vai darbhān sa prayataḥ śuciḥ,
13.91.17: kathaṁ nu śāpena na māṁ daheyurbrāhmaṇā iti ॥17॥
13.91.20: mā te bhūd bhīḥ pūrvadr̥ṣṭo dharmo’yaṁ brahmaṇā svayam ॥20॥
13.91.22: svayambhuvihitaṁ putra tat kuruṣva nibodha me ॥22॥
13.91.24: viśvedevāśca ye nityaṁ pitr̥bhiḥ saha gocarāḥ,
13.91.27: devāstu pitaro nāma nirmitā ye svayambhuvā,
13.91.28: te śrāddhenārcyamānā vai vimucyante ha kilbiṣāt,
13.91.29: viśve cāgnimukhā devāḥ saṅkhyātāḥ pūrvameva te,
13.91.31: vivasvān vīryavān hrīmān kīrtimān kr̥ta eva ca,
13.91.33: srajo vajrī varī caiva viśvedevāḥ sanātanāḥ,
13.91.37: anugoptā sugoptā ca naptā ceśvara eva ca,
13.91.42: nivāpe havyakavye vā garhitaṁ ca sudarśanam,
13.91.43: kāṣāyavāsāḥ kuṣṭhī vā patito brahmahāpi vā ॥43॥
13.91.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate anuśāsanaparvaṇi dānadharmaparvaṇi śrāddhakalpe ekanavatitamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥91॥
13.92.1: tathā nimau pravr̥tte tu sarva eva maharṣayaḥ,
13.92.7: te somavacanād devāḥ pitr̥bhiḥ saha bhārata,
13.92.8: prasādaṁ kuru no deva śreyo naḥ saṁvidhīyatām ॥8॥
13.92.10: jarayiṣyatha cāpyannaṁ mayā sārdhaṁ na saṁśayaḥ ॥10॥
13.92.11: etasmāt kāraṇāccāgneḥ prāk tāvad dīyate nr̥pa ॥11॥
13.92.13: pūrvaṁ piṇḍaṁ piturdadyāt tato dadyāt pitāmahe ॥13॥
13.92.14: prapitāmahāya ca tata eṣa śrāddhavidhiḥ smr̥taḥ,
brūyācchrāddhe ca sāvitrīṁ piṇḍe piṇḍe samāhitaḥ ॥14॥
13.92.15: somāyeti ca vaktavyaṁ tathā pitr̥mateti ca,
rajasvalā ca yā nārī vyaṅgitā karṇayośca yā,
13.92.19: sadā nāvi jalaṁ tajjñāḥ prayacchanti samāhitāḥ,
13.92.22: ete ca pitaro rājanneṣa śrāddhavidhiḥ paraḥ,
13.92.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate anuśāsanaparvaṇi dānadharmaparvaṇi śrāddhakalpe dvinavatitamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥92॥
13.93.3: tapaḥ syādetadeveha tapo’nyad vāpi kiṁ bhavet ॥3॥
13.93.4: ātmatantropaghātī yo na tapasvī na dharmavit ॥4॥
13.93.5: tyāgasya cāpi sampattiḥ śiṣyate tapa uttamam,
sadopavāsī ca bhaved brahmacārī tathaiva ca ॥5॥
13.93.6: muniśca syāt sadā vipro vedāṁścaiva sadā japet,
13.93.7: amāṁsāśī sadā ca syāt pavitraṁ ca sadā paṭhet,
r̥tavādī sadā ca syānniyataśca sadā bhavet ॥7॥
13.93.8: vighasāśī kathaṁ ca syād sadā caivātithipriyaḥ,
amr̥tāśī sadā ca syāt pavitrī ca sadā bhavet ॥8॥
13.93.9: kathaṁ sadopavāsī syād brahmacārī ca pārthiva,
vighasāśī kathaṁ ca syāt kathaṁ caivātithipriyaḥ ॥9॥
13.93.10: antarā sāyamāśaṁ ca prātarāśaṁ ca yo naraḥ,
sadopavāsī bhavati yo na bhuṅkte’ntarā punaḥ ॥10॥
13.93.11: bhāryāṁ gacchan brahmacārī r̥tau bhavati caiva ha,
r̥tavādī sadā ca syād dānaśīlastu mānavaḥ ॥11॥
13.93.13: bhr̥tyātithiṣu yo bhuṅkte bhuktavatsu naraḥ sadā,
amr̥taṁ kevalaṁ bhuṅkte iti viddhi yudhiṣṭhira ॥13॥
13.93.14: abhuktavatsu nāśnāti brāhmaṇeṣu tu yo naraḥ,
13.93.16: teṣāṁ lokā hyaparyantāḥ sadane brahmaṇaḥ smr̥tāḥ,
13.93.22: śūdraḥ paśusakhaścaiva bhartā cāsyā babhūva ha ॥22॥
13.93.23: te ca sarve tapasyantaḥ purā cerurmahīmimām,
13.93.25: dakṣiṇārthe’tha r̥tvigbhyo dattaḥ putraḥ purā kila ॥25॥
13.93.27: mayi yad vidyate vittaṁ tad vr̥ṇudhvaṁ tapodhanāḥ ॥27॥
13.93.31: tajjānamānaḥ kasmāt tvaṁ kuruṣe naḥ pralobhanam ॥31॥
13.93.32: amalo hyeṣa tapasā prītaḥ prīṇāti devatāḥ ॥32॥
13.93.33: tad dāva iva nirdahyāt prāpto rājapratigrahaḥ ॥33॥
13.93.34: kuśalaṁ saha dānena rājannastu sadā tava,
13.93.35: tataḥ pracoditā rājñā vanaṁ gatvāsya mantriṇaḥ,
13.93.37: na smahe mandavijñānā na smahe mandabuddhayaḥ ॥37॥
13.93.39: tathā bahu pratīcchan vai pāpiṣṭhāṁ patate gatim ॥39॥
13.93.40: sarvaṁ tannālamekasya tasmād vidvān śamaṁ caret ॥40॥
13.93.41: prārthanā puruṣasyeva tasya mātrā na vidyate ॥41॥
13.93.44: pratigrahe saṁyamo vai tapo dhārayate dhruvam,
13.93.45: dharmārthaṁ sañcayo yo vai dravyāṇāṁ pakṣasammataḥ,
13.93.47: yad vai dharme paraṁ nāsti brāhmaṇāstaddhanaṁ viduḥ,
13.93.48: kuśalaṁ saha dānena tasmai yasya prajā imāḥ,
13.93.49: ityuktvā hemagarbhāṇi hitvā tāni phalāni vai,
13.93.50: upadhiṁ śaṅkamānāste hitvā tāni phalāni vai,
13.93.51: teṣāṁ vai pratikartuṁ ca sarveṣāmagamad gr̥ham ॥51॥
13.93.56: vinaṣṭeṣu tathā svairaṁ gaccha yatrepsitaṁ tava ॥56॥
13.93.57: jagāma tad vanaṁ yatra viceruste maharṣayaḥ ॥57॥
13.93.58: vyacaran bhakṣayanto vai mūlāni ca phalāni ca ॥58॥
13.93.60: arundhatī tu taṁ dr̥ṣṭvā sarvāṅgopacitaṁ śubham,
13.93.61: sāyaṁ prātaśca hotavyaṁ tena pīvāñchunā saha ॥61॥
13.93.62: kr̥cchrādhītaṁ praṇaṣṭaṁ ca tena pīvāñchunā saha ॥62॥
13.93.64: sañcintyaṁ vārṣikaṁ citte tena pīvāñchunā saha ॥64॥
13.93.65: dehi dehīti bhikṣanti tena pīvāñchunā saha ॥65॥
13.93.67: ekaikaṁ vai trivarṣīyaṁ tena pīvāñchunā saha ॥67॥
13.93.68: atha dr̥ṣṭvā parivrāṭ sa tān maharṣīn śunā saha,
13.93.70: ādadānāḥ samuddhr̥tya mūlāni ca phalāni ca ॥70॥
13.93.77: ekā tiṣṭhasi kā ca tvaṁ kasyārthe kiṁ prayojanam,
13.93.78: yāsmi sāsmyanuyogo me na kartavyaḥ kathañcana,
ārakṣiṇīṁ māṁ padminyā vitta sarve tapodhanāḥ ॥78॥
13.93.79: sarva eva kṣudhārtāḥ sma na cānyat kiñcidasti naḥ,
13.93.80: ekaiko nāma me proktvā tato gr̥hṇīta māciram ॥80॥
13.93.82: arātriratriḥ sā rātriryāṁ nādhīte triradya vai,
13.93.84: vasiṣṭhatvācca vāsācca vasiṣṭha iti viddhi mām ॥84॥
13.93.86: kulaṁ kulaṁ ca kuvamaḥ kuvamaḥ kaśyapo dvijaḥ,
13.93.88: bhare’sutān bhare’śiṣyān bhare devān bhare dvijān,
bhare bhāryāṁ bhare dvājaṁ bharadvājo’smi śobhane ॥88॥
13.93.90: viddhi māṁ gautamaṁ kr̥tye yātudhāni nibodha mām ॥90॥
13.93.92: viśve devāśca me mitraṁ mitramasmi gavāṁ tathā,
13.93.100: paśūn rañjāmi dr̥ṣṭvāhaṁ paśūnāṁ ca sadā sakhā,
13.93.103: tasmāt punaridānīṁ tvaṁ brūhi yannāma te dvija ॥103॥
13.93.104: sakr̥duktaṁ mayā nāma na gr̥hītaṁ tvayā yadi,
tasmāt tridaṇḍābhihatā gaccha bhasmeti mā jiram ॥104॥
13.93.105: sā brahmadaṇḍakalpena tena mūrdhni hatā tadā,
kr̥tyā papāta medinyāṁ bhasma sā ca jagāma ha ॥105॥
13.93.106: śunaḥsakhā ca hatvā tāṁ yātudhānīṁ mahābalām,
13.93.107: tataste munayaḥ sarve puṣkarāṇi bisāni ca,
13.93.108: śrameṇa mahatā kr̥tvā te bisāni kalāpaśaḥ,
13.93.109: athotthāya jalāt tasmāt sarve te samupāgaman,
13.93.111: ta ūcuḥ samayaṁ sarve kurma ityarikarśana ॥111॥
13.93.112: ta uktvā bāḍhamityevaṁ sarva eva tadā samam,
13.93.113: sa gāṁ spr̥śatu pādena sūryaṁ ca pratimehatu,
13.93.115: śaraṇāgataṁ hantu sa vai svasutāṁ copajīvatu,
arthān kāṅkṣatu kīnāśād bisastainyaṁ karoti yaḥ ॥115॥
13.93.116: sarvatra sarvaṁ lapatu nyāsalopaṁ karotu ca,
13.93.117: yātu striyaṁ divā caiva bisastainyaṁ karoti yaḥ ॥117॥
13.93.118: brāhmaṇaṁ cāpi jayatāṁ bisastainyaṁ karoti yaḥ ॥118॥
13.93.119: juhotu ca sa kakṣāgnau bisastainyaṁ karoti yaḥ ॥119॥
13.93.120: anr̥tau maithunaṁ yātu bisastainyaṁ karoti yaḥ ॥120॥
13.93.122: vikrīṇātu tathā somaṁ bisastainyaṁ karoti yaḥ ॥122॥
13.93.123: tasya sālokyatāṁ yātu bisastainyaṁ karoti yaḥ ॥123॥
13.93.124: jīvato vai gurūn bhr̥tyān bharantvasya pare janāḥ,
13.93.125: karṣako matsarī cāstu bisastainyaṁ karoti yaḥ ॥125॥
13.93.127: ekā svādu samāśnātu bisastainyaṁ karoti yā ॥127॥
13.93.129: dadātu kanyāṁ śulkena bisastainyaṁ karoti yā ॥129॥
13.93.130: sādhayitvā svayaṁ prāśed dāsye jīryatu caiva ha,
13.93.133: iṣṭametad dvijātīnāṁ yo’yaṁ te śapathaḥ kr̥taḥ,
tvayā kr̥taṁ bisastainyaṁ sarveṣāṁ naḥ śunaḥsakha ॥133॥
13.93.144: arthabhāgī ca bhavati na ca durgāṇyavāpnute ॥144॥
13.93.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate anuśāsanaparvaṇi dānadharmaparvaṇi bisastainyopākhyāne trinavatitamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥93॥
13.94.1: yad vr̥ttaṁ tīrthayātrāyāṁ śapathaṁ prati tacchr̥ṇu ॥1॥
13.94.17: pure ca bhikṣurbhavatu yaste harati puṣkaram ॥17॥
13.94.18: sarvatra sarvaṁ paṇatu nyāse lobhaṁ karotu ca,
13.94.19: karṣako matsarī cāstu yaste harati puṣkaram ॥19॥
13.94.22: śvaśurāttasya vr̥ttiḥ syād yaste harati puṣkaram ॥22॥
13.94.23: tasya lokān sa vrajatu yaste harati puṣkaram ॥23॥
13.94.24: preṣyo bhavatu rājñaśca yaste harati puṣkaram ॥24॥
13.94.25: śrāddhe śūdrasya cāśnīyād yaste harati puṣkaram ॥25॥
13.94.27: anr̥tau ca vratī caiva bhāryāyāṁ sa prajāyatu,
13.94.28: vidyāṁ prayacchatu bhr̥to yaste harati puṣkaram ॥28॥
13.94.29: nihantu brāhmaṇaṁ cāpi yaste harati puṣkaram ॥29॥
13.94.31: śulkena tu dadatkanyāṁ yaste harati puṣkaram ॥31॥
13.94.32: padbhyāṁ sa gāṁ tāḍayatu sūryaṁ ca pratimehatu,
13.94.34: śunaḥ karṣatu vr̥ttyarthe yaste harati puṣkaram ॥34॥
13.94.35: tat tasyāstu sadā pāpaṁ yaste harati puṣkaram ॥35॥
13.94.37: dattvā dānaṁ kīrtayatu yaste harati puṣkaram ॥37॥
13.94.38: ekā svādu samaśnātu yā te harati puṣkaram ॥38॥
13.94.41: duhyeta paravatsena yā te harati puṣkaram ॥41॥
13.94.45: brahmaṇaḥ sadanaṁ yātu yaste harati puṣkaram ॥45॥
13.94.48: ārṣo vai śāśvato nityamavyayo’yaṁ mayā śrutaḥ ॥48॥
13.94.50: ityuktaḥ sa mahendreṇa tapasvī kopano bhr̥śam,
13.94.52: ākhyānaṁ ya idaṁ yuktaḥ paṭhet parvaṇi parvaṇi,
na mūrkhaṁ janayet putraṁ na bhavecca nirākr̥tiḥ ॥52॥
13.94.53: na tamāpat spr̥śet kācid vijvaro najarāvahaḥ,
13.94.54: sa gacched brahmaṇo lokamavyayaṁ ca narottama ॥54॥
13.94.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate anuśāsanaparvaṇi dānadharmaparvaṇi śapathavidhirnāma caturnavatitamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥94॥
13.95.2: kathaṁ caitat samutpannaṁ kimarthaṁ caiva dīyate,
13.95.4: yathaitat prathitaṁ loke yathā caitat pravartitam ॥4॥
13.95.5: yathā cākṣayyatāṁ prāptaṁ puṇyatāṁ ca yathā gatam,
13.95.8: atha tena sa śabdena jyāyāścaiva śarasya ca ॥8॥
13.95.9: prahr̥ṣṭaḥ sampracikṣepa sā ca pratyājahāra tān,
13.95.12: tasthau tasyā hi santaptaṁ śiraḥ pādau tathaiva ca,
sthitā sā tu muhūrtaṁ vai bhartuḥ śāpabhayācchubhā ॥12॥
13.95.14: sā vai khinnā sucārvaṅgī padbhyāṁ duḥkhaṁ niyacchatī,
13.95.15: reṇuke kiṁ cireṇa tvamāgateti punaḥ punaḥ ॥15॥
13.95.16: śirastāvat pradīptaṁ me pādau caiva tapodhana,
13.95.17: etacchrutvā mama vibho mā krudhastvaṁ tapodhana ॥17॥
13.95.19: sa visphārya dhanurdivyaṁ gr̥hītvā ca śarān bahūn,
atiṣṭhat sūryamabhito yā to yāti tato mukhaḥ ॥19॥
13.95.20: atha taṁ prekṣya sannaddhaṁ sūryo’bhyetya tathābravīt,
13.95.21: rasaṁ hr̥taṁ vai varṣāsu pravarṣati divākaraḥ ॥21॥
13.95.22: annaṁ prāṇā iti yathā vedeṣu paripaṭhyate ॥22॥
13.95.26: annataḥ sampravartante tathā tvaṁ vettha bhārgava ॥26॥
13.95.28: sarvaṁ hi vettha vipra tvaṁ yadetat kīrtitaṁ mayā,
prasādaye tvāṁ viprarṣe kiṁ te sūryaṁ nipātya vai ॥28॥
13.95.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate anuśāsanaparvaṇi dānadharmaparvaṇi chatropānahotpattirnāma pañcanavatitamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥95॥
13.96.4: calaṁ nimittaṁ viprarṣe sadā sūryasya gacchataḥ,
kathaṁ calaṁ bhetsyasi tvaṁ sadā yāntaṁ divākaram ॥4॥
13.96.5: sthiraṁ cāpi calaṁ cāpi jāne tvāṁ jñānacakṣuṣā,
13.96.6: madhyāhne vai nimeṣārdhaṁ tiṣṭhasi tvaṁ divākara,
tatra bhetsyāmi sūrya tvāṁ na me’trāsti vicāraṇā ॥6॥
13.96.7: asaṁśayaṁ māṁ viprarṣe bhetsyase dhanvināṁ vara,
13.96.8: na bhīḥ sūrya tvayā kāryā praṇipātagato hyasi ॥8॥
13.96.9: saumyatāṁ caiva somasya gāmbhīryaṁ varuṇasya ca ॥9॥
13.96.10: dīptimagneḥ prabhāṁ meroḥ pratāpaṁ tapanasya ca,
13.96.11: bhavet sa gurutalpī ca brahmahā ca sa vai bhavet,
13.96.17: dharmasteṣu mahān bhāvī na me’trāsti vicāraṇā ॥17॥
13.96.18: chatraṁ hi bharataśreṣṭha yaḥ pradadyād dvijātaye,
śubhraṁ śataśalākaṁ vai sa pretya sukhamedhate ॥18॥
13.96.21: goloke sa mudā yukto vasati pretya bhārata ॥21॥
13.96.22: etat te bharataśreṣṭha mayā kārtsnyena kīrtitam,
13.96.22d2: ke ca śuśrūṣayā lokā vihitā bharatarṣabha,
13.96.22d8: arayaḥ ṣaḍ vijetavyā nityaṁ svaṁ dehamāśritāḥ,
13.96.22d10: karmaṇā manasā vācā cakṣuṣā ca caturvidham,
āsthāya niyamaṁ dhīmān śānto dānto jitendriyaḥ.
13.96.22d18: tatrāpi śūdro bhikṣūṇāṁ mr̥daṁ śeṣaṁ ca kalpayet.
13.96.22d21: sajalaṁ bhājanaṁ sthāpyaṁ mr̥ttikāṁ ca parīkṣitām,
parīkṣya bhūmiṁ mūtrārthī tata āsīta vāgyataḥ.
13.96.22d22: udaṅmukho divā kuryād rātrau ced dakṣiṇāmukhaḥ,
13.96.22d23: asamāpte tathā śauce na vācaṁ kiñcidīrayet,
13.96.22d26: vipruṣaśca yathā na syuryathā corū na saṁspr̥śet,
13.96.22d27: yathā ghāto hi na bhavet kledajaḥ paridhānake,
savye dvādaśa deyāḥ syustisrastisraḥ punaḥ punaḥ,
13.96.22d28: yathā yathā viśuddhyeta tat tathā tadupakramet.
13.96.22d34: r̥gvedaṁ tena prīṇāti prathamaṁ yaḥ pibedapaḥ,
dvitīyaṁ ca yajurvedaṁ tr̥tīyaṁ sāma eva ca.
13.96.22d37: prīṇāti vāyuṁ ghrāṇaṁ ca diśaścāpyatha śrotrayoḥ,
13.96.22d38: prīṇāti viṣṇuḥ padbhyāṁ tu salilaṁ vai samādadhat.
13.96.22d45: ātithyena tathā vaiśyaḥ śūdro dāsyena śobhate.
13.96.22d46: yatātmanā tu śūdreṇa śuśrūṣā nityameva tu,
13.96.22d51: ato’nyathā tu kurvāṇaḥ śreyo nāpnoti mānavaḥ,
13.96.22d52: iha yat kurute śreyastat pretya samupāśnute,
13.96.22d57: nātaḥ paraṁ mamāstyanya eṣa dharmaḥ sanātanaḥ.
13.96.22d60: yathā prīto bhaved bhikṣustathā kāryaṁ prasādhayet.
13.96.22d61: yadakalpaṁ bhaved bhikṣorna tat kāryaṁ samācaret,
13.96.22d74: teṣāṁ prasādāt tapasā prāpsyāmīṣṭāṁ śubhāṁ gatim.
13.96.22d77: yādr̥śena tu toyena śuddhiṁ prakurute naraḥ,
13.96.22d79: adhvanā karśitānāṁ ca vyādhitānāṁ tathaiva ca.
13.96.22d81: prāyaścittaṁ yathā na syāt tathā sarvaṁ samācaret.
13.96.22d85: na tveva dharmamutsr̥jya kuryāt teṣāṁ pratikriyām.
13.96.22d86: svabhāvataḥ sarvabhāvā bhavanti na bhavanti ca.
13.96.22d90: uttaraṁ ca na sandadyāt kruddhaṁ caiva prasādayet,
