13.96.22d94: ekarātraṁ dvirātraṁ vā na kvacit sajjate dvijaḥ.
13.96.22d99: ūrdhvaṁ nādho na tiryak ca na kiñcidabhikāmayet.
13.96.22d100: kālasya pariṇāmāt tu yathā pakvaphalaṁ tathā.
13.96.22d101: sa visr̥jya svakaṁ dehaṁ praviśed brahma śāśvatam,
13.96.22d105: yat karoti yadaśnāti śubhaṁ vā yadi vāśubham.
13.96.22d106: nākr̥taṁ bhujyate karma na kr̥taṁ naśyate phalam,
13.96.22d110: imaṁ hi dharmamāsthāya ye’pi syuḥ pāpayonayaḥ.
13.96.22d111: striyo vaiśyāśca śūdrāśca prāpnuyuḥ paramāṁ gatim,
kiṁ punarbrāhmaṇo vidvān kṣatriyo vā bahuśrutaḥ.
13.96.22d113: tathaiva varted guruṣu bhūyāṁsaṁ vā samāhitaḥ.
13.96.22d118: phalaṁ jñānasya hi śamaḥ praśamāya yatet sadā,
13.96.22d119: dhr̥tyā śiśnodaraṁ rakṣet pāṇipādaṁ ca cakṣuṣā.
13.96.22d123: na cāyuktena śakyo’yaṁ draṣṭuṁ dehe maheśvaraḥ.
13.96.22d124: yuktastu paśyate buddhyā saṁniveśya mano hr̥di,
atha tvevaṁ na śaknoti kartuṁ hr̥dayadhāraṇam.
13.96.22d128: evaṁ varṣma samuttīrya tīrṇo bhavati nānyathā.
13.96.22d137: yeṣāṁ loke namaskuryāt tān bravītu bhavān mama.
13.96.22d138: tasya tad vacanaṁ śrutvā devarājaḥ śacīpatiḥ,
13.96.22d139: dharmaṁ cārthaṁ ca kāmaṁ ca yeṣāṁ cintayatāṁ matiḥ,
nādharme vartate nityaṁ tān namasyāmi mātale.
13.96.22d142: calitāṁ ye nigr̥hṇanti tān nityaṁ pūjayāmyaham.
13.96.22d144: dharmārthau yasya niyatau tān namasyāmi mātale.
13.96.22d146: ye bhuktvā mānuṣān bhogān pūrve vayasi mātale,
13.96.22d155: tasmāttāṁste pravakṣyāmi taṭāke ye guṇāḥ smr̥tāḥ,
yā ca tatra phalaprāptī r̥ṣibhiḥ samudāhr̥tā.
13.96.22d156: varṣamātraṁ taṭāke tu salilaṁ yatra tiṣṭhati,
13.96.22d158: sakulaṁ tārayed vaṁśaṁ yasya khāte jalāśaye,
gāvaḥ pibanti pānīyaṁ sādhavaśca nasaḥ sadā.
13.96.22d159: taṭāke yasya gāvastu pibanti tr̥ṣitā jalam,
13.96.22d160: yat pibanti jalaṁ tatra snāyante viśramanti ca,
13.96.22d165: sthāvarāṇāṁ tu bhūtānāṁ jātayaḥ ṣaṭ prakīrtitāḥ,
13.96.22d168: kīrtiśca mānuṣe loke pretya caiva śubhaṁ phalam,
13.96.22d170: tārayed vr̥kṣaropī tu tasmād vr̥kṣān praropayet,
tasya putrā bhavantyeva pādapā nātra saṁśayaḥ.
13.96.22d171: puṣpaiḥ suragaṇān vr̥kṣāḥ phalaiścāpi tathā pitr̥̄n.
13.96.22d174: vr̥kṣadān putravad vr̥kṣāḥ tārayanti paratra ca,
tasmāt taṭāke vr̥kṣā vai ropyāḥ śreyo’rthinā sadā.
13.96.22d176: ete svarge mahīyante ye cānye satyavādinaḥ,
yajecca vividhairyajñaiḥ satyaṁ ca vidhivad vadet,
13.96.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate anuśāsanaparvaṇi dānadharmaparvaṇi chatropānahadānapraśaṁsā nāma ṣaṇṇavatitamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥96॥
13.97.1: r̥ddhimāpnoti kiṁ kr̥tvā manuṣya iha pārthiva ॥1॥
13.97.3: papraccha bharataśreṣṭha māṁ tvaṁ yat pr̥cchase’dya vai ॥3॥
13.97.4: gārhasthyaṁ dharmamāśritya mayā vā madvidhena vā,
kimavaśyaṁ dhare kāryaṁ kiṁ vā kr̥tvā kr̥taṁ bhavet ॥4॥
13.97.8: kuryāt tathaiva devā vai prīyante madhusūdana,
13.97.13: manuṣyebhya iti prāhurbaliṁ dvāri gr̥hasya vai,
13.97.14: niśācarebhyo bhūtebhyo baliṁ naktaṁ tathā haret ॥14॥
13.97.15: evaṁ kr̥tvā baliṁ samyag dadyād bhikṣāṁ dvijāya vai,
13.97.17: pitr̥̄n santarpayitvā tu baliṁ kuryād vidhānataḥ,
13.97.20: te yad vadeyustat kuryāditi dharmo vidhīyate ॥20॥
13.97.21: gr̥hasthaḥ puruṣaḥ kr̥ṣṇa śiṣṭāśī ca sadā bhavet,
rājartvijaṁ snātakaṁ ca guruṁ śvaśurameva ca ॥21॥
13.97.23: sa iharṣivarān prāpya pretya loke mahīyate ॥23॥
13.97.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate anuśāsanaparvaṇi dānadharmaparvaṇi balidānavidhirnāma saptanavatitamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥97॥
13.98.1: kathametat samutpannaṁ phalaṁ vā tad bravīhi me ॥1॥
13.98.3: varṇato hemavarṇaḥ sa suvarṇa iti paprathe ॥3॥
13.98.7: tatra tau kathayantau stāṁ kathā nānāvidhāśrayāḥ,
13.98.9: kimetat kathamutpannaṁ phalaṁ yogaṁ ca śaṁsa me ॥9॥
13.98.10: śukrasya ca baleścaiva saṁvādaṁ vai mahātmanoḥ ॥10॥
13.98.17: amr̥taṁ ca viṣaṁ caiva ye cānye tr̥ṇajātayaḥ ॥17॥
13.98.18: amr̥taṁ manasaḥ prītiṁ sadyastr̥ptiṁ dadāti ca,
mano glapayate tīvraṁ viṣaṁ gandhena sarvaśaḥ ॥18॥
13.98.20: mano hlādayate yasmācchriyaṁ cāpi dadhāti ca,
13.98.21: devatābhyaḥ sumanaso yo dadāti naraḥ śuciḥ,
tasya tuṣyanti vai devāstuṣṭāḥ puṣṭiṁ dadatyapi ॥21॥
13.98.22: yaṁ yamuddiśya dīyeran devaṁ sumanasaḥ prabho,
maṅgalārthaṁ sa tenāsya prīto bhavati daityapa ॥22॥
13.98.24: āsurāṇi ca mālyāni daivatebhyo hitāni ca ॥24॥
13.98.25: rakṣasāmuragāṇāṁ ca yakṣāṇāṁ ca tathā priyāḥ,
13.98.27: dvividho hi smr̥to gandha iṣṭo’niṣṭaśca puṣpajaḥ,
13.98.28d1: padmaṁ ca tulasī jātirapi sarveṣu pūjitā,
13.98.29: jalajāni ca mālyāni padmādīni ca yāni vai,
13.98.36: sadyaḥ prīṇāti devān vai te prītā bhāvayantyuta,
13.98.37: prītāḥ prīṇanti satataṁ mānitā mānayanti ca,
13.98.45: yathā yena yadā caiva pradeyā yādr̥śāśca te ॥45॥
13.98.46: pradānaṁ tejasāṁ tasmāt tejo vardhayate nr̥ṇām ॥46॥
13.98.54: jyotiṣāṁ caiva sālokyaṁ dīpadātā naraḥ sadā ॥54॥
13.98.65: suvarṇāya manuḥ prāha suvarṇo nāradāya ca ॥65॥
13.98.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate anuśāsanaparvaṇi dānadharmaparvaṇi suvarṇamanusaṁvādo nāmāṣṭanavatitamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥98॥
13.99.1: phalaṁ balividhāne ca tad bhūyo vaktumarhasi ॥1॥
13.99.8: sarvaṁ tasya gr̥he rājñaḥ prāvartata mahātmanaḥ,
13.99.16: kathameṣa mayā śakyaḥ śaptuṁ yasya mahāmune,
varadena varo datto bhavato viditaśca saḥ ॥16॥
13.99.17: yo me dr̥ṣṭipathaṁ gacchet sa me vaśyo bhavediti,
ityanena varaṁ devo yācito gacchatā divam ॥17॥
13.99.18: evaṁ na dagdhaḥ sa mayā bhavatā ca na saṁśayaḥ,
anyenāpyr̥ṣimukhyena na dagdho na ca pātitaḥ ॥18॥
13.99.19: amr̥taṁ caiva pānāya dattamasmai purā vibho,
13.99.21: tatra yatprāptakālaṁ nastad brūhi vadatāṁ vara,
13.99.23: adya hi tvāṁ sudurbuddhī rathe yokṣyati devarāṭ,
13.99.28: yathā ca rocate tubhyaṁ tathā kartāsmyahaṁ mune ॥28॥
13.99.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate anuśāsanaparvaṇi dānadharmaparvaṇi agastyabhr̥gusaṁvādo nāma navanavatitamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥99॥
13.100.1: kathaṁ vai sa vipannaśca kathaṁ vai pātito bhuvi,
13.100.2: sarvā eva pravartante yā divyā yāśca mānuṣīḥ ॥2॥
13.100.4: devaloke nr̥loke ca sadācārā budhaiḥ smr̥tāḥ ॥4॥
13.100.5: te ced bhavanti rājendra r̥ddhyante gr̥hamedhinaḥ,
13.100.7: yathā ca gr̥hiṇastoṣo bhaved vai balikarmaṇi,
13.100.8: evaṁ dhūpapradānaṁ ca dīpadānaṁ ca sādhavaḥ,
13.100.9: snānenādbhiśca yat karma kriyate vai vipaścitā,
13.100.16: nimīlaya svanayane jaṭāṁ yāvad viśāmi te,
13.100.17: bhr̥guḥ sa sumahātejāḥ pātanāya nr̥pasya ca,
tataḥ sa devarāṭ prāptastamr̥ṣiṁ vāhanāya vai ॥17॥
13.100.18: yojayasveti māṁ kṣipraṁ kaṁ ca deśaṁ vahāmi te ॥18॥
13.100.19: yatra vakṣyasi tatra tvāṁ nayiṣyāmi surādhipa,
13.100.20: na cāpi darśanaṁ tasya cakāra sa bhr̥gustadā ॥20॥
13.100.21: na cukopa tadāgastyo yukto’pi nahuṣeṇa vai ॥21॥
13.100.22: taṁ tu rājā pratodena codayāmāsa bhārata,
na cukopa sa dharmātmā tataḥ pādena devarāṭ ॥22॥
13.100.25: tasmādāśu mahīṁ gaccha sarpo bhūtvā sudurmate,
ityuktaḥ sa tadā tena sarpo bhūtvā papāta ha ॥25॥
13.100.27: na ca śakto’bhaviṣyad vai pātane tasya tejasā,
13.100.29: śāpāntārthaṁ mahārāja sa ca prādāt kr̥pānvitaḥ ॥29॥
13.100.33: tadā sa pātayitvā taṁ nahuṣaṁ bhūtale bhr̥guḥ,
13.100.35: sa cāgastyena kruddhena bhraṁśito bhūtalaṁ gataḥ,
na ca śakyaṁ vinā rājñā surā vartayituṁ kvacit ॥35॥
13.100.36: evaṁ sambhāṣamāṇaṁ tu devāḥ pārtha pitāmaham ॥36॥
13.100.39: sa ca taireva saṁsiddho nahuṣaḥ karmabhiḥ punaḥ,
tasmād dīpāḥ pradātavyāḥ sāyaṁ vai gr̥hamedhibhiḥ ॥39॥
13.100.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate anuśāsanaparvaṇi dānadharmaparvaṇi agastyabhr̥gusaṁvādo nāma śatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥100॥
13.101.1: nr̥śaṁsakāriṇo mūḍhāḥ kva te gacchanti mānavāḥ ॥1॥
13.101.1d1: sānvayāste vinaśyanti caṇḍālāḥ pretya ceha ca.
13.101.5: brāhmaṇasya gavāṁ rājan hriyatīnāṁ rajaḥ purā,
13.101.7: ye’pi tatrāpiban kṣīraṁ ghr̥taṁ dadhi ca mānavāḥ,
13.101.10: cāṇḍālo’haṁ tato rājan bhuktvā tadabhavaṁ nr̥pa,
brahmasvahārī ca nr̥paḥ so’pratiṣṭhāṁ gatiṁ yayau ॥10॥
13.101.11: brahmasvaṁ rajasā dhvastaṁ bhuktvā māṁ paśya yādr̥śam ॥11॥
13.101.13: ye cainaṁ krīṇate tāta ye ca vikrīṇate janāḥ,
te tu vaivasvataṁ prāpya rauravaṁ yānti sarvaśaḥ ॥13॥
13.101.14: somaṁ tu rajasā dhvastaṁ vikrīṇan vidhipūrvakam,
śrotriyo vārdhuṣī bhūtvā na ciraṁ sa vinaśyati ॥14॥
13.101.16: śvānaṁ vai pāpinaṁ paśya vivarṇaṁ hariṇaṁ kr̥śam ॥16॥
13.101.17: ahaṁ vai vipule tāta kule dhanasamanvite ॥17॥
13.101.18: abhavaṁ tatra jānāno hyetān doṣān madāt sadā ॥18॥
13.101.19: so’haṁ tena ca vr̥ttena bhojanena ca tena vai ॥19॥
13.101.23: ahaṁ hi pāpayonyāṁ vai prasūtaḥ kṣatriyarṣabha,
13.101.24: śubhena yena mokṣaṁ vai prāptumicchāmyahaṁ nr̥pa ॥24॥
13.101.28: ityuktaḥ sa tadā tena brahmasvārthe parantapa,
13.101.29: tasmād rakṣyaṁ tvayā putra brahmasvaṁ bharatarṣabha,
13.101.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate anuśāsanaparvaṇi dānadharmaparvaṇi rājanyacāṇḍālasaṁvādo nāmaikottaraśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥101॥
13.102.1: eke lokāḥ sukr̥tinaḥ sarve tvāho pitāmaha,
tatra tatrāpi bhinnāste tanme brūhi pitāmaha ॥1॥
13.102.2: karmabhiḥ pārtha nānātvaṁ lokānāṁ yānti mānavāḥ,
puṇyān puṇyakr̥to yānti pāpān pāpakr̥to narāḥ ॥2॥
13.102.5: sa tu dīrgheṇa kālena babhūvātibalo mahān ॥5॥
13.102.7: hriyamāṇaṁ tu taṁ dr̥ṣṭvā gautamaḥ saṁśitavrataḥ,
13.102.10: śiṣṭaṁ dāntaṁ kr̥tajñaṁ ca priyaṁ ca satataṁ mama,
na me vikrośato rājan hartumarhasi kuñjaram ॥10॥
13.102.22: tad brūhi tvaṁ tvarito hyeṣa yāmi ॥22॥
13.102.45: puṇyaṁ ca naimiṣaṁ tīrthaṁ bāhudāṁ karatoyinīm ॥45॥
13.102.47: sarasvatīdr̥ṣadvatyau yamunāṁ ye tu yānti ca ॥47॥
13.102.48: prayānti puṇyagandhāḍhyā dhr̥tarāṣṭro na tatra vai ॥48॥
13.102.49: na kṣutpipāse na glānirna duḥkhaṁ na sukhaṁ tathā ॥49॥
13.102.50: na dveṣyo na priyaḥ kaścinna bandhurna ripustathā,
na jarāmaraṇe tatra na puṇyaṁ na ca pātakam ॥50॥
13.102.53: na tatra dhr̥tarāṣṭraste śakyo draṣṭuṁ mahāmune ॥53॥
13.102.57: śvetaṁ kareṇuṁ mama putraṁ hi nāgaṁ
13.102.61: hantaihi brāhmaṇa kṣipraṁ saha putreṇa hastinā,
tvaṁ hi prāptuṁ śubhām̐llokānahnāya ca cirāya ca ॥61॥
13.102.62: sa gautamaṁ puraskr̥tya saha putreṇa hastinā,
13.102.63: idaṁ yaḥ śr̥ṇuyānnityaṁ yaḥ paṭhedvā jitendriyaḥ,
sa yāti brahmaṇo lokaṁ brāhmaṇo gautamo yathā ॥63॥
13.102.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate anuśāsanaparvaṇi dānadharmaparvaṇi hastikūṭo nāma dvyadhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥102॥
13.103.1: svadāratuṣṭiścoktā te phalaṁ dānasya caiva yat ॥1॥
13.103.3: mataṁ mamātra kaunteya tapo nānaśanāt param ॥3॥
13.103.5: atītya suralokaṁ ca gavāṁ lokaṁ ca bhārata,
r̥ṣilokaṁ ca so’gacchad bhagīratha iti śrutam ॥5॥
13.103.6: taṁ tu dr̥ṣṭvā vacaḥ prāha brahmā rājan bhagīratham,
13.103.7: na hi devā na gandharvā na manuṣyā bhagīratha,
13.103.15: dogdhrīṇāṁ vai gavāṁ cāpi prayutāni daśaiva ha,
13.103.17: ekaikasmin kratau tena phalenāhaṁ na cāgataḥ ॥17॥
13.103.18: prādāṁ hemasrajāṁ brahman koṭīrdaśa ca sapta ca ॥18॥
13.103.19: padmino vai sahasrāṇi prādāṁ daśa ca sapta ca ॥19॥
13.103.38: gavāṁ śatānāmayutamadadaṁ na ca tena vai ॥38॥
13.103.41: imaṁ lokamanuprāpto mā bhūt te’tra vicāraṇā ॥41॥
13.103.43: ityuktavantaṁ brahmā tu rājānaṁ sa bhagīratham,
13.103.44: viprāṇāṁ vacanāt sarvaṁ paratreha ca sidhyati ॥44॥
13.103.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate anuśāsanaparvaṇi dānadharmaparvaṇi brahmabhagīrathasaṁvāde tryadhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥103॥
13.104.2: kena vā labhate kīrtiṁ kena vā labhate śriyam ॥2॥
13.104.3: karmaṇā manasā vācā tanme brūhi pitāmaha ॥3॥
13.104.5: yena vā labhate kīrtiṁ yena vā labhate śriyam,
13.104.6: ācārāt kīrtimāpnoti puruṣaḥ pretya ceha ca ॥6॥
13.104.7: trasanti yasmād bhūtāni tathā paribhavanti ca ॥7॥
13.104.10: bhūtikarmāṇi kurvāṇaṁ taṁ janāḥ kurvate priyam ॥10॥
13.104.15: loṣṭhamardī tr̥ṇacchedī nakhakhādī ca yo naraḥ,
13.104.18: nopasr̥ṣṭaṁ na vāristhaṁ na madhyaṁ nabhaso gatam,
13.104.19: tasmāt tiṣṭhet sadā pūrvāṁ paścimāṁ caiva vāgyataḥ,
ye na pūrvāmupāsante dvijāḥ sandhyāṁ na paścimām ॥19॥
13.104.22: yāvanto romakūpāḥ syuḥ strīṇāṁ gātreṣu nirmitāḥ,
13.104.23: pūrvāhṇa eva kāryāṇi devatānāṁ ca pūjanam ॥23॥
13.104.24: nātikalyaṁ nātisāyaṁ na ca madhyandine sthite ॥24॥
13.104.25: nājñātaiḥ saha gaccheta naiko na vr̥ṣalaiḥ saha,
panthā deyo brāhmaṇāya gobhyo rājabhya eva ca ॥25॥
13.104.28: catuṣpathaṁ na seveta ubhe sandhye tathaiva ca,
upānahau ca vastraṁ ca dhr̥tamanyairna dhārayet ॥28॥
13.104.29: brahmacārī ca nityaṁ syāt pādaṁ pādena nākramet,
13.104.30: ākrośaṁ parivādaṁ ca paiśunyaṁ ca vivarjayet ॥30॥
13.104.33: vācā duruktaṁ bībhatsaṁ na saṁrohati vākkṣatam ॥33॥
13.104.34: vākśalyastu na nirhartuṁ śakyo hr̥diśayo hi saḥ ॥34॥
13.104.36: nāstikyaṁ vedanindāṁ ca devatānāṁ ca kutsanam,
13.104.37: parasya daṇḍaṁ nodyacchet kruddho nainaṁ nipātayet,
13.104.38: tithiṁ pakṣasya na brūyāt tathāsyāyurna riṣyate ॥38॥
13.104.39: kr̥tvā mūtrapurīṣe tu rathyāmākramya vā punaḥ,
13.104.41: saṁyāvaṁ kr̥saraṁ māṁsaṁ śaṣkulīṁ pāyasaṁ tathā,
ātmārthaṁ na prakartavyaṁ devārthaṁ tu prakalpayet ॥41॥
13.104.42d1: na sandhyāyāṁ svapennityaṁ snāyācchuddhaḥ sadā bhavet,
13.104.43: na cābhyuditaśāyī syāt prāyaścittī tathā bhavet,
13.104.46: anyatra tu guruṁ vr̥ddhaṁ dhārmikaṁ vā vicakṣaṇam ॥46॥
13.104.47: na cājñātāṁ striyaṁ gacched garbhiṇīṁ vā kadācana ॥47॥
13.104.47d2: indriyāṇi sadā yacchet svapne śuddhamanā bhavet.
13.104.48: udakśirā na svapeta tathā pratyakśirā na ca,
13.104.49: na bhagne nāvaśīrṇe ca śayane prasvapīta ca,
nāntardhāne na saṁyukte na ca tiryak kadācana ॥49॥
13.104.50: na cāpi gacchet kāryeṇa samayād vāpi nāstikaiḥ,
āsanaṁ tu padā’’kr̥ṣya na prasajjet tathā naraḥ ॥50॥
13.104.51: na nagnaḥ karhicit snāyānna niśāyāṁ kadācana,
13.104.52: na cānulimpedasnātvā snātvā vāso na nirdhunet,
na caivārdrāṇi vāsāṁsi nityaṁ seveta mānavaḥ ॥52॥
13.104.53: udakyayā ca sambhāṣāṁ na kurvīta kadācana ॥53॥
13.104.54: notsr̥jeta purīṣaṁ ca kṣetre grāmasya cāntike,
ubhe mūtrapurīṣe tu nāpsu kuryāt kadācana ॥54॥
13.104.55: bhuktvā cānnaṁ tathaiva trirdviḥ punaḥ parimārjayet ॥55॥
13.104.57: dhanyaṁ paścānmukho bhuṅkte r̥taṁ bhuṅkte udaṅmukhaḥ ॥57॥
13.104.58: gātrāṇi caiva sarvāṇi nābhiṁ pāṇitale tathā ॥58॥
13.104.60: niṣaṇṇaścāpi khādeta na tu gacchan kadācana ॥60॥
13.104.61: mūtraṁ nottiṣṭhatā kāryaṁ na bhasmani na govraje,
13.104.63: agniṁ gāṁ brāhmaṇaṁ caiva tathā hyāyurna riṣyate,
13.104.64: ūrdhvaṁ prāṇā hyutkrāmanti yūnaḥ sthavira āyati ॥64॥
13.104.66: na cāsītāsane bhinne bhinnakāṁsyaṁ ca varjayet ॥66॥
13.104.67: svaptavyaṁ naiva nagnena na cocchiṣṭo’pi saṁviśet ॥67॥
13.104.69: na cābhīkṣṇaṁ śiraḥ snāyāt tathāsyāyurna riṣyate ॥69॥
13.104.71: vāte ca pūtigandhe ca manasāpi na cintayet ॥71॥
13.104.75: pratyādityaṁ pratyanalaṁ prati gāṁ ca prati dvijān,
ye mehanti ca panthānaṁ te bhavanti gatāyuṣaḥ ॥75॥
13.104.78: kṣatriyo’pi dahet kruddho yāvat spr̥śati tejasā ॥78॥
13.104.80: guruṇā caiva nirbandho na kartavyaḥ kadācana,
13.104.83: raktamālyaṁ na dhāryaṁ syācchuklaṁ dhāryaṁ tu paṇḍitaiḥ,
varjayitvā tu kamalaṁ tathā kuvalayaṁ prabho ॥83॥
13.104.84: raktaṁ śirasi dhāryaṁ tu tathā vāneyamityapi,
kāñcanīyāpi mālā yā na sā duṣyati karhicit ॥84॥
13.104.85: viparyayaṁ na kurvīta vāsaso buddhimān naraḥ ॥85॥
13.104.86: tathā nānyadhr̥taṁ dhāryaṁ na cāpadaśameva ca,
13.104.91: na saṁnikr̥ṣṭe medhāvī nāśucerna ca satsu ca,
13.104.92: pippalaṁ ca vaṭaṁ caiva śaṇaśākaṁ tathaiva ca,
13.104.93: na pāṇau lavaṇaṁ vidvān prāśnīyānna ca rātriṣu,
dadhisaktūn na bhuñjīta vr̥thā māṁsaṁ ca varjayet ॥93॥
13.104.94: vālena tu na bhuñjīta paraśrāddhaṁ tathaiva ca ॥94॥
13.104.96: paścād bhuñjīta medhāvī na cāpyanyamanā naraḥ ॥96॥
13.104.98: nirasya śeṣamanyeṣāṁ na pradeyaṁ tu kasyacit ॥98॥
13.104.99: dadhi cāpyanupānaṁ vai na kartavyaṁ bhavārthinā ॥99॥
13.104.101: pāṇiṁ mūrdhni samādhāya spr̥ṣṭvā cāgniṁ samāhitaḥ,
13.104.102: adbhiḥ prāṇān samālabhya nābhiṁ pāṇitale tathā,
13.104.104: tena pitryāṇi kurvīta spr̥ṣṭvāpo nyāyataḥ sadā ॥104॥
13.104.106: patitaistu kathāṁ necched darśanaṁ ca vivarjayet,
saṁsargaṁ ca na gaccheta tathā’’yurvindate mahat ॥106॥
13.104.107: na divā maithunaṁ gacchenna kanyāṁ na ca bandhakīm,
na cāsnātāṁ striyaṁ gacchet tathāyurvindate mahat ॥107॥
13.104.108: sve sve tīrthe samācamya kārye samupakalpite,
13.104.109: kurvīta pitryaṁ daivaṁ ca vedadr̥ṣṭena karmaṇā ॥109॥
13.104.110: brāhmaṇārthe ca yacchaucaṁ tacca me śr̥ṇu kaurava,
13.104.111: niṣṭhīvya tu tathā kṣuttvā spr̥śyāpo hi śucirbhavet ॥111॥
13.104.112: vr̥ddho jñātistathā mitraṁ daridro yo bhavedapi,
13.104.112d1: kulīnaḥ paṇḍita iti rakṣyā niḥsvāḥ svaśaktitaḥ,
13.104.113: gr̥heṣvete na pāpāya tathā vai tailapāyikāḥ ॥113॥
13.104.113d1: śuddhaṁ jalaṁ suvarṇaṁ ca rajataṁ gr̥hamaṅgalam.
13.104.115: agamyāśca na gaccheta rājñaḥ patnīṁ sakhīstathā ॥115॥
13.104.116: bandhūnāṁ brāhmaṇānāṁ ca tathā śāraṇikasya ca ॥116॥
13.104.118: sandhyāyāṁ na svaped rājan vidyāṁ na ca samācaret ॥118॥
13.104.119: na bhūñjīta ca medhāvī tathāyurvindate mahat,
naktaṁ na kuryāt pitryāṇi bhuktvā caiva prasādhanam ॥119॥
13.104.120: pānīyasya kriyā naktaṁ na kāryā bhūtimicchatā,
13.104.121: śeṣāṇi caiva pānāni pānīyaṁ cāpi bhojane,
sauhityaṁ na ca kartavyaṁ rātrau na ca samācaret ॥121॥
13.104.122: dvijacchedaṁ na kurvīta bhuktvā na ca samācaret,
13.104.125: putrā niveśyāśca kulād bhr̥tyā labhyāśca bhārata,
13.104.126: nakṣatre na ca kurvīta yasmin jāto bhavennaraḥ,
na proṣṭhapadayoḥ kāryaṁ tathāgneye ca bhārata ॥126॥
13.104.127: dāruṇeṣu ca sarveṣu pratyariṁ ca vivarjayet,
jyotiṣe yāni coktāni tāni sarvāṇi varjayet ॥127॥
13.104.130: varjayed vyaṅginīṁ nārīṁ tathā kanyāṁ narottama,
samārṣāṁ vyaṅgitāṁ caiva mātuḥ svakulajāṁ tathā ॥130॥
13.104.131: vr̥ddhāṁ pravajitāṁ caiva tathaiva ca pativratām,
tathā nikr̥ṣṭavarṇāṁ ca varṇotkr̥ṣṭāṁ ca varjayet ॥131॥
13.104.132: ayoniṁ ca viyoniṁ ca na gaccheta vicakṣaṇaḥ,
13.104.133: śvitriṇāṁ ca kule jātāṁ kṣayiṇāṁ manujeśvara ॥133॥
13.104.134: lakṣaṇairanvitā yā ca praśastā yā ca lakṣaṇaiḥ,
manojñāṁ darśanīyāṁ ca tāṁ bhavān voḍhumarhati ॥134॥
13.104.135: avarā patitā caiva na grāhyā bhūtimicchatā ॥135॥
13.104.136: vede ca brāhmaṇaiḥ proktāstāśca sarvāḥ samācaret ॥136॥
13.104.137: na cerṣyā strīṣu kartavyā rakṣyā dārāśca sarvaśaḥ,
13.104.138: prage niśāmāśu tathā naivocchiṣṭāḥ svapanti vai ॥138॥
13.104.140: sandhyāyāṁ ca na bhuñjīta na snāyenna tathā paṭhet,
prayataśca bhavet tasyāṁ na ca kiñcit samācaret ॥140॥
13.104.142: animantrito na gaccheta yajñaṁ gaccheta darśakaḥ,
13.104.143: na caikena parivrajyaṁ na gantavyaṁ tathā niśi,
13.104.144: hitaṁ cāpyahitaṁ cāpi na vicāryaṁ nararṣabha ॥144॥
13.104.145: dhanurvede ca vede ca yatnaḥ kāryo narādhipa,
13.104.147: yuktiśāstraṁ ca te jñeyaṁ śabdaśāstraṁ ca bhārata ॥147॥
13.104.149: mahātmanāṁ ca caritaṁ śrotavyaṁ nityameva te,
patnī rajasvalā yā ca nābhigacchenna cāhvayet ॥149॥
13.104.150: snātāṁ caturthe divase rātrau gacched vicakṣaṇaḥ,
pañcame divase nārī ṣaṣṭhe’hani pumān bhavet ॥150॥
13.104.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate anuśāsanaparvaṇi dānadharmaparvaṇi āyuṣyākhyāne caturadhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥104॥
13.105.1: kaniṣṭhāśca yathā jyeṣṭhe varteraṁstad bravīhi me ॥1॥
13.105.2: jyeṣṭhavat tāta vartasva jyeṣṭho’si satataṁ bhavān,
13.105.4: andhaḥ syādandhavelāyāṁ jaḍaḥ syādapi vā budhaḥ,
parihāreṇa tad brūyād yasteṣāṁ syād vyatikramaḥ ॥4॥
13.105.6: jyeṣṭhaḥ kulaṁ vardhayati vināśayati vā punaḥ,
13.105.7: atha yo vinikurvīta jyeṣṭho bhrātā yavīyasaḥ,
13.105.8: nikr̥tī hi naro lokān pāpān gacchatyasaṁśayam,
vidulasyeva tat puṣpaṁ moghaṁ janayituḥ smr̥tam ॥8॥
13.105.10: sarve cāpi vikarmasthā bhāgaṁ nārhanti sodarāḥ,
13.105.12: na putrabhāgaṁ viṣamaṁ pitā dadyāt kadācana ॥12॥
13.105.13: na jyeṣṭho vāvamanyeta duṣkr̥taḥ sukr̥to’pi vā,
yadi strī yadyavarajaḥ śreyaścet tat tadācaret ॥13॥
13.105.14: dharmaṁ hi śreya ityāhuriti dharmavido janāḥ,
13.105.15: daśa caiva pitr̥̄n mātā sarvāṁ vā pr̥thivīmapi,
13.105.16: mātā garīyasī yacca tenaitāṁ manyate janaḥ,
jyeṣṭho bhrātā pitr̥samo mr̥te pitari bhārata ॥16॥
13.105.17: sa hyeṣāṁ vr̥ttidātā syāt sa caitān pratipālayet,
13.105.18: śarīrametau sr̥jataḥ pitā mātā ca bhārata ॥18॥
13.105.19: ācāryaśāstā yā jātiḥ sā satyā sājarāmarā,
13.105.20: bhrāturbhāryā ca tadvat syād yasyā bālye stanaṁ pibet ॥20॥
13.105.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate anuśāsanaparvaṇi dānadharmaparvaṇi jyeṣṭhakaniṣṭhavr̥ttirnāma pañcādhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥105॥
13.106.1: upavāse matiriyaṁ kāraṇaṁ ca na vidmahe ॥1॥
13.106.5: svargaṁ puṇyaṁ ca labhate kathaṁ bharatasattama ॥5॥
13.106.6: upoṣya cāpi kiṁ tena pradeyaṁ syānnarādhipa,
dharmeṇa ca sukhānarthāllam̐bhed yena bravīhi tam ॥6॥
13.106.8: idaṁ khalu mayā rājan śrutamāsīt purātanam,
13.106.9: yathā māṁ tvaṁ tathaivāhaṁ pr̥ṣṭavāṁstaṁ tapodhanam ॥9॥
13.106.12: trirātraṁ vā dvirātraṁ vā tayorvyuṣṭirna vidyate ॥12॥
13.106.14: pañcamyāṁ vāpi ṣaṣṭhyāṁ ca paurṇamāsyāṁ ca bhārata,
13.106.15: nānapatyo bhavet prājño daridro vā kadācana ॥15॥
13.106.16: yajiṣṇuḥ pañcamīṁ ṣaṣṭhīṁ kule bhojayate dvijān,
13.106.18: bhojayecca dvijān śaktyā sa mucyed vyādhikilbiṣaiḥ,
13.106.20: pauṣamāsaṁ tu kaunteya bhaktenaikena yaḥ kṣipet,
13.106.21: māghaṁ tu niyato māsamekabhaktena yaḥ kṣipet,
13.106.22: strīṣu vallabhatāṁ yāti vaśyāścāsya bhavanti tāḥ ॥22॥
13.106.23: caitraṁ tu niyato māsamekabhaktena yaḥ kṣipet,
13.106.24: naro vā yadi vā nārī jñātīnāṁ śreṣṭhatāṁ vrajet ॥24॥
13.106.25: aiśvaryamatulaṁ śreṣṭhaṁ pumān strī vā prapadyate ॥25॥
13.106.30: kārtikaṁ tu naro māsaṁ yaḥ kuryādekabhojanam,
13.106.31: tithīnāṁ niyamā ye tu śr̥ṇu tānapi pārthiva ॥31॥
13.106.32: pakṣe pakṣe gate yastu bhaktamaśnāti bhārata,
13.106.33: māsi māsi trirātrāṇi kr̥tvā varṣāṇi dvādaśa,
13.106.34: ete tu niyamāḥ sarve kartavyāḥ śarado daśa,
13.106.35: yastu prātastathā sāyaṁ bhuñjāno nāntarā pibet,
13.106.36: ṣaḍbhiḥ sa varṣairnr̥pate sidhyate nātra saṁśayaḥ,
13.106.43: ṣaṣṭhe kāle tu kaunteya naraḥ saṁvatsaraṁ kṣipan ॥43॥
13.106.45: aṣṭamena tu bhaktena jīvan saṁvatsaraṁ nr̥pa ॥45॥
13.106.47: pakṣe pakṣe gate rājan yo’śnīyād varṣameva tu ॥47॥
13.106.49: vīṇānāṁ vallakīnāṁ ca veṇūnāṁ ca viśāmpate,
13.106.50: phalaṁ viśvajitastāta prāpnoti sa naro nr̥pa ॥50॥
13.106.51: saptatiṁ ca sahasrāṇi varṣāṇāṁ divi modate ॥51॥
13.106.53: pade pade yajñaphalaṁ sa prāpnoti na saṁśayaḥ ॥53॥
13.106.54: śataṁ varṣasahasrāṇāṁ modate sa divi prabho ॥54॥
13.106.55: śataṁ cāpsarasaḥ kanyā ramayantyapi taṁ naram,
ārto vā vyādhito vāpi gacchedanaśanaṁ tu yaḥ ॥55॥
13.106.56: śataṁ varṣasahasrāṇāṁ modate sa divi prabho,
13.106.65: nāsti vedāt paraṁ śāstraṁ nāsti mātr̥samo guruḥ,
na dharmāt paramo lābhastapo nānaśanāt param ॥65॥
13.106.66: brāhmaṇebhyaḥ paraṁ nāsti pāvanaṁ divi ceha ca,
13.106.69: sarva eva divaṁ prāptāḥ kṣamāvanto maharṣayaḥ ॥69॥
13.106.70: yaḥ pradarśayate nityaṁ na sa duḥkhamavāpnute ॥70॥
13.106.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate anuśāsanaparvaṇi dānadharmaparvaṇi upavāsavidhau ṣaḍadhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥106॥
13.107.1: guṇāścaiṣāṁ yathātathyaṁ pretya ceha ca sarvaśaḥ ॥1॥
13.107.2: na te śakyā daridreṇa yajñāḥ prāptuṁ pitāmaha,
13.107.4: yo daridrairapi vidhiḥ śakyaḥ prāptuṁ sadā bhavet,
13.107.6: yastu kalyaṁ tathā sāyaṁ bhuñjāno nāntarā pibet ॥6॥
13.107.7: ṣaḍbhireva sa varṣaistu sidhyate nāja saṁśayaḥ ॥7॥
13.107.9: trīṇi varṣāṇi yaḥ prāśet satataṁ tvekabhojanam ॥9॥
13.107.11: kṣānto dānto jitakrodhaḥ sa gacchati parāṁ gatim ॥11॥
13.107.12: dve samāpte tataḥ padme so’psarobhirvaset saha ॥12॥
13.107.19: nivartanaṁ ca tatrāsya trīṇi padmāni caiva ha,
13.107.26: divase yastu ṣaṣṭhe vai muniḥ prāśeta bhojanam ॥26॥
13.107.31: padmānyaṣṭādaśa tathā patāke dve tathaiva ca,
13.107.43: yastu saṁvatsaraṁ bhuṅkte daśāhe vai gate gate ॥43॥
13.107.49: ekādaśe tu divase yaḥ prāpte prāśate haviḥ,
13.107.50: anr̥taṁ ca na bhāṣeta mātāpitroḥ kr̥tepi vā ॥50॥
13.107.55: sa tasmai darśanaṁ prāpto divase divase bhavet,
divase dvādaśe yastu prāpte vai prāśate haviḥ ॥55॥
13.107.60: trayodaśe tu divase prāpte yaḥ prāśate haviḥ,
13.107.63: tatra śaṅkhapatāke dve yugāntaṁ kalpameva ca,
ayutāyutaṁ tathā padmaṁ samudraṁ ca tathā vaset ॥63॥
13.107.65: caturdaśe tu divase yaḥ pūrṇe prāśate haviḥ,
13.107.69: yattu pakṣe gate bhuṅkte ekabhaktaṁ jitendriyaḥ,
13.107.78: divase saptadaśame yaḥ prāpte prāśate haviḥ ॥78॥
13.107.84: sadā dvādaśamāsān vai saptalokān sa paśyati,
13.107.86: tatra kalpasahasraṁ sa kanyābhiḥ saha modate ॥86॥
13.107.88: sadā dvādaśamāsān vai saptalokān sa paśyati,
13.107.90: pūrṇe’tha viṁśe divase yo bhuṅkte hyekabhojanam ॥90॥
13.107.93: ekaviṁśe tu divase yo bhuṅkte hyekabhojanam ॥93॥
13.107.96: dvāviṁśe divase prāpte yo bhuṅkte hyekabhojanam ॥96॥
13.107.102: caturviṁśe tu divase yaḥ prāpte prāśate haviḥ ॥102॥
13.107.111: saptānāṁ marutāṁ lokān vasūnāṁ cāpi so’śnute ॥111॥
13.107.113: dve yugānāṁ sahasre tu divye divyena tejasā,
13.107.114: phalaṁ prāpnoti vipulaṁ devaloke ca pūjyate ॥114॥
13.107.127: rudrāṇāṁ ca tathā lokaṁ brahmalokaṁ ca gacchati,
yastu māse gate bhuṅkte ekabhaktaṁ śamātmakaḥ ॥127॥
13.107.139: divaṁ gatvā śarīreṇa svena rājan yathāmaraḥ ॥139॥
13.107.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate anuśāsanaparvaṇi dānadharmaparvaṇi upavāsavidhirnāma saptādhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥107॥
13.108.1: yad varaṁ sarvatīrthānāṁ tanme brūhi pitāmaha,
yatra caiva paraṁ śaucaṁ tanme vyākhyātumarhasi ॥1॥
13.108.2: yattu tīrthaṁ ca śaucaṁ ca tanme śr̥ṇu samāhitaḥ ॥2॥
13.108.6d1: nārāyaṇe’tha rudre vā bhaktistīrthaṁ paraṁ matā,
13.108.9: sa snāto yo damasnātaḥ sa bāhyābhyantaraḥ śuciḥ ॥9॥
13.108.10: śaucameva paraṁ teṣāṁ yeṣāṁ notpadyate spr̥hā ॥10॥
13.108.12: jñānotpannaṁ ca yacchaucaṁ tacchaucaṁ paramaṁ smr̥tam ॥12॥
13.108.13: snāti yo mānase tīrthe tatsnānaṁ tattvadarśinaḥ ॥13॥
13.108.15: pr̥thivyāṁ yāni tīrthāni puṇyāni śr̥ṇu tānyapi ॥15॥
13.108.16: tathā pr̥thivyā bhāgāśca puṇyāni salilāni ca ॥16॥
13.108.17: dhunanti pāpaṁ tīrtheṣu te prayānti sukhaṁ divam ॥17॥
13.108.19: ubhayoreva yaḥ snāyāt sa siddhiṁ śīghramāpnuyāt ॥19॥
13.108.20: yathā balaṁ kriyāhīnaṁ kriyā vā balavarjitā,
neha sādhayate kāryaṁ samāyuktā tu sidhyati ॥20॥
13.108.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate anuśāsanaparvaṇi dānadharmaparvaṇi śaucānupr̥cchā nāmāṣṭādhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥108॥
13.109.2: śr̥ṇu rājan yathā gītaṁ svayameva svayambhuvā,
yat kr̥tvā nirvr̥to bhūyāt puruṣo nāja saṁśayaḥ ॥2॥
13.109.4: tathaiva pauṣamāse tu pūjyo nārāyaṇeti ca,
13.109.6: tathaiva phālgune māsi govindeti ca pūjayan,
13.109.10: āṣāḍhe māsi dvādaśyāṁ vāmaneti ca pūjayan,
13.109.14: dvādaśyāṁ kārtike māsi pūjya dāmodareti ca,
gavāṁ yajñamavāpnoti pumān strī vā na saṁśayaḥ ॥14॥
13.109.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate anuśāsanaparvaṇi dānadharmaparvaṇi viṣṇordvādaśakaṁ nāma navādhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥109॥
13.110.2: aṅgānāṁ rūpasaubhāgyaṁ priyaṁ caiva kathaṁ bhavet,
13.110.4: guhyaṁ tu phālgunī vidyāt kr̥ttikā kaṭikāstathā ॥4॥
13.110.6: bāhubhyāṁ tu viśākhāsu hastau hastena nirdiśet,
13.110.7: grīvāṁ jyeṣṭhā ca rājendra śravaṇena tu karṇayoḥ,
13.110.8: hāsaṁ śatabhiṣāṁ caiva maghāṁ caivātha nāsikām,
13.110.9: bharaṇyāṁ tu śiro vidyāt keśānārdrāṁ narādhipa,
samāpte tu ghr̥taṁ dadyād brāhmaṇe vedapārage ॥9॥
13.111.2: kena vr̥ttena rājendra vartamānā narā bhuvi,
prāpnuvantyuttamaṁ svargaṁ kathaṁ ca narakaṁ nr̥pa ॥2॥
13.111.5: naitadanyena śakyaṁ hi vaktuṁ kenacidadya vai,
vaktā br̥haspatisamo na hyanyo vidyate kvacit ॥5॥
13.111.7: pūjāmanupamāṁ cakre sarve te ca sabhāsadaḥ ॥7॥
13.111.9: martyasya kaḥ sahāyo vai pitā mātā suto guruḥ ॥9॥
13.111.12: asahāyaḥ pitā mātā tathā bhrātā suto guruḥ ॥12॥
13.111.15: tasmād dharmaḥ sahāyaśca sevitavyaḥ sadā nr̥bhiḥ,
13.111.19: śrutaṁ bhagavato vākyaṁ dharmayuktaṁ paraṁ hitam ॥19॥
13.111.20: mr̥taṁ śarīraṁ hi nr̥ṇāṁ sūkṣmamavyaktatāṁ gatam ॥20॥
13.111.22: buddhirātmā ca sahitā dharmaṁ paśyanti nityadā,
13.111.23: tvagasthimāṁsaṁ śukraṁ ca śoṇitaṁ ca mahāmate ॥23॥
13.111.24: tato dharmasamāyuktaḥ prāpnute jīva eva hi ॥24॥
13.111.25: tato’sya karma paśyanti śubhaṁ vā yadi vāśubham,
13.111.26: ihaloke pare caiva kiṁ bhūyaḥ kathayāmi te ॥26॥
13.111.27: etat tu jñātumicchāmi kathaṁ retaḥ pravartate ॥27॥
13.111.30: etat te sarvamākhyātaṁ bhūyaḥ kiṁ śrotumicchasi ॥30॥
13.111.31: ākhyātaṁ me bhagavatā garbhaḥ sañjāyate yathā,
13.111.33: tato’sya karma paśyanti śubhaṁ vā yadi vāśubham,
13.111.34: jīvaḥ sa bhagavan kvasthaḥ sukhaduḥkhe samaśnute ॥34॥
13.111.35: strīṇāṁ puṣpaṁ samāsādya sūte kālena bhārata ॥35॥
13.111.36: duḥkhaṁ saṁsāracakraṁ ca naraḥ kleśaṁ sa vindati ॥36॥
13.111.37: ihaloke ca sa prāṇī janmaprabhr̥ti pārthiva,
sukr̥taṁ karma vai bhuṅkte dharmasya phalamāśritaḥ ॥37॥
13.111.38: tataḥ sa puruṣo bhūtvā sevate nityadā sukham ॥38॥
13.111.41: karmaṇā yena yeneha yasyāṁ yonau prajāyate,
13.111.42: yamasya viṣayaṁ ghoraṁ martyo lokaḥ prapadyate ॥42॥
13.111.45: yena yena tu bhāvena karmaṇā puruṣo gatim,
prayāti paruṣāṁ ghorāṁ tatte vakṣyāmyataḥ param ॥45॥
13.111.47: kharo jīvati varṣāṇi daśa pañca ca bhārata,
kharo mr̥to balīvardaḥ sapta varṣāṇi jīvati ॥47॥
13.111.49: tatra jīvati varṣāṇi daśa pañca ca bhārata ॥49॥
13.111.50: gardabhaḥ pañca varṣāṇi pañca varṣāṇi sūkaraḥ ॥50॥
13.111.51: kukkuṭaḥ pañca varṣāṇi pañca varṣāṇi jambukaḥ,
śvā varṣamekaṁ bhavati tato jāyati mānavaḥ ॥51॥
13.111.52: sa jīva iha saṁsārāṁstrīnāpnoti na saṁśayaḥ ॥52॥
13.111.53: prāk śvā bhavati rājendra tataḥ kravyāttataḥ kharaḥ,
13.111.54: manasāpi gurorbhāryāṁ yaḥ śiṣyo yāti pāpakr̥t,
13.111.55: śvayonau tu sa sambhūtastrīṇi varṣāṇi jīvati,
13.111.58: so’pi rājan mr̥to jantuḥ pūrvaṁ jāyeta gardabhaḥ ॥58॥
13.111.59: gardabhatvaṁ tu samprāpya daśa varṣāṇi jīvati,
13.111.61: kharo jīvati māsāṁstu daśa śvā ca caturdaśa,
13.111.62: tāḍayitvā tu tāveva jāyate kacchapo nr̥pa ॥62॥
13.111.63: kacchapo daśa varṣāṇi trīṇi varṣāṇi śalyakaḥ,
vyālo bhūtvā ca ṣaṇmāsāṁstato jāyati mānuṣaḥ ॥63॥
13.111.65: vānaro daśa varṣāṇi pañca varṣāṇi mūṣikaḥ,
śvātha bhūtvā tu ṣaṇmāsāṁstato jāyati mānuṣaḥ ॥65॥
13.111.66: nyāsāpahartā tu naro yamasya viṣayaṁ gataḥ,
13.111.67: tatra jīvati varṣāṇi daśa pañca ca bhārata,
duṣkr̥tasya kṣayaṁ kr̥tvā tato jāyati mānuṣaḥ ॥67॥
13.111.68: viśvāsahartā tu naro mīno jāyati durmatiḥ ॥68॥
13.111.69: bhūtvā mīno’ṣṭa varṣāṇi mr̥to jāyati bhārata,
13.111.70: chāgastu nidhanaṁ prāpya pūrṇe saṁvatsare tataḥ,
13.111.73: tataḥ pretya mahārāja mr̥to jāyati sūkaraḥ,
13.111.74: śvā tato jāyate mūḍhaḥ karmaṇā tena pārthiva,
bhūtvā śvā pañca varṣāṇi tato jāyati mānavaḥ ॥74॥
13.111.75: paradārābhimarśaṁ tu kr̥tvā jāyati vai vr̥kaḥ,
śvā śr̥gālastato gr̥dhro vyālaḥ kaṅko bakastathā ॥75॥
13.111.76: bhrāturbhāryāṁ tu pāpātmā yo dharṣayati mohitaḥ,
13.111.78: sūkaraḥ pañca varṣāṇi daśa varṣāṇi śvāvidhaḥ,
biḍālaḥ pañca varṣāṇi daśa varṣāṇi kukkuṭaḥ ॥78॥
13.111.81: upasthite vivāhe tu yajñe dāne’pi vā vibho,
mohāt karoti yo vighnaṁ sa mr̥to jāyate kr̥miḥ ॥81॥
13.111.82: kr̥mirjīvati varṣāṇi daśa pañca ca bhārata,
adharmasya kṣayaṁ kr̥tvā tato jāyati mānavaḥ ॥82॥
13.111.83: pūrvaṁ dattvā tu yaḥ kanyāṁ dvitīye dātumicchati,
so’pi rājan mr̥to jantuḥ kr̥miyonau prajāyate ॥83॥
13.111.85: anirvāpya samaśnan vai mr̥to jāyati vāyasaḥ ॥85॥
13.111.86: jāyate vyālakaścāpi māsaṁ tasmāt tu mānuṣaḥ ॥86॥
13.111.88: krauñco jīvati varṣaṁ tu tato jāyati cīrakaḥ,
13.111.89: tataḥ samprāpya nidhanaṁ jāyate sūkaraḥ punaḥ ॥89॥
13.111.90: śvā tato jāyate mūḍhaḥ karmaṇā tena pārthiva ॥90॥
13.111.92: kr̥taghnastu mr̥to rājan yamasya viṣayaṁ gataḥ,
13.111.96: kr̥mirbhavati varṣāṇi daśa pañca ca bhārata,
tato garbhaṁ samāsādya tatraiva mriyate śiśuḥ ॥96॥
13.111.100: phalaṁ vā mūlakaṁ hr̥tvā apūpaṁ vā pipīlikāḥ,
13.111.102: ayo hr̥tvā tu durbuddhirvāyaso jāyate naraḥ,
kāṁsyaṁ hr̥tvā tu durbuddhirhārito jāyate naraḥ ॥102॥
13.111.103: hr̥tvā tu kāñcanaṁ bhāṇḍaṁ kr̥miyonau prajāyate ॥103॥
13.111.104: kauśikaṁ tu tato hr̥tvā naro jāyati vartakaḥ ॥104॥
13.111.105: aṁśukaṁ corayitvā tu śuko jāyati mānavaḥ,
corayitvā dukūlaṁ tu mr̥to haṁsaḥ prajāyate ॥105॥
13.111.106: krauñcaḥ kārpāsikaṁ hr̥tvā mr̥to jāyati mānavaḥ,
corayitvā naraḥ paṭṭaṁ tvāvikaṁ caiva bhārata ॥106॥
13.111.107: kṣaumaṁ ca vastramādāya śaśo jantuḥ prajāyate,
varṇān hr̥tvā tu puruṣo mr̥to jāyati barhiṇaḥ ॥107॥
13.111.109: tatra jīvati varṣāṇi tato daśa ca pañca ca ॥109॥
13.111.110: adharmasya kṣayaṁ gatvā tato jāyati mānuṣaḥ,
13.111.112: arthārthī yadi vā vairī sa mr̥to jāyate kharaḥ ॥112॥
13.111.113: kharo jīvati varṣe dve tataḥ śastreṇa vadhyate,
13.111.114: mr̥go vadhyati śastreṇa gate saṁvatsare tu saḥ,
hato mr̥gastato mīnaḥ so’pi jālena badhyate ॥114॥
13.111.115: śvāpado daśa varṣāṇi dvīpī varṣāṇi pañca ca ॥115॥
13.111.116: adharmasya kṣayaṁ kr̥tvā tato jāyati mānuṣaḥ ॥116॥
13.111.117: striyaṁ hatvā tu durbuddhiryamasya viṣayaṁ gataḥ,
13.111.119: bhojanaṁ corayitvā tu makṣikā jāyate naraḥ,
13.111.120: dhānyaṁ hr̥tvā tu puruṣo lomaśaḥ samprajāyate ॥120॥
13.111.121: sa jāyate babhrusamo dāruṇo mūṣiko naraḥ ॥121॥
13.111.122: daśan vai mānuṣānnityaṁ pāpātmā sa viśāmpate,
ghr̥taṁ hr̥tvā tu durbuddhiḥ kākamadguḥ prajāyate ॥122॥
13.111.124: viśvāsena tu nikṣiptaṁ yo vinihnoti mānavaḥ,
13.111.126: pāpāni tu narāḥ kr̥tvā tiryag jāyanti bhārata,
na cātmanaḥ pramāṇaṁ te dharmaṁ jānanti kiñcana ॥126॥
13.111.127: ye pāpāni narāḥ kr̥tvā nirasyanti vrataiḥ sadā,
13.111.129: varjayanti ca pāpāni janmaprabhr̥ti ye narāḥ,
13.111.133: etacchrutvā mahārāja dharme kuru manaḥ sadā ॥133॥
13.111.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate anuśāsanaparvaṇi dānadharmaparvaṇi saṁsāracakraṁ nāma ekādaśādhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥111॥
13.112.1: dharmasya tu gatiṁ śrotumicchāmi vadatāṁ vara ॥1॥
13.112.2: kr̥tvā karmāṇi pāpāni kathaṁ yānti śubhāṁ gatim,
karmaṇā ca kr̥teneha kena yānti śubhāṁ gatim ॥2॥
13.112.5: yathā yathā manastasya duṣkr̥taṁ karma garhate,
tathā tathā śarīraṁ tu tenādharmeṇa mucyate ॥5॥
13.112.9: pradānāni tu vakṣyāmi yāni dattvā yudhiṣṭhira,
13.112.12: annasya hi pradānena rantidevo divaṁ gataḥ ॥12॥
13.112.14: hr̥ṣṭena manasā dattaṁ na sa tiryaggatirbhavet ॥14॥
13.112.16d3: vedārthaṁ jñāpayitvā tu śuddhān viprān yathārthataḥ.
13.112.16d4: sarvātithyaṁ paraṁ hyeṣāṁ tasmādannaṁ paraṁ smr̥tam.
13.112.20: annaṁ dattvā dvijātibhyaḥ śūdraḥ pāpāt pramucyate ॥20॥
13.112.21: yaḥ prayacchati viprebhyo na sa durgāṇi paśyati ॥21॥
13.112.24: dānavadbhiḥ kr̥taḥ panthā yena yānti manīṣiṇaḥ,
te hi prāṇasya dātārastebhyo dharmaḥ sanātanaḥ ॥24॥
13.112.25: kāryaṁ pātrāgataṁ nityamannaṁ hi paramā gatiḥ ॥25॥
13.112.26: annasya hi pradānena naro raudraṁ na sevate,
13.112.27: yated brāhmaṇapūrvaṁ hi bhoktumannaṁ gr̥hī sadā,
13.112.29: na yāti narakaṁ ghoraṁ saṁsārāṁśca na sevate,
13.112.31: mūlametat tu dharmāṇāṁ pradānānāṁ ca bhārata ॥31॥
13.112.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate anuśāsanaparvaṇi dānadharmaparvaṇi saṁsāracakre dvādaśādhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥112॥
13.113.1: tapo’tha guruśuśrūṣā kiṁ śreyaḥ puruṣaṁ prati ॥1॥
13.113.3: ahiṁsāpāśrayaṁ dharmaṁ yaḥ sādhayati vai naraḥ ॥3॥
13.113.4: trīn doṣān sarvabhūteṣu nidhāya puruṣaḥ sadā,
13.113.5: ātmanaḥ sukhamanvicchan sa pretya na sukhī bhavet ॥5॥
13.113.6: ātmopamastu bhūteṣu yo vai bhavati pūruṣaḥ,
13.113.8: na tat parasya sandadhyāt pratikūlaṁ yadātmanaḥ,
13.113.9: pratyākhyāne ca dāne ca sukhaduḥkhe priyāpriye,
13.113.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate anuśāsanaparvaṇi dānadharmaparvaṇi saṁsāracakrasamāptau trayodaśādhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥113॥
13.114.3: vācā ca manasā caiva kathaṁ duḥkhāt pramucyate ॥3॥
13.114.5: yathā sarvaścatuṣpād vai tribhiḥ pādairna tiṣṭhati,
13.114.7: evaṁ lokeṣvahiṁsā tu nirdiṣṭā dharmataḥ purā,
karmaṇā lipyate janturvācā ca manasāpi ca ॥7॥
13.114.8: pūrvaṁ tu manasā tyaktvā tathā vācātha karmaṇā,
na bhakṣayati yo māṁsaṁ trividhaṁ sa vimucyate ॥8॥
13.114.9: mano vāci tathā’’svāde doṣā hyeṣu pratiṣṭhitāḥ ॥9॥
13.114.10: doṣāṁstu bhakṣaṇe rājan māṁsasyeha nibodha me ॥10॥
13.114.12: hiṁsāṁ kr̥tvāvaśaḥ pāpo bhūyiṣṭhaṁ jāyate tathā ॥12॥
13.114.13: rasaṁ ca pratijihvāyā jñānaṁ prajñāyate yathā,
tathā śāstreṣu niyataṁ rāgo hyāsvāditād bhavet ॥13॥
13.114.15: niṣeviṣyanti vai mandā māṁsabhakṣāḥ kathaṁ narāḥ ॥15॥
13.114.16d1: bhasma viṣṭhā kr̥mirvāpi niṣṭhā yasyedr̥śī dhruvā,
sa kāyaḥ parapīḍābhiḥ kathaṁ dhāryo vipaścitā.
13.114.18: jīvitaṁ hi parityajya bahavaḥ sādhavo janāḥ,
13.114.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate anuśāsanaparvaṇi dānadharmaparvaṇi māṁsavarjanakathane caturdaśādhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥114॥
13.115.1: jāto naḥ saṁśayo dharme māṁsasya parivarjane,
doṣo bhakṣayataḥ kaḥ syāt kaścābhakṣayato guṇaḥ ॥1॥
13.115.2: hanyād vā yaḥ parasyārthe krītvā vā bhakṣayennaraḥ ॥2॥
13.115.7: babhūva teṣāṁ tu mataṁ yat tacchr̥ṇu yudhiṣṭhira ॥7॥
13.115.10: na bhakṣayati yo māṁsaṁ na ca hanyānna ghātayet,
13.115.13: dadāti yajate cāpi tapasvī ca bhavatyapi,
13.115.14: māsi māsyaśvamedhena yo yajeta śataṁ samāḥ,
na khādati ca yo māṁsaṁ samametanmataṁ mama ॥14॥
13.115.15: sadā yajati satreṇa sadā dānaṁ prayacchati,
13.115.16: sarve vedā na tat kuryuḥ sarve yajñāśca bhārata,
13.115.18: dātā bhavati loke sa prāṇānāṁ nātra saṁśayaḥ ॥18॥
13.115.19: evaṁ vai paramaṁ dharmaṁ praśaṁsanti manīṣiṇaḥ,
13.115.22: dharmasyāyatanaṁ śreṣṭhaṁ svargasya ca sukhasya ca ॥22॥
13.115.23: ahiṁsā paramaṁ satyaṁ yato dharmaḥ pravartate ॥23॥
13.115.24: na hi māṁsaṁ tr̥ṇāt kāṣṭhādupalād vāpi jāyate,
hatvā jantuṁ tato māṁsaṁ tasmād doṣastu bhakṣaṇe ॥24॥
13.115.29: yadi cet khādako na syānna tadā ghātako bhavet,
ghātakaḥ khādakārthāya tad ghātayati vai naraḥ ॥29॥
13.115.33: lobhād vā buddhimohād vā balavīryārthameva ca,
13.115.36: idaṁ tu khalu kaunteya śrutamāsīt purā mayā,
13.115.37: yo hi khādati māṁsāni prāṇināṁ jīvitaiṣiṇām,
hatānāṁ vā mr̥tānāṁ vā yathā hantā tathaiva saḥ ॥37॥
13.115.41: māṁsasyābhakṣaṇe dharmo viśiṣṭa iti naḥ śrutiḥ ॥41॥
13.115.42: khādakasya kr̥te jantūn yo hanyāt puruṣādhamaḥ,
13.115.44: tasyāpi sumahān dharmo yaḥ pāpād vinivartate ॥44॥
13.115.45: saṁskartā copabhoktā ca khādakāḥ sarva eva te ॥45॥
13.115.49: śrūyate hi purā kalpe nr̥ṇāṁ vrīhimayaḥ paśuḥ,
13.115.50: abhakṣyamapi māṁsaṁ yaḥ prāha bhakṣyamiti prabho ॥50॥
13.115.52: idaṁ tu śr̥ṇu rājendra kīrtyamānaṁ mayānagha,
13.115.55: caturo vārṣikān māsān yo māṁsaṁ parivarjayet,
13.115.57: varjayanti hi māṁsāni māsaśaḥ pakṣaśo’pi vā,
13.115.58: māṁsaṁ tu kaumudaṁ pakṣaṁ varjitaṁ pārtha rājabhiḥ,
13.115.62: satyaṁ vadata māsatyaṁ satyaṁ dharmaḥ sanātanaḥ,
13.115.65: ailena pr̥thunā caiva vīrasenena caiva ha ॥65॥
13.115.66: ikṣvākuṇā śambhunā ca śvetena sagareṇa ca,
ajena dhundhunā caiva tathaiva ca subāhunā ॥66॥
13.115.67: haryaśvena ca rājendra kṣupeṇa bharatena ca,
etaiścānyaiśca rājendra purā māṁsaṁ na bhakṣitam ॥67॥
13.115.69: ye caranti mahātmāno nākapr̥ṣṭhe vasanti te ॥69॥
13.115.70: madhu māṁsaṁ ca ye nityaṁ varjayantīha dhārmikāḥ,
janmaprabhr̥ti madyaṁ ca sarve te munayaḥ smr̥tāḥ ॥70॥
13.115.71: api cet sudurācāro na jātu nirayaṁ vrajet ॥71॥
13.115.72: paṭhed vā ya idaṁ rājan śr̥ṇuyād vāpyabhīkṣṇaśaḥ,
13.115.73: viśiṣṭatāṁ jñātiṣu ca labhate nātra saṁśayaḥ ॥73॥
13.115.75: r̥ddhimān vai kuruśreṣṭha prāpnuyācca mahad yaśaḥ ॥75॥
13.115.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate anuśāsanaparvaṇi dānadharmaparvaṇi māṁsabhakṣaṇaniṣedhe pañcadaśādhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥115॥
13.116.1: ime vai mānavā loke nr̥śaṁsā māṁsagr̥ddhinaḥ,
13.116.4: kiṁ ca bhakṣyamabhakṣyaṁ vā sarvametad vadasva me ॥4॥
13.116.5: yathaitad yādr̥śaṁ caiva guṇā ye cāsya varjane,
doṣā bhakṣayato ye’pi tanme brūhi pitāmaha ॥5॥
13.116.6: ye bhavanti manuṣyāṇāṁ tān me nigadataḥ śr̥ṇu ॥6॥
13.116.8: na hi prāṇāt priyataraṁ loke kiñcana vidyate,
tasmād dayāṁ naraḥ kuryād yathā’’tmani tathā pare ॥8॥
13.116.9: bhakṣaṇe tu mahān doṣo nivr̥ttyā puṇyamucyate ॥9॥
13.116.10: na hyataḥ sadr̥śaṁ kiñcidiha loke paratra ca,
13.116.11: na bhayaṁ vidyate jātu narasyeha dayāvataḥ,
13.116.14: kṣataṁ ca skhalitaṁ caiva patitaṁ kr̥ṣṭamāhatam,
13.116.15: nainaṁ byālamr̥gā ghnanti na piśācā na rākṣasāḥ,
mucyate bhayakāleṣu mokṣayed yo bhaye parān ॥15॥
13.116.16: prāṇadānāt paraṁ dānaṁ na bhūtaṁ na bhaviṣyati,
13.116.17: mr̥tyukāle hi bhūtānāṁ sadyo jāyati vepathuḥ ॥17॥
13.116.21: kumbhīpāke ca pacyante tāṁ tāṁ yonimupāgatāḥ,
ākramya māryamāṇāśca bhrāmyante vai punaḥ punaḥ ॥21॥
13.116.23: sarvamāṁsāni yo rājan yāvajjīvaṁ na bhakṣayet,
svarge sa vipulaṁ sthānaṁ prāpnuyānnātra saṁśayaḥ ॥23॥
13.116.24: bhakṣyante te’pi bhūtaistairiti me nāsti saṁśayaḥ ॥24॥
13.116.25: māṁ sa bhakṣayate yasmād bhakṣayiṣye tamapyaham,
13.116.26: ghātako vadhyate nityaṁ tathā vadhyati bhakṣitā,
13.116.27: yena yena śarīreṇa yad yat karma karoti yaḥ,
13.116.31: ahiṁsraḥ sarvabhūtānāṁ yathā mātā yathā pitā ॥31॥
13.116.32: na hi śakyā guṇā vaktumapi varṣaśatairapi ॥32॥
13.116.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate anuśāsanaparvaṇi dānadharmaparvaṇi ahiṁsāphalakathane ṣoḍaśādhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥116॥
13.117.1: akāmāśca sakāmāśca ye hatāḥ sma mahāmr̥dhe,
kāṁ gatiṁ pratipannāste tanme brūhi pitāmaha ॥1॥
13.117.3: samr̥ddhau vāsamr̥ddhau vā śubhe vā yadi vāśubhe,
kāraṇaṁ tatra me brūhi sarvajño hyasi me mataḥ ॥3॥
13.117.4: samr̥ddhau vāsamr̥ddhau vā śubhe vā yadi vāśubhe,
13.117.5: niratā yena bhāvena tatra me śr̥ṇu kāraṇam,
13.117.8: sarvajñaḥ sa tadā dr̥ṣṭvā kīṭaṁ vacanamavravīt ॥8॥
13.117.10: śakaṭasyāsya mahato ghoṣaṁ śrutvā bhayaṁ mama,
āgataṁ vai mahābuddhe svana eṣa hi dāruṇaḥ ॥10॥
13.117.11: śrūyate na ca māṁ hanyāditi hyasmādapakrame,
13.117.12: nr̥ṇāṁ ca saṁvāhayatāṁ śrūyate vividhaḥ svanaḥ ॥12॥
13.117.14: duḥkhaṁ hi mr̥tyurthūtānāṁ jīvitaṁ ca sudurlabham,
ato bhītaḥ palāyāmi gaccheyaṁ nā sukhaṁ sukhāt ॥14॥
13.117.15: ityuktaḥ sa tu taṁ prāha kutaḥ kīṭa sukhaṁ tava,
maraṇaṁ te sukhaṁ manye tiryagyonau tu vartase ॥15॥
13.117.16: śabdaṁ sparśaṁ rasaṁ gandhaṁ bhogāṁścoccāvacān bahūn,
nābhijānāsi kīṭa tvaṁ śreyo maraṇameva te ॥16॥
13.117.17: sarvatra nirato jīva itaścāpi sukhaṁ mama,
13.117.19: ahamāsaṁ manuṣyo vai śūdro bahudhanaḥ prabho,
13.117.23: akasmāt te mayā tyaktā na trātā abhayaiṣiṇaḥ ॥23॥
13.117.24: dhanaṁ dhānyaṁ priyān dārān yānaṁ vāsastathādbhutam,
13.117.25: īrṣyuḥ parasukhaṁ dr̥ṣṭvā anyasya na bubhūṣakaḥ,
13.117.27: mātā ca pūjitā vr̥ddhā brāhmaṇaścārcito mayā ॥27॥
13.117.28: atithiḥ pūjito brahmaṁstena māṁ nājahāt smr̥tiḥ ॥28॥
13.117.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate anuśāsanaparvaṇi dānadharmaparvaṇi kīṭopākhyāne saptadaśādhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥117॥
13.118.1: śubhena karmaṇā yadvai tiryagyonau na muhyase,
mamaiva kīṭa tat karma yena tvaṁ na pramuhyase ॥1॥
13.118.3: jānāmi pāpaiḥ svakr̥tairgataṁ tvāṁ kīṭa kīṭatām,
avāpsyasi punardharmaṁ dharmaṁ tu yadi manyase ॥3॥
13.118.4: karma bhūmikr̥taṁ devā bhuñjate tiryagāśca ye,
dharmo’pi hi manuṣyeṣu kāmārthaśca tathā guṇāḥ ॥4॥
13.118.5: kiṁ hāsyati manuṣyasya mandasyāpi hi jīvataḥ ॥5॥
13.118.6: jīvan hi kurute pūjāṁ viprāgryaḥ śaśisūryayoḥ,
bruvannapi kathāṁ puṇyāṁ tatra kīṭa tvameṣyasi ॥6॥
13.118.7: tatra te’haṁ vineṣyāmi brahma tvaṁ yatra vaiṣyasi ॥7॥
13.118.9: cakrākrameṇa bhinnaśca kīṭaḥ prāṇān mumoca ha,
13.118.16: stuvanti māṁ yathā devā mahendraṁ priyavādinaḥ ॥16॥
13.118.18: namaste’stu mahāprājña kiṁ karomi praśādhi mām,
13.118.19: adya te kīṭatāṁ prāpya smr̥tirjātā jugupsitā ॥19॥
13.118.20: na tu nāśo’sti pāpasya yastvayopacitaḥ purā,
13.118.21: mama te darśanaṁ prāptaṁ tacca vai sukr̥taṁ tvayā,
tiryagyonau sma jātena mama cābhyarcanāt tathā ॥21॥
13.118.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate anuśāsanaparvaṇi dānadharmaparvaṇi kīṭopākhyāne aṣṭādaśādhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥118॥
13.119.1: tyaktvā sa kīṭatāṁ rājaṁścacāra vipulaṁ tapaḥ ॥1॥
13.119.2: tasya dharmārthaviduṣo dr̥ṣṭvā tad vipulaṁ tapaḥ,
13.119.6: maharṣervacanaṁ śrutvā prajā dharmeṇa pālya ca ॥6॥
13.119.9: bho bho brahmarṣabha śrīman mā vyathiṣṭhāḥ kathañcana,
13.119.11: dharmalopabhayaṁ te syāt tasmād dharmaṁ carottamam,
13.119.12: dharmamūlāṁ śriyaṁ prāpya pāpmā naṣṭa ihādya me,
13.119.14: avāpa ca padaṁ kīṭaḥ pārtha brahma sanātanam,
13.119.15: samprāptāste gatiṁ puṇyāṁ tasmānmā śoca putraka ॥15॥
13.119.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate anuśāsanaparvaṇi dānadharmaparvaṇi kīṭopākhyāne ekonaviṁśatyadhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥119॥
13.120.1: vidyā tapaśca dānaṁ ca kimeteṣāṁ viśiṣyate,
pr̥cchāmi tvāṁ satāṁ śreṣṭha tanme brūhi pitāmaha ॥1॥
13.120.6: kāraṇaṁ brūhi dharmātman vyasmayiṣṭhāḥ kutaśca te ॥6॥
13.120.7: etat pr̥cchāmi te vidvannabhivādya praṇamya ca ॥7॥
13.120.10: na druhyeccaiva dadyācca satyaṁ caiva paraṁ vadet ॥10॥
13.120.11: idānīṁ caiva naḥ kr̥tyaṁ purastācca pariśrutam ॥11॥
13.120.14: puṇyasyaiva hi te sattvaṁ puṇyasyaiva ca darśanam ॥14॥
13.120.16: no cet sarvapavitrebhyo dānameva paraṁ bhavet ॥16॥
13.120.17: teṣāṁ śreṣṭhataraṁ dānamiti me nātra saṁśayaḥ ॥17॥
13.120.18: dānakr̥dbhiḥ kr̥taḥ panthā yena yānti manīṣiṇaḥ,
te hi prāṇasya dātārasteṣu dharmaḥ pratiṣṭhitaḥ ॥18॥
13.120.20: tvaṁ hi tāta mahābuddhe sukhameṣyasi śobhanam,
13.120.21: śrīmantaḥ prāpnuvantyarthān dānaṁ yajñaṁ tathā sukham ॥21॥
13.120.22: dr̥śyate hi mahāprājña niyataṁ vai svabhāvataḥ ॥22॥
13.120.23: puṇyamanyat pāpamanyanna puṇyaṁ na ca pāpakam ॥23॥
13.120.24: na vr̥ttaṁ manyate tasya manyate na ca pātakam,
tathā svakarmanirvr̥ttaṁ na puṇyaṁ na ca pāpakam ॥24॥
13.120.25: ye’bhidruhyanti bhūtāni te vai pāpakr̥to janāḥ ॥25॥
13.120.26: dravyāṇyādadate caiva duḥkhaṁ yānti patanti ca,
tato’nyat karma yatkiñcinna puṇyaṁ na ca pātakam ॥26॥
13.120.27: ramasvaidhasva modasva dehi caiva yajasva ca,
na tvāmabhibhaviṣyanti vaidyā na ca tapasvinaḥ ॥27॥
13.120.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate anuśāsanaparvaṇi dānadharmaparvaṇi maitreyabhikṣāyāṁ viṁśatyadhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥120॥
13.121.3: yad yadicchasi maitreya yāvad yāvad yathā yathā,
brūhi tattvaṁ mahāprājña śuśrūṣe vacanaṁ tava ॥3॥
13.121.4: vidyātapobhyāṁ hi bhavān bhāvitātmā na saṁśayaḥ ॥4॥
13.121.8: asmiṁstr̥pte ca nr̥pyante pitaro daivatāni ca,
13.121.9: andhaṁ syāt tama evedaṁ na prajñāyeta kiñcana,
13.121.10: yathā hi sukr̥te kṣetre phalaṁ vindati mānavaḥ,
evaṁ dattvā śrutavati phalaṁ dātā samaśnute ॥10॥
13.121.11: pratigrahītā dānasya moghaṁ syāt dhanināṁ dhanam ॥11॥
13.121.12: taṁ cānnaṁ pāti yaścānnaṁ sa hantā hanyate’budhaḥ ॥12॥
13.121.13: sa cānnājjāyate tasmāt sūkṣma eṣa vyatikramaḥ ॥13॥
13.121.17: tairhi sadbhiḥ kr̥taḥ panthāstena yāto na muhyate,
te hi svargasya netāro yajñavāhāḥ sanātanāḥ ॥17॥
13.122.1: diṣṭyaivaṁ tvaṁ vijānāsi diṣṭyā te buddhirīdr̥śī ॥1॥
13.122.3: yat te bhr̥śataraṁ dānād vartayiṣyāmi tacchr̥ṇu ॥3॥
13.122.5: tapaḥ pavitraṁ vedasya tapaḥ svargasya sādhanam ॥5॥
13.122.6: tapasā mahadāpnoti vidyayā ceti naḥ śrutam,
13.122.7: yad yaddhi kiñcit sandhāya puruṣastapyate tapaḥ,
13.122.8: sarvaṁ vai tapasābhyeti tapo hi balavattaram ॥8॥
13.122.11: dānapradāḥ sukhaṁ pretya prāpnuvantīha ca śriyam ॥11॥
13.122.12: imaṁ ca brahmalokaṁ ca lokaṁ ca balavattaram,
13.122.13: sa dātā yatra yatraiti sarvataḥ sampraṇūyate ॥13॥
13.122.14: akartā caiva kartā ca labhate yasya yādr̥śam,
13.122.17: yo bhartā vāsitātuṣṭo bhartustuṣṭā ca vāsitā,
yasminnevaṁ kule sarvaṁ kalyāṇaṁ tatra vartate ॥17॥
13.122.19: svasti prāpnuhi maitreya gr̥hān sādhu vrajāmyaham,
13.122.20: taṁ praṇamyātha maitreyaḥ kr̥tvā cāpi pradakṣiṇam,
13.122.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate anuśāsanaparvaṇi dānadharmaparvaṇi maitreyabhikṣāyāṁ dvāviṁśatyadhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥122॥
13.123.3: kena vr̥ttena kalyāṇi samācāreṇa kena vā,
13.123.6: na tvamalpena tapasā dānena niyamena vā,
imaṁ lokamanuprāptā tvaṁ hi tattvaṁ vadasva me ॥6॥
13.123.8: na ca muṇḍā ca jaṭilā bhūtvā devatvamāgatā ॥8॥
13.123.9: ahitāni ca vākyāni sarvāṇi paruṣāṇi ca,
13.123.10: devatānāṁ pitr̥̄ṇāṁ ca brāhmaṇānāṁ ca pūjane,
13.123.11: advāri na ca tiṣṭhāmi ciraṁ na kathayāmi ca ॥11॥
13.123.12: asad vā hasitaṁ kiñcidahitaṁ vāpi karmaṇā,
13.123.14: bhakṣyaṁ vā yadi vā lehyaṁ tatsarvaṁ varjayāmyaham ॥14॥
13.123.15d2: bālānāṁ varjaye nityaṁ śāpaṁ kopaṁ pratāpanam.
13.123.15d4: samudgamya ca śuddhāhaṁ bhikṣāṁ dadyāṁ dvijātiṣu,
13.123.16: pravāsaṁ yadi me yāti bhartā kāryeṇa kenacit,
13.123.18: āntareṣvapi kāryeṣu tena tuṣyati me manaḥ ॥18॥
13.123.22: sa devalokaṁ samprāpya nandane sa sukhī vaset ॥22॥
13.123.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate anuśāsanaparvaṇi dānadharmaparvaṇi śāṇḍilīsumanāsaṁvāde trayoviṁśatyadhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥123॥
13.124.0d2: śrotavyaṁ ca tvayā samyag jñātavyaṁ ca viśāmpate.
13.124.0d6: yaḥ paraḥ prakr̥teḥ proktaḥ puruṣaḥ pañcaviṁśakaḥ,
13.124.0d7: tānyeva cāyanaṁ tasya tena nārāyaṇaḥ smr̥taḥ.
13.124.0d9: nārāyaṇaḥ paraṁ brahma tattvaṁ nārāyaṇaḥ paraḥ,
13.124.0d10: vāsudevaṁ tathā viṣṇumātmānaṁ ca tathā viduḥ,
13.124.0d11: āloḍya sarvaśāstrāṇi vicārya ca punaḥ punaḥ,
13.124.0d14: namo nārāyaṇāyeti yo veda brahma śāśvatam,
13.124.0d17: keśavārādhanaṁ hitvā naiva yānti parāṁ gatim.
13.124.0d21: atha kālena mahatā tathā pratyakṣatāṁ gataḥ,
13.124.0d22: gataḥ sampūjitaḥ sarvaiḥ sa yoganilayo hariḥ.
13.124.1: sāmni cāpi pradāne ca jyāyaḥ kiṁ bhavato matam,
13.124.2: sāmnā prasādyate kaścid dānena ca tathā paraḥ,
13.124.3: guṇāṁstu śr̥ṇu me rājan sāntvasya bharatarṣabha,
13.124.4: gr̥hītvā rakṣasā mukto dvijātiḥ kānane yathā ॥4॥
13.124.6: sāmaivāsmin prayuyuje na mumoha na vivyathe ॥6॥
13.124.7: rakṣastu vācaṁ sampūjya praśnaṁ papraccha taṁ dvijam,
mokṣyase brūhi me praśnaṁ kenāsmi hariṇaḥ kr̥śaḥ ॥7॥
13.124.11: avajānanti nūnaṁ tvāṁ tenāsi hariṇaḥ kr̥śaḥ ॥11॥
13.124.13: māhātmyād vyathase nūnaṁ tenāsi hariṇaḥ kr̥śaḥ ॥13॥
13.124.14: jitaṁ tvāṁ manyate sādho tenāsi hariṇaḥ kr̥śaḥ ॥14॥
13.124.15: manye tvaṁ dhyāyasi janāṁstenāsi hariṇaḥ kr̥śaḥ ॥15॥
13.124.17: vañcayitvā gatastvāṁ vai tenāsi hariṇaḥ kr̥śaḥ ॥17॥
13.124.18: tajjñairna pūjyase nūnaṁ tenāsi hariṇaḥ kr̥śaḥ ॥18॥
13.124.19: guṇāste na virājante tenāsi hariṇaḥ kr̥śaḥ ॥19॥
13.124.20: mahat prārthayase nūnaṁ tenāsi hariṇaḥ kr̥śaḥ ॥20॥
13.124.21d1: sudurvinītaḥ putro vā jāmātā vā pramārjakaḥ,
dārā vā pratikūlāste tenāsi hariṇaḥ kr̥śaḥ.
13.124.21d2: bhrātaro’tīva viṣamāḥ pitā vā kṣutkṣato mr̥taḥ,
mātā jyeṣṭho gururvāpi tenāsi hariṇaḥ kr̥śaḥ.
13.124.21d3: brāhmaṇo vā hato gaurvā brahmasvaṁ vā hr̥taṁ purā,
devasvaṁ vādhikaṁ kāle tenāsi hariṇaḥ kr̥śaḥ.
13.124.21d4: hr̥tadāro’tha vr̥ddho vā loke dviṣṭo’tha vā naraiḥ,
13.124.21d5: vārdhakyārthaṁ dhanaṁ dr̥ṣṭvā svāṁ śrīrvāpi parairhr̥tā,
13.124.22: yuvā sulalitaḥ kāmī tenāsi hariṇaḥ kr̥śaḥ ॥22॥
13.124.23: na bhāti kāle’bhihitaṁ tenāsi hariṇaḥ kr̥śaḥ ॥23॥
13.124.24: anunetuṁ na śaknoṣi tenāsi hariṇaḥ kr̥śaḥ ॥24॥
13.124.26: mamārtha iti jānīte tenāsi hariṇaḥ kr̥śaḥ ॥26॥
13.124.29: yaśaḥ prārthayase nūnaṁ tenāsi hariṇaḥ kr̥śaḥ ॥29॥
13.124.32: sādhūn gr̥hasthān dr̥ṣṭvā ca tathā sādhūn vanecarān,
13.124.34: dharmyamarthyaṁ ca kāmyaṁ ca kāle cābhihitaṁ vacaḥ,
na pratīyanti te nūnaṁ tenāsi hariṇaḥ kr̥śaḥ ॥34॥
13.124.35: prāpya vartayase nūnaṁ tenāsi hariṇaḥ kr̥śaḥ ॥35॥
13.124.36: dhruvaṁ garhayase nityaṁ tenāsi hariṇaḥ kr̥śaḥ ॥36॥
13.124.39: evaṁ sampūjitaṁ rakṣo vipraṁ taṁ pratyapūjayat,
13.124.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate anuśāsanaparvaṇi dānadharmaparvaṇi hariṇakr̥śakākhyāne caturviṁśatyadhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥124॥
13.125.2: dānānāmuttamaṁ yacca deyaṁ yacca yathā yathā,
13.125.3: dharmāṇāṁ paramaṁ guhyaṁ bhīṣmaḥ provāca pārthivam ॥3॥
13.125.4: yathā hi bhagavān vyāsaḥ purā kathitavān mayi ॥4॥
13.125.6: yena yaḥ prīyate devaḥ prīyante pitarastathā,
r̥ṣayaḥ pramathāḥ śrīśca citragupto diśāṁ gajāḥ ॥6॥
13.125.14: ye paṭhanti sadā martyā yeṣāṁ caivopatiṣṭhati,
śrutvā ca phalamācaṣṭe svayaṁ nārāyaṇaḥ prabhuḥ ॥14॥
13.125.15: gavāṁ phalaṁ tīrthaphalaṁ yajñānāṁ caiva yat phalam,
13.125.16: śrotāraḥ śraddadhānāśca yeṣāṁ śuddhaṁ ca mānasam,
teṣāṁ vyaktaṁ jitā lokāḥ śraddadhānena sādhunā ॥16॥
13.125.17: mucyate kilbiṣāccaiva na sa pāpena lipyate,
dharmaṁ ca labhate nityaṁ pretya lokagato naraḥ ॥17॥
13.125.20: kimarthaṁ ca trayaḥ piṇḍāḥ pravibhaktāḥ pr̥thak pr̥thak ॥20॥
13.125.21: prathamaḥ kasya dātavyo madhyamaḥ kva ca gacchati,
13.125.23: svāgataṁ te’stu bhadraṁ te śrūyatāṁ khecarottama,
13.125.24: śrāddhaṁ dattvā ca bhuktvā ca puruṣo yaḥ striyaṁ vrajet,
pitarastasya taṁ māsaṁ tasmin retasi śerate ॥24॥
13.125.25: piṇḍo hyadhastād gacchaṁstu apa āviśya bhāvayet ॥25॥
13.125.26: piṇḍaṁ tu madhyamaṁ tatra patnī tvekā samaśnute,
13.125.27: eṣa śrāddhavidhiḥ prokto yathā dharmo na lupyate,
13.125.29: pitr̥̄ṇāṁ triṣu sarveṣāṁ niruktaṁ kathitaṁ tvayā,
ekaḥ samuddhr̥taḥ piṇḍo hyadhastāt kasya gacchati ॥29॥
13.125.30: kaṁ vā prīṇayate devaṁ kathaṁ tārayate pitr̥̄n,
madhyamaṁ tu tadā patnī bhuṅkte’nujñātameva hi ॥30॥
13.125.32: bhavate kā gatistasya kaṁ vā samanugacchati,
etadicchāmyahaṁ śrotuṁ piṇḍeṣu triṣu yā gatiḥ ॥32॥
13.125.33: phalaṁ vr̥ttiṁ ca mārgaṁ ca yaścainaṁ pratipadyate,
13.125.38: apo gacchati yo hyatra śaśinaṁ hyeṣa prīṇayet,
13.125.39: bhuṅkte tu patnī yaṁ caiṣāmanujñātā tu madhyamam,
13.125.40: havyavāhe tu yaḥ piṇḍo dīyate tannibodha me,
pitarastena tr̥pyanti prītāḥ kāmān diśanti ca ॥40॥
13.125.41: etat te kathitaṁ sarvaṁ triṣu piṇḍeṣu yā gatiḥ,
13.125.42: śucinā tu sadā śrāddhaṁ bhoktavyaṁ khecarottama ॥42॥
13.125.43: ye mayā kathitā doṣāste tathā syurna cānyathā,
tasmāt snātaḥ śuciḥ kṣāntaḥ śrāddhaṁ bhuñjīta vai dvijaḥ ॥43॥
13.125.48: pitaraśca mahābhāgāḥ pūjayanti sma taṁ munim,
kurukṣetraṁ gayāṁ gaṅgāṁ prabhāsaṁ puṣkarāṇi ca ॥48॥
13.125.49: etāni manasā dhyātvā avagāhet tato jalam,
tathā mucyati pāpena rāhuṇā candramā yathā ॥49॥
13.125.50: tryahaṁ snātaḥ sa bhavati nirāhāraśca vartate,
spr̥śate yo gavāṁ pr̥ṣṭhaṁ bāladhiṁ ca namasyati ॥50॥
13.125.53: śrutaṁ me bhāṣamāṇasya sthāṇoḥ sthāne br̥haspateḥ ॥53॥
13.125.57: tejasā sūryavad dīpto bhrājate somavat punaḥ ॥57॥
13.125.60: pratimehanti ye sūryamanilaṁ dviṣate ca ye,
havyavāhe pradīpte ca samidhaṁ ye na juhvati ॥60॥
13.125.61: bālavatsāṁ ca ye dhenuṁ duhanti kṣīrakāraṇāt,
teṣāṁ doṣān pravakṣyāmi tān nibodha śacīpate ॥61॥
13.125.64: striyaḥ sarvāśca durvr̥ttāḥ pratimehanti yā ravim ॥64॥
13.125.65: havyavāhasya dīptasya samidhaṁ ye na juhvati ॥65॥
13.125.66: agnikāryeṣu vai teṣāṁ havyaṁ nāśnāti pāvakaḥ,
kṣīraṁ tu bālavatsānāṁ ye pibantīha mānavāḥ ॥66॥
13.125.68: tasmād varjyāni varjyāni kāryaṁ kāryaṁ ca nityaśaḥ ॥68॥
13.125.71: ānr̥ṇyaṁ vā kathaṁ martyā gaccheyuḥ kena karmaṇā ॥71॥
13.125.72: etadicchāmahe śrotuṁ paraṁ kautūhalaṁ hi naḥ,
13.125.81: tamorūpaṁ na tasyāsti dīpakaṁ yaḥ prayacchati,
amāvāsyāṁ tu ye martyāḥ prayacchanti tilodakam ॥81॥
13.125.82: kr̥taṁ bhavati taiḥ śrāddhaṁ sarahasyaṁ yathārthavat ॥82॥
13.125.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate anuśāsanaparvaṇi dānadharmaparvaṇi pitr̥rahasyaṁ nāma pañcaviṁśatyadhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥125॥
13.126.1: kena te ca bhavet prītiḥ kathaṁ tuṣṭiṁ tu gacchasi,
13.126.3: teṣāṁ tuṣyāmi martyānāṁ yaścakre ca baliṁ haret ॥3॥
13.126.4: vāmanaṁ brāhmaṇaṁ dr̥ṣṭvā varāhaṁ ca jalotthitam,
uddhr̥tāṁ dharaṇīṁ caiva mūrdhnā dhārayate tu yaḥ ॥4॥
13.126.5: aśvatthaṁ rocanāṁ gāṁ ca pūjayed yo naraḥ sadā ॥5॥
13.126.6: tena rūpeṇa teṣāṁ ca pūjāṁ gr̥hṇāmi tattvataḥ ॥6॥
13.126.8: nāhaṁ tat pratigr̥hṇāmi na sā tuṣṭikarī mama ॥8॥
13.126.9: cakraṁ pādau varāhaṁ ca brāhmaṇaṁ cāpi vāmanam,
uddhr̥tāṁ dharaṇīṁ caiva kimarthaṁ tvaṁ praśaṁsasi ॥9॥
13.126.10: bhavān sr̥jati bhūtāni bhavān saṁharati prajāḥ,
13.126.11: cakreṇa nihatā daityāḥ padbhyāṁ krāntā vasundharā ॥11॥
13.126.12: vāmanaṁ rūpamāsthāya jito rājā mayā baliḥ ॥12॥
13.126.13: tanmāṁ ye pūjayiṣyanti nāsti teṣāṁ parābhavaḥ ॥13॥
13.126.18: kalya utthāya yo martyaḥ spr̥śed gāṁ vai ghr̥taṁ dadhi,
sarṣapaṁ ca priyaṅguṁ ca kalmaṣāt pratimucyate ॥18॥
13.126.19: bhūtāni caiva sarvāṇi agrataḥ pr̥ṣṭhato’pi vā,
13.126.20: upavāsaṁ tu gr̥hṇīyād yad vā saṅkalpayed vratam ॥20॥
13.126.21: anyathā hi vr̥thā martyāḥ kurvate svalpabuddhayaḥ ॥21॥
13.126.22: balirbhikṣā tathārghyaṁ ca pitr̥̄ṇāṁ ca tilodakam ॥22॥
13.126.25: eteṣu daivaṁ pitryaṁ vā na deyaṁ syāt kathañcana ॥25॥
13.126.26: piṇḍadāstasya hīyante na ca prīṇāti vai pitr̥̄n,
13.126.29: pādamudyamya yo martyaḥ spr̥śed gāśca sudurmatiḥ,
13.126.31: vaimanasyaṁ ca devānāṁ kr̥taṁ bhavati puṣkalam,
13.126.32: ājanmanāṁ śataṁ caiva narake pacyate tu saḥ,
niṣkr̥tiṁ ca na tasyāpi anumanyanti karhicit ॥32॥
13.126.33: tasmād gāvo na pādena spraṣṭavyā vai kadācana,
13.126.34: ete doṣā mayā proktāstriṣu yaḥ pādamutsr̥jet ॥34॥
13.126.36: yadā bhādrapade māsi bhavate bahule maghā ॥36॥
13.126.38: kṣeme ca sakhyeva hi bhūyasī ca,
13.126.41: na tasya pāpaṁ na bhayaṁ na śokaḥ
13.126.45: prāpnuvantīha yajñasya phalaṁ kena ca karmaṇā,
13.126.46: aho praśno mahābhāgā gūḍhārthaḥ paramaḥ śubhaḥ,
13.126.47: yathā yajñaphalaṁ martyo labhate nāja saṁśayaḥ ॥47॥
13.126.48: pauṣamāsasya śukle vai yadā yujyeta rohiṇī,
13.126.50: etad vaḥ paramaṁ guhyaṁ kathitaṁ dvijasattamāḥ,
13.126.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate anuśāsanaparvaṇi dānadharmaparvaṇi devarahasye ṣaḍviṁśatyadhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥126॥
13.127.2: sthito hyabhimukho martyaḥ paurṇamāsyāṁ baliṁ haret,
13.127.5: havyaṁ na tasya devāśca pratigr̥hṇanti parvasu,
13.127.8: yastu saṁvatsaraṁ pūrṇaṁ dadyād dīpaṁ karañjake,
13.127.9: ātithyaṁ satataṁ kuryād dīpaṁ dadyāt pratiśraye,
varjayāno divā svāpaṁ na ca māṁsāni bhakṣayet ॥9॥
13.127.10: gobrāhmaṇaṁ na hiṁsyācca puṣkarāṇi ca kīrtayet,
13.127.11: na tu kṣīyanti te dharmāḥ śraddadhānaiḥ prayojitāḥ ॥11॥
13.127.12: idaṁ ca paramaṁ guhyaṁ sarahasyaṁ nibodhata,
śrāddhakalpe ca daive ca tairthike parvaṇīṣu ca ॥12॥
13.127.13: rajasvalā ca yā nārī śvitrikāputrikā ca yā,
13.127.14: kīrtayed bhārataṁ caiva tathā syādakṣayaṁ haviḥ ॥14॥
13.127.15: bhinnabhāṇḍaṁ ca khaṭvāṁ ca kukkuṭaṁ śunakaṁ tathā,
13.127.16: bhinnabhāṇḍe kaliṁ prāhuḥ khaṭvāyāṁ tu dhanakṣayaḥ,
vr̥kṣamūle dhruvaṁ sattvaṁ tasmād vr̥kṣaṁ na ropayet ॥16॥
13.127.17: avākśirā vā lambeta satraṁ vā sphītamāharet ॥17॥
13.127.18: na yasya hr̥dayaṁ śuddhaṁ narakaṁ sa dhruvaṁ vrajet,
tulyaṁ yajñaśca satyaṁ ca hr̥dayasya ca śuddhatā ॥18॥
13.127.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate anuśāsanaparvaṇi dānadharmaparvaṇi devarahasye saptaviṁśatyadhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥127॥
13.128.3: caturo vārṣikān māsān yo dadāti tilodakam ॥3॥
13.128.6: manyate dharma eveti sa cādharmeṇa lipyate,
13.128.7: prāyaścittaṁ tu yat tatra bruvatastannibodha me ॥7॥
13.128.8: yat kr̥tvā tu naraḥ samyak sukhī bhavati vijvaraḥ,
gavāṁ mūtrapurīṣeṇa payasā ca ghr̥tena ca ॥8॥
13.128.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate anuśāsanaparvaṇi dānadharmaparvaṇi devarahasye aṣṭāviṁśatyadhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥128॥
13.129.2: brahmasvaṁ harate yaśca samadoṣā bhavanti te ॥2॥
13.129.4: tasmāt parasya vai dārāṁstyajed vandhyāṁ ca yoṣitam,
13.129.6: dvādaśyāṁ paurṇamāsyāṁ ca māsi māsi ghr̥tākṣatam,
13.129.8: prītaśca bhagavān soma iṣṭān kāmān prayacchati ॥8॥
13.129.10: kalyamutthāya yo martyaḥ snātaḥ śuklena vāsasā,
13.129.11: tilodakaṁ ca yo dadyāt pitr̥̄ṇāṁ madhunā saha,
dīpakaṁ kr̥saraṁ caiva śrūyatāṁ tasya yat phalam ॥11॥
13.129.12: gopradānaṁ ca yaḥ kuryād bhūmidānaṁ ca śāśvatam ॥12॥
13.129.13: agniṣṭomaṁ ca yo yajñaṁ yajeta bahudakṣiṇam,
13.129.14: dīpe ca kr̥sare caiva tuṣyante’sya pitāmahāḥ ॥14॥
13.129.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate anuśāsanaparvaṇi dānadharmaparvaṇi lomaśarahasye ekonatriṁśadadhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥129॥
13.130.3: bhavatāṁ ca prasādena dharmān vakṣyāmi śāśvatān ॥3॥
13.130.4: śraddadhāne prayoktavyā yasya śuddhaṁ tathā manaḥ ॥4॥
13.130.5: asambhāṣyā hi catvāro naiṣāṁ dharmaḥ prakāśayet ॥5॥
13.130.6: ahanyahani yo dadyāt kapilāṁ dvādaśīḥ samāḥ,
māsi māsi ca satreṇa yo yajeta sadā naraḥ ॥6॥
13.130.9: niṣiñceta gavāṁ śr̥ṅge mastakena ca tajjalam ॥9॥
13.130.10: śrūyante yāni tīrthāni triṣu lokeṣu kānicit ॥10॥
13.130.13: varaṁ dadāmi te dhanye tapaste vardhatāṁ sadā ॥13॥
13.130.14: ramaṇīyā kathā divyā yuṣmatto yā mayā śrutā,
śrūyatāṁ citraguptasya bhāṣitaṁ mama ca priyam ॥14॥
13.130.16: na hi puṇyaṁ tathā pāpaṁ kr̥taṁ kiñcid vinaśyati,
13.130.17: pretalokaṁ gate martye tat tat sarvaṁ vibhāvasuḥ,
13.130.18: pānīyaṁ caiva dīpaṁ ca dātavyaṁ satataṁ tathā ॥18॥
13.130.19: upānahau ca chatraṁ ca kapilā ca yathātatham,
13.130.23: tatra dharmaṁ pravakṣyāmi yena durgāṇi santaret ॥23॥
13.130.24: alpavyayaṁ mahārthaṁ ca pretya caiva sukhodayam,
13.130.25: tatra puṇyodakā nāma nadī teṣāṁ vidhīyate,
13.130.26: sa tatra toyaṁ pibati pānīyaṁ yaḥ prayacchati,
13.130.29: tasmād dīpaḥ pradātavyaḥ pānīyaṁ ca viśeṣataḥ,
13.130.30: puṣkare ca viśeṣeṇa śrūyatāṁ tasya yat phalam,
gośataṁ savr̥ṣaṁ tena dattaṁ bhavati śāśvatam ॥30॥
13.130.31: pāpaṁ karma ca yat kiñcid brahmahatyāsamaṁ bhavet,
śodhayet kapilā hyekā pradattaṁ gośataṁ yathā ॥31॥
13.130.32: na teṣāṁ viṣamaṁ kiñcinna duḥkhaṁ na ca kaṇṭakāḥ ॥32॥
13.130.33: upānahau ca yo dadyāt pātrabhūte dvijottame,
13.130.34: na hi dattasya dānasya nāśo’stīha kadācana,
13.130.36: dānametat prayacchanti na teṣāṁ vidyate bhayam ॥36॥
13.130.40: asambhāṣyāḥ pitr̥̄ṇāṁ ca devānāṁ caiva pañca te,
snātakānāṁ ca viprāṇāṁ ye cānye ca tapodhanāḥ ॥40॥
13.130.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate anuśāsanaparvaṇi dānadharmaparvaṇi arundhatīcitraguptarahasye triṁśadadhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥130॥
13.131.1: tataḥ sarve mahābhāgā devāśca pitaraśca ha,
13.131.3: ke ca smr̥tāḥ pratīghātā yena martyān na hiṁsatha,
13.131.4: mohānmāṁsāni khādeta vr̥kṣamūle ca yaḥ svapet ॥4॥
13.131.5: āmiṣaṁ śīrṣato yasya pādato yaśca saṁviśet,
13.131.6: ete bhakṣyāśca vadhyāśca mānuṣā nātra saṁśayaḥ ॥6॥
13.131.7: śrūyatāṁ ca pratīghātān yairna śaknuma hiṁsitum ॥7॥
13.131.9: ye ca māṁsaṁ na khādanti tān na śaknuma hiṁsitum,
yasya cāgnirgr̥he nityaṁ divārātrau ca dīpyate ॥9॥
13.131.12: etad vaḥ kathitaṁ sarvaṁ yatra vaḥ saṁśayo mahān ॥12॥
13.131.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate anuśāsanaparvaṇi dānadharmaparvaṇi pramatharahasye ekatriṁśadadhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥131॥
13.132.1: uvāca vacanaṁ devān vāsavaṁ ca śacīpatim ॥1॥
13.132.4: dharmaguhyāni sarvāṇi gatvā pr̥cchatu tatra vai ॥4॥
13.132.5: pitāmahavacaḥ śrutvā te devā reṇukaṁ tadā,
13.132.8: imaṁ mantraṁ japan śrāddhe yatāhāro hyakopanaḥ,
13.132.9: teṣāṁ kulodbhavā ye ca mahābhūtā bhujaṅgamāḥ ॥9॥
13.132.11: evamuktvā baliṁ tatra valmīke tu nivedayet ॥11॥
13.132.12: nirvapet taṁ tu valmīke astaṁ yāte divākare ॥12॥
13.132.14: brāhmaṇaḥ kṣatriyo vaiśyaḥ śūdro vā yadyupoṣitaḥ ॥14॥
13.132.15: evaṁ saṁvatsaraṁ kr̥tvā dānaṁ bahuphalaṁ labhet,
13.132.16: ye ca nāgā mahāvīryāstriṣu lokeṣu kr̥tsnaśaḥ,
13.132.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate anuśāsanaparvaṇi dānadharmaparvaṇi diggajānāṁ rahasye dvātriṁśadadhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥132॥
13.133.1: dharmaguhyamidaṁ mattaḥ śr̥ṇudhvaṁ sarva eva ha ॥1॥
13.133.2: yeṣāṁ dharmāśritā buddhiḥ śraddadhānāśca ye narāḥ,
13.133.4: imā gāvo mahābhāgāḥ pavitraṁ paramaṁ smr̥tāḥ,
13.133.5: tāsu caiva mahāpuṇyaṁ śuśrūṣā ca mahāphalam,
13.133.6: mayā hyetā hyanujñātāḥ pūrvamāsan kr̥te yuge,
13.133.7: rame’haṁ saha gobhiśca tasmāt pūjyāḥ sadaiva tāḥ ॥7॥
13.133.9: tasya tatra caturbhāgo yo dadāti gavāhnikam ॥9॥
13.133.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate anuśāsanaparvaṇi dānadharmaparvaṇi mahādevarahasye trayastriṁśadadhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥133॥
13.134.1: nīlaṣaṇḍasya śr̥ṅgābhyāṁ gr̥hītvā mr̥ttikāṁ tu yaḥ ॥1॥
13.134.2: abhiṣekaṁ tryahaṁ kuryāt tasya dharmaṁ nibodhata,
13.134.8: r̥ṣīṇāṁ caiva guhyāni yaḥ paṭhedāhnikaṁ sadā ॥8॥
13.134.9: nāsya vighnaḥ prabhavati bhayaṁ cāsya na vidyate ॥9॥
13.134.10: ye ca dharmāḥ śubhāḥ puṇyāḥ sarahasyā udāhr̥tāḥ,
teṣāṁ dharmaphalaṁ tasya yaḥ paṭheta jitendriyaḥ ॥10॥
13.134.11: nāsya pāpaṁ prabhavati na ca pāpena lipyate,
paṭhed vā śrāvayed vāpi śrutvā vā labhate phalam ॥11॥
13.134.13: r̥ṣīṇāṁ devatānāṁ ca pitr̥̄ṇāṁ caiva nityadā,
13.134.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate anuśāsanaparvaṇi dānadharmaparvaṇi skandadevarahasye catustriṁśadadhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥134॥
13.135.1: ke bhojyā brāhmaṇasyeha ke bhojyāḥ kṣatriyasya ha,
tathā vaiśyasya ke bhojyāḥ ke śūdrasya ca bhārata ॥1॥
13.135.2: brāhmaṇā brāhmaṇasyeha bhojyā ye caiva kṣatriyāḥ,
13.135.3: brāhmaṇāḥ kṣatriyā vaiśyā bhojyā vai kṣatriyasya ha,
13.135.4: vaiśyāstu bhojyā viprāṇāṁ kṣatriyāṇāṁ tathaiva ca,
13.135.5: śūdrāṇāmatha yo bhuṅkte sa bhuṅkte pr̥thivīmalam,
malaṁ nr̥ṇāṁ sa pibati malaṁ bhuṅkte janasya ca ॥5॥
13.135.6: śūdrāṇāṁ yastathā bhuṅkte sa bhuṅkte pr̥thivīmalam,
13.135.9: karoti karma yad vaiśyastad gatvā hyupajīvati,
13.135.10: śūdrakarma tu yaḥ kuryādavahāya svakarma ca,
sa vijñeyo yathā śūdro na ca bhojyaḥ kadācana ॥10॥
13.135.13: kulaṁ vīryaṁ ca tejaśca tiryagyonitvameva ca,
sa prayāti yathā śvā vai niṣkriyo dharmavarjitaḥ ॥13॥
13.135.14: puṁścalyannaṁ ca mūtraṁ syāt kārukānnaṁ ca śoṇitam ॥14॥
13.135.15: tadapyannaṁ yathā śaudraṁ tat sādhuḥ parivarjayet ॥15॥
13.135.16: vacanīyasya yo bhuṅkte tamāhuḥ śoṇitaṁ hradam,
13.135.18: vyādhiṁ kulakṣayaṁ caiva kṣipraṁ prāpnoti brāhmaṇaḥ,
13.135.19: goghne ca brāhmaṇaghne ca surāpe gurutalpage,
13.135.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate anuśāsanaparvaṇi dānadharmaparvaṇi bhojyābhojyānnakathanaṁ nāma pañcatriṁśadadhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥135॥
13.136.3: hanta vakṣyāmi te rājan brāhmaṇānāṁ mahātmanām,
pratigraheṣu bhojye ca mucyate yena pāpmanaḥ ॥3॥
13.136.6: kr̥ṣṇāyasaṁ ca vivr̥taṁ dhārayan mucyate dvijaḥ ॥6॥
13.136.7: evaṁ pratigr̥hīte’tha dhane vastre tathā striyām,
13.136.9: vrīhau puṣpe phale caiva jale piṣṭamaye tathā,
13.136.12: kr̥ṣṇapakṣe tu yaḥ śrāddhaṁ pitr̥̄ṇāmaśnute dvijaḥ,
13.136.13: na ca sandhyāmupāsīta na ca jāpyaṁ pravartayet,
na saṅkiret tadannaṁ ca tataḥ pūyeta brāhmaṇaḥ ॥13॥
13.136.18: sapta triṣavaṇaṁ snātvā pūto bhavati brāhmaṇaḥ ॥18॥
13.136.21: sa vai trirātraṁ dīkṣitvā mucyate tena karmaṇā ॥21॥
13.136.23: śūdrasya tu kulaṁ hanti vaiśyasya paśubāndhavān,
13.136.24: prāyaścittaṁ ca śāntiṁ ca juhuyāt tena mucyate,
13.136.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate anuśāsanaparvaṇi dānadharmaparvaṇi prāyaścittavidhirnāma ṣaṭtriṁśadadhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥136॥
13.137.7: divyaṁ śataśalākaṁ ca yajñārthaṁ kāñcanaṁ śubham,
13.137.9: sāvitraḥ kuṇḍalaṁ divyaṁ yānaṁ ca janamejayaḥ,
brāhmaṇāya ca gā dattvā gato lokānanuttamān ॥9॥
13.137.11: nimī rāṣṭraṁ ca vaidarbhiḥ kanyāṁ dattvā mahātmane,
13.137.14: rāmo dāśarathiścaiva hutvā yajñeṣu vai vasu,
sa gato hyakṣayām̐llokān yasya loke mahad yaśaḥ ॥14॥
13.137.18: madayantīṁ priyāṁ bhāryāṁ dattvā ca tridivaṁ gataḥ ॥18॥
13.137.23: nāmnā ca dyutimān nāma śālvarājo mahādyutiḥ,
13.137.25: lomapādaśca rājarṣiḥ śāntāṁ dattvā sutāṁ prabhuḥ,
13.137.26: kautsāya dattvā kanyāṁ tu haṁsīṁ nāma yaśasvinīm,
13.137.27: dattvā śatasahasraṁ tu gavāṁ rājā bhagīrathaḥ,
13.137.28: ete cānye ca bahavo dānena tapasā ca ha,
yudhiṣṭhira gatāḥ svargaṁ vivartante punaḥ punaḥ ॥28॥
13.137.30: śiṣṭānāṁ caritaṁ hyetat kīrtitaṁ me yudhiṣṭhira,
13.137.31: dattvā tu satataṁ te’stu kauravāṇāṁ dhurandhara,
13.137.32: yatra te nr̥paśārdūla sandeho vai bhaviṣyati,
śvaḥ prabhāte hi vakṣyāmi sandhyā hi samupasthitā ॥32॥
13.138.2: dānaṁ katividhaṁ deyaṁ kiṁ tasya ca phalaṁ labhet ॥2॥
13.138.3: kathaṁ kebhyaśca dharmyaṁ ca dānaṁ dātavyamiṣyate,
13.138.4: śr̥ṇu tattvena kaunteya dānaṁ prati mamānagha,
13.138.7: dadāti vā dāsyati vā mahyaṁ dattamanena vā,
13.138.8: nāsyāhaṁ na madīyo’yaṁ pāpaṁ kuryād vimānitaḥ,
iti dadyād bhayādeva dr̥ḍhaṁ mūḍhāya paṇḍitaḥ ॥8॥
13.139.1: āgamairbahubhiḥ sphīto bhavān naḥ pravare kule ॥1॥
13.139.3: ayaṁ ca kālaḥ samprāpto durlabho jñātibāndhavaiḥ,
śāstā ca na hi naḥ kaścit tvāmr̥te puruṣarṣabha ॥3॥
13.139.4: vaktumarhasi naḥ praśnaṁ yat tvāṁ pr̥cchāmi pārthiva ॥4॥
13.139.6: asya caiva samakṣaṁ tvaṁ pārthivānāṁ ca sarvaśaḥ,
bhrātr̥̄ṇāṁ ca priyārthaṁ me snehād bhāṣitumarhasi ॥6॥
13.139.8: asya viṣṇoḥ purā rājan prabhāvo yo mayā śrutaḥ ॥8॥
13.139.9: yaśca govr̥ṣabhāṅkasya prabhāvastaṁ ca me śr̥ṇu,
rudrāṇyāḥ saṁśayo yaśca dampatyostaṁ ca me śr̥ṇu ॥9॥
13.139.15: rājarṣīṇāṁ surāṇāṁ ca ye vasanti tapodhanāḥ ॥15॥
13.139.23: praśritaṁ madhuraṁ snigdhaṁ papraccha vadatāṁ varaḥ ॥23॥
13.139.26: bhavān visr̥jate lokān bhavān saṁharate punaḥ,
bhavān śītaṁ bhavānuṣṇaṁ bhavāneva ca varṣati ॥26॥
13.139.27: pr̥thivyāṁ yāni bhūtāni sthāvarāṇi carāṇi ca,
teṣāṁ pitā tvaṁ mātā tvaṁ prabhuḥ prabhava eva ca ॥27॥
13.139.29: yacchrutaṁ yacca dr̥ṣṭaṁ nastat pravakṣyāmahe hare ॥29॥
13.139.30: etad vai vaiṣṇavaṁ tejo mama vaktrād viniḥsr̥tam,
13.139.32: mama vahniḥ samudbhūto na vai vyathitumarhatha ॥32॥
13.139.34: tato mamātmā yo dehe so’gnirbhūtvā viniḥsr̥taḥ,
13.139.37: mayā proktaṁ samāsena na bhīḥ kāryā tapodhanāḥ ॥37॥
13.139.39: yacchrutaṁ yacca vo dr̥ṣṭaṁ divi vā yadi vā bhuvi,
āścaryaṁ paramaṁ kiñcit tad bhavanto bruvantu me ॥39॥
13.139.41: divi vā bhuvi vā kiñcit paśyāmyamaradarśanāḥ ॥41॥
13.139.42: prakr̥tiḥ sā mama parā na kvacit pratihanyate,
13.140.16: oṣadhyo jvalamānāśca dyotayanti sma tad vanam,
vihaṅgāśca mudā yuktāḥ prānr̥tyan vyanadaṁśca ha ॥16॥
13.140.26: haranetre śubhe devī sahasā sā samāvr̥ṇot ॥26॥
13.140.29: jvālā ca mahatī dīptā lalāṭāt tasya niḥsr̥tā ॥29॥
13.140.36: taṁ dr̥ṣṭvā mathitaṁ śailaṁ śailarājasutā tataḥ,
13.140.39: prakr̥tisthaṁ giriṁ dr̥ṣṭvā prītā devaṁ maheśvaram,
13.140.41: kimarthaṁ te lalāṭe vai tr̥tīyaṁ netramutthitam,
13.140.42: tathaiva drumasañcchannaḥ kr̥to’yaṁ te pitā mama ॥42॥
13.140.42d1: eṣa me saṁśayo deva hr̥di me sampravartate,
13.140.42d4: tvadr̥te māṁ hi vai praṣṭuṁ na śakyaṁ kenacit priye,
prakāśaṁ yadi vā guhyaṁ priyārthaṁ prabravīmyaham.
13.140.42d5: sarveṣāmeva lokānāṁ kūṭasthaṁ viddhi māṁ priye.
13.140.42d6: madadhīnāstrayo lokā yathā viṣṇau tathā mayi,
sraṣṭā viṣṇurahaṁ goptā ityetad viddhi bhāmini.
13.140.42d7: tasmād yadā māṁ spr̥śati śubhaṁ vā yadi vetarat,
tathaivedaṁ jagat sarvaṁ tattad bhavati śobhane.
13.140.43: netre me saṁvr̥te devi tvayā bālyādanindite,
13.140.44: tr̥tīyaṁ locanaṁ dīptaṁ sr̥ṣṭaṁ me rakṣatā prajāḥ ॥44॥
13.140.45: tasya cākṣṇo mahat tejo yenāyaṁ mathito giriḥ,
tvatpriyārthaṁ ca me devi prakr̥tisthaḥ punaḥ kr̥taḥ ॥45॥
13.140.46: bhagavan kena te vaktraṁ candravat priyadarśanam,
13.140.47: dakṣiṇaṁ ca mukhaṁ raudraṁ kenordhvaṁ kapilā jaṭāḥ,
kena kaṇṭhaśca te nīlo barhibarhanibhaḥ kr̥taḥ ॥47॥
13.140.48: haste deva pinākaṁ te satataṁ kena tiṣṭhati,
13.140.49: etanme saṁśayaṁ sarvaṁ vaktumarhasi vai prabho,
13.140.50: tasyā dhr̥tyā ca buddhyā ca prītimānabhavat prabhuḥ ॥50॥
13.140.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate anuśāsanaparvaṇi dānadharmaparvaṇi umāmaheśvarasaṁvādo nāma catvāriṁśadadhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥140॥
13.141.1: tilaṁ tilaṁ samuddhr̥tya ratnānāṁ nirmitā śubhā ॥1॥
13.141.3: tatastato mukhaṁ cāru mama devi vinirgatam ॥3॥
13.141.8: indreṇa ca purā vrajaṁ kṣiptaṁ śrīkāṅkṣiṇā mama,
dagdhvā kaṇṭhaṁ tu tad yātaṁ tena śrīkaṇṭhatā mama ॥8॥
13.141.8d3: tad dr̥ṣṭvā vibudhāḥ sarve tadā vimanaso’bhavan,
grastaṁ hi tanmayā devi lokānāṁ hitakāraṇāt.
13.141.8d4: tatkr̥tā nīlatā cāsīt kaṇṭhe barhinibhā śubhe,
13.141.8d5: etat te sarvamākhyātaṁ kiṁ bhūyaḥ śrotumicchasi,
13.141.8d7: śastrāgamaṁ te vakṣyāmi śr̥ṇu dharmyaṁ śucismite,
13.141.8d8: tathā tasya tapo ghoraṁ carataḥ kālaparyayāt.
13.141.8d9: tasmai brahmā varaṁ dātuṁ jagāma tapasārcitaḥ.
13.141.8d10: dattvā tasmai varaṁ devo veṇuṁ dr̥ṣṭvā tvacintayat,
13.141.8d12: dhanuṣī dve tadā prādād viṣṇave mama caiva tu,
pinākaṁ nāma me cāpaṁ śārṅgaṁ nāma harerdhanuḥ.
13.141.8d13: tacca somāya nirdiśya brahmā lokaṁ gataḥ punaḥ.
13.141.10: sā sr̥ṣṭā bahudhā jātā kṣaramāṇā payo’mr̥tam ॥10॥
13.141.12: vr̥ṣaṁ cainaṁ dhvajārthaṁ me dadau vāhanameva ca ॥12॥
13.141.13: tāṁśca santyajya bhagavan śmaśāne ramase katham ॥13॥
13.141.16: na ca medhyataraṁ kiñcit śmaśānādiha lakṣyate ॥16॥
13.141.17: tena me sarvavāsānāṁ śmaśāne ramate manaḥ,
13.141.19: eṣa vāso hi me medhyaḥ svargīyaśca mataḥ śubhe,
13.141.19d2: sthānaṁ me tatra vihitaṁ vīrasthānamiti priye,
13.141.19d4: madanyena na śakyaṁ hi nihantuṁ bhūtajaṁ bhayam,
tatrastho’haṁ prajāḥ sarvāḥ pālayāmi dine dine.
13.141.19d5: manniyogād bhūtasaṅghā na ca ghnantīha kañcana,
13.141.19d6: piṅgalaṁ vikr̥taṁ bhāti rūpaṁ te tu bhayānakam.
13.141.19d11: āgneyamiti me rūpaṁ devi lokahite ratam.
13.141.19d13: iti te kathitaṁ devi kiṁ bhūyaḥ śrotumicchasi.
13.141.19d16: namo ghoratarād ghora namo rudrāya śaṅkara,
13.141.19d19: aho devasya māhātmyamaho devasya vai kr̥pā.
13.141.19d20: samprītyarthaṁ munīnāṁ sā kṣaṇajñā paramaṁ hitam.
13.141.23: dharmaḥ kiṁlakṣaṇaḥ proktaḥ kathaṁ vā carituṁ naraiḥ,
13.141.25: śamo dānaṁ yathāśakti gārhasthyo dharma uttamaḥ ॥25॥
13.141.28: cāturvarṇyasya yo dharmaḥ sve sve varṇe guṇāvahaḥ ॥28॥
13.141.29: vaiśye kiṁlakṣaṇo dharmaḥ śūdre kiṁlakṣaṇo bhavet ॥29॥
13.141.29d3: karmāṇi ca tadarhāṇi śāstreṣu vihitāni vai,
13.141.29d6: teṣāṁ dharmāṁśca karmāṇi śr̥ṇu devi samāhitā.
13.141.29d7: viprāḥ kr̥tā bhūmidevā lokānāṁ dhāraṇe kr̥tāḥ,
13.141.29d8: yadi te brāhmaṇā na syurdānayogavahāḥ sadā,
13.141.29d9: prahareta hared vāpi dhanaṁ teṣāṁ narādhamaḥ.
13.141.29d10: sa ca māmavamanyeta māṁ krodhayati nindati.
13.141.29d12: svādhyāyo yajanaṁ dānaṁ tasya dharma iti sthitiḥ,
13.141.29d13: satyaṁ śāntistapaḥ śaucaṁ tasya dharmaḥ sanātanaḥ,
13.141.29d14: tapa eva sadā dharmo brāhmaṇasya na saṁśayaḥ,
sa tu dharmārthamutpannaḥ pūrvaṁ dhātrā tapobalāt.
13.141.31: upavāsaḥ sadā dharmo brāhmaṇasya na saṁśayaḥ,
13.141.32: tasya dharmakriyā devi brahmacaryā ca nyāyataḥ,
13.141.42: bhukte parijane paścād bhojanaṁ dharma ucyate,
13.141.45: dvijānāṁ ca satāṁ nityaṁ sadaivaiṣa pravartate ॥45॥
13.141.46: yastu kṣatragato devi mayā dharma udīritaḥ,
tamahaṁ te pravakṣyāmi tanme śr̥ṇu samāhitā ॥46॥
13.141.47d1: kṣatriyāstu tato devi dvijānāṁ pālane smr̥tāḥ,
yadi na kṣatriyo loke jagat syādadharottaram.
13.141.48: prajāḥ pālayate yo hi dharmeṇa manujādhipaḥ,
13.141.49: tasya rājñaḥ paro dharmo damaḥ svādhyāya eva ca,
13.141.53d2: yadi na syustathā vaiśyā na bhaveyustathā pare,
13.141.56: tilān gandhān rasāṁścaiva vikrīṇīyānna caiva hi,
13.141.57: śūdradharmaḥ paro nityaṁ śuśrūṣā ca dvijātiṣu ॥57॥
13.141.59d1: śūdrāśca yadi te na syuḥ karmakartā na vidyate.
13.141.59d2: trayaḥ pūrve śūdramūlāḥ sarve karmakarāḥ smr̥tāḥ,
13.141.59d3: vārtā ca kārukarmāṇi śilpaṁ nāṭyaṁ tathaiva ca,
13.141.60d2: āśramāṇāṁ tu yo dharmaḥ kriyate brahmavādibhiḥ.
13.141.60d8: brahmacaryaṁ kṣamā śaucaṁ tasya dharmaḥ sanātanaḥ,
evaṁ sa vigate prāṇe devaloke mahīyate.
13.141.60d10: sadā dhyānaparatvaṁ ca doṣaśuddhiḥ kṣamā dayā.
13.141.60d12: āgamiṣyati yat pātraṁ tat pātraṁ tārayiṣyati.
13.141.60d14: cittamūlo bhaved dharmo dharmamūlaṁ bhaved yaśaḥ.
13.141.60d15: tasmāt saumyena cittena dātavyaṁ devi sarvathā,
13.141.60d19: śreyo dānaṁ ca bhogaśca dhanaṁ prāpya yaśasvinī,
13.141.60d20: nāsti bhūmau dānasamaṁ nāsti dānasamo nidhiḥ,
nāsti satyāt paro dharmo nānr̥tāt pātakaṁ param.
13.141.60d23: gr̥hāśramasya te devi kalāṁ nārhanti ṣoḍaśīm,
gr̥hāśramasya yā caryā vratāni niyamāśca ye.
13.141.60d24: yathā ca devatāḥ pūjyāḥ satataṁ gr̥hamedhinā,
13.141.60d25: tat sarvaṁ śrotumicchāmi kathyamānaṁ tvayā vibho,
13.141.60d27: śuśrūṣante ye pitaraṁ mātaraṁ ca gr̥hāśrame.
13.141.60d28: bhartāraṁ caiva yā nārī agnihotraṁ ca ye dvijāḥ,
teṣu teṣu ca prīṇanti devā indrapurogamāḥ.
13.141.60d30: vidhavānāṁ ca nārīṇāṁ bhavānetad bravītu me,
13.141.60d33: dīpaṁ pratiśrayaṁ caiva dadyāt pādyāsanaṁ tathā.
13.141.60d41: tathā gr̥hāśramaṁ prāpya sarve jīvanti cāśramāḥ,
13.141.60d43: ete cānye ca bahavaḥ tarkayanti gr̥hāśramam.
13.141.60d46: gr̥he kṣetre bile caiva śataśo’tha sahasraśaḥ,
13.141.60d47: upayuktaṁ ca yat teṣāṁ matimān nānuśocati,
dharma ityeva saṅkalpya yastu tasya phalaṁ śr̥ṇu.
13.141.60d48: varṣe sa dvādaśe devi phalenaitena yujyate.
13.141.61: sarvavyāpī tu yo dharmo bhagavaṁstad bravīhi me ॥61॥
13.141.63: brāhmaṇeṣu hi yo dharmaḥ sa dharmaḥ paramo mataḥ ॥63॥
13.141.64: ime te lokadharmārthaṁ trayaḥ sr̥ṣṭāḥ svayambhuvā,
pr̥thivyāṁ sarjane nityaṁ sr̥ṣṭāṁstānapi me śr̥ṇu ॥64॥
13.141.66: trikarmā triparikrānto maitra eṣa smr̥to dvijaḥ ॥66॥
13.141.67: vr̥ttyarthaṁ brāhmaṇānāṁ vai śr̥ṇu dharmān sanātanān ॥67॥
13.141.69: nityaḥ svādhyāyitā dharmo dharmo yajñaḥ sanātanaḥ,
13.141.73: dīpaṁ pratiśrayaṁ caiva yo dadāti sa dhārmikaḥ ॥73॥
13.141.80: tasya vr̥ttiṁ pravakṣyāmi śr̥ṇu me devi tattvataḥ ॥80॥
13.141.82: na kuṭyāṁ nodake saṅgo na vāsasi na cāsane,
na tridaṇḍe na śayane nāgnau na śaraṇālaye ॥82॥
13.141.83: yukto yogaṁ prati sadā pratisaṅkhyānameva ca ॥83॥
13.141.88: eṣa mokṣavidāṁ dharmo vedoktaḥ satpathaḥ satām,
yo mārgamanuyātīmaṁ padaṁ tasya ca vidyate ॥88॥
13.141.89: haṁsaḥ paramahaṁsaśca yo yaḥ paścāt sa uttamaḥ ॥89॥
13.141.90: ataḥ parataraṁ nāsti nāvaraṁ na tirogrataḥ,
13.141.93: taṁ dr̥ṣṭvā me manaḥ prītaṁ maheśvara sadā bhavet ॥93॥
13.141.95: yaṁ kr̥tvā munayo yānti siddhiṁ svatapasā śubhe ॥95॥
13.141.97: uñchanti satataṁ ye te brāhmyaṁ phenotkaraṁ śubham,
13.141.101: aṅguṣṭhaparvamātrā ye bhūtvā sve sve vyavasthitāḥ,
13.141.106: yajñānāṁ caiva pañcānāṁ yajanaṁ dharma ucyate ॥106॥
13.141.107: r̥ṣidharmaḥ sadā cīrṇo yo’nyastamapi me śr̥ṇu ॥107॥
13.141.115: na stambhī na ca mānī syānnāprasanno na vismitaḥ,
13.142.4: vānaprastheṣu yo dharmastaṁ me śr̥ṇu samāhitā,
13.142.5d2: nirdvandvo vā sadāro vā vanavāsāya savrajet.
13.142.5d4: tatra gatvā vidhiṁ jñātvā dīkṣāṁ kuryād yathākramam,
13.142.5d6: kāle śaucaṁ ca kāryaṁ ca jaṭāvalkaladhāraṇam.
13.142.17: santaḥ satpathanityā ye te yānti paramāṁ gatim ॥17॥
13.142.19: eṣa dharmo mayā devi vānaprasthāśritaḥ śubhaḥ,
13.142.20: yo dharmo munisaṅghasya siddhivādeṣu taṁ vada ॥20॥
13.142.22: teṣāṁ mauṇḍyaṁ kaṣāyaśca vāse rātriśca kāraṇam ॥22॥
13.142.24: ye ca te pūrvakathitā dharmāste vanavāsinām,
13.142.29: ubhe ete same syātāmārjavaṁ vā viśiṣyate ॥29॥
13.142.32: dharme ratamanā nityaṁ naro dharmeṇa yujyate ॥32॥
13.142.33d2: dharmaṁ yāyāvarāṇāṁ tvaṁ śr̥ṇu bhāmini tatparā.
13.142.33d7: etat te kathitaṁ devi kiṁ bhūyaḥ śrotumicchasi.
13.142.33d8: teṣāṁ cakracarāṇāṁ ca dharmamicchāmi vai prabho.
13.142.33d9: etat te kathayiṣyāmi śr̥ṇu śākaṭikaṁ śubhe.
13.142.33d10: saṁvahanto dhuraṁ dāraiḥ śakaṭānāṁ tu sarvadā,
13.142.33d13: etat te kathitaṁ devi kiṁ bhūyaḥ śrotumicchasi.
13.142.33d15: te vai vaikhānasā nāma vānaprasthāḥ śubhekṣaṇe,
13.142.33d20: svavaśādeva te mr̥tyuṁ bhīṣayanti ca nityaśaḥ.
13.142.33d22: etat te kathitaṁ devi bhūyaḥ śrītuṁ kimicchasi.
13.142.33d26: udyantaṁ satataṁ sūryaṁ stuvanto vividhaiḥ stavaiḥ,
13.142.33d28: teṣveva nirmalaṁ satyaṁ lokārthaṁ tu pratiṣṭhitam,
13.142.33d29: mahātmanāṁ tu tapasā satyena ca śucismite,
kṣamayā ca mahābhāge bhūtānāṁ saṁsthitiṁ viduḥ.
13.142.33d30: tapasā prāpyate sarvaṁ tapasā prāpyate phalam.
13.142.33d31: duṣprāpamapi yalloke tapasā prāpyate hi tat.
13.142.34: dīptimantaḥ kayā caiva caryayātha bhavanti te ॥34॥
13.142.36: kena vā karmaṇā deva bhavanti vanagocarāḥ ॥36॥
13.142.39: dīkṣāṁ carati dharmātmā sa nāgaiḥ saha modate ॥39॥
13.142.40: śaṣpaṁ mr̥gamukhocchiṣṭaṁ yo mr̥gaiḥ saha bhakṣati,
dīkṣito vai mudā yuktaḥ sa gacchatyamarāvatīm ॥40॥
13.142.41: śaivālaṁ śīrṇaparṇaṁ vā tadvratī yo niṣevate,
śītayogavaho nityaṁ sa gacchet paramāṁ gatim ॥41॥
13.142.44: maruṁ saṁsādhya yatnena rājā bhavati pārthivaḥ ॥44॥
13.142.45: praviśya ca mudā yukto dīkṣāṁ dvādaśavārṣikīm ॥45॥
13.142.46: dehaṁ cānaśane tyaktvā sa svarge sukhamedhate,
13.142.48: dehaṁ vānaśane tyaktvā sa svargaṁ samupāśnute,
13.142.50: aśmanā caraṇau bhittvā guhyakeṣu sa modate,
13.142.53: yastu devi yathānyāyaṁ dīkṣito niyato dvijaḥ,
13.142.57: sukhaṁ vasati dharmātmā divi devagaṇaiḥ saha,
13.142.59: kāmagena vimānena sa vai carati chandataḥ,
13.142.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate anuśāsanaparvaṇi dānadharmaparvaṇi umāmaheśvarasaṁvāde dvicatvāriṁśadadhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥142॥
13.143.3: vaiśyo vā kṣatriyaḥ kena dvijo vā kṣatriyo bhavet,
pratilomaḥ kathaṁ deva śakyo dharmo nivartitum ॥3॥
13.143.4: kena vā karmaṇā vipraḥ śūdrayonau prajāyate,
kṣatriyaḥ śūdratāmeti kena vā karmaṇā vibho ॥4॥
13.143.6: brāhmaṇyaṁ devi duṣprāpaṁ nisargād brāhmaṇaḥ śubhe,
kṣatriyo vaiśyaśūdrau vā nisargāditi me matiḥ ॥6॥
13.143.7: karmaṇā duṣkr̥teneha sthānād bhraśyati vai dvijaḥ,
jyeṣṭhaṁ varṇamanuprāpya tasmād rakṣeta vai dvijaḥ ॥7॥
13.143.8: kṣatriyo vātha vaiśyo vā brahmabhūyaṁ sa gacchati ॥8॥
13.143.11: sa dvijo vaiśyatāmeti vaiśyo vā śūdratāmiyāt,
13.143.13: kṣatriyo vā mahābhāge vaiśyo vā dharmacāriṇi,
13.143.14: brāhmaṇaḥ kṣatriyo vaiśyaḥ śūdratvaṁ yāti tādr̥śaḥ ॥14॥
13.143.17: duṣṭānnaṁ naiva bhoktavyaṁ śūdrānnaṁ naiva karhicit ॥17॥
13.143.21: tāṁ tāṁ yoniṁ vrajed vipro yasyānnamupajīvati ॥21॥
13.143.22: abhojyānnāni cāśnāti sa dvijatvāt pateta vai ॥22॥
13.143.26: śūdro brāhmaṇatāṁ yāti vaiśyaḥ kṣatriyatāṁ vrajet ॥26॥
13.143.27: śuśrūṣāṁ paricaryāṁ ca jyeṣṭhe varṇe prayatnataḥ ॥27॥
13.143.34: sa vaiśyaḥ kṣatriyakule śucau mahati jāyate ॥34॥
13.143.35: sa vaiśyaḥ kṣatriyo jāto janmaprabhr̥ti saṁskr̥taḥ,
13.143.37: satyaḥ satyāni kurute nityaṁ yaḥ sukhadarśanaḥ ॥37॥
13.143.42: arthād vā yadi vā kāmānna kiñcidupalakṣayet,
13.143.45: vipro bhavati dharmātmā kṣatriyaḥ svena karmaṇā ॥45॥
13.143.47: brāhmaṇyaṁ sa samutsr̥jya śūdro bhavati tādr̥śaḥ ॥47॥
13.143.48: śūdro’pi dvijavat sevya iti brahmābravīt svayam ॥48॥
13.143.49: svabhāvaḥ karma ca śubhaṁ yatra śūdre’pi tiṣṭhati,
viśiṣṭaḥ sa dvijātervai vijñeya iti me matiḥ ॥49॥
13.143.50: na yonirnāpi saṁskāro na śrutaṁ na ca santatiḥ,
13.143.51: sarvo’yaṁ brāhmaṇo loke vr̥ttena tu vidhīyate,
13.143.52: brāhmaḥ svabhāvaḥ suśroṇi samaḥ sarvatra me matiḥ,
nirguṇaṁ nirmalaṁ brahma yatra tiṣṭhati sa dvijaḥ ॥52॥
13.143.53: svayaṁ ca varadenoktā brahmaṇā sr̥jatā prajāḥ ॥53॥
13.143.54: brāhmaṇo’pi mahat kṣetraṁ loke carati pādavat,
yat tatra bījaṁ vapati sā kr̥ṣiḥ pretya bhāvini ॥54॥
13.143.57: evambhūto hi yo vipraḥ satpathaṁ satyathe sthitaḥ,
13.143.59: etat te guhyamākhyātaṁ yathā śūdro bhaved dvijaḥ,
brāhmaṇo vā cyuto dharmād yathā śūdratvamāpnute ॥59॥
13.143.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate anuśāsanaparvaṇi dānadharmaparvaṇi umāmaheśvarasaṁvāde tricatvāriṁśadadhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥143॥
13.144.1: dharmādharmau nr̥ṇāṁ deva brūhi me’saṁśayaṁ vibho ॥1॥
13.144.2: karmaṇā manasā vācā trividhaṁ hi naraḥ sadā,
13.144.3: kena śīlena vr̥ttena karmaṇā kīdr̥śena vā,
13.144.7: karmaṇā manasā vācā ye na hiṁsanti kiñcana ॥7॥
13.144.8: ye na sajjanti kasmiṁścit te na baddhyanti karmabhiḥ,
13.144.15: eṣa devakr̥to mārgaḥ sevitavyaḥ sadā naraiḥ ॥15॥
13.144.18: vācā tu baddhyate yena mucyate’pyathavā punaḥ,
tāni karmāṇi me deva vada bhūtapate’nagha ॥18॥
13.144.19: ye mr̥ṣā na vadantīha te narāḥ svargagāminaḥ ॥19॥
13.144.20: anr̥taṁ ye na bhāṣante te narāḥ svargagāminaḥ ॥20॥
13.144.22: paruṣaṁ ye na bhāṣante kaṭukaṁ niṣṭhuraṁ tathā,
13.144.23: r̥taṁ maitraṁ tu bhāṣante te narāḥ svargagāminaḥ ॥23॥
