13.144.24: ye varjayanti paruṣaṁ paradrohaṁ ca mānavāḥ,
13.144.26: na kopād vyāharante ye vācaṁ hr̥dayadāraṇīm,
sāntvaṁ vadanti kruddhā’pi te narāḥ svargagāminaḥ ॥26॥
13.144.27: eṣa vāṇīkr̥to devi dharmaḥ sevyaḥ sadā naraiḥ,
śubhaḥ satyaguṇo nityaṁ varjanīyo mr̥ṣā budhaiḥ ॥27॥
13.144.28: manasā baddhyate yena karmaṇā puruṣaḥ sadā,
13.144.29: svargaṁ gacchanti kalyāṇi tanme kīrtayataḥ śr̥ṇu ॥29॥
13.144.30: mano baddhyati yeneha śr̥ṇu vākyaṁ śubhānane ॥30॥
13.144.31: araṇye vijane nyastaṁ parasvaṁ dr̥śyate yadā,
manasāpi na hiṁsanti te narāḥ svargagāminaḥ ॥31॥
13.144.32: grāme gr̥he vā ye dravyaṁ pārakyaṁ vijane sthitam,
nābhinandanti vai nityaṁ te narāḥ svargagāminaḥ ॥32॥
13.144.33: manasāpi na hiṁsanti te narāḥ svargagāminaḥ ॥33॥
13.144.34: śatruṁ mitraṁ ca ye nityaṁ tulyena manasā narāḥ,
bhajanti maitrāḥ saṅgamya te nasaḥ svargagāminaḥ ॥34॥
13.144.38: vipākajñāśca ye devi te narāḥ svargagāminaḥ ॥38॥
13.144.41: mahān me saṁśayaḥ kaścinmartyān prati maheśvara,
13.144.43: kṣīṇāyuḥ kena bhavati karmaṇā bhuvi mānavaḥ,
13.144.53: yātanāṁ niraye raudrāṁ sa kr̥cchrāṁ labhate naraḥ ॥53॥
13.144.57: na ghātayati no hanti ghnantaṁ naivānumodate,
13.144.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate anuśāsanaparvaṇi dānadharmaparvaṇi umāmaheśvarasaṁvāde catuścatvāriṁśadadhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥144॥
13.145.4: āsanaṁ śayanaṁ yānaṁ gr̥haṁ ratnaṁ dhanaṁ tathā,
13.145.8: tatra kāmaguṇaiḥ sarvaiḥ samupeto mudā yutaḥ,
13.145.9: brahmaṇā vai purā proktāḥ sarvasya priyadarśanāḥ ॥9॥
13.145.12: na dhanāni na vāsāṁsi na bhogān na ca kāñcanam,
13.145.14: te vai manuṣyatāṁ yānti yadā kālasya paryayāt,
13.145.17: apare stambhino nityaṁ māninaḥ pāpato ratāḥ,
13.145.18: mārgārhasya ca ye mārgaṁ na yacchantyalpabuddhayaḥ,
pādyārhasya ca ye pādyaṁ na dadatyalpabuddhayaḥ ॥18॥
13.145.24: na stambhī na ca mānī yo devatādvijapūjakaḥ,
13.145.31: eṣa dharmo mayā prokto vidhātrā svayamīritaḥ ॥31॥
13.145.32: hastābhyāṁ yadi vā padbhyāṁ rajjvā daṇḍena vā punaḥ ॥32॥
13.145.35: sa vai manuṣyatāṁ gacched yadi kālasya paryayāt,
13.145.39: na rajjvā na ca daṇḍena na loṣṭairnāyudhena ca,
13.145.40: tatrāsau bhavane divye mudā vasati devavat ॥40॥
13.145.42: eṣa devi satāṁ mārgo bādhā yatra na vidyate ॥42॥
13.145.46: narāḥ klībāśca dr̥śyante kāraṇaṁ brūhi tatra vai ॥46॥
13.145.49: sa cenmānuṣatāṁ yāti medhāvī tatra jāyate,
13.145.51: manasā tu praduṣṭena nagnāṁ paśyanti ye striyam,
13.145.52: ye tu mūḍhā durācārā viyonau maithune ratāḥ,
13.145.53: paśūṁśca ye ghātayanti ye caiva gurutalpagāḥ,
prakīrṇamaithunā ye ca klībā jāyanti te nasaḥ ॥53॥
13.145.54: sāvadyaṁ kinnu vai karma niravadyaṁ tathaiva ca,
13.145.55: śreyāṁsaṁ mārgamanvicchan sadā yaḥ pr̥cchati dvijān,
13.145.56: yadi mānuṣatāṁ devi kadācit sa nigacchati,
13.145.57: eṣa devi satāṁ dharmo mantavyo bhūtikārakaḥ,
nr̥ṇāṁ hitārthāya mayā tava vai samudāhr̥taḥ ॥57॥
13.145.64: eṣa devi mayā sarvaḥ saṁśayacchedanāya te,
13.145.64d4: sa cāpi daṇḍayan martyān bhartsayan vividhānapi,
13.145.64d6: rājāyattaṁ hi yat sarvaṁ lokavr̥ttaṁ śubhāśubham,
13.145.64d7: arājake purā tvāsīt prajānāṁ saṅkulaṁ mahat,
tad dr̥ṣṭvā saṅkulaṁ brahmā manuṁ rājye nyaveśayat.
13.145.64d8: tanme śr̥ṇu varārohe tasya pathyaṁ jagaddhitam.
13.145.64d9: yathā pretya labhet svargaṁ yathā vīryaṁ yaśastathā,
pitryaṁ vā bhūtapūrvaṁ vā svayamutpādya vā punaḥ.
13.145.64d13: svasmāt pūrvataraṁ rājā vinayatyeva vai prajāḥ,
13.145.64d16: pañcaiva svavaśe kr̥tvā tadarthān pañca śoṣayet,
13.145.64d27: prajākāryaṁ tu tatkāryaṁ prajāsaukhyaṁ tu tatsukham,
prajāpriyaṁ priyaṁ tasya svahitaṁ tu prajāhitam.
13.145.64d29: prakr̥tīnāṁ hi rakṣārthaṁ rāgadveṣau vyudasya ca,
13.145.64d35: cāraiḥ karmapravr̥ttyā ca tad vijñāya vicārayet,
13.145.64d36: daṇḍyāṁśca daṇḍayed devi nātra kāryā vicāraṇā.
13.145.64d39: sarvodyogaṁ svayaṁ kuryād durgādiṣu sadā nr̥ṣu,
13.145.64d41: adharmyaṁ paruṣaṁ tīkṣṇaṁ vākyaṁ vaktuṁ na cārhati.
13.145.64d42: aviśvāsyaṁ hi vacanaṁ vaktuṁ satsu na cārhati,
13.145.64d45: nigrāhyā eva te rājñā saṅgr̥hītvā yatastataḥ.
13.145.64d47: arājakaṁ kṣaṇamapi rājyaṁ na syāddhi śobhane,
13.145.64d52: sandhiṁ ca vigrahaṁ caiva tad viśeṣāṁstathā parān,
13.145.64d53: sarveṣāṁ sampriyo bhūtvā maṇḍalaṁ satataṁ caret,
śubheṣvapi ca kāryeṣu na caikāntaḥ samācaret.
13.145.64d61: svargaloke tadā rājā tridaśaiḥ saha toṣyate.
13.145.64d65: pr̥ṣṭhaṁ dattvā ca ye tatra nāyakasya narādhamāḥ.
13.145.64d67: yaccāsti sukr̥taṁ teṣāṁ yujyate tena nāyakaḥ,
ahiṁsā paramo dharma iti ye’pi narā viduḥ,
13.145.64d73: yajate sa tu pūtātmā saṅgrāmeṇa mahākratum.
13.145.64d74: varma kr̥ṣṇājinaṁ tasya dantakāṣṭhaṁ dhanuḥ smr̥tam,
13.145.64d76: srugbhāṇḍaṁ cāpi yat kiñcid yajñopakaraṇāni ca.
13.145.64d77: āyudhānyasya tat sarvaṁ samidhaḥ sāyakāḥ smr̥tāḥ.
13.145.64d81: hiraṇyaṁ ca suvarṇaṁ ca yad vai yajñasya dakṣiṇā.
13.145.64d84: svarge hatāḥ prapūjyante hantā tvatraiva pūjyate,
13.145.64d87: tathā sarve na sandeho dharmā dharmabhr̥tāṁ varam.
13.145.64d88: dharma eva hato hanti dharmo rakṣati rakṣitaḥ,
tasmād dharmo na hantavyaḥ pārthivena viśeṣataḥ.
13.145.64d92: tasmāt pramādaṁ suśroṇi na kuryāt paṇḍito nr̥paḥ.
13.145.64d93: teṣu mitreṣu tyakteṣu tathā martyeṣu hastiṣu,
13.145.64d101: laghutvaṁ caiva prāpnoti ājñā cāsya nivartate.
13.145.64d102: ayācyāni ca yācanti avaktavyaṁ bruvanti ca.
13.145.64d104: na viśvasedaviśvaste viśvaste na ca viśvaset,
13.145.64d106: tasmāt pramādaṁ lobhaṁ ca na ca kuryānna viśvaset.
13.145.64d110: ye caivainaṁ praśaṁsanti ye ca nindanti mānavāḥ,
13.145.64d114: avadhyā brāhmaṇā gāvo dūtāścaiva pitā tathā,
vidyāṁ grāhayate yaśca ye ca pūrvopakāriṇaḥ.
13.145.64d116: dharaṇīṁ gāṁ hiraṇyaṁ ca siddhānnaṁ ca tilān ghr̥tam,
13.145.64d117: evaṁ carati yo nityaṁ rājā rāṣṭrahite rataḥ,
tasya rāṣṭraṁ dhanaṁ dharmo yaśaḥ kīrtiśca vardhate.
13.145.64d118: na ca pāpairna cānarthairyujyate sa narādhipaḥ.
13.145.64d119: ṣaḍbhāgamupayuñjan yaḥ prajā rājā na rakṣati.
13.145.64d122: tat pāpaṁ sakalaṁ rājā hatarāṣṭraḥ prapadyate.
13.145.64d123: mātulaṁ bhāgineyaṁ vā mātaraṁ śvaśuraṁ gurum,
13.145.64d124: svasya rāṣṭrasya rakṣārthaṁ yudhyamānastu yo hataḥ,
saṅgrāme paracakreṇa śrūyatāṁ tasya yā gatiḥ.
13.145.64d127: rājā vā rājamātro vā bhūyo bhavati vīryavān.
13.145.64d129: bharaṇaṁ caiva bhr̥tyānāṁ vāhanānāṁ ca poṣaṇam.
13.145.64d130: śreya eva narendrāṇāmiha caiva paratra ca.
13.145.64d132: ahiṁsā paramo dharmo hyahiṁsā paramaṁ sukham,
13.145.64d137: indriyāṇāṁ nirodhena dānena ca damena ca,
13.145.64d138: yato yato mahābhāge hiṁsā syānmahatī tataḥ,
13.145.64d139: nivr̥ttiḥ paramo dharmo nivr̥ttiḥ paramaṁ sukham,
13.145.64d140: manasā baddhyate cāpi mucyate cāpi mānavaḥ.
13.145.64d141: nigr̥hīte bhavet svargo visr̥ṣṭe narako dhruvaḥ,
13.145.64d142: sukhaṁ vā yadi vā duḥkhaṁ yathāpūrvaṁ kr̥taṁ tu vā.
13.145.64d143: na hi tasya priyaḥ kaścinna dveṣyo na ca madhyamaḥ.
13.145.64d144: samaḥ sarveṣu bhūteṣu kālaḥ kālaṁ nirīkṣate,
13.145.64d145: vidyā vārtā ca sevā ca kārutvaṁ nāṭyatā tathā,
13.145.64d149: ātmānaṁ vidyayā tasmāt pūrvaṁ kr̥tvā tu bhājanam,
13.145.64d151: yadi ced vidyayā caiva vr̥ttiṁ kāṅkṣedathātmanaḥ.
13.145.64d152: rājavidyāṁ tu vā devi lokavidyāmathāpi vā,
13.145.64d158: yaḥ kaścit sevayā vr̥ttiṁ kāṅkṣeta matimān naraḥ,
13.145.64d159: yathā yathā sa tuṣyeta tathā santoṣayet tu tam,
13.145.64d160: vipriyaṁ nācaret tasya eṣā sevā samāsataḥ.
13.145.64d161: viprayogāt purā tena gatimanyāṁ na lakṣayet.
13.145.64d162: kārukarma ca nāṭyaṁ ca prāyaśo nīcayoniṣu,
13.145.64d165: kāraṇāni pravāsaṁ ca prakṣepaṁ ca phalodayam.
13.145.64d168: pālayan vardhayan bhuñjaṁstāṁ prāpya na vināśayet,
13.145.64d169: ājīvebhyo dhanaṁ prāpya caturdhā vibhajed budhaḥ,
13.145.64d175: āvāhe ca vivāhe ca pūrṇānāṁ vr̥ttikāraṇāt.
13.145.64d177: anarthaṁ bādhate hyartho arthaṁ caiva phalānyuta.
13.145.64d178: tasmād dhanaṁ rakṣitavyaṁ dātavyaṁ ca vidhānataḥ.
13.145.64d180: vicārya guṇadoṣau tu trayāṇāṁ tatra santyajet,
13.145.64d184: dhanyaṁ yaśasyamāyuṣyaṁ svargyaṁ ca paramaṁ yaśaḥ,
trivargo hi vaśe yuktaḥ sarveṣāṁ śaṁ vidhīyate.
13.145.64d191: evamādi śubhaṁ sarvaṁ tasya vr̥ttamiti sthitam.
13.145.64d194: hitaṁ pathyaṁ sadāhāraṁ jīrṇaṁ bhuñjīta mātrayā.
13.145.64d195: śeṣaṁ bhuñjecchucirbhūtvā na ca bhāṣeta vipriyam.
13.145.64d196: pratiśrayaṁ ca pānīyaṁ baliṁ bhikṣāṁ ca sarvataḥ,
13.145.64d197: madhyāhne vārdharātre vā gamanaṁ naiva rocayet.
13.145.64d199: bhayād vā yadi vā lobhānna kurvīta kadācana.
13.145.64d200: ārabheta tadā karma śubhaṁ vā yadi vetarat.
13.145.64d201: manasā karmaṇā vācā na ca kāṅkṣeta pātakam.
13.145.64d205: kimarthaṁ mānuṣe loke na samatvena kalpitāḥ,
13.145.64d210: na bhūñjate kimarthaṁ te tanme śaṁsitumarhasi.
13.145.64d211: paraiḥ sañcoditā dharmaṁ kurvate na svakāmataḥ,
dharmaśraddhāṁ bahiṣkr̥tya kurvanti ca rudanti ca.
13.145.64d212: phalāni tāni samprāpya bhuñjate na kadācana.
13.145.64d217: iti te kathitaṁ devi kiṁ bhūyaḥ śrotumicchasi.
13.145.64d220: apare yatamānāśca na labhante tu kiñcana,
13.145.64d223: abhigamya svayaṁ tatra grāhayanti prasādya ca,
13.145.64d224: punarjanmani te devi tādr̥śāḥ śobhanā narāḥ,
13.145.64d225: apare ye ca dānāni dadatyeva prayācitāḥ.
13.145.64d226: yadā yadārthine dattvā punardānaṁ ca yācitāḥ,
tāvatkālaṁ tato devi punarjanmani te narāḥ,
13.145.64d227: yācitā api kecit tu na dadatyeva kiñcana,
13.145.64d228: te punarjanmani śubhe yatanto bahudhā narāḥ,
13.145.64d229: nānuptaṁ rohate sasyaṁ tadvad dānaphalaṁ viduḥ,
yad yad dadāti puruṣastat tat prāpnoti kevalam.
13.145.64d230: iti te kathitaṁ devi bhūyaḥ śrotuṁ kimicchasi.
13.145.64d234: hanta te kathayiṣyāmi śr̥ṇu tattvaṁ samāhitā.
13.145.64d236: ārabhante punardharmān dātuṁ dānāni vā narāḥ.
13.145.64d240: asamarthāśca tān bhoktuṁ bhavanti kila kāraṇam.
13.145.64d242: te punarjanmani śubhe prāpya tāni phalānyuta,
13.145.64d245: hanta te kathayiṣyāmi śr̥ṇu tattvaṁ samāhitā.
13.145.64d246: ye purā mānuṣā devi lajjāyuktāḥ priyaṁvadāḥ,
śaktāḥ sumadhurā nityaṁ bhūtvā caiva svabhāvataḥ.
13.145.64d251: tadahaṁ te pravakṣyāmi śr̥ṇu kalyāṇi kāraṇam.
13.145.64d254: kathañcit prāpya mānuṣyaṁ tatra te rūpavarjitāḥ.
13.145.64d257: ye purā mānuṣā devi saumyaśīlāḥ priyaṁvadāḥ,
13.145.64d263: tadahaṁ te pravakṣyāmi śr̥ṇu sarvaṁ samāhitā.
13.145.64d270: tadahaṁ te pravakṣyāmi śr̥ṇu kalyāṇi kāraṇam.
13.145.64d271: ye purā manujā devi śrutavanto’pi kevalam,
13.145.64d272: niṣkiñcanā bhavantyeva anuptaṁ hi na rohati.
13.145.64d275: ye purā manujā devi bāliśā api sarvataḥ,
13.145.64d276: te punarjanmani śubhe prāpnuvantyeva tat tathā.
13.145.64d280: ye purā manujā devi guruśuśrūṣakā bhr̥śam,
jñānārthaṁ te tu saṅgr̥hya tīrthaṁ te vidhipūrvakam.
13.145.64d282: vidyāsthānāni ye loke sthāpayanti ca yatnataḥ,
13.145.64d286: vadanti ye parān nityaṁ jñānādhikyena darpitāḥ,
jñānādasūyāṁ kurvanti na sahante hi cāparān.
13.145.64d292: jñātibhiḥ saha modante avighnaṁ tu dine dine,
13.145.64d293: tadahaṁ te pravakṣyāmi śr̥ṇu sarvaṁ samāhitā.
13.145.64d294: ye purā manujā devi āḍhyā vā itare’pi vā,
13.145.64d298: divi vā bhūvi vā devi jāyante karmabhoginaḥ.
13.145.64d300: rūpaṁ dravyaṁ balaṁ cāyurbhogaiśvaryaṁ kulaṁ śrutam,
13.145.64d305: ye purā manujā devi āsuraṁ bhāvamāśritāḥ,
13.145.64d307: kathañcit prāpya mānuṣyaṁ tatra te duḥkhapīḍitāḥ.
13.145.64d309: iti te kathitaṁ devi bhūyaḥ śrotuṁ kimicchasi.
13.145.64d314: yadi cenmānuṣaṁ janma labheraṁste tathāpi vā,
svabhāvato vā jātā vā andhā eva bhavanti te.
13.145.64d317: ādiprabhr̥ti vai martyā jātā vāpyatha kāraṇāt,
13.145.64d318: hanta te kathayiṣyāmi śr̥ṇu devi samāhitā.
13.145.64d319: kuvaktārastu ye devi jihvayā kaṭukaṁ bhr̥śam,
asatyaṁ paruṣaṁ ghoraṁ gurūn prati parān prati.
13.145.64d323: anye mukhāśritāḥ doṣāḥ sarve cātmakr̥taṁ phalam.
13.145.64d326: ye purā manujā devi kāmakrodhavaśā bhr̥śam,
13.145.64d328: kathañcit prāpya mānuṣyaṁ tatra te vyādhipīḍitāḥ.
13.145.64d329: bhavantyeva tathā devi yathā caiva kr̥taṁ purā.
13.145.64d332: tiryagyoniṣu dhūrtā vai maithunārthaṁ caranti ca.
13.145.64d333: kāmadoṣeṇa ye dhūrtāḥ kanyāsu vidhavāsu ca,
13.145.64d336: ye purā manujā devi māṁsalubdhāḥ sulolupāḥ,
13.145.64d341: ye purā manujā devi pareṣāṁ rūpanāśanāḥ,
13.145.64d344: yadi vai mānuṣaṁ janma labheṁrasteṣu duḥkhitāḥ.
13.145.64d347: bhavantyeva narā devi yathā yena kr̥taṁ phalam.
13.145.64d351: tadaṅgahīnā vai pretya bhavantyeva na saṁśayaḥ.
13.145.64d352: svabhāvato vā jātā vā paṅgavaste bhavanti vai.
13.145.64d354: ye purā manujā devi granthibhedakarā nr̥ṇām,
13.145.64d360: bhagavan mānuṣāḥ kecid dr̥śyante bahavo bhuvi,
13.145.64d363: tadahaṁ te pravakṣyāmi śr̥ṇu kalyāṇi kāraṇam.
13.145.64d364: ye purā manujā devi tvāsuraṁ bhāvamāśritāḥ,
13.145.64d366: yadi vai mānuṣaṁ janma labheraṁste tathāvidhāḥ.
13.145.64d370: āḍhyā vā durgatā vāpi dr̥śyante vyādhipīḍitāḥ.
13.145.64d371: evamātmakr̥taṁ karma bhuñjate tatra tatra te,
grahītuṁ na ca śakyaṁ hi kenaciddhyakr̥taṁ phalam.
13.145.64d372: iti te kathitaṁ devi bhūyaḥ śrotuṁ kimicchasi.
13.145.64d379: bhagavan mānuṣāḥ kecid dr̥śyante mānuṣeṣu vai,
13.145.64d381: bahudhā pralapantyeva hasanti ca parān bhr̥śam.
13.145.64d382: vr̥ddhān gurūṁśca ye mūrkhā vr̥thaivāpahasanti ca.
13.145.64d387: ye purā manujā devi sarvaprāṇiṣu nirdayāḥ,
13.145.64d389: mānuṣyaṁ sucirāt prāpya nirapatyā bhavanti te,
13.145.64d392: bhīṣayanti parān nityaṁ vikurvanti tathaiva ca.
13.145.64d393: ye śvabhiḥ krīḍamānāśca trāsayanti vane mr̥gān,
prāṇihiṁsāṁ tathā devi kurvanti ca yatastataḥ.
13.145.64d394: yeṣāṁ gr̥heṣu vai śvānaḥ trāsayanti vr̥thā narān.
13.145.64d396: kathañcit prāpya mānuṣyaṁ tatra te duḥkhasaṁyutāḥ.
13.145.64d400: tadahaṁ te pravakṣyāmi śr̥ṇu kalyāṇi kāraṇam,
13.145.64d404: strīṇāmapi tathā devi yathā puṁsāṁ tu karmajam,
iti te kathitaṁ devi bhūyaḥ śrotuṁ kimicchasi.
13.145.64d406: kuṭumbaṁ tatra vai patyurnāśayanti vr̥thā tathā.
13.145.64d407: anyāsāṁ hi patīn yānti svapatīn dveṣyakāraṇāt.
13.145.64d410: tatra tā bhogarahitā vidhavāśca bhavanti vai.
13.145.64d413: tadahaṁ te pravakṣyāmi śr̥ṇu kalyāṇi kāraṇam.
13.145.64d414: ye purā manujā devi pareṣāṁ vittahārakāḥ.
13.145.64d417: kathañcit prāpya mānuṣyaṁ tatra te devi sarvathā.
13.145.64d419: teṣāṁ karmāṇi kurvanti yeṣāṁ te dhanahārakāḥ,
13.145.64d420: tat tathā kṣīyate karma teṣāṁ pūrvāparādhajam.
13.145.64d423: prītipūrvaṁ tu yo bhartrā mukto muktaḥ sa pāvanaḥ,
13.145.64d424: yathārhaṁ kārayet karma daṇḍaṁ kāraṇataḥ kṣipet,
iti te kathitaṁ devi bhūyaḥ śrotuṁ kimicchasi.
13.145.64d427: sthāne saṁśayitaṁ devi śr̥ṇu tattvaṁ samāhitā.
13.145.64d428: yamaloke na daṇḍyante tatra te yamadaṇḍanaiḥ.
13.145.64d429: adaṇḍitā vā ye tathyā mithyā vā daṇḍitā bhuvi,
tān yamo daṇḍayatyeva sa hi veda kr̥tākr̥tam.
13.145.64d430: nātikramed yamaṁ kaścit karma kr̥tveha mānuṣaḥ,
rājā yamaśca kurvāte daṇḍamātraṁ tu śobhane.
13.145.64d431: iti te kathitaṁ sarvaṁ nirviśaṅkā bhava priye.
13.145.64d432: kimarthaṁ duṣkr̥taṁ kr̥tvā mānuṣā bhuvi nityaśaḥ,
13.145.64d434: sthāne saṁśayitaṁ devi śr̥ṇu tattvaṁ samāhitā,
saṁśayo hi mahāneva pūrveṣāṁ ca manīṣiṇām.
13.145.64d435: dvidhā tu kriyate pāpaṁ sadbhiścāsadbhireva ca,
13.145.64d438: anyathā yat kr̥taṁ pāpaṁ pramādād vā yadr̥cchayā,
13.145.64d439: viddhyevaṁ pāpake kārye nirviśaṅkā bhava priye,
iti te kathitaṁ devi bhūyaḥ śrotuṁ kimicchasi.
13.145.64d444: iti satyaṁ prajānīhi loke tatra vidhiṁ prati,
karmakartā naro’bhoktā sa nāsti divi vā bhuvi,
13.145.64d449: loke grahakr̥taṁ sarvaṁ matvā karma śubhāśubham,
13.145.64d450: eṣa me saṁśayo deva taṁ me tvaṁ chettumarhasi,
13.145.64d451: mānavānāṁ mahābhāge na tu karmakarāḥ svayam.
13.145.64d453: kintu tatra śubhaṁ karma sugrahaistu nivedyate,
13.145.64d455: bhagavan vividhaṁ karma kr̥tvā jantuḥ śubhāśubham,
kiṁ tayoḥ pūrvakataraṁ bhuṅkte janmāntare punaḥ.
13.145.64d456: eṣa me saṁśayo deva taṁ me tvaṁ chettumarhasi,
sthāne saṁśayitaṁ devi tat te vakṣyāmi tattvataḥ.
13.145.64d457: mithyā tadubhayaṁ proktaṁ kevalaṁ tad bravīmi te.
13.145.64d458: r̥ddhiṁ hāniṁ sukhaṁ duḥkhaṁ tat sarvamabhayaṁ bhayam.
13.145.64d460: narake svargaloke ca na tathā saṁsthitiḥ priye,
nityaṁ duḥkhaṁ hi narake svarge nityaṁ sukhaṁ tathā.
13.145.64d461: tatrāpi sumahad bhuktvā pūrvamalpaṁ punaḥ śubhe,
etat te sarvamākhyātaṁ kiṁ bhūyaḥ śrotumicchasi.
13.145.64d462: bhagavan prāṇino loke mriyante kena hetunā,
jātā jātā na tiṣṭhanti tanme śaṁsitumarhasi.
13.145.64d463: tadahaṁ te pravakṣyāmi śr̥ṇu satyaṁ samāhitā,
ātmā karmakṣayād dehaṁ yathā muñcati tacchr̥ṇu.
13.145.64d465: akarmayogyaṁ saṁśīrṇaṁ tyaktvā dehī tato vrajet.
13.145.64d467: tathā dhāvati kālo’yaṁ kṣaṇaṁ kiñcinna tiṣṭhati.
13.145.64d469: bhagavan prāṇino bālā dr̥śyante maraṇaṁ gatāḥ,
13.145.64d471: śr̥ṇu tat kāraṇaṁ devi nirṇayastveka eva saḥ,
13.145.64d472: iti te kathitaṁ devi nirviśaṅkā bhava priye.
13.145.64d474: śr̥ṇu tat sarvamakhilaṁ guhyaṁ pathyataraṁ nr̥ṇām,
13.145.64d478: svarge vā mānuṣe vāpi ciraṁ tiṣṭhanti dhārmikāḥ.
13.145.64d484: etat te kathitaṁ sarvaṁ bhūyaḥ śrotuṁ kimicchasi.
13.145.64d486: strīprāṇaḥ puruṣaprāṇa ekaḥ sa pr̥thageva vā,
eṣa me saṁśayo deva taṁ me chettuṁ tvamarhasi.
13.145.64d487: nirvikāraḥ sadaivātmā strītvaṁ puṁstvaṁ na cātmani,
13.145.64d488: kr̥tvā tu pauruṣaṁ karma strī pumānapi jāyate,
strībhāvayuk pumān kr̥tvā karmaṇā pramadā bhavet.
13.145.64d489: bhagavan sarvalokeśa karmātmā na karoti cet,
ko’nyaḥ karmakaro dehe tanme tvaṁ vaktumarhasi.
13.145.64d490: śr̥ṇu bhāmini kartāramātmā hi na ca karmakr̥t,
13.145.64d493: rajo duḥkhātmakaṁ tatra tamo mohātmakaṁ smr̥tam,
13.145.64d494: satyaṁ prāṇidayā śaucaṁ śreyaḥ prītiḥ kṣamā damaḥ,
13.145.64d495: dākṣyaṁ karmaparatvaṁ ca lobho moho vidhiṁ prati,
13.145.64d501: kimarthamātmā bhinne’smin dehe śastreṇa vā hate,
13.145.64d502: tadahaṁ te pravakṣyāmi śr̥ṇu kalyāṇi kāraṇam,
13.145.64d503: upadravo bhaved dehe yena kenāpi hetunā.
13.145.64d504: tannimittaṁ śarīrī tu śarīraṁ prāpya saṅkṣayam,
13.145.64d505: tiṣṭhet karmaphalaṁ yāvad vrajet karmakṣaye punaḥ.
13.145.64d506: etat te kathitaṁ devi kiṁ bhūyaḥ śrotumicchasi.
13.145.64d510: guruḥ santarjayan śiṣyān bhartā bhr̥tyajanān svakān.
13.145.64d513: tasmin hate bhaved dharmaḥ kuta eva tu pātakam.
13.145.64d514: etat kr̥tvā tu pāpebhyo na doṣaṁ prāpnuyuḥ kvacit.
13.145.64d523: ataḥ paraṁ tamotpattiṁ śr̥ṇu devi samāhitā,
dvividhaṁ hi tamo loke śārvaraṁ dehajaṁ tathā.
13.145.64d524: jyotirbhiśca tamo loke nāśaṁ gacchati śārvaram,
dehajaṁ tu tamo loke taiḥ samastairna śāmyati.
13.145.64d527: dehajaṁ tat tamo ghoraṁ vedaireva vināśitam.
13.145.64d531: evaṁ nityaṁ pravardhete rodasī ca parasparam.
13.145.64d532: jñānād viśiṣṭaṁ jantūnāṁ nāsti lokatraye’pi ca.
13.145.64d534: kāmaṁ krodhaṁ bhayaṁ darpamajñānaṁ caiva buddhijam,
13.145.64d537: tadahaṁ te pravakṣyāmi śr̥ṇu tattvaṁ samāhitā.
13.145.64d538: ye mr̥tāḥ sahasā martyā jāyante sahasā punaḥ,
teṣāṁ paurāṇiko’bhyāsaḥ kañcid kālaṁ hi tiṣṭhati.
13.145.64d539: teṣāṁ vivardhatāṁ sañjñā svapnavat sā praṇaśyati.
13.145.64d542: tadahaṁ te pravakṣyāmi kāraṇaṁ śr̥ṇu śobhane.
13.145.64d544: vahanti te kvacinmohādanyaṁ martyaṁ tu dhārmikāḥ,
nirvikāraṁ hi tat sarvaṁ yamo veda kr̥tākr̥tam.
13.145.64d547: kiṁ tat svabhāvamanyad vā tanme śaṁsitumarhasi.
13.145.64d549: nimittaṁ ca bhavet tasmāt prāṇināṁ svapnadarśanam,
etat te kathitaṁ devi bhūyaḥ śrotuṁ kimicchasi.
13.145.64d551: apare ceṣṭayā ceti dr̥ṣṭvā pratyakṣataḥ kriyām,
pakṣabhede dvidhā cāsmin saṁśayasthaṁ mano mama.
13.145.64d552: tattvaṁ vada mahādeva śrotuṁ kautūhalaṁ hi me.
13.145.64d553: tadahaṁ te pravakṣyāmi śr̥ṇu tattvaṁ samāhitā,
13.145.64d554: kr̥ṣau tu dr̥śyate karma karṣaṇaṁ vapanaṁ tathā.
13.145.64d555: ropaṇaṁ caiva lavanaṁ yaccānyat pauruṣaṁ smr̥tam,
13.145.64d557: ropaṇaṁ caiva lavanaṁ yaccānyat pauruṣaṁ smr̥tam.
13.145.64d558: kāle vr̥ṣṭiḥ suvāpaṁ ca prarohaḥ paṅktireva ca,
evamādi tu yaccānyat tad daivatamiti smr̥tam.
13.145.64d560: tādr̥śaṁ kāraṇaṁ daivaṁ śubhaṁ vā yadi vetarat,
yādr̥śaṁ cātmanā śakyaṁ tat pauruṣamiti smr̥tam.
13.145.64d562: tayoḥ samāhitaṁ karma śītoṣṇaṁ yugapat tathā,
13.145.64d563: ātmanā tu na śakyaṁ hi tathā kīrtimavāpnuyāt.
13.145.64d568: tapodānāni yat karma tatra tad dr̥śyate vr̥thā,
nāsti paunarbhavaṁ janma iti kecid vyavasthitāḥ.
13.145.64d569: tat sarvaṁ nāsti nāstīti saṁśayasthāstathā pare.
13.145.64d570: uktaṁ bhagavatā yat tu tat tu lokasya saṁsthitiḥ.
13.145.64d571: praśnametat tu pr̥cchantyā rudrāṇyā pariṣat tadā,
13.145.64d573: sarvamarthaṁ śrutaṁ dr̥ṣṭaṁ yat prāguktaṁ mayā tava,
13.145.64d574: kāmān sañchidya parighān dhr̥tyā vai paramāsanāḥ,
abhiyāntyeva te svargaṁ paśyantaḥ karmaṇaḥ phalam.
13.145.64d575: evaṁ śraddhābhavaṁ loke parataḥ sumahat phalam,
buddhiḥ śraddhā ca vinayaḥ karaṇāni hitaiṣiṇām.
13.145.64d582: etat te kathitaṁ devi r̥ṣiguhyaṁ prajāhitam.
13.145.64d584: kīdr̥śaṁ bhavanaṁ tasya kathaṁ daṇḍayati prajāḥ.
13.145.64d586: śr̥ṇu kalyāṇi tat sarvaṁ yat te devi manaḥpriyam,
dakṣiṇasyāṁ diśi śubhe yamasya sadanaṁ mahat.
13.145.64d588: tatrāste daṇḍayan nityaṁ yamo lokahite rataḥ.
13.145.64d590: tasya māyāmayāḥ pāśā na vedyante surāsuraiḥ,
ko hi mānuṣamātrastu devasya caritaṁ mahat.
13.145.64d594: nr̥ṣu janma labhante ye karmaṇā madhyamāḥ smr̥tāḥ,
13.145.64d600: saṁnayanti yathā kāle tanme śr̥ṇu śucismite,
13.145.64d605: pūjayan daṇḍayan kāṁścit teṣāṁ śr̥ṇvan śubhāśubham,
13.145.64d607: prastutya tat kr̥taṁ teṣāṁ lokaṁ sandiśate yamaḥ,
13.145.64d608: jāyantāṁ mānuṣeṣveva iti sandiśate ca tān.
13.145.64d613: tīkṣṇadaṁṣṭrāstathā śvānaḥ kāṁścit tatra hyadanti vai.
13.145.64d619: evaṁ tvayā kr̥to doṣastadarthaṁ daṇḍanaṁ tviti,
13.145.64d623: apare yātanā bhuktvā mucyante tatra kilbiṣāt.
13.145.64d624: bahu taptaṁ yathā lohamamalaṁ tat tathā bhavet.
13.145.64d625: bhagavaṁste kathaṁ tatra daṇḍyante narakeṣu vai,
kati te narakā ghorāḥ kīdr̥śāste maheśvara.
13.145.64d626: śr̥ṇu bhāmini tat sarvaṁ pañcaite narakāḥ smr̥tāḥ,
13.145.64d629: te ciraṁ tatra tiṣṭhanti na tatra śayanāsane,
13.145.64d630: evaṁ pramāṇamudvignā yāvat tiṣṭhanti tatra te,
13.145.64d632: duḥkhasyāntaramātraṁ tu jñānaṁ vā na ca labhyate.
13.145.64d633: tasmād dviguṇitaṁ viddhi māne duḥkhe ca rauravāt.
13.145.64d640: atighoraṁ ciraṁ kr̥tvā mahābhūtāni yānti tam.
13.145.64d641: pañcakaṣṭena hi samaṁ nāsti duḥkhaṁ tathā param,
13.145.64d647: evaṁ bhuktvā tu narakaṁ mucyante pāpasaṅkṣayāt.
13.145.64d648: bhagavan kati kālaṁ te tiṣṭhanti narakeṣu vai,
13.145.64d650: bhagavaṁsteṣu ke tatra tiṣṭhantīti vada prabho.
13.145.64d652: dvitīye dviguṇaṁ kālaṁ pacyante tādr̥śā narāḥ,
13.145.64d655: evaṁ te narakān bhuktvā tatra kṣapitakalmaṣāḥ,
13.145.64d657: mr̥gapakṣiṣu tad bhuktvā labhante mānuṣaṁ padam.
13.145.64d659: tadahaṁ te pravakṣyāmi yat tvamicchasi śobhane,
13.145.64d660: yaśca māṁsapriyo nityaṁ kākagr̥dhrān sa saṁspr̥śet,
surāpaḥ satataṁ martyaḥ sūkaratvaṁ vrajed dhruvam.
13.145.64d661: ātmaghno yo naraḥ kopāt pretajātiṣu tiṣṭhati.
13.145.64d662: nāstikaścaiva yo mūrkho mr̥gajātiṁ sa gacchati.
13.145.64d666: tāṁ tāṁ yoniṁ prapadyante svakr̥tasyaiva kāraṇāt.
13.145.64d669: tasmāt sudurlabhaṁ ceti viddhi janmasu mānuṣam.
13.145.64d670: śubhāśubhamiti proktaṁ karma svaṁ svaṁ samāsataḥ.
13.145.64d671: tadahaṁ te pravakṣyāmi tat sarvaṁ śr̥ṇu śobhane,
13.145.64d672: tayoryad duṣkr̥taṁ karma tacca sañjāyate tridhā,
13.145.64d673: manaḥpūrvaṁ tu vā karma vartate vāṅmayaṁ tataḥ,
13.145.64d677: cauryaṁ pareṣāṁ dravyāṇāṁ haraṇaṁ nāśanaṁ tathā,
13.145.64d683: trividhaṁ tat kr̥taṁ pāpaṁ kartāraṁ pāpakaṁ nayet,
pātakaṁ cāpi yat karma karmaṇā buddhipūrvakam.
13.145.64d684: kathañcit tat kr̥tamapi kartā tena na lipyate.
13.145.64d685: bhagavan pāpakaṁ karma yathā kr̥tvā na lipyate.
13.145.64d686: śatrumudyataśastraṁ vā pūrvaṁ tena hato’pi vā.
13.145.64d687: yaḥ prajaghnan naro hanyānna sa pāpena lipyate.
13.145.64d689: akāryaṁ vāpyabhakṣyaṁ vā kr̥tvā pāpānna lipyate.
13.145.64d690: keciddhasanti tat pītvā pravadanti tathā pare,
nr̥tyanti muditāḥ kecid gāyanti ca śubhāśubhān.
13.145.64d691: kvacid dhāvanti sahasā praskhalanti patanti ca.
13.145.64d692: ayuktaṁ bahu bhāṣante yatra kvacana śobhane,
13.145.64d693: ye pibanti mahāmohaṁ pānaṁ pāpayutā narāḥ.
13.145.64d694: dhr̥tiṁ lajjāṁ ca buddhiṁ ca pānaṁ pītaṁ praṇāśayet,
13.145.64d698: paruṣaṁ kaṭukaṁ ghoraṁ vākyaṁ vadati sarvaśaḥ.
13.145.64d699: saṁvidaṁ kurute śauṇḍairna śr̥ṇoti hitaṁ kvacit.
13.145.64d700: evaṁ bahuvidhā doṣāḥ pānape santi śobhane,
kevalaṁ narakaṁ yānti nāsti tatra vicāraṇā.
13.145.64d703: tasmād buddherhi rakṣārthaṁ sadbhiḥ pānaṁ vivarjitam,
procyate tat tridhā devi sukr̥taṁ ca samāsataḥ.
13.145.64d705: prathamaṁ varjayed doṣān yugapat pr̥thageva vā,
13.145.64d708: ye tādr̥śaṁ na budhyante ātmādhīnaṁ ca nirvr̥tāḥ.
13.145.64d714: īśvarāṇāṁ prabhavatāṁ daridrāṇāṁ ca vai nr̥ṇām,
13.145.64d715: tapo dānaṁ mahādevi doṣamalpaṁ hi nirharet,
13.145.64d718: nāsti satyāt paraṁ dānaṁ nāsti satyāt paraṁ tapaḥ.
13.145.64d719: yathā śrutaṁ yathā dr̥ṣṭamātmanā yad yathā kr̥tam,
13.145.64d724: śuddhakāyo naro bhūtvā snātvā tīrthe yathāvidhi,
13.145.64d727: vratabhaṅgo yathā na syād rakṣitavyaṁ tathā budhaiḥ.
13.145.64d734: etaiḥ sammārjanaiḥ kāyamambhasā ca punaḥ punaḥ,
akṣobhyaṁ yat prakīrṇaṁ ca nityasrotaśca yajjalam.
13.145.64d740: brāhmaṇānāṁ ca vākyena sadā saṁśodhanaṁ bhavet,
13.145.64d746: iti te kathitaṁ devi bhūyaḥ śrotuṁ kimicchasi.
13.145.64d753: yastu sarvāṇi māṁsāni yāvajjīvaṁ na bhakṣayet,
sa svarge vipulaṁ sthānaṁ labhate nātra saṁśayaḥ.
13.145.64d754: yat tu varṣaśataṁ pūrṇaṁ tapyate paramaṁ tapaḥ,
13.145.64d755: na hi prāṇaiḥ priyatamaṁ loke kiñcana vidyate,
tasmāt prāṇidayā kāryā yathā’’tmani tathā pare.
13.145.64d759: ye piturbhrātaro jyeṣṭhā ye ca tasyānujāstathā.
13.145.64d760: pituḥ pitā ca sarve te pūjanīyāḥ pitā tathā.
13.145.64d761: māturyā bhaginī jyeṣṭhā māturyā ca yavīyasī,
mātāmahī ca dhātrī ca sarvāstā mātaraḥ smr̥tāḥ.
13.145.64d762: upādhyāyasya yaḥ putro yaśca tasya bhaved guruḥ,
r̥tvig guruḥ pitā ceti guravaḥ samprakīrtitāḥ.
13.145.64d763: bhayatrātā ca bhartā ca guravaste prakīrtitāḥ.
13.145.64d764: anuvr̥ttiṁ ca pūjāṁ ca teṣāmapi nibodha me.
13.145.64d769: na brūyād vipriyaṁ teṣāmaniṣṭaṁ na pravartayet,
vigr̥hya na vadet teṣāṁ samīpe spardhayā kvacit.
13.145.64d774: na tad yajñaphalaṁ kuryāt tapo vā’’caritaṁ mahat,
yat kuryāt puruṣasyeha gurupūjā sadā kr̥tā.
13.145.64d776: svamarthaṁ svaśarīraṁ ca gurvarthe santyajed budhaḥ,
vivādaṁ dhanahetorvā mohād vā tairna rocayet.
13.145.64d782: jīvopaghātaṁ ca tathā sa jīvan dhanya iṣyate,
13.145.64d786: tadahaṁ te pravakṣyāmi śr̥ṇu devi samāhitā.
13.145.64d787: brahmacaryaṁ paraṁ śaucaṁ brahmacaryaṁ paraṁ tapaḥ,
13.145.64d794: pāvanārthaṁ ca śaucārthaṁ brahmaṇā nirmitaṁ purā.
13.145.64d797: devairvā sevitaṁ devi tat tīrthaṁ paramaṁ smr̥tam.
13.145.64d799: api kūlaṁ taṭākaṁ vā sevitaṁ munibhiḥ priye.
13.145.64d800: tat tu tīrthamiti jñeyaṁ prabhāvāt tu tapasvinām.
13.145.64d801: evaṁ tīrthaṁ bhaved devi tasya snānavidhiṁ śr̥ṇu.
13.145.64d803: bahireva śucirbhūtvā tat tīrthaṁ manmanā viśet.
13.145.64d805: etad vidhānaṁ sarveṣāṁ tīrthaṁ tīrthamiti priye,
13.145.64d807: evaṁ puṇyeṣu tīrtheṣu tīrthasnānaṁ śubhaṁ bhavet,
13.145.64d808: lokasiddhaṁ tu yad dravyaṁ sarvasādhāraṇaṁ bhavet,
tad dadat sarvasāmānyaṁ kathaṁ dharmaṁ labhennaraḥ.
13.145.64d809: tathaiva tad dadanmartyo labhet puṇyaṁ sa tacchr̥ṇu.
13.145.64d810: dātā pratigrahītā ca deyaṁ sopakramaṁ tathā,
deśakālau ca yat tvetad dānaṁ ṣaḍguṇamucyate.
13.145.64d814: etān pātraguṇān viddhi tādr̥k pātraṁ praśasyate.
13.145.64d815: yad yadarhati yo loke pātraṁ tasya bhavecca saḥ.
13.145.64d816: annasya kṣudhitaṁ pātraṁ tr̥ṣitaṁ tu jalasya vai.
13.145.64d818: paropaghātād yad dravyaṁ cauryād vā labhyate nr̥bhiḥ,
13.145.64d820: tādr̥śena kr̥taṁ dharmaṁ niṣphalaṁ viddhi bhāmini,
13.145.64d821: yad yadātmapriyaṁ nityaṁ tat tad deyamiti sthitiḥ,
13.145.64d822: dātā dānaṁ tathā dadyād yathā tuṣyeta tena saḥ.
13.145.64d823: eṣa dānavidhiḥ śreṣṭhaḥ samāhūya tu madhyamaḥ.
13.145.64d824: pūrvaṁ ca pātratāṁ jñātvā samāhūya nivedya ca,
13.145.64d827: atiśaktyā paraṁ dānaṁ yathāśaktyā tu madhyamam.
13.145.64d829: yathā sambhāvitaṁ pūrvaṁ dātavyaṁ tat tathaiva ca,
puṇyakṣetreṣu yad dattaṁ puṇyakāleṣu vā tathā.
13.145.64d830: yaśca puṇyatamo deśastathā kālaśca śaṁsa me.
13.145.64d835: dātā deyaṁ ca pātraṁ ca upakramayutā kriyā,
13.145.64d836: yadaiva yugapat sampat tatra dānaṁ mahad bhavet.
13.145.64d839: kr̥tvā dharmaṁ tu vidhivat paścāttāpaṁ karoti cet,
ślāghayā vā yadi brūyād vr̥thā saṁsadi yat kr̥tam.
13.145.64d841: anugrahāt pareṣāṁ tu gr̥hasthānāmr̥ṇaṁ hi tat.
13.145.64d842: ityevaṁ mana āviśya dātavyaṁ satataṁ budhaiḥ.
13.145.64d843: evameva kr̥taṁ nityaṁ sukr̥taṁ tad bhavenmahat,
13.145.64d845: ajasraṁ dharmakāryaṁ ca tathā naimittikaṁ priye,
13.145.64d846: sneho gandhaśca bhaiṣajyaṁ tilāśca lavaṇaṁ tathā,
13.145.64d849: arcayīta prayatnena sa hi yajño varapradaḥ.
13.145.64d850: putro yasya tu pautro vā śrotriyaṁ bhojayiṣyati.
13.145.64d859: tatra te suciraṁ kālaṁ vihr̥tyāpsarasāṁ gaṇaiḥ,
13.145.64d861: sarvakālaṁ ca sarvasya sarvatra ca sadaiva ca.
13.145.64d863: api pāpakr̥taṁ krūraṁ dattaṁ rukmaṁ prakāśayet.
13.145.64d869: ya etat paramaṁ dānaṁ dattvā sauvarṇamadbhutam,
dyutiṁ medhāṁ vapuḥ kīrtiṁ punarjāte labhed dhruvam.
13.145.64d870: tasmāt svaśaktyā dātavyaṁ kāñcanaṁ bhuvi mānavaiḥ,
na hyetasmāt paraṁ lokeṣvanyat pāpāt pramucyate.
13.145.64d871: na hi gobhyaḥ paraṁ dānaṁ vidyate jagati priye.
13.145.64d872: lokān sisr̥kṣuṇā pūrvaṁ gāvaḥ sr̥ṣṭāḥ svayambhuvā,
vr̥ttyarthaṁ sarvabhūtānāṁ tasmāt tā mātaraḥ smr̥tāḥ.
13.145.64d879: samānavatsāṁ yo dadyād dhenuṁ vipre payasvinīm,
13.145.64d880: samānavatsāṁ yo dadyāt kr̥ṣṇāṁ dhenuṁ payasvinīm,
13.145.64d883: samānavatsāṁ yo dhenuṁ dattvā gaurīṁ payasvinīm,
13.145.64d884: yuvānaṁ balinaṁ śyāmaṁ śatena saha yūthapam,
13.145.64d886: na cāsāṁ māṁsamaśnīyād goṣu bhaktaḥ sadā bhavet.
13.145.64d888: na cāsāṁ cintayet pāpamiti dharmavido viduḥ.
13.145.64d889: gāvaḥ pavitraṁ paramaṁ goṣu lokāḥ pratiṣṭhitāḥ,
13.145.64d890: goṣu pūjā ca bhaktiśca narasyāyuṣyatāṁ vahet.
13.145.64d895: yāvat tiṣṭhati sā bhūmistāvat tasya phalaṁ viduḥ,
13.145.64d896: yat kiñcit kurute pāpaṁ puruṣo vr̥ttikarśitaḥ,
13.145.64d900: vimuktaḥ kaluṣaiḥ sarvaiḥ śakralokaṁ sa gacchati.
13.145.64d902: grāhayitvā nijāṁ bhūmiṁ na yānti yamasādanam.
13.145.64d903: tathā bhūmeḥ kr̥taṁ dānaṁ sasye sasye vivardhate.
13.145.64d907: etat sarvaṁ mayoddiṣṭaṁ bhūmidānasya yat phalam,
13.145.64d912: vr̥ttyāyatīṁ yathā kr̥tvā sadgr̥he tau niveśayet.
13.145.64d913: evaṁ kr̥tvā vadhūdānaṁ tasya dānasya gauravāt,
13.145.64d915: vidyādānaṁ tathā devi pātrabhūtāya vai dadat,
pretyabhāve labhenmartyo medhāṁ vr̥ddhiṁ dhr̥tiṁ smr̥tim.
13.145.64d917: svayaṁ dattena tulyaṁ syāditi viddhi śubhānane.
13.145.64d918: tvatpriyārthaṁ mayā devi bhūyaḥ śrotuṁ kimicchasi.
13.145.64d919: tasya tasya phalaṁ brūhi dattasya ca kr̥tasya ca.
13.145.64d921: tilāḥ pavitrāḥ pāpaghnāḥ supuṇyā iti saṁsmr̥tāḥ.
13.145.64d928: kevalaṁ vā tilaireva bhūmau kr̥tvā gavākr̥tim,
13.145.64d930: nr̥po dadad brāhmaṇāya sa puṇyaphalabhāg bhavet.
13.145.64d935: dāsīdāsaṁ ca vividhaṁ labhet pretya guṇānvitam.
13.145.64d937: dīrghāyuṣyaṁ ca saubhāgyaṁ tathā pretya gatiṁ śubhām.
13.145.64d940: mārgakr̥t satataṁ martyo bhavet santānavān punaḥ,
13.145.64d942: sa tu puṇyaphalaṁ pretya labhate kr̥cchramokṣaṇam.
13.145.64d943: vedagoṣṭhāḥ sabhāḥ śālā bhikṣūṇāṁ ca pratiśrayam,
yaḥ kuryāllabhate nityaṁ naraḥ pretya śubhaṁ phalam.
13.145.64d944: ramyaṁ sadaiva govāṭaṁ yaḥ kuryāllabhate naraḥ,
pretyabhāve śubhāṁ jātiṁ vyādhimokṣaṁ tathaiva ca,
evaṁ nānāvidhaṁ dravyaṁ dānakartā labhet phalam.
13.145.64d945: rūpeṇa saptadhā bhūtvā mānuṣyaṁ phalati dhruvam.
13.145.64d947: devatānāṁ tu pūjā yā yajñeṣveva samāhitā,
13.145.64d948: idaṁ tu sakalaṁ dravyaṁ divi vā bhuvi vā priye,
yajñārthaṁ viddhi tat sr̥ṣṭaṁ lokānāṁ hitakāmyayā.
13.145.64d949: evaṁ vijñāya tat kartā sadāraḥ satataṁ dvijaḥ,
13.145.64d950: brāhmaṇeṣveva tad brahma nityaṁ devi samāhitam.
13.145.64d955: tathā kr̥teṣu yajñeṣu devānāṁ toṣaṇaṁ bhavet,
13.145.64d956: tasmād yajvā divaṁ gatvāmaraiḥ saha modate,
nāsti yajñasamaṁ dānaṁ nāsti yajñasamo nidhiḥ.
13.145.64d966: lokeṣu pitaraḥ pūjyā devatānāṁ ca devatāḥ,
13.145.64d968: tasya deśāḥ kurukṣetraṁ gayā gaṅgā sarasvatī,
prabhāsaṁ puṣkaraṁ ceti teṣu dattaṁ mahāphalam.
13.145.64d969: tīrthāni saritaḥ puṇyā viviktāni vanāni ca,
13.145.64d972: pūrvāhṇe śuklapakṣe ca rātrau janmadineṣu vā,
yugmeṣvahassu ca śrāddhaṁ na ca kurvīta paṇḍitaḥ.
13.145.64d973: eṣa kālo mayā proktaḥ pitr̥medhasya pūjitaḥ,
yasmiṁśca brāhmaṇaṁ pātraṁ paśyet kālaḥ sa ca smr̥taḥ.
13.145.64d974: bhojayed yadi pāpiṣṭhān śrāddheṣu narakaṁ vrajet.
13.145.64d976: etān nimantrayed vidvān pūrvedyuḥ prātareva vā,
13.145.64d978: kutapaḥ khaḍgapātraṁ ca kuśā darbhāstilā madhu,
13.145.64d984: tatsamīpe’gnimiddhvā ca svadhāṁ ca juhuyāt tataḥ.
13.145.64d987: sadakṣiṇaṁ sasambhāraṁ yathā tuṣyanti te dvijāḥ.
13.145.64d988: yatra tat kriyate tatra na jalpenna japenmithaḥ,
niyamya vācaṁ dehaṁ ca śrāddhakarma samārabhet.
13.145.64d990: patnīṁ vā madhyamaṁ piṇḍaṁ putrakāmāṁ hi prāśayet,
13.145.64d994: dīrghāyuśca bhavet svasthaḥ pitr̥medhena vā punaḥ,
13.145.64d996: śrāddhāni puṣṭikāmā vai ye prakurvanti paṇḍitāḥ,
teṣāṁ puṣṭiṁ prajāṁ caiva dāsyanti pitaraḥ sadā.
13.145.64d999: yatsārastu naro loke tad dānaṁ cottamaṁ smr̥tam,
13.145.64d1000: prasthaṁ sāraṁ daridrasya sāraṁ koṭidhanasya ca,
13.145.64d1001: ubhayaṁ tanmahat tacca phalenaiva samaṁ smr̥tam.
13.145.64d1003: śr̥ṇu dattasya vai devi pañcadhā phalakalpanām,
ānantyaṁ ca mahaccaiva samaṁ hīnaṁ hi pātakam.
13.145.64d1004: teṣāṁ viśeṣaṁ vakṣyāmi śr̥ṇu devi samāhitā,
dustyajasya ca vai dānaṁ pātra ānantyamucyate.
13.145.64d1005: yathāśraddhaṁ tu vai dānaṁ yathārhaṁ samamucyate.
13.145.64d1006: guṇatastu tathā hīnaṁ dānaṁ hīnamiti smr̥tam,
13.145.64d1007: mahatastu tathā kālaṁ svargaloke tu pūjyate.
13.145.64d1008: samasya tu tadā dānaṁ mānuṣyaṁ bhogamāvahet,
13.145.64d1010: aśubhasyāpi dānasya śubhaṁ syācca phalaṁ katham,
13.145.64d1011: anyāni dharmakāryāṇi śr̥ṇu sadbhiḥ kr̥tāni ca.
13.145.64d1012: govāṭaśca taṭākaśca sabhā śālā ca sarvaśaḥ.
13.145.64d1015: tat kartavyaṁ manuṣyeṇa svaśaktyā śraddhayā śubhe.
13.145.64d1016: pretyabhāve labhet puṇyaṁ nāsti tatra vicāraṇā,
13.145.64d1017: svarge vā mānuṣe vāpi taistairāpyāyate hi saḥ.
13.145.64d1023: iti te kathitaṁ devi bhūyaḥ śrotuṁ kimicchasi.
13.145.64d1025: tadahaṁ te pravakṣyāmi jīvitaṁ vidyate yathā,
13.145.64d1026: manasā karmaṇā vācā pratikūlā bhavanti ye,
13.145.64d1032: śaucārjavaparā dhīrāḥ parārthān na haranti ye,
ye samāḥ sarvabhūteṣu te narāḥ svargagāminaḥ.
13.145.64d1034: daridrā api ye kecid yācitāḥ prītipūrvakam,
dadatyeva ca yat kiñcit te narāḥ svargagāminaḥ.
13.145.64d1041: r̥javo mr̥davo nityaṁ te narāḥ svargagāminaḥ.
13.145.64d1047: hanta te kathayiṣyāmi śr̥ṇu devi samāhitā,
13.145.64d1053: tatrānr̥ṇyaṁ ca samprāpya vr̥ddho vā vyādhito’pi vā.
13.145.64d1054: sarvaṁ vihāya bandhūṁśca karmaṇāṁ bharaṇaṁ tathā.
13.145.64d1055: anujñāpya janaṁ sarvaṁ vācā madhurayā bruvan.
13.145.64d1057: parityajya tato grāmyaṁ dharmaṁ kuryād yathepsitam.
13.145.64d1064: kr̥tvā kāṣṭhamayaṁ cityaṁ puṇyakṣetre nadīṣu vā.
13.145.64d1068: khyāte puṇyatame tīrthe nimajjet sukr̥taṁ smaran.
13.145.64d1075: evaṁ rājā mr̥taḥ sadyaḥ svargaloke mahīyate,
13.145.64d1077: svāmyarthaṁ santyajet prāṇān puṇyām̐llokān sa gacchati,
13.145.64d1078: evaṁ gobrāhmaṇārthaṁ vā dīnārthaṁ vā tyajet tanum,
13.145.64d1080: kāmāt krodhād bhayād vāpi yadi cet santyajet tanum,
13.145.64d1081: svabhāvaṁ maraṇaṁ nāma na tu cātmecchayā bhavet,
yathā mr̥tānāṁ yat kāryaṁ tanme śr̥ṇu yathāvidhi.
13.145.64d1083: nirjīvaṁ vr̥ṇuyāt sadyo vāsasā tu kalevaram,
13.145.64d1087: etat sarvaṁ mayā proktaṁ mānuṣāṇāṁ hitaṁ vacaḥ.
13.145.64d1090: etadeva viśiṣṭaṁ te yat tvaṁ pr̥cchasi māṁ priye.
13.145.64d1092: yasmin yasmiṁśca viṣaye yo yo yāti viniścayam,
13.145.64d1094: nāsti mokṣāt paraṁ devi nāsti mokṣāt parā gatiḥ,
13.145.64d1095: nātra devi jarā mr̥tyuḥ śoko vā duḥkhameva vā,
anuttamamacintyaṁ ca tad devi paramaṁ sukham.
13.145.64d1097: viśanti tat padaṁ prājñāḥ spr̥haṇīyaṁ surāsuraiḥ.
13.145.64d1099: yathā jyotirgaṇā vyomni nivartante punaḥ punaḥ,
evaṁ jīvā amī loke nivartante punaḥ punaḥ.
13.145.64d1101: saṁsāre prāṇinaḥ sarve nivartante yathā punaḥ.
13.145.64d1104: brāhmaṇaḥ kṣatriyo vāpi bhūtvā pūrvaṁ gr̥he sthitaḥ,
ānr̥ṇyaṁ sarvataḥ prāpya tatastān santyajed gr̥hān.
13.145.64d1107: dvividhaṁ ca punarmokṣaṁ sāṅkhyaṁ yogamiti smr̥tiḥ.
13.145.64d1110: samaḥ śītoṣṇaharṣādīn viṣaheta sa vai muniḥ.
13.145.64d1111: tyajet saṅkalpajān granthīn sadā dhyānaparo bhavet.
13.145.64d1115: kāraṇe cāpi samprāpte na kupyeta kadācana.
13.145.64d1116: dayā ca sarvabhūteṣu tasya dharmaḥ sanātanaḥ.
13.145.64d1118: yadā bhāvaṁ na kurute sarvabhūteṣu pāpakam,
karmaṇā manasā vācā brahma sampadyate tadā.
13.145.64d1120: samaḥ śatrau ca mitre ca nirvāṇamadhigacchati.
13.145.64d1123: jñānaṁ te sampravakṣyāmi tanmūlamamr̥taṁ hi vai.
13.145.64d1125: naṣṭe dhane vā dāre vā putre pitari vā mr̥te,
13.145.64d1126: dravyeṣu samatīteṣu ye śubhāstān na cintayet,
13.145.64d1128: mr̥taṁ vā yadi vā naṣṭaṁ yo’tītamanuśocati,
santāpena ca yujyeta taccāsya na nivartate.
13.145.64d1130: sukhaṁ prāpya na saṁhr̥ṣyenna duḥkhaṁ prāpya sañjvaret.
13.145.64d1131: doṣadarśī bhavet tatra yatra snehaḥ pravartate,
13.145.64d1132: yathā kāṣṭhaṁ ca kāṣṭhaṁ ca sameyātāṁ mahodadhau,
13.145.64d1133: snehastatra na kartavyo viprayogo hi tairdhruvaḥ.
13.145.64d1134: aiśvaryaṁ svasthatā ceti na muhyet tatra paṇḍitaḥ.
13.145.64d1136: na nityaṁ labhate duḥkhaṁ na nityaṁ labhate sukham,
13.145.64d1139: nāśe duḥkhaṁ vyaye duḥkhaṁ dhigarthaṁ duḥkhabhājanam.
13.145.64d1140: rājā coraśca dāyādā bhūtāni kṣaya eva ca.
13.145.64d1142: upadraveṣu cārthānāṁ duḥkhaṁ hi niyataṁ bhavet.
13.145.64d1146: ekasminneva rāṣṭre tu sa cāpi nivasennr̥paḥ.
13.145.64d1147: nagare’pi gr̥haṁ caikaṁ bhavet tasya niveśanam.
13.145.64d1148: āvāse śayanaṁ caikaṁ niśi yatra pralīyate.
13.145.64d1150: sarvaṁ mameti sammūḍho balaṁ paśyati bāliśaḥ,
13.145.64d1151: tato bhūyastaro bhogo duḥkhāya tapanāya ca.
13.145.64d1152: nāsti tr̥ṣṇāsamaṁ duḥkhaṁ nāsti tyāgasamaṁ sukham,
13.145.64d1153: yā dustyajā durmatibhiryā na jīryati jīryataḥ,
yo’sau prāṇāntiko rogastāṁ tr̥ṣṇāṁ tyajataḥ sukham.
13.145.64d1157: yat pr̥thivyāṁ vrīhiyavaṁ hiraṇyaṁ paśavaḥ striyaḥ,
13.145.64d1158: yacca kāmasukhaṁ loke yacca divyaṁ mahat sukham,
13.145.64d1161: na ca pāpairna cānarthaiḥ saṁyujyeta vicakṣaṇaḥ.
13.145.64d1167: naiva rohati tattvajñe rūḍho vā chidyate punaḥ.
13.145.64d1169: purastācca sthite mr̥tyau kiṁ sukhaṁ paśyataḥ śubhe.
13.145.64d1174: tapasā vā sumahatā karmaṇā vā śrutena vā,
13.145.64d1176: na dhanena na rājyena nāgryeṇa tapasāpi vā,
13.145.64d1180: na hyahāni nivartante na māsā na punaḥ kṣapāḥ,
13.145.64d1183: gādhodake matsya iva kiṁ nu tasya kumāratā.
13.145.64d1184: maraṇaṁ hi śarīrasya niyataṁ dhruvameva ca,
tiṣṭhannapi kṣaṇaṁ sarvaḥ kālasyaiti vaśaṁ punaḥ.
13.145.64d1185: na mriyeran na jīryeran yadi syuḥ sarvadehinaḥ,
na cāniṣṭaṁ pravarteta śoko vā prāṇināṁ kvacit.
13.145.64d1186: apramattasya kālasya kṣayaṁ prāpto na mucyate.
13.145.64d1187: ko’pi tad veda yatrāsau mr̥tyunā nābhivīkṣitaḥ.
13.145.64d1189: idaṁ me syādidaṁ me syādityevaṁ manasā narāḥ,
13.145.64d1190: kā śraddhā prāṇināṁ mārge viṣame bhramatāṁ sadā.
13.145.64d1191: phalānāmiva pakvānāṁ sadā hi patanād bhayam.
13.145.64d1193: na saṁvego’sti cet puṁsaḥ kāṣṭhaloṣṭasamo hi saḥ.
13.145.64d1197: vairāgyeṇa parāṁ śāntiṁ labhante mānavāḥ śubhe,
13.145.64d1198: etat te kathitaṁ devi vairāgyotpādanaṁ vacaḥ,
evaṁ sañcintya sañcintya mucyante hi mumukṣavaḥ.
13.145.64d1200: śārīraṁ tu tapo ghoraṁ sāṅkhyāḥ prāhurnirarthakam.
13.145.64d1203: tebhyo bhūtāni pañcabhyaḥ śarīraṁ vai pravartate,
13.145.64d1206: icchā dveṣaḥ sukhaṁ duḥkhaṁ saṅghātaścetanā dhr̥tiḥ,
13.145.64d1210: tanmūlaṁ ca jagat sarvaṁ tanmūlā sr̥ṣṭiriṣyate.
13.145.64d1212: sukhaṁ tuṣṭiḥ prakāśaśca trayaste sāttvikā guṇāḥ,
rāgadveṣau sukhaṁ duḥkhaṁ stambhaśca rajaso guṇāḥ.
13.145.64d1213: aprakāśo bhayaṁ mohastandrī ca tamaso guṇāḥ.
13.145.64d1216: viṣādaḥ saṁśayo mohastandrī nidrā bhayaṁ tathā,
13.145.64d1218: tatra yat prītisaṁyuktaṁ kāyena manasāpi vā,
vartate sāttviko bhāva ityupekṣeta tat tadā.
13.145.64d1221: samāsāt sāttviko dharmaḥ samāsād rājasaṁ dhanam,
13.145.64d1223: ūrdhvaṁ gacchanti sattvasthā madhye tiṣṭhanti rājasāḥ,
13.145.64d1225: vijñānaṁ ca vivekaśca mahato lakṣaṇaṁ bhavet.
13.145.64d1226: mahān buddhirmatiḥ prajñā nāmāni mahato viduḥ,
13.145.64d1228: khaṁ vāyuragniḥ salilaṁ pr̥thivī ceti pañcamī,
13.145.64d1229: sparśavat prāṇināṁ ceṣṭā pavanasya guṇāḥ smr̥tāḥ.
13.145.64d1230: rasaḥ snehastathā jihvā śaityaṁ ca jalajā guṇāḥ.
13.145.64d1231: gandho ghrāṇaṁ śarīraṁ ca pr̥thivyāste guṇāstrayaḥ,
13.145.64d1234: tad gandhatvamapāṁ nāsti pr̥thivyā eva tad guṇaḥ,
13.145.64d1236: tat sarvaṁ bhautikaṁ viddhi dehairevāsya svāmikam.
13.145.64d1238: śabdaḥ sparśaśca rūpaṁ ca raso gandhaśca pañcamaḥ,
13.145.64d1239: karmendriyārthān jānīyāt te ca bhūtodbhavā matāḥ.
13.145.64d1240: prārthanālakṣaṇaṁ tacca indriyaṁ tu manaḥ smr̥tam.
13.145.64d1241: niyuṅkte ca sadā tāni bhūtāni manasā saha,
niyame ca visarge ca manasaḥ kāraṇaṁ prabhuḥ.
13.145.64d1243: śarīrācca paro dehī śarīraṁ ca vyapāśritaḥ,
śarīriṇaḥ śarīrasya so’ntaraṁ vetti vai muniḥ.
13.145.64d1245: yaḥ paśyet paramātmānaṁ bandhanaiḥ sa vimucyate.
13.145.64d1246: sa hi sarveṣu bhūteṣu sthāvareṣu careṣu ca,
13.145.64d1247: naiva cordhvaṁ na tiryak ca nādhastānna kadācana,
indriyairiha buddhyā vā na dr̥śyeta kadācana.
13.145.64d1248: navadvāraṁ puraṁ gatvā satataṁ niyato vaśī,
13.145.64d1251: puruṣaḥ prakr̥tistho hi bhuṅkte prakr̥tijān guṇān,
13.145.64d1258: dr̥ṣṭvā tu taṁ mahātmānaṁ punastanna nivartate.
13.145.64d1259: iti te kathito devi sāṅkhyadharmaḥ sanātanaḥ.
13.145.64d1261: yogadharmaṁ punaḥ kr̥tsnaṁ kīrtayiṣyāmi te śr̥ṇu.
13.145.64d1262: sa ca yogo dvidhā bhinno brahmadevarṣisammataḥ,
13.145.64d1269: amogho nirmalo dāntaḥ paścād yogaṁ samācaret.
13.145.64d1270: ekānte vijane deśe sarvataḥ saṁvr̥te śucau,
13.145.64d1274: tvakchrotraṁ ca tato jihvāṁ ghrāṇaṁ cakṣuśca saṁharet,
13.145.64d1276: prāṇāpānau tadā tasya yugapat tiṣṭhato vaśe,
13.145.64d1277: śarīraṁ cintayet sarvaṁ vipāṭya ca samīpataḥ,
13.145.64d1278: prāṇo mūrdhani ca śvāso vartamāno viceṣṭate.
13.145.64d1280: bastimūlaṁ gudaṁ caiva pāvakaṁ ca samāśritaḥ,
vahan mūtraṁ purīṣaṁ ca sadāpānaḥ pravartate.
13.145.64d1286: ūṣmā so’gniriti jñeyaḥ so’nnaṁ pacati dehinām.
13.145.64d1295: aśrāntaścintayed yogī utthāya ca punaḥ punaḥ,
13.145.64d1296: prasīdati manaḥ kṣipraṁ prasanne dr̥śyate param.
13.145.64d1300: kāmaḥ krodho bhayaṁ svapnaḥ snehamatyaśanaṁ tathā,
13.145.64d1303: aṇimā mahimā caiva prāptiḥ prākāmyameva hi,
īśitvaṁ ca vaśitvaṁ ca yatra kāmāvasāyitā.
13.145.64d1304: etānaṣṭau guṇān prāpya kathañcid yogināṁ varāḥ,
13.145.64d1309: arcayitvā yathāśakti svakaṁ devaṁ viśanti te.
13.145.64d1310: sāyujyānāṁ viśiṣṭaṁ ca māmakaṁ vaiṣṇavaṁ tathā,
māṁ prāpya na nivartante viṣṇuṁ vā śubhalocane,
iti te kathito devi yogadharmaḥ sanātanaḥ,
13.145.64d1315: ācāraḥ kīdr̥śasteṣāṁ kena tuṣṭo bhaved bhavān.
13.145.64d1316: varṇyamānaṁ tvayā sākṣāt prīṇayatyadhikaṁ hi mām.
13.145.64d1317: yena te na nivartante yuktāḥ paramayoginaḥ.
13.145.64d1318: sāṅkhyayogau mayā sr̥ṣṭau sarvaṁ cāpi carācaram.
13.145.64d1320: na māṁ viduḥ suragaṇā munayaśca tapodhanāḥ,
13.145.64d1322: vyācakhye’haṁ tathā devi yogaṁ pāśupataṁ mahat.
13.145.64d1323: gr̥hītaṁ tacca taiḥ sarvaṁ mukhācca mama dakṣiṇāt,
śrutvā tat triṣu lokeṣu sthāpitaṁ cāpi taiḥpunaḥ.
13.145.64d1324: idānīṁ ca tvayā pr̥ṣṭo vadāmyekamanāḥ śr̥ṇu.
13.145.64d1325: ahaṁ paśupatirnāma madbhaktā ye ca mānavāḥ,
13.145.64d1326: rakṣārthaṁ maṅgalārthaṁ ca pavitrārthaṁ ca bhāmini,
liṅgārthaṁ caiva bhaktānāṁ bhasma dattaṁ mayā purā.
13.145.64d1332: sthāpitaṁ triṣu lokeṣu śivaliṅgaṁ mayā mama,
13.145.64d1335: iṣṭasya hayamedhasya yat phalaṁ tat phalaṁ bhavet.
13.145.64d1336: ghr̥tamaṇḍena yo nityamarcayed yaḥ śivaṁ mama,
13.145.64d1337: kevalenāpi toyena snāpayed yaḥ śivaṁ mama,
sa cāpi labhate puṇyaṁ priyaṁ ca labhate naraḥ.
13.145.64d1338: saghr̥taṁ guggulaṁ samyag dhūpayed yaḥ śivāntike,
gosavasya tu yajñasya yat phalaṁ tasya tad bhavet.
13.145.64d1339: tasya rukmapradānasya yat phalaṁ tasya tad bhavet.
13.145.64d1345: phalaṁ vā yadi vā śākaṁ puṣpaṁ vā yadi vā jalam,
13.145.64d1348: etat te sarvamākhyātaṁ yogaṁ pāśupataṁ mahat,
13.145.64d1349: śr̥ṇuyād yaḥ paṭhed vāpi mamedaṁ dharmaniścayam,
svargaṁ kīrtiṁ dhanaṁ dhānyaṁ labhate sa narottamaḥ.
13.145.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate anuśāsanaparvaṇi dānadharmaparvaṇi umāmaheśvarasaṁvāde pañcacatvāriṁśadadhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥145॥
13.146.3: pr̥cchāmi tvāṁ varārohe pr̥ṣṭā vada mamepsitam ॥3॥
13.146.4d1: lakṣmīrviṣṇoḥ priyā bhāryā dhr̥tirbhāryā yamasya tu
13.146.5: varuṇasya tathā gaurī sūryasya ca suvarcalā,
rohiṇī śaśinaḥ sādhvī svāhā caiva vibhāvasoḥ ॥5॥
13.146.8: samānasāravīryā ca tapastīvraṁ kr̥taṁ ca te ॥8॥
13.146.9: tvayā hyukto viśeṣeṇa guṇavān sa bhaviṣyati,
13.146.10: gauryāṁ gacchati suśroṇi lokeṣveṣā gatiḥ sadā ॥10॥
13.146.11: mama cārdhaṁ śarīrasya tava cārdhena nirmitam,
13.146.11d1: pramadoktaṁ tu yat kiñcit tat strīṣu bahu manyate,
13.146.12: tava sarvaḥ suviditaḥ strīdharmaḥ śāśvataḥ śubhe,
13.146.13: tvatprabhāvādiyaṁ deva vāk caiva pratibhāti me ॥13॥
13.146.15: prabhavan yo’nahaṁvādī sa vai puruṣa ucyate ॥15॥
13.146.18: vipāśā ca vitastā ca candrabhāgā irāvatī,
13.146.19: gaganād gāṁ gatā devī gaṅgā sarvasaridvarā ॥19॥
13.146.23: na caikasādhyaṁ paśyāmi vijñānaṁ bhuvi kasyacit,
13.146.24: evaṁ sarvāḥ saricchreṣṭhāḥ pr̥ṣṭāḥ puṇyatamāḥ śivāḥ,
tato devanadī gaṅgā niyuktā pratipūjya ca ॥24॥
13.146.28: prabhavan pr̥cchate yo hi sammānayati vā punaḥ,
13.146.29: pravaktr̥̄n pr̥cchate yo’nyān sa vai nāpadamr̥cchati ॥29॥
13.146.33: strīdharmo māṁ prati yathā pratibhāti yathāvidhi,
13.146.34: strīdharmaḥ pūrva evāyaṁ vivāhe bandhubhiḥ kr̥taḥ,
13.146.36: sā bhaved dharmaparamā sā bhaved dharmabhāginī,
devavat satataṁ sādhvī yā bhartāraṁ prapaśyati ॥36॥
13.146.37: śuśrūṣāṁ paricāraṁ ca devavad yā karoti ca,
13.146.38: yā sādhvī niyatāhārā sā bhaved dharmacāriṇī ॥38॥
13.146.39: śrutvā dampatidharmaṁ vai sahadharmaṁ kr̥taṁ śubham,
13.146.42: paruṣāṇyapi coktā yā dr̥ṣṭā dr̥ṣṭena cakṣuṣā,
13.146.43: na candrasūryau na taruṁ puṁnāmnā yā nirīkṣate,
13.146.45: yā nārī prayatā dakṣā yā nārī putriṇī bhavet,
13.146.46: supratītā vinītā ca sā nārī dharmabhāginī ॥46॥
13.146.47: na kāmeṣu na bhogeṣu naiśvarye na sukhe tathā,
spr̥hā yasyā yathā patyau sā nārī dharmabhāginī ॥47॥
13.146.51: mātāpitr̥parā nityaṁ yā nārī sā tapodhanā ॥51॥
13.146.53: vrataṁ carati yā nityaṁ duścaraṁ laghusattvayā,
13.146.54: yā nārī bhartr̥paramā bhaved bhartr̥vratā satī ॥54॥
13.146.55: patyā samā gatirnāsti daivataṁ vā yathā patiḥ ॥55॥
13.146.56: patiprasādaḥ svargo vā tulyo nāryā na vā bhavet,
ahaṁ svargaṁ na hīccheyaṁ tvayyaprīte maheśvare ॥56॥
13.146.57: patirbrūyād daridro vā vyādhito vā kathañcana ॥57॥
13.146.59: eṣa deva mayā proktaḥ strīdharmo vacanāt tava,
13.146.60: ityuktaḥ sa tu deveśaḥ pratipūjya gireḥ sutām,
13.146.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate anuśāsanaparvaṇi dānadharmaparvaṇi umāmaheśvarasaṁvāde strīdharmakathane ṣaṭcatvāriṁśadadhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥146॥
13.147.6: saṁhartā caiva bhūtānāṁ sthāvarasya carasya ca ॥6॥
13.147.7: sa hi devavaraḥ sākṣād devanāthaḥ parantapaḥ,
13.147.8: na tasmāt paramaṁ bhūtaṁ triṣu lokeṣu kiñcana ॥8॥
13.147.9: sanātano vai madhuhā govinda iti viśrutaḥ,
sa sarvān pārthivān saṅkhye ghātayiṣyati mānadaḥ ॥9॥
13.147.14: sarvāḥ sukhaṁ saṁśritāśca śarīre tasya devatāḥ,
13.147.15: uttamena sa śīlena damena ca śamena ca ॥15॥
13.147.23: aṅgo nāma manoḥ putro antardhāmā tataḥ paraḥ ॥23॥
13.147.30: tasya tvavarajaḥ putraḥ śūro nāma bhaviṣyati,
13.147.36: śūraseneṣu bhūtvā sa dvārakāyāṁ vasan prabhuḥ,
pālayiṣyati gāṁ devīṁ vijitya nayavit sadā ॥36॥
13.147.38: yo hi māṁ draṣṭumiccheta brahmāṇaṁ ca pitāmaham,
13.147.39: dr̥ṣṭe tasminnahaṁ dr̥ṣṭo na me’trāsti vicāraṇā,
pitāmaho vā deveśa iti vitta tapodhanāḥ ॥39॥
13.147.41: yaśca taṁ mānave loke saṁśrayiṣyati keśavam,
13.147.42: dharmāṇāṁ deśikaḥ sākṣāt sa bhaviṣyati dharmabhāk,
13.147.43: dharma eva paro hi syāt tasminnabhyarcite vibhau,
13.147.45: tasmāt sa vāgmī dharmajño namasyo dvijapuṅgavāḥ ॥45॥
13.147.46: divi śreṣṭho hi bhagavān harirnārāyaṇaḥ prabhuḥ,
vandito hi sa vandeta mānito mānayīta ca,
13.147.50: karmaṇā manasā vācā sa namasyo dvijaiḥ sadā,
13.147.51: eṣa vo’bhihito mārgo mayā vai munisattamāḥ,
taṁ dr̥ṣṭvā sarvaśo devaṁ dr̥ṣṭāḥ syuḥ surasattamāḥ ॥51॥
13.147.53: tatra ca tritayaṁ dr̥ṣṭaṁ bhaviṣyati na saṁśayaḥ,
samastā hi vayaṁ devāstasya dehe vasāmahe ॥53॥
13.147.54: halī bala iti khyāto bhaviṣyati dharādharaḥ ॥54॥
13.147.59: sa ca śeṣo vicarate parayā vai mudā yutaḥ,
13.147.60: ya eva viṣṇuḥ so’nanto bhagavān vasudhādharaḥ,
yo rāmaḥ sa hr̥ṣīkeśo yo’cyutaḥ sa dharādharaḥ ॥60॥
13.147.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate anuśāsanaparvaṇi dānadharmaparvaṇi puruṣamāhātmye saptacatvāriṁśadadhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥147॥
13.148.2: prāvr̥ṣīva ca parjanyo vavr̥ṣe nirmalaṁ payaḥ,
13.148.3: tato devagirau tasmin ramye puṇye sanātane,
13.148.4: vyabhraṁ ca gaganaṁ sadyaḥ kṣaṇena samapadyata,
13.148.7: dr̥ṣṭvā ca vismitāḥ kr̥ṣṇa sā ca naḥ smr̥tirāgatā ॥7॥
13.148.8: etat te devadevasya māhātmyaṁ kathitaṁ prabho,
13.148.11: na hi naḥ sā ratiḥ svarge yā ca tvaddarśane vibho,
tadr̥taṁ ca mahābāho yadāha bhagavān bhavaḥ ॥11॥
13.148.13: na ca te’viditaṁ kiñcittriṣu lokeṣu vidyate ॥13॥
13.148.14: janma caiva prasūtiśca yaccānyat kāraṇaṁ vibho,
13.148.15: tataḥ sthite tvayi vibho laghutvāt pralapāmahe,
na hi kiñcit tadāścaryaṁ yanna vetti bhavāniha ॥15॥
13.148.16: divi vā bhuvi vā deva sarvaṁ hi viditaṁ tava,
13.148.19: so’yaṁ nārāyaṇaḥ śrīmān dīptyā paramayā yutaḥ,
13.148.20: pūrṇe ca daśame māsi putro’sya paramādbhutaḥ,
rukmiṇyāṁ sammato jajñe śūro vaṁśadharaḥ prabho ॥20॥
13.148.31: pratiyoddhuṁ na śakyo hi mānuṣaireṣa saṁyuge,
13.148.34: yāvat tasya bhavet puṣṭistejo dīptiḥ parākramaḥ,
13.148.35: kaḥ śaknotyanyathākartuṁ tad yadi syāt tathā śr̥ṇu,
13.148.38: na hi pratijñā yā dattā tāṁ prahātumarindama ॥38॥
13.148.39: vayaṁ ca kālena hatāḥ kālo hi parameśvaraḥ ॥39॥
13.148.40: na hi kālena kālajñaḥ spr̥ṣṭaḥ śocitumarhasi,
13.148.42: mādhavasyāsya māhātmyaṁ śrutaṁ yat kathitaṁ mayā,
13.148.43: vyāsasya vacanaṁ śrutvā nāradasya ca dhīmataḥ,
13.148.45: śr̥ṇuyāt kathayed vā yaḥ sa śreyo labhate param ॥45॥
13.148.46: pretya svargaṁ ca labhate naro nāstyatra saṁśayaḥ ॥46॥
13.148.47: eṣa evākṣayo vipraiḥ stuto rājan janārdanaḥ ॥47॥
13.148.48: te tvayā manasā dhāryāḥ kururāja divāniśam ॥48॥
13.148.50: yastasya vipulo daṇḍaḥ samyagdharmaḥ sa kīrtyate ॥50॥
13.148.51: ya eṣa kathito rājan mayā sajjanasaṁnidhau,
13.148.53: sandeśo devapūjārthaṁ taṁ tathā kuru pāṇḍava ॥53॥
13.148.54: etadatyadbhutaṁ vr̥ttaṁ puṇye hi bhavati prabho,
13.148.59: dhruvaṁ śreyaḥ paraṁ tāta bhaviṣyati tavottamam,
yasya te puruṣavyāghraḥ sakhā cāyaṁ janārdanaḥ ॥59॥
13.148.60: duryodhanaṁ tu śocāmi pretya loke’pi durmatim,
13.148.62: tūṣṇīṁ babhūva kauravyo madhye teṣāṁ mahātmanām ॥62॥
13.148.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate anuśāsanaparvaṇi dānadharmaparvaṇi mahāpuruṣaprastāve aṣṭacatvāriṁśadadhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥148॥
13.149.2: kimekaṁ daivataṁ loke kiṁ vāpyekaṁ parāyaṇam,
13.149.3: ko dharmaḥ sarvadharmāṇāṁ bhavataḥ paramo mataḥ,
13.149.9: paramaṁ yo mahattejaḥ paramaṁ yo mahattapaḥ,
paramaṁ yo mahadbrahma paramaṁ yaḥ parāyaṇam ॥9॥
13.149.10: pavitrāṇāṁ pavitraṁ yo maṅgalānāṁ ca maṅgalam,
daivataṁ devatānāṁ ca bhūtānāṁ yo’vyayaḥ pitā ॥10॥
13.149.15: pūtātmā paramātmā ca muktānāṁ paramā gatiḥ,
avyayaḥ puruṣaḥ sākṣī kṣetrajño’kṣara eva ca ॥15॥
13.149.21: īśānaḥ prāṇadaḥ prāṇo jyeṣṭhaḥ śreṣṭhaḥ prajāpatiḥ,
13.149.22: īśvaro vikramī dhanvī medhāvī vikramaḥ kramaḥ,
13.149.30: atīndraḥ saṅgrahaḥ sargo dhr̥tātmā niyamo yamaḥ ॥30॥
13.149.31: vedyo vaidyaḥ sadāyogī vīrahā mādhavo madhuḥ,
13.149.42: subhujo durdharo vāgmī mahendro vasudo vasuḥ,
13.149.45: kāmahā kāmakr̥t kāntaḥ kāmaḥ kāmapradaḥ prabhuḥ ॥45॥
13.149.54: karaṇaṁ kāraṇaṁ kartā vikartā gahano gr̥haḥ ॥54॥
13.149.56: rāmo virāmo virajo mārgo neyo nayo’nayaḥ,
13.149.57: vaikuṇṭhaḥ puruṣaḥ prāṇaḥ prāṇadaḥ praṇavaḥ pr̥thuḥ,
13.149.61: yajña ijyo mahejyaśca kratuḥ satraṁ satāṁ gatiḥ,
13.149.62: suvrataḥ sumukhaḥ sūkṣmaḥ sughoṣaḥ sukhadaḥ suhr̥t,
13.149.67: vinayo jayaḥ satyasandho dāśārhaḥ sātvatāṁ patiḥ ॥67॥
13.149.75: trisāmā sāmagaḥ sāma nirvāṇaṁ bheṣajaṁ bhiṣak,
13.149.86: stavyaḥ stavapriyaḥ stotraṁ stutiḥ stotā raṇapriyaḥ,
13.149.91: eko naikaḥ savaḥ kaḥ kiṁ yat tat padamanuttamam,
13.149.111: akrūraḥ peśalo dakṣo dakṣiṇaḥ kṣamiṇāṁ varaḥ,
13.149.122: nāśubhaṁ prāpnuyāt kiñcit so’mutreha ca mānavaḥ ॥122॥
13.149.123: vedāntago brāhmaṇaḥ syāt kṣatriyo vijayī bhavet,
13.149.127: na bhayaṁ kvacidāpnoti vīryaṁ tejaśca vindati,
13.149.128: rogārto mucyate rogād baddho mucyeta bandhanāt,
13.149.133: na krodho na ca mātsaryaṁ na lobho nāśubhā matiḥ,
13.149.136: indriyāṇi mano buddhiḥ sattvaṁ tejo balaṁ dhr̥tiḥ,
13.149.139: yogo jñānaṁ tathā sāṅkhyaṁ vidyā śilpādi karma ca,
13.149.141: paṭhed ya icchet puruṣaḥ śreyaḥ prāptuṁ sukhāni ca ॥141॥
13.149.142: bhajanti ye puṣkarākṣaṁ na te yānti parābhavam ॥142॥
13.149.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate śatasāhasryāṁ saṁhitāyāṁ vaiyāsikyāmanuśāsanaparvaṇi dānadharmaparvaṇi viṣṇusahasranāmakathane ekonapañcāśadadhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥149॥
13.150.1: kiṁ japyaṁ japato nityaṁ bhaved dharmaphalaṁ mahat ॥1॥
13.150.2: prasthāne vā praveśe vā pravr̥tte vāpi karmaṇi,
daive vā śrāddhakāle vā kiṁ japyaṁ karmasādhanam ॥2॥
13.150.3: japyaṁ yad brahmasamitaṁ tad bhavān vaktumarhati ॥3॥
13.150.7: āyuṣmān bhavate caiva yaṁ śrutvā pārthivātmaja,
puruṣastu susiddhārthaḥ pretya ceha ca modate ॥7॥
13.150.19: api yajñasya vettāro dattasya sukr̥tasya ca,
13.150.27: pr̥thivyāṁ tapasā siddhāḥ sthāvarāśca carāśca ha,
13.150.32: bhuvi kr̥tvā śubhaṁ karma modante divi daivataiḥ ॥32॥
13.150.42: ityete munayo divyā ekaikaḥ sapta saptadhā ॥42॥
13.150.43: yasyāṁ yasyāṁ diśi hyete tanmukhaḥ śaraṇaṁ vrajet ॥43॥
13.150.46: aputro labhate putraṁ daridro labhate dhanam ॥46॥
13.150.47: tathā dharmārthakāmeṣu siddhiṁ ca labhate naraḥ,
pr̥thuṁ vainyaṁ nr̥pavaraṁ pr̥thvī yasyābhavat sutā ॥47॥
13.150.50: gavāmayena yajñena yeneṣṭaṁ vai kr̥te yuge ॥50॥
13.150.52: tathā śvetaṁ ca rājarṣiṁ kīrtayet paramadyutim,
13.150.54: sāṅkhyaṁ yogaṁ ca paramaṁ havyaṁ kavyaṁ tathaiva ca ॥54॥
13.150.56: prayataḥ kīrtayeccaitān kalyaṁ sāyaṁ ca bhārata ॥56॥
13.150.57: ete vai pānti varṣanti bhānti vānti sr̥janti ca,
ete vināyakāḥ śreṣṭhā dakṣāḥ śāntā jitendriyāḥ ॥57॥
13.150.60: etān kīrtayatāṁ nityaṁ duḥsvapno naśyate nr̥ṇām,
13.150.62: rogārto vyādhiyukto vā paṭhan pāpāt pramucyate,
vāstumadhye tu paṭhataḥ kule svastyayanaṁ bhavet ॥62॥
13.150.63: kṣetramadhye tu paṭhataḥ sarvaṁ sasyaṁ prarohati,
13.150.64: ātmanaśca sutānāṁ ca dārāṇāṁ ca dhanasya ca,
13.150.65: etān saṅgrāmakāle tu paṭhataḥ kṣatriyasya tu,
vrajanti ripavo nāśaṁ kṣemaṁ ca parivartate ॥65॥
13.150.66: etān daive ca pitrye ca paṭhataḥ puruṣasya hi,
bhuñjate pitaraḥ kavyaṁ havyaṁ ca tridivaukasaḥ ॥66॥
13.150.67: na vyādhiśvāpadabhayaṁ na dvipānna hi taskarāt,
kaśmalaṁ laghutāṁ yāti pāpmanā ca pramucyate ॥67॥
13.150.68: yānapātre ca yāne ca pravāse rājaveśmani,
13.150.69: na ca rājabhayaṁ teṣāṁ na piśācānna rākṣasāt,
13.150.71: na tatra bālo mriyate na ca tiṣṭhanti pannagāḥ ॥71॥
13.150.72: na teṣāṁ vidyate duḥkhaṁ gacchanti paramāṁ gatim,
13.150.73: gavāṁ madhye tu paṭhato gāvo’sya bahuvatsalāḥ,
prasthāne vā pravāse vā sarvāvasthāṁ gataḥ paṭhet ॥73॥
13.150.74: japatāṁ juhvatāṁ caiva nityaṁ ca prayatātmanām,
13.150.76: tadetat te samākhyātaṁ tathyaṁ brahma sanātanam,
13.150.77: paṭhanti śucayo nityaṁ sāvitrīṁ prāṇināṁ gatim ॥77॥
13.150.78: abhyāse nityaṁ devānāṁ saptarṣīṇāṁ dhruvasya ca,
13.150.80: tulyaṁ phalaṁ bhavati tasya ca tasya caiva ॥80॥
13.150.82: eṣā te kathitā rājan sāvitrī brahma śāśvatī,
vivakṣurasi yaccānyat tat te vakṣyāmi bhārata ॥82॥
13.150.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate anuśāsanaparvaṇi dānadharmaparvaṇi sāvitrīvratopākhyāne pañcāśadadhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥150॥
13.151.1: ke pūjyāḥ ke namaskāryāḥ kathaṁ varteta keṣu ca,
13.151.3: te hi lokānimān sarvān dhārayanti manīṣiṇaḥ ॥3॥
13.151.6: tapo yeṣāṁ dhanaṁ nityaṁ vāk caiva vipulaṁ balam,
13.151.9: dhuri ye nāvasīdanti viṣaye sadgavā iva,
13.151.14: samaṁ yeṣāṁ dukūlaṁ ca tathā kṣaumājināni ca ॥14॥
13.151.18: devānāmapi ye devāḥ kāraṇaṁ kāraṇasya ca,
13.151.20: avidvān brāhmaṇo devaḥ pātraṁ vai pāvanaṁ mahat,
13.151.22: śmaśāne hyapi tejasvī pāvako naiva duṣyati,
13.151.23: sarvathā brāhmaṇo mānyo daivataṁ viddhi tatparam ॥23॥
13.152.1: kāṁ tu brāhmaṇapūjāyāṁ vyuṣṭiṁ dr̥ṣṭvā janādhipa,
kaṁ vā karmodayaṁ matvā tānarcasi mahāmate ॥1॥
13.152.5: svavittaṁ tena dattaṁ tu dattātreyāya kāraṇe,
13.152.8: mama bāhusahasraṁ tu paśyatāṁ sainikā raṇe,
13.152.9: caturthaṁ tu varaṁ yāce tvāmahaṁ dvijasattama ॥9॥
13.152.11: ityuktaḥ sa dvijaḥ prāha tathāstviti narādhipam,
13.152.12: abravīd vīryasammohāt ko vāsti sadr̥śo mama ॥12॥
13.152.14: na tvaṁ mūḍha vijānīṣe brāhmaṇaṁ kṣatriyād varam,
sahito brāhmaṇeneha kṣatriyaḥ śāsti vai prajāḥ ॥14॥
13.152.15: kuryāṁ bhūtāni tuṣṭo’haṁ kruddho nāśaṁ tathānaye,
karmaṇā manasā vācā na matto’sti varo dvijaḥ ॥15॥
13.152.17: brāhmaṇāḥ saṁśritāḥ kṣatraṁ na kṣatraṁ brāhmaṇāśritam,
śritā brahmopadhā viprāḥ khādanti kṣatriyān bhuvi ॥17॥
13.152.18: kṣatrād vr̥ttirbrāhmaṇānāṁ taiḥ kathaṁ brāhmaṇo varaḥ ॥18॥
13.152.21: na ca māṁ cyāvayed rāṣṭrāt triṣu lokeṣu kaścana,
devo vā mānuṣo vāpi tasmājjyeṣṭho dvijādaham ॥21॥
13.152.22: na hi me saṁyuge kaścit soḍhumutsahate balam ॥22॥
13.152.25: athavā tvāṁ mahīpāla śamayiṣyanti vai dvijāḥ,
13.152.26: taṁ rājā kastvamityāha tatastaṁ prāha mārutaḥ,
13.152.27: yādr̥śaṁ pr̥thivībhūtaṁ tādr̥śaṁ brūhi me dvijam ॥27॥
13.152.28: vāyorvā sadr̥śaṁ kiñcid brūhi tvaṁ brāhmaṇottamam,
apāṁ vai sadr̥śaṁ vahneḥ sūryasya nabhaso’pi vā ॥28॥
13.152.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate anuśāsanaparvaṇi dānadharmaparvaṇi pavanārjunasaṁvāde brāhmaṇamāhātmye dvipañcāśadadhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥152॥
13.153.1: śr̥ṇu mūḍha guṇān kāṁścid bāhmaṇānāṁ mahātmanām,
ye tvayā kīrtitā rājaṁstebhyo’tha brāhmaṇo varaḥ ॥1॥
13.153.2: nāśaṁ jagāma tāṁ vipro vyastambhayata kaśyapaḥ ॥2॥
13.153.3: ajeyā brāhmaṇā rājan divi ceha ca nityadā,
13.153.4: sa tāḥ piban kṣīramiva nātr̥pyata mahāmanāḥ,
13.153.5: tasminnahaṁ ca kruddhe vai jagat tyaktvā tato gataḥ,
13.153.6: ahalyāṁ kāmayāno vai dharmārthaṁ ca na hiṁsitaḥ ॥6॥
13.153.7: tathā samudro nr̥pate pūrṇo mr̥ṣṭasya vāriṇaḥ,
13.153.10: samo na tvaṁ dvijātibhyaḥ śreyo viddhi narādhipa,
garbhasthān brāhmaṇān samyaṅ namasyati kila prabhuḥ ॥10॥
13.153.12: tvayā ca vipulaṁ rājyaṁ balaṁ dharmaṁ śrutaṁ tathā,
13.153.13: agniṁ tvaṁ yajase nityaṁ kasmād brāhmaṇamarjuna,
sa hi sarvasya lokasya havyavāṭ kiṁ na vetsi tam ॥13॥
13.153.15: yenedaṁ nikhilaṁ viśvaṁ janitaṁ sthāvaraṁ caram ॥15॥
13.153.16: aṇḍād bhinnād babhuḥ śailā diśo’mbhaḥpr̥thivī divam ॥16॥
13.153.17: draṣṭavyaṁ naitadevaṁ hi kathaṁ jāyedajo hi saḥ,
13.153.18: tiṣṭhet kathamiti brūhi na kiñciddhi tadā bhavet,
13.153.19: nāstyaṇḍamasti tu brahmā sa rājā lokabhāvanaḥ,
13.153.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate anuśāsanaparvaṇi dānadharmaparvaṇi pavanārjunasaṁvāde tripañcāśadadhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥153॥
13.154.1: imāṁ bhūmiṁ dvijātibhyo ditsurvai dakṣiṇāṁ purā,
aṅgo nāma nr̥po rājaṁstataścintāṁ mahī yayau ॥1॥
13.154.2: kathamicchati māṁ dātuṁ dvijebhyo brahmaṇaḥ sutām ॥2॥
13.154.3: sāhaṁ tyaktvā gamiṣyāmi bhūmitvaṁ brahmaṇaḥ padam,
13.154.4: tatastāṁ kaśyapo dr̥ṣṭvā vrajantīṁ pr̥thivīṁ tadā,
13.154.7: pr̥thivī kāśyapī jajñe sutā tasya mahātmanaḥ ॥7॥
13.154.8: anya prabrūhi vā tvaṁ ca kaśyapāt kṣatriyaṁ varam ॥8॥
13.154.10: bhadrā somasya duhitā rūpeṇa paramā matā,
13.154.11: sā ca tīvraṁ tapastepe mahābhāgā yaśasvinī,
13.154.12: bhāryārthe sa ca jagrāha vidhivad bhūridakṣiṇaḥ ॥12॥
13.154.13: tāṁ tvakāmayata śrīmān varuṇaḥ pūrvameva ha,
sa cāgamya vanaprasthaṁ yamunāyāṁ jahāra tām ॥13॥
13.154.14: jaleśvarastu hr̥tvā tāmanayat svaṁ puraṁ prati,
13.154.15: na hi ramyataraṁ kiñcit tasmādanyat purottamam,
13.154.16: tatra devastayā sārdhaṁ reme rājan jaleśvaraḥ,
13.154.17: provāca gaccha brūhi tvaṁ varuṇaṁ paruṣaṁ vacaḥ ॥17॥
13.154.18: madvākyānmuñca me bhāryāṁ kasmāt tāṁ hr̥tavānasi,
13.154.19: somena dattā bhāryā me tvayā cāpahr̥tādya vai,
13.154.20: iti śrutvā vacastasya so’tha taṁ varuṇo’bravīt ॥20॥
13.154.21: ityukto varuṇenātha nāradaḥ prāpya taṁ munim,
13.154.22: na prayacchati te bhāryāṁ yat te kāryaṁ kuruṣva tat ॥22॥
13.154.27: adr̥śyā gaccha bhīru tvaṁ sarasvati marun prati,
13.154.29: mumoca ca jagad duḥkhād varuṇaṁ caiva haihaya ॥29॥
13.154.30: tataḥ sa labdhvā tāṁ bhāryāṁ varuṇaṁ prāha dharmavit,
13.154.32: bravīmyahaṁ brūhi vā tvamutathyāt kṣatriyaṁ varam ॥32॥
13.154.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate anuśāsanaparvaṇi dānadharmaparvaṇi pavanārjunasaṁvādo nāma catuṣpañcāśadadhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥154॥
13.155.2: yajñāścaiṣāṁ hr̥tāḥ sarve pitr̥̄ṇāṁ ca svadhāstathā ॥2॥
13.155.5: abhivādya tu taṁ devāḥ pr̥ṣṭvā kuśalameva ca,
13.155.6: tadasmānno bhayāt tīvrāt trāhi tvaṁ munipuṅgava ॥6॥
13.155.9: ubhau lokau parityajya gatāḥ kāṣṭhāṁ tu dakṣiṇām ॥9॥
13.155.10: ye’nye’dhasthā mahīsthāśca te na dagdhā mahāsurāḥ ॥10॥
13.155.11: tato lokāḥ punaḥ prāptāḥ suraiḥ śāntabhayairnr̥pa,
13.155.12: ityuktaḥ prāha devān sa na śakto’smi mahīgatān,
dagdhuṁ tapo hi kṣīyenme na śakyāmīti pārthiva ॥12॥
13.155.13: evaṁ dagdhā bhagavatā dānavāḥ svena tejesā,
13.155.14: bravīmyahaṁ brūhi vā tvamagastyāt kṣatriyaṁ varam ॥14॥
13.155.15: śr̥ṇu rājan vasiṣṭhasya mukhyaṁ karma yaśasvinaḥ ॥15॥
13.155.16: ādityāḥ satramāsanta saro vai mānasaṁ prati,
vasiṣṭhaṁ manasā gatvā jñātvā tat tasya gauravam ॥16॥
13.155.19: te pragr̥hya mahāghorān parvatān parighān drumān,
13.155.21: sa ca tairvyathitaḥ śakro vasiṣṭhaṁ śaraṇaṁ yayau,
13.155.22: tadā tān duḥkhitān jñātvā ānr̥śaṁsyaparo muniḥ,
13.155.23: kailāsaṁ prasthitāṁ caiva nadīṁ gaṅgāṁ mahātapāḥ,
ānayat tatsaro divyaṁ tayā bhinnaṁ ca tatsaraḥ ॥23॥
13.155.24: saro bhinnaṁ tayā nadyā sarayūḥ sā tato’bhavat,
hatāśca khalino yatra sa deśaḥ khalino’bhavat ॥24॥
13.155.26: etat karma vasiṣṭhasya kathitaṁ hi mayānagha,
bravīmyahaṁ brūhi vā tvaṁ vasiṣṭhāt kṣatriyaṁ varam ॥26॥
13.155.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate anuśāsanaparvaṇi dānadharmaparvaṇi pavanārjunasaṁvāde pañcapañcāśadadhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥155॥
13.156.3: atha te tamasā grastā nihanyante sma dānavaiḥ,
13.156.6: nādhigacchāma śāntiṁ ca bhayāt trāyasva naḥ prabho ॥6॥
13.156.7: timiraghnaśca savitā dasyuhantā ca no bhava ॥7॥
13.156.9: dr̥ṣṭvā nātiprabhaṁ somaṁ tathā sūryaṁ ca pārthiva,
13.156.14: bravīmyahaṁ brūhi vā tvamatritaḥ kṣatriyaṁ varam ॥14॥
13.156.18: aśvibhyāṁ saha necchāmaḥ somaṁ pātuṁ mahāvrata,
yadanyad vakṣyase vipra tat kariṣyāmi te vacaḥ ॥18॥
13.156.20: kriyatāṁ madvaco devā yathā vai samudāhr̥tam,
13.156.21: aśvibhyāṁ saha somaṁ vai na pāsyāmi dvijottama,
13.156.22: na cet kariṣyasi vaco mayoktaṁ balasūdana,
mayā pramathitaḥ sadyaḥ somaṁ pāsyasi vai makhe ॥22॥
13.156.24: tat tu karma samārabdhaṁ dr̥ṣṭvendraḥ krodhamūrcchitaḥ,
13.156.31: aśvibhyāṁ saha somaṁ ca pibāma vigatajvarāḥ,
tataḥ sa praṇataḥ śakraścakāra cyavanasya tat ॥31॥
13.156.32: tataḥ pratyāharat karma madaṁ ca vyabhajanmuniḥ ॥32॥
13.156.33: akṣeṣu mr̥gayāyāṁ ca pāne strīṣu ca vīryavān ॥33॥
13.156.34: etairdoṣairnarā rājan kṣayaṁ yānti na saṁśayaḥ,
13.156.35: etat te cyavanasyāpi karma rājan prakīrtitam,
bravīmyahaṁ brūhi vā tvaṁ kṣatriyaṁ brāhmaṇād varam ॥35॥
13.156.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate anuśāsanaparvaṇi dānadharmaparvaṇi pavanārjunasaṁvāde ṣaṭpañcāśadadhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥156॥
13.157.1: śr̥ṇu me brāhmaṇeṣveva mukhyaṁ karma janādhipa ॥1॥
13.157.3: ubhau lokau hr̥tau matvā te devā duḥkhitā’bhavan,
13.157.4: cyavanena hr̥tā bhūmiḥ kapaiścaiva divaṁ prabho ॥4॥
13.157.6: te yayuḥ śaraṇaṁ viprānūcuste kān jayāmahe,
13.157.8: tacchrutvā preṣito dūto brāhmaṇebhyo dhanī kapaiḥ,
sa ca tān brāhmaṇānāha dhanī kapavaco yathā ॥8॥
13.157.9: bhavadbhiḥ sadr̥śāḥ sarve kapāḥ kimiha vartate,
sarve vedavidaḥ prājñāḥ sarve ca kratuyājinaḥ ॥9॥
13.157.10: śrīścaiva ramate teṣu dhārayanti śriyaṁ ca te ॥10॥
13.157.11: vr̥thādārān na gacchanti vr̥thāmāṁsaṁ na bhuñjate,
dīptamagniṁ juhvate ca gurūṇāṁ vacane sthitāḥ ॥11॥
13.157.13: pūrvāhṇeṣu na dīvyanti divā caiva na śerate ॥13॥
13.157.14: vijeṣyatha nivartadhvaṁ nivr̥ttānāṁ sukhaṁ hi vaḥ ॥14॥
13.157.15: kapānvayaṁ vijeṣyāmo ye devāste vayaṁ smr̥tāḥ,
tasmād vadhyāḥ kapā’smākaṁ dhanin yāhi yathā’’gatam ॥15॥
13.157.16: dhanī gatvā kapānāha na vo viprāḥ priyaṅkarāḥ,
13.157.19: hatvā vai dānavān devāḥ sarve sambhūya saṁyuge,
13.157.21: nāradasya vacaḥ śrutvā prītāḥ sarve divaukasaḥ,
13.157.22: teṣāṁ tejastathā vīryaṁ devānāṁ vavr̥dhe tataḥ,
13.157.26: tvayā proktāni kārtsnyena śrutāni prayatena ca ॥26॥
13.157.27: bhr̥gubhyaste bhayaṁ ghoraṁ tat tu kālād bhaviṣyati ॥27॥
13.157.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate anuśāsanaparvaṇi dānadharmaparvaṇi pavanārjunasaṁvāde saptapañcāśadadhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥157॥
13.158.1: kaṁ tu karmodayaṁ dr̥ṣṭvā tānarcasi janādhipa ॥1॥
13.158.2: kāṁ vā brāhmaṇapūjāyāṁ vyuṣṭiṁ dr̥ṣṭvā mahāvrata,
13.158.12: dharme sthitvā sa tu vai bhāvitātmā
13.158.32: so’horātraḥ sa kalā vai sa kāṣṭhāḥ,
13.158.36: vedyaṁ ca yad vedayate ca vedyaṁ
dharme ca vede ca bale ca sarvaṁ
13.158.44: bhūtaṁ ca yacceha na vidyā kiñcid
13.158.45: yat praśastaṁ ca lokeṣu puṇyaṁ yacca śubhāśubham,
13.158.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate anuśāsanaparvaṇi dānadharmaparvaṇi mahāpuruṣamāhātmye aṣṭapañcāśadadhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥158॥
13.159.1: vettā tvamasya cārthasya veda tvāṁ hi pitāmahaḥ ॥1॥
13.159.2: yathā tattvena vadato guṇān vai kurusattama ॥2॥
13.159.5: sadā dvijātīn sampūjya kiṁ phalaṁ tatra mānada,
etad brūhi sphuṭaṁ sarvaṁ sumahān saṁśayo’tra me ॥5॥
13.159.6: ityukte vacane tasmin pradyumnena tathā tvaham,
13.159.11: mā te manyurmahābāho bhavatvatra dvijān prati ॥11॥
13.159.13: kathaṁ teṣu na varteran samyag jñānāt sutejasaḥ ॥13॥
13.159.15: sa svairaṁ carate lokān ye divyā ye ca mānuṣāḥ ॥15॥
13.159.16: durvāsasaṁ vāsayet ko brāhmaṇaṁ satkr̥taṁ gr̥he ॥16॥
13.159.17: paribhāṣāṁ ca me śrutvā ko nu dadyāt pratiśrayam ॥17॥
13.159.18: yo māṁ kaścid vāsayīta na sa māṁ kopayediti,
13.159.19: ekadā so’lpakaṁ bhuṅkte na caivaiti punargr̥hān ॥19॥
13.159.20: na cāsya vayasā tulyaḥ pr̥thivyāmabhavat tadā ॥20॥
13.159.21: atha svāvasathaṁ gatvā sa śayyāstaraṇāni ca,
13.159.22: atha māmabravīd bhūyaḥ sa muniḥ saṁśitavrataḥ,
13.159.23: tadaiva tu mayā tasya cittajñena gr̥he janaḥ,
13.159.25: taṁ bhūktvaiva sa tu kṣipraṁ tato vacanamabravīt,
kṣipramaṅgāni limpasva pāyaseneti sa sma ha ॥25॥
13.159.26: avimr̥śyaiva ca tataḥ kr̥tavānasmi tat tathā,
13.159.27: sa dadarśa tadābhyāśe mātaraṁ te śubhānanām,
13.159.28: tamāruhya rathaṁ caiva niryayau sa gr̥hānmama ॥28॥
13.159.29: agnivarṇo jvalan dhīmān sa dvijo rathadhuryavat,
13.159.30: na ca me stokamapyāsīd duḥkhamīrṣyākr̥taṁ tadā,
tathā sa rājamārgeṇa mahatā niryayau bahiḥ ॥30॥
13.159.32: brāhmaṇā eva jāyeran nānyo varṇaḥ kathañcana,
13.159.34: tasmin vrajati durdharṣe prāskhalad rukmiṇī pathi,
13.159.35: tataḥ paramasaṅkruddho rathāt praskandya sa dvijaḥ,
13.159.37: tato vilokya tejasvī brāhmaṇo māmuvāca ha,
13.159.38: prīto’smi tava govinda vr̥ṇu kāmān yathepsitān ॥38॥
13.159.39: prasannasya ca me tāta paśya vyuṣṭiṁ yathāvidhi,
13.159.40: yathaivānne tathā teṣāṁ tvayi bhāvo bhaviṣyati,
13.159.42: yatte bhinnaṁ ca dagdhaṁ ca yacca kiñcid vināśitam,
sarvaṁ tathaiva draṣṭāsi viśiṣṭaṁ vā janārdana ॥42॥
13.159.44: na tu pādatale lipte kasmātte putrakādya vai,
naitanme priyamityevaṁ sa māṁ prīto’bravīt tadā ॥44॥
13.159.45: rukmiṇīṁ cābravīt prītaḥ sarvastrīṇāṁ varaṁ yaśaḥ ॥45॥
13.159.46: na tvāṁ jarā vā rogo vā vaivarṇyaṁ cāpi bhāvini ॥46॥
13.159.48: variṣṭhā ca salokyā ca keśavasya bhaviṣyasi,
13.159.51: yatkiñcid brāhmaṇo brūyāt sarvaṁ kuryāmiti prabho,
etad vratamahaṁ kr̥tvā mātrā te saha putraka ॥51॥
13.159.53: yad bhinnaṁ yacca vai dagdhaṁ tena vipreṇa putraka,
tato’haṁ vismayaṁ prāptaḥ sarvaṁ dr̥ṣṭvā navaṁ dr̥ḍham ॥53॥
13.159.54: apūjayaṁ ca manasā raukmiṇeya sadā dvijān,
13.159.55: tathā tvamapi kaunteya brāhmaṇān satataṁ prabho ॥55॥
13.159.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate anuśāsanaparvaṇi dānadharmaparvaṇi durvāsobhikṣā nāma ekonaṣaṣṭyadhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥159॥
13.160.1: durvāsasaḥ prasādāt te yat tadā madhusūdana,
13.160.2: mahābhāgyaṁ ca yat tasya nāmāni ca mahātmanaḥ,
tat tvatto jñātumicchāmi sarvaṁ matimatāṁ vara ॥2॥
13.160.3: yadavāptaṁ mayā rājan śreyo yaccārjitaṁ yaśaḥ ॥3॥
13.160.6: nāsti kiñcit paraṁ bhūtaṁ mahādevād viśāmpate,
iha triṣvapi lokeṣu bhūtānāṁ prabhavo hi saḥ ॥6॥
13.160.7: na hi bhūtaṁ samaṁ tena triṣu lokeṣu vidyate ॥7॥
13.160.8: gandhenāpi hi saṅgrāme tasya kruddhasya śatravaḥ,
visañjñā hatabhūyiṣṭhā vepante ca patanti ca ॥8॥
13.160.10: yāṁśca ghoreṇa rūpeṇa paśyet kruddhaḥ pinākadhr̥t,
na surā nāsurā loke na gandharvā na pannagāḥ ॥10॥
13.160.13: te na śarma kutaḥ śāntiṁ viṣādaṁ lebhire surāḥ,
viddhe ca sahasā yajñe kupite ca maheśvare ॥13॥
13.160.15: vyadravan girayaścāpi dyauḥ paphāla ca sarvaśaḥ ॥15॥
13.160.16: andhena tamasā lokāḥ prāvr̥tā na cakāśire,
praṇaṣṭā jyotiṣāṁ bhāśca saha sūryeṇa bhārata ॥16॥
13.160.17: bhr̥śaṁ bhītāstataḥ śāntiṁ cakruḥ svastyayanāni ca,
13.160.20: punaśca sandadhe rudro dīptaṁ suniśitaṁ śaram ॥20॥
13.160.21: rudrasya vikramaṁ dr̥ṣṭvā bhītā devāḥ saharṣibhiḥ,
13.160.23: rudrasya bhāgaṁ yajñe ca viśiṣṭaṁ te tvakalpayan,
bhayena tridaśā rājan śaraṇaṁ ca prapedire ॥23॥
13.160.24: tena caiva hi tuṣṭena sa yajñaḥ sandhito’bhavat,
13.160.29: śalyamagniṁ tathā kr̥tvā puṅkhaṁ vaivasvataṁ yamam,
vedān kr̥tvā dhanuḥ sarvān jyāṁ ca sāvitrimuttamām ॥29॥
13.160.30: brahmāṇaṁ sārathiṁ kr̥tvā viniyujya ca sarvaśaḥ,
triparvaṇā triśalyena tena tāni bibheda saḥ ॥30॥
13.160.32: taṁ caivāṅkagataṁ dr̥ṣṭvā bālaṁ pañcaśikhaṁ punaḥ,
13.160.33: sa vajraṁ stambhayāmāsa taṁ bāhuṁ parighopamam ॥33॥
13.160.35: tato dhyātvā ca bhagavān brahmā tamamitaujasam,
ayaṁ śreṣṭha iti jñātvā vavande tamumāpatim ॥35॥
13.160.36: tataḥ prasādayāmāsurumāṁ rudraṁ ca te surāḥ,
13.160.37: sa cāpi brāhmaṇo bhūtvā durvāsā nāma vīryavān,
13.160.38: viprakārān prayuṅkte sma subahūn mama veśmani,
13.160.39: sa vai rudraḥ sa ca śivaḥ so’gniḥ sarvaḥ sa sarvajit,
sa caivendraśca vāyuśca so’śvinau sa ca vidyutaḥ ॥39॥
13.160.40: sa candramāḥ sa ceśānaḥ sa sūryo varuṇaśca saḥ,
sa kālaḥ so’ntako mr̥tyuḥ sa yamo rātryahāni ca ॥40॥
13.160.41: sa dhātā sa vidhātā ca viśvakarmā sa sarvavit ॥41॥
13.160.43: ekadhā ca dvidhā caiva bahudhā ca sa eva hi,
13.160.44: na hi śakyā guṇā vaktumapi varṣaśatairapi ॥44॥
13.160.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate anuśāsanaparvaṇi dānadharmaparvaṇi īśvarapraśaṁsā nāma ṣaṣṭyadhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥160॥
13.161.2: ekākṣaṁ tryambakaṁ caiva viśvarūpaṁ śivaṁ tathā ॥2॥
13.161.3: dve tanū tasya devasya vedajñā brāhmaṇā viduḥ,
ghorāmanyāṁ śivāmanyāṁ te tanū bahudhā punaḥ ॥3॥
13.161.4: ugrā ghorā tanuryāsya so’gnirvidyut sa bhāskaraḥ,
śivā saumyā ca yā tvasya dharmastvāpo’tha candramāḥ ॥4॥
13.161.8: devānāṁ sumahān yacca yaccāsya viṣayo mahān,
yacca viśvaṁ mahat pāti mahādevastataḥ smr̥taḥ ॥8॥
13.161.10: dahatyūrdhvaṁ sthito yacca prāṇān tr̥̄ṇāṁ sthiraśca yat ॥10॥
13.161.11: yadasya bahudhā rūpaṁ bhūtaṁ bhavyaṁ bhavattathā ॥11॥
13.161.14: sarvathā yat paśūn pāti taiśca yad ramate saha,
13.161.16: vigrahaṁ pūjayed yo vai liṅgaṁ vāpi mahātmanaḥ,
13.161.19: eṣa eva śmaśāneṣu devo vasati nirdahan,
13.161.21: tasya ghorāṇi rūpāṇi dīptāni ca bahūni ca,
13.161.27: sa dadāti manuṣyebhyaḥ sa evākṣipate punaḥ,
13.161.28: sa eva vyāpr̥to nityaṁ trailokyasya śubhāśubhe,
13.161.29: tasya devasya yad vaktraṁ samudre vaḍavāmukham ॥29॥
13.161.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate anuśāsanaparvaṇi dānadharmaparvaṇi maheśvaramāhātmyaṁ nāma ekaṣaṣṭyadhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥161॥
13.162.2: pratyakṣamāgamo veti kiṁ tayoḥ kāraṇaṁ bhavet ॥2॥
13.162.3: nāstyatra saṁśayaḥ kaściditi me vartate matiḥ,
śr̥ṇu vakṣyāmi te prājña samyak tvaṁ me’nupr̥cchasi ॥3॥
13.162.6: atha cenmanyase caikaṁ kāraṇaṁ kiṁ bhavediti ॥6॥
13.162.9: na tveva gamanaṁ rājan hetuto gamanaṁ tathā,
13.162.15: dharma ityeva sambuddhāstānupāsva ca pr̥ccha ca ॥15॥
13.162.16: na teṣāṁ bhidyate vr̥ttaṁ yajñāḥ svādhyāyakarma ca,
13.162.17: punareva hi me buddhiḥ saṁśaye parimuhyati,
13.162.20: eka eveti jānīhi tridhā dharmasya darśanam,
pr̥thaktve ca na me buddhistrayāṇāmapi vai tathā ॥20॥
13.162.21: jijñāsā na tu kartavyā dharmasya paritarkaṇāt ॥21॥
13.162.22: andho jaḍa ivāśaṅkī yad bravīmi tadācara ॥22॥
13.162.25: na sa pramāṇatāmarho vivādajanano hi saḥ ॥25॥
13.162.26: eteṣveva tvime lokāḥ kr̥tsnā iti nibodha tān ॥26॥
13.162.27: ye ca dharmamasūyante ye cainaṁ paryupāsate,
bravītu me bhavānetat kva te gacchanti tādr̥śāḥ ॥27॥
13.162.29: ye tu dharmaṁ mahārāja satataṁ paryupāsate,
13.162.31: manuṣyā yadi vā devāḥ śarīramupatāpya vai,
13.162.33: asatāṁ kīdr̥śaṁ rūpaṁ sādhavaḥ kiṁ ca kurvate,
13.162.35: rājamārge gavāṁ madhye dhānyamadhye ca dharmiṇaḥ,
13.162.36: na jalpanti ca bhuñjānā na nidrāntyārdrapāṇayaḥ ॥36॥
13.162.37: brāhmaṇaṁ dhārmikaṁ vr̥ddhaṁ ye kurvanti pradakṣiṇam ॥37॥
13.162.38: brāhmaṇānāṁ gavāṁ rājñāṁ panthānaṁ dadate ca ye ॥38॥
13.162.39: atithīnāṁ ca sarveṣāṁ preṣyāṇāṁ svajanasya ca,
13.162.42: nānyadā gacchate yastu brahmacaryaṁ ca tat smr̥tam,
13.162.43: karma vai saphalaṁ kr̥tvā gurūṇāṁ pratipādayet ॥43॥
13.162.46: na nagnāmīkṣate nārīṁ na nagnān puruṣānapi,
13.162.47: darśanānāṁ paraṁ jñānaṁ santoṣaḥ paramaṁ sukham ॥47॥
13.162.48: sāyaṁ prātaśca vr̥ddhānāṁ śr̥ṇuyāt puṣkalā giraḥ,
13.162.50: saṁskr̥taṁ pāyasaṁ nityaṁ yavāgūṁ kr̥saraṁ haviḥ,
13.162.52: tvaṅkāro vā vadho veti vidvatsu na viśiṣyate ॥52॥
13.162.55: na māṁ manuṣyāḥ paśyanti na māṁ paśyanti devatāḥ,
13.162.58: tasmāt pāpaṁ na gūheta gūhamānaṁ vivardhayet,
kr̥tvā tat sādhuṣvākhyeyaṁ te tat praśamayantyuta ॥58॥
13.162.59: anye caitat prapadyante viyoge tasya dehinaḥ ॥59॥
13.162.61: eka eva cared dharmaṁ na dharmadhvajiko bhavet,
13.162.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate anuśāsanaparvaṇi dānadharmaparvaṇi dharmapramāṇakathane dviṣaṣṭyadhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥162॥
13.163.4: yadi yatno bhavenmartyaḥ sa sarvaṁ phalamāpnuyāt,
13.163.9: yathā pipāsāṁ jayati puruṣaḥ prāpya vai jalam ॥9॥
13.163.10: iṣṭārtho vidyayā hyeva na vidyāṁ prajahennaraḥ,
13.163.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate anuśāsanaparvaṇi dānadharmaparvaṇi dharmapraśaṁsāyāṁ triṣaṣṭyadhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥163॥
13.164.8: kāryāvetau hi dharmeṇa dharmo hi vijayāvahaḥ,
13.164.9: na tu kaścinnayet prājño gr̥hītvaiva kare naram,
13.164.12: lokadharme ca dharme ca viśeṣakaraṇaṁ kr̥tam,
13.164.13: adhruvo hi kathaṁ lokaḥ smr̥to dharmaḥ kathaṁ dhruvaḥ,
yatra kālo dhruvastāta tatra dharmaḥ sanātanaḥ ॥13॥
13.164.14: kālo dharmeṇa saṁyuktaḥ śeṣa eva svayaṁ guruḥ ॥14॥
13.164.15: evaṁ sati na doṣo’sti bhūtānāṁ dharmasevane,
tiryagyonāvapi satāṁ loka eva mato guruḥ ॥15॥
13.164.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate anuśāsanaparvaṇi dānadharmaparvaṇi dharmapraśaṁsāyāṁ catuḥṣaṣṭyadhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥164॥
13.165.2: kiṁ śreyaḥ puruṣasyeha kiṁ kurvan sukhamedhate,
vipāpmā sa bhavet kena kiṁ vā kalmaṣanāśanam ॥2॥
13.165.6: mucyate sarvapāpebhyaḥ kīrtayan vai śuciḥ sadā,
nāndho na badhiraḥ kāle kurute svastimān sadā ॥6॥
13.165.7: tiryagyoniṁ na gacchecca narakaṁ saṅkarāṇi ca,
na ca duḥkhabhayaṁ tasya maraṇe sa na muhyati ॥7॥
13.165.11: varuṇaḥ saha gauryā ca saha r̥ddhyā dhaneśvaraḥ ॥11॥
13.165.15: viśvācī ca ghr̥tācī ca pañcacūḍā tilottamā ॥15॥
13.165.16: ādityā vasavo rudrāḥ sāśvinaḥ pitaro’pi ca,
dharmaḥ śrutaṁ tapo dīkṣā vyavasāyaḥ pitāmahaḥ ॥16॥
13.165.19: sindhuśca devikā caiva prabhāsaṁ puṣkarāṇi ca ॥19॥
13.165.20: gaṅgā mahānadī veṇā kāverī narmadā tathā,
13.165.22: godāvarī ca veṇyā ca kr̥ṣṇaveṇā tathādrijā,
13.165.23: prayāgaṁ ca prabhāsaṁ ca puṇyaṁ naimiṣameva ca,
13.165.25: hiraṇvatī vitastā ca tathā plakṣavatī nadī,
13.165.27: carmaṇvatī nadī puṇyā kauśikī yamunā tathā,
nadī bhīmarathī caiva bāhudā ca mahānadī ॥27॥
13.165.34: pāntu naḥ satataṁ devāḥ kīrtitā’kīrtitā mayā ॥34॥
13.165.41: paścimāṁ diśamāśritya ya edhante nibodha tān,
13.165.43: atreḥ putraśca dharmātmā tathā sārasvataḥ prabhuḥ,
uttarāṁ diśamāśritya ya edhante nibodha tān ॥43॥
13.165.46: devaśarmā ca dhaumyaśca hastikāśyapa eva ca,
13.165.62: mā vighnaṁ mā ca me pāpaṁ mā ca me paripanthinaḥ,
dhruvo jayo me nityaḥ syāt paratra ca śubhā gatiḥ ॥62॥
13.165.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate anuśāsanaparvaṇi dānadharmaparvaṇi vaṁśānukīrtanaṁ nāma pañcaṣaṣṭyadhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥165॥
13.166.7: upāste tvāṁ naravyāghra saha kr̥ṣṇena dhīmatā,
13.166.9: uvāca cainaṁ madhuraṁ nr̥paṁ śāntanavo nr̥paḥ,
praviśasva purīṁ rājan vyetu te mānaso jvaraḥ ॥9॥
13.166.11: śreyasā yokṣyase caiva vyetu te mānaso jvaraḥ ॥11॥
13.166.13: anu tvāṁ tāta jīvantu mitrāṇi suhr̥dastathā,
13.166.14: āgantavyaṁ ca bhavatā samaye mama pārthiva,
13.166.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate anuśāsanaparvaṇi dānadharmaparvaṇi bhīṣmānujñāyāṁ ṣaṭṣaṣṭyadhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥166॥
13.167.7: ghr̥taṁ mālyaṁ ca gandhāṁśca kṣaumāṇi ca yudhiṣṭhiraḥ,
13.167.8: mālyāni ca varārhāṇi ratnāni vividhāni ca ॥8॥
13.167.9: mātaraṁ ca pr̥thāṁ dhīmān bhrātr̥̄ṁśca puruṣarṣabhān ॥9॥
13.167.10: yuyutsunā ca kauravyo yuyudhānena vā vibho ॥10॥
13.167.19: śr̥ṇoṣi cenmahābāho brūhi kiṁ karavāṇi te ॥19॥
13.167.23: yacceha kiñcit kartavyaṁ tatsarvaṁ prāpitaṁ mayā,
yathoktaṁ bhavatā kāle sarvameva ca tat kr̥tam ॥23॥
13.167.24: dadarśa bhāratān sarvān sthitān samparivārya ha ॥24॥
13.167.25: tataśca taṁ balī bhīṣmaḥ pragr̥hya vipulaṁ bhujam,
13.167.30: bahuśrutā hi te viprā bahavaḥ paryupāsitāḥ ॥30॥
13.167.32: na śocitavyaṁ kauravya bhavitavyaṁ hi tat tathā,
13.167.33: yathā pāṇḍoḥ sutā rājaṁstathaiva tava dharmataḥ,
tān pālaya sthito dharme guruśuśrūṣaṇe ratān ॥33॥
13.167.34: dharmarājo hi śuddhātmā nideśe sthāsyate tava,
13.167.40: rakṣyāśca te pāṇḍaveyā bhavān yeṣāṁ parāyaṇam,
13.167.42: sandhānasya paraḥ kālastaveti ca punaḥ punaḥ,
na ca me tad vaco mūḍhaḥ kr̥tavān sa sumandadhīḥ,
ghātayitveha pr̥thivīṁ tataḥ sa nidhanaṁ gataḥ ॥42॥
13.167.44: tathā me nāradaḥ prāha vyāsaśca sumahātapāḥ,
13.167.45: sa māṁ tvamanujānīhi kr̥ṣṇa mokṣye kalevaram,
13.167.46: anujānāmi bhīṣma tvāṁ vasūn prāpnuhi pārthiva,
13.167.47: tena mr̥tyustava vaśe sthito bhr̥tya ivānataḥ ॥47॥
13.167.49: satyeṣu yatitavyaṁ vaḥ satyaṁ hi paramaṁ balam ॥49॥
13.167.51: ityuktvā suhr̥daḥ sarvān sampariṣvajya caiva ha,
13.167.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate anuśāsanaparvaṇi bhīṣmasvargārohaṇaparvaṇi dānadharme saptaṣaṣṭyadhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥167॥
13.168.4: tat tad viśalyaṁ bhavati yogayuktasya tasya vai ॥4॥
13.168.5: kṣaṇena prekṣatāṁ teṣāṁ viśalyaḥ so’bhavat tadā,
13.168.21: vidhivat kṣatriyaśreṣṭhāḥ sa ca sarvo janastadā,
13.168.24: jāmadagnyena rāmeṇa yaḥ purā na parājitaḥ ॥24॥
13.168.26: apaśyantyāḥ priyaṁ putraṁ yanna dīryati me’dya vai,
13.168.27: yasya nāsti bale tulyaḥ pr̥thivyāmapi kaścana ॥27॥
13.168.28: hataṁ śikhaṇḍinā śrutvā na vidīryeta yanmanaḥ,
13.168.30: samāśvasihi bhadre tvaṁ mā śucaḥ śubhadarśane ॥30॥
13.168.31: gataḥ sa paramaṁ lokaṁ tava putro na saṁśayaḥ,
13.168.34: na śaktaḥ saṁyuge hantuṁ sākṣādapi śatakratuḥ,
13.168.35: na śaktā vinihantuṁ hi raṇe taṁ sarvadevatāḥ,
vasūneṣa gato devi putraste vijvarā bhava ॥35॥
13.168.36: ityuktā sā tu kr̥ṣṇena vyāsena tu saridvarā,
tyaktvā śokaṁ mahārāja svaṁ vāryavatatāra ha ॥36॥
13.168.37: satkr̥tya te tāṁ saritaṁ tataḥ kr̥ṣṇamukhā nr̥pa,
13.168.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate śatasāhasryāṁ saṁhitāyāṁ vaiyāsikyāmanuśāsanaparvaṇi bhīṣmasvargārohaṇaparvaṇi dānadharme bhīṣmayudhiṣṭhirasaṁvāde bhīṣmamuktirnāmāṣṭaṣaṣṭyadhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥168॥
